author: Edward H
title: Amazing experience on the edge of Little Italy and Chinatown
text: My family and I stayed in this hotel for 8 nights in August 2026, and we had a fabulous time here. The hotel was in a great location next to Manhattan Bridge, the room was fantastic with unbelievable views uptown (we recommend a city view as high up as possible instead of a bridge view), and the staff were amazing and couldn't have done more for us during our stay. We also enjoyed the rooftop bar on a couple of evenings. All in all I would recommend this hotel 100% to all prospective visitors.

author: jjab123 - Jim N
title: Another Great Stay at Hotel 50 Bowery
text:
We had another great stay at Hotel 50 Bowery. The service was excellent from check-in through the end of our stay. Kim from the bell staff was very helpful, and Steven and Jordan at the front desk were outstanding. Our housekeeper also did a wonderful job, although unfortunately I did not get her name.

We had a couple of small issues with the room safe and phone, but the staff responded quickly and took care of everything right away. The hotel is also in a very convenient Chinatown location. We always enjoy staying here and look forward to coming back again.

author: Boris P
title: Great Place to Stay!
text: The location was great, the room was clean and spacious and the staff was very accommodating! We really enjoyed our stay!

author: afsafs
title: Traffic Noise - Room at Front of Building
text: Avoid rooms facing the front of the hotel. The traffic noise made it very difficult to sleep. I wish I had paid more attention to the noise levels prior to booking. The hotel would be a great option in NYC (large clean rooms) but for the excessive traffic noise.

author: Laura H
title: All this and a terrace too!
text:
We recently stayed here for 4 nights, and we loved our visit!

Location:
I don't usually stay this far downtown, but we had a party to go to in the area.  It worked out beautifully.  We walked almost everywhere we wanted to go, and train stops were nearby.  

Atmosphere:
The hotel was busy but not crowded, and there were visitors from many different places.  The vibe was relaxed and welcoming.  And we very much appreciated getting water in bottles that were metal, not plastic!

Room:
Wow, much roomier than I expected!  We were in room 812.  Our view was directly onto the Manhattan Bridge entrance, and it was gorgeous.  We had enough space to navigate without bumping into each other.  Good closet with a few little drawers. although not much else in the way of drawer space.  The bed was comfortable, or as much as it ever is for us (we have a very firm mattress at home).  

The bathroom was spacious and I liked having both the rain shower head and the one I could pick up and direct at smaller areas of my body.  I'm glad to see hotels switching to bottles of body wash and so forth, but we're always happy to get hand soap too.  I'd say the bath towels were on the skimpy side, though.

There were enough outlets for our devices, and I really appreciate having a table with drawers next to the bed.  We used the fridge mostly to keep drinks cold.  

Value:
We booked far enough in advance that we were able to get rooms in the $300 a night range, including taxes.  It was a real deal.  

Cleanliness
I always appreciate a hotel that has a recycle bin along with regular trash.  All of the spaces I saw, inside and out, were clean and well maintained.  

Noise level:
We found it to be quite livable.  Nights were fairly quiet given the location, and even in the day, the room kept out most of the street noise.  

Service:
The staff were all helpful and informative.  We interacted most with the breakfast crew, and I want to give special praise to John and the rest of the folks for the warm, welcoming, helpful experience we had with them.  They provided a filling, affordable meal and scrambled eggs to the perfect amount of dryness for my husband.  The fruit cup was generous and a work of art.  They let me hang out for as long as I wanted to and invited me to enjoy the terrace when I was finished with breakfast.  They were just charming and I miss them already!

We didn't have dinner in the restaurant.  But one afternoon, I went up to buy a glass of ginger ale for my husband, who was feeling a little off.  The bartender kindly gave me an icy cold glass and wouldn't let me pay for it.  Nowadays, acts of kindness like hers are in short supply, so many thanks to her!

The 2nd floor terrace was an extraordinary luxury in an NYC hotel.  We spent some time there every day enjoying the view and the sounds of the city.  

The only thing we didn't like was that the elevators are all very dark inside.  Seems like a strange choice for the hotel to make.  But that was a tiny detail in a stay that more than exceeded our expectations.  Looking forward to returning!

author: AMV
title: No Amenities or Service / Great Location & Roof
text: This hotel has pros and cons. It could be a good hotel choice if you are ok with the cons. Cons - -After closing the door to our room we discovered that it was unlocked for several minutes before automatically locking. This is a security flaw which we discovered. We waited in the hall until we heard the door lock before leaving. -One tiny quart sized ice maker on a counter in a common area for the entire hotel. This was always empty. -No room service, nobody will come to clean the room or pick up old towels. This is weird because in the room there is a sign that says to put towels on the floor if you want them replaced. -Upon check in, nobody was at the front desk and the front door was locked. It was check in time, but we were stuck on the street. -Front desk was unattended about 25% of the time. -Coffee maker amenities - there was no milk or sugar, just sacks of coffee for the maker -TV Channels were limited, very hard to get even local news for the Today Show which is filmed in NY -Noise, there is a club next door and a food truck that comes each night and people on the street are extremely loud which you can hear from the room. Pros- -This is one of the cheapest hotels that offers a rooftop viewing area. -Rooftop viewing was good for seeing the fireworks on the 4th which is what we wanted. -Room was clean upon check in and the bed was comfortable. -Good location, lots of restaurants and stores in the area.

everything is good here...

author: Wredcedar
title: Worst room ever, and I have travelled all but 2 continents in my 73 years.
text: I don’t ever write negative reviews but the incredibly bad experience we just had at The Ridge demands that I spare other tourists the nightmare.  I checked in early and left our bags at front desk.  Returned at normal check in time and our bags were waiting for us in the tiniest room, adjacent to the entry lobby and side exterior exit door, which also housed a coffee machine for every guest to bang around as they gossiped outside the door to our room.   Every guest returning to hotel into the wee hours, and every guest checking out in the early morning had no idea that our room was right there, around the corner.  Had they known, I trust that some effort might have been made to moderate their festive volume.   My disappointment is that I was not informed in advance of this nightmare of claustrophobia, and as I mentioned, I arrived 3 hours before check in, so I definitely was not the last guest checking in.   Never again.   Spare yourself a similar experience.

author: Odyssey213722
title: Don't do it............
text:
I passed by the hotel and there were junkies on the stoop. 
I would not feel safe staying here solo.
 There is no attendant. 
I canceled 2 days in advance and was still charged for the room.

author: Taylor B
title: The WORST hotel experience I have ever had
text:
The WORST hotel experience I have ever had. The Ridge hotel is an absolute scam. I booked and paid for a king-sized room, and after traveling 12 hours, they overbooked and tried to sneak me into a tiny, filthy double room without saying a word. The room was so cramped you could barely walk around the bed, it was dirty, and it looked nothing like the photos advertised. When I confronted the front desk that it clearly wasn’t the King room we purchased, they admitted the lie and promised a refund. We had no choice but to accept the tiny room, or sleep on the street. I showed them grace and trusted that the refund (at least for the difference in rooms) would come, but it didn’t.
For almost two months, the owner dodged my calls and refused to take responsibility. I was finally forced to go through Expedia just to claw back a partial refund, because the hotel itself did absolutely nothing.
This was no more than a bait and switch scam. The Ridge Hotel is dishonest, dirty, and run by people who have no respect for their guests. 
Shout out to Jasmine at the front desk who at least tried to be helpful.  Stay literally anywhere else <3

author: Wayne M
title: Avoid annexe rooms!!
text: The hotel needs to be more honest about the condition and environment of rooms in the annexe building. It’s a building site, habitable rooms only on floor 5, and they are of a basic standard with works incomplete in the rooms. Floors 0-4 are a building site, we had to navigate pallets of building materials to access and egress the building, stairs were blocked due to scaffolding, with an antiquated lift holding only 2 persons service the habitable floor. If the lift breaks down you’re knackered, how they get a certificate to confirm the building is safe and meets the standards is beyond me. If you intend booking this hotel establish beyond doubt if you’re in main hotel or annexe, if the annexe, I would encourage you to find elsewhere as it is a pretty poor offer at present.

author: Lynsey C
title: Fantastic hotel, great location!
text:
Don't be alarmed by the negative reviews on here. We have just returned from a 3 night stay (July 2026) and the hotel was perfect. Location could not be better. Both Aircon and WiFi were really strong. The hotel staff were great, we forgot our travel adaptors and they provided us with 2, we also required an iron and strong hairdryer and both were brought to our room in minutes.
Our room was lovely, no sign of wear and tear, nice and modern, comfortable bed and we even had a small balcony and great views from the 5th floor 
The rooftop bar is a nice touch but the jacuzzi did look like it needed cleaning but we weren't really interested in this feature.
The breakfast was average, like any European hotel, it was sufficient for what you needed.
Overall we were extremely pleased with the hotel and if we went back to Rome we would almost certainly stay here again, location and value for money were fantastic.

author: Paris S
title: DO NOT GO! WARNING! STAY AWAY!!!

author: Shannon
title: Worst Experience!
text:
Without a doubt, this was the worst hotel experience I’ve ever had.

The biggest issue was the room itself. The air conditioning unit was leaking continuously onto the floor throughout our stay. It wasn’t just a few drops—it leaked enough that we had to keep towels on the floor to soak up the water to avoid slipping. This is completely unacceptable for any hotel, let alone one that claims to be a 4-star property.

The room also felt poorly maintained, with visible damage and unfinished repairs. There were holes in the wallpaper where fixtures had clearly been removed, and the overall condition of the room was tired and neglected. The ceiling light fitting was also incomplete, exposing what looked like part of the fixture rather than a properly finished installation.

For the price we paid, I expected a clean, well-maintained room and basic amenities to function properly. Instead, we spent our stay dealing with a leaking air conditioner and a room that felt like it had been patched together rather than properly maintained.

When first checked into hotel too, receptionist went through everything as usual when checking in, also said that we had breakfast included in the stay, so we came down to breakfast the next day and then got told we didn’t have breakfast included, after we basically sat down with our food. When speaking to the manager again he denied saying this. I would have not have gone down to buffet breakfast if he said we didn’t have breakfast included.

The cleaners also cleaned out room every day but one of the days they left our room open all day! we came back and tried to use our key card to find it was already open! anyone could have gone in our room and stolen anything. 

I would not stay here again and would not recommend Hotel 87 to anyone looking for a comfortable stay in Rome. There are far better options available.

author: Jose V
title: DO NOT STAY IF THEY PLACE YOU IN THE ANNEX
text: DO NOT STAY IF THEY PLACE YOU IN THE ANNEX.....Hotel 87 eighty-seven - Maison d'Art Collection is a 4 star, we paid premium prices and were placed in thier annex on the 5th floor, the rest of the building was under construction, the entry way was dusty the walls were marked up, the elevator was full of dust on top and inside. The rooms walls were painted with 2 different paints that didn't matched and looked spotty, the closet light would not turn off and shined all night I had to put a towel to block the light. At 7 in the morning construction workers started to hammer, grind tiles, and throw concrete bags on the floor, that could be heard throughout the building, for 2 days we had to walk down the 5 flights because the were using the elevater to move stuff up and down in the building. I tried 3 times to speak to the manager Fransico and he blow me off till 5 minutes before he went home I explained the issue and he said he spoke to the construction manager and that they would have thier workers would start at 9 am instead of 7 am, he also said to speak to you that he was not going to compensate me for any inconvenience with a I don't care attitude. The next morning construction started again at 7 am, so he basically lied to my face because he knew we were leaving the next morning. That stay was a 1.5 star, I am very disappointed in the experience we had.

author: Paul Q
title: Beautiful building, friendly staff, and a relaxing weeks stay!
text:
Found this hotel for our weeks stay in Rome and happy that we did. 

Arrived before the 3pm check-in time and our room was ready, so we could get freshened up after a day of travelling. We got the train from Fiumicino to Termini, and the hotel was a short 10 minute walk from the station. Tons of cafes, restaurants, gelatarias etc all within a short walking distance of the hotel. Most major sights were about a 30 minute walk away from us here including Trevi Fountain, Colloseum, Roman Forum, Pantheon etc. 

The room was ample in size, with a large blackout glass bathroom, equipped with shower, toilet, bidet, sink & amenties. Beds were comfy enough, no duvets provided, just a sheet and a blanket which is more than enough in the summer heat. The room is fully air conditioned, all controlled by the dial on the wall, as our all the lights in the room. We would have loved an extra pillow each, but it is a small preference. There is a mini bar in the room, all items individually priced on the card inside. Room was refreshed daily, and the only negative on this was although there is a sign in the bathroom stating the company try being environmentally friendly and don't wash towels everyday unless left on the sink, they would still wash them even when they weren't place on the sink. We had a small issue with our sink, but maintenance were in quickly to resolve it and did so very quickly and politely. 

Staff were friendly throughout our stay, always happy to help answer questions, and the service at breakfast was efficient and tables turned and cleaned quickly enough when it got busier. 

The pool was a great highlight! After or before busy days out in the scorching heat, it was great to get into the pool and refresh and cool down. There is a lovely upper terrace outside with cuddle sofas, and more sunloungers, so plenty of space to chill or suntan. Towels are available at reception, so just ask before you head out. Beds by the poolside fill up fast, but if you are fortunate you can grab one. I would have liked to have seen staff keeping an eye on the pool, as signs up to state no diving etc, but there were children constantly running, diving, wrestling on the pool edge, and being a little dangerous around other people, but nobody was there monitoring it. 

The food was good too. We ate at varying times of day, as breakfast was included. Breakfast had a good amount of options, and was good enough to set us up for the busy days we had planned. 

One added feature was the lobby. It was a beautiful setting to relax after a busy day, with a quiet drink, and some lovely piano playing every night. Was so comfortable, and honestly was such a nice way to end our days. 

Definitely recommend this hotel to anyone happy to stay a little further away from the sights. We would love to return to this beautiful hotel one day!! Thanks to all the team for a comfortable stay

author: Juan Carlos M
title: The Building Hotel in Rome was extremely disappointing
text:
A room in a state totally unworthy of what we expected

Our experience at The Building Hotel in Rome was extremely disappointing, mainly due to the state of cleanliness and maintenance of our room.

As soon as we settled in, we noticed numerous problems, which we took care to photograph.

The carpet was covered with numerous stains and dark marks. The wall coverings were also very stained, with large water marks, various traces, and even a torn section revealing the material behind it.

The bathroom was in an equally concerning state: shower drain heavily clogged and deteriorated, deposits around the metal elements, dirty and degraded shower seals and rails, damaged finishes, as well as very marked and worn faucets.

Even more concerning, we found and photographed a small arthropod on the bedroom carpet. We also discovered an item of undetermined origin stuck directly into a seam of the mattress. We do not claim to identify these items with certainty, but their presence, added to the general state of the room, seriously worried us regarding the level of hygiene and cleaning.

It is therefore not, in our opinion, a simple aesthetic defect or a few normal signs of wear. It is the accumulation of problems—heavily stained carpet, dirty and damaged walls, dirty and deteriorated bathroom, as well as the discovery of an arthropod in the room—that made this experience particularly unpleasant.

The photos attached to this review show the state in which we found the room and will allow everyone to form their own opinion.

For an establishment of this category, we expected a very different level of cleanliness, maintenance, and comfort.

An unfortunately very disappointing experience that we do not wish to repeat.

author: Gazza1267
title: It was a ideal location. Close to metroand other transport
text:
Just returned this week. Had a great stay here. Good location to train station but used the metro to see the historical sites. Pool was adequate for a cool dip for its size. I found staff ok with me and helpful. Rooms adequate for our stay. Order another pillow due to only one each. Room cleaned daily with new towels. Air con was adjustable using the panel. 
Close to local restaurants. Buses are packed and over crowded use metro 10 min walk. Breakfast was OK. Can order a special coffee at breakfast.
Had lunch here and felt it was good value. Additional cost for the Spa at e25  for two hours not used.Hotel tax extra cost. A great terrace with sunbeds to relax. Nothing really to moan about as it did what we wanted

author: Mark E
title: Not a bad choice at all
text:
I thought the Building Hotel was good overall. Staff were polite and accommodating. We had issues with the air con, so we had a mobile unit for 1 night delivered promptly, and moved rooms the next day. Breakfast was okay overall and had a good range of food availible.
Short walk to the Metro and in a nice, quiet location with a local shop and restaurants 1-2 minutes away. 
Overall, I would stay again.

author: Meander39089686170
title: AVOID AT ALL COSTS!
text: The palace is impressive, certainly, but for a week at 1300 euros, pathetic services! Neglected cleaning, for a 4-star hotel, sink and shower not cleaned, toiletries (shower gel, body lotion and soaps, toilet paper, etc.) not restocked (not to mention the bouquet of flowers as announced in the listing), bedding changed once in a week instead of daily and even then, one sheet out of two without pillowcases, the terrace with garden furniture cushions without covers, the breakfast could not be more basic with an undrinkable Americano coffee served in a thermos (knowing that at the reception, we were told that we could ask for a cappuccino, espresso and others included in the price but no one is aware, you just have to ask the question). And the staff is haughty. On the last day, at 5 a.m., I was asked for 45 euros in taxes even though I had paid 105 euros for them upon my arrival; fortunately I had kept the proof, otherwise I would have missed my flight. And since I was leaving early and had paid for my breakfast, I asked for a breakfast to go; they provided it, but I threw it all away, as it had spent the night outside. Anyway! A total scam! A sucker trap! Fortunately, Rome is full of treasures (the Basilica of Saint Mary Major, the beach, the Basilica of Saint Paul, the Colosseum, etc.).

author: Joan C
title: Wonderful stay in Le Marais!
text: My husband and I love the Le Marais neighborhood and Assia & Nathalie were the very best! So welcoming, so warm and helpful and the room was wonderful! The location was perfect for us as we went all over the city.  The accommodations were excellent and the breakfasts were delightful!

author: Suzanne D
title: A Perfect Stay in Paris with Exceptional Hosts
text: We just returned from an amazing trip to Paris and couldn’t have asked for a better stay. We were guests at a lovely bed and breakfast hosted by Assia and Natalie, who truly made our experience exceptional. From the moment we arrived, we felt warmly welcomed and completely at home. Everything we needed was thoughtfully provided, the breakfast each morning was wonderful, and the room was spacious, spotless, and very comfortable. We highly recommend staying here!

author: Travel4aWalk
title: 4th time staying, it's the best!
text: This was my 4th time staying at Assia et Nathalie's and again, it was perfect.  For me I am no longer just staying at a luxury B&B, I am also staying with friends.  The warm welcome, the conversations, the comfortable and safe space to stay, and the fantastic breakfasts...amazing!  I truly cannot say enough good things about staying at Assia et Nathalie's.  I wholeheartedly recommend staying here, I know I will be back.

author: lapetitefemme80
title: Well-housed, Well-nourished, Well-guided
text:
We searched high and low on Trip Advisor for a clean and comfy B&B in a safe and quiet neighborhood for our 5-night stay. Assia et Nathalie near Place des Vosges in Le Marais ticked all the boxes. We truly appreciated the preserved charm of the gated historic residential building with modern conveniences like an elevator, updated plumbing, and motorized window shutters. 

Since our time in the City of Light was abbreviated, we packed our itinerary. It was important to start our day well-fueled. Every morning, we enjoyed a delicious and filling breakfast, consuming freshly baked goods, a variety of tasty meats and cheeses, and an assortment of succulent fruit. Every night, we returned to the guesthouse 21:00-22:00, washed the day off in our well-appointed bathroom stocked with posh toiletries and plush towels. We slept like babies in the cloud-like, yet supportive bed. A perfect setting for much needed restorative sleep after sightseeing all day.

From the moment we stepped into the B&B, we felt at home not just because of the beautiful décor & design, and attention to detail, but also because of the genuine care and hospitality of Assia and Nathalie. They are kind and generous. Assia answered every email inquiry promptly. She informed us of the flat rate taxi fare to and from CDG; gave us accurate directions and suggestions on the quickest and most economical way to our destinations (by bus, by subway, by train); loaned us multiple local maps and museum guides; offered to make restaurant reservations… personalized assistance right there! 

We loved our time in Paris, taking in all the sights and sounds and calling Assia et Nathalie our temporary home as we were well-housed, well-nourished, and well-guided.

author: bob
title: Haven of peace in the center of Marais
text: Fabulous welcome, good advice, nice quiet room in a haven of peace in the middle of the Marais district. Good bedding and beautiful bathroom. 10 out of 10.

author: Nos gusta viaja... V
title: I recommend it
text: Very good hotel near the bridge, friendly, everything clean and a big bed, we recommend it

author: Trinh D
title: Recommended
text:
Great location. Helpful, friendly staff. 
Great view if you stay at the Tower view room - definitely choose this room if you stay here. I spent 5 days waking up with the tower on my left, amazing view!
One thing to note - I would like the room to be cleaned more thoroughly. At the end of each day when I enter the room, I notice a lot of fine dust on the TV, table and the shelving unit.

author: Annika R
title: Fantastic, I will return
text: Excellent, kind, and super helpful staff

author: Vincenzo maria D
title: Top experience
text:
Hotel located in an excellent position (near the Tower Hill underground station), this alone would be enough to make it excellent, let's add that the king superior rooms by London standards are truly very spacious and offer a spectacular view without even having to pay an extra charge. 
Very easygoing staff, there are also some Italians present who can help in case you don't know the language well. 
The surrounding area is also very quiet and patrolled, you are close to the Shard and Tower Bridge which are 2 fundamental points to visit in London.
For our 6-day and 5-night vacation it was perfect and above all not too expensive, I highly recommend it.

author: Sean H
title: Waste your ENTIRE TRIP waiting for elevators!
text:
The elevator situation at citizenM Tower of London is beyond unacceptable. There are four elevators, yet two are permanently blocked off for “priority service.” When I asked what that meant, I was told they were reserved for staff and housekeeping.
So guests are left fighting over just two elevators in a hotel of this size, while housekeeping still uses the guest elevators anyway. What exactly is the point of reserving half the elevators for staff if staff are also filling the only two available to paying guests?
The result is total dysfunction. The elevators stop at practically every floor going up and every floor coming down. They are so overcrowded that guests trying to leave with luggage cannot even get into an elevator travelling downward. I watched a woman on the second floor take the elevator all the way up to the eighth floor just so she could stay inside and ride it back down to the lobby. That is how absurd this situation is.
Guests are trying to reach taxis and Ubers, dragging luggage through packed elevators, while the staff appear completely indifferent. No urgency, no apology, no attempt to manage the situation—just a shrug while paying guests waste their time.
For a hotel of this size to dedicate half its elevator capacity to staff while guests are effectively trapped on their floors is appalling. This is not a small inconvenience or a busy moment. It is a glaring operational failure and a complete disregard for the people actually paying to stay here.

author: Owenthomas
title: Friendly staff
text: We had a triple room,  so not much room to move around. Beds were comfortable and room was quiet. Nice sized bathroom. With soap and shampoo. The location is perfect. It is literally just across Euston Road from Kings Cross Station. Room was very warm.

author: Durgesh_Pandey
title: Avoid it if you can!!! Nothing except location
text:

So location is bang on. Can’t be more convenient other than that, oh it’s a nightmare.

All rooms (I had my friend staying in different floor) stinking of sewer.

Basin was clogged. Oh it was very bad.

author: Philippe G
title: Avoid, too expensive for the service.
text: Well-located hotel, friendly receptionist, but those are the only positive points. No hot water, very noisy room, refrigerator containing leftover food, not even a stick of instant coffee in the room...

Horrible expérience.

author: Jeff D
title: Just ok
text:
Picked this location to have a room with AC, a bathroom, and an elevator for my 46-year-old disabled wife.  Were frequent travelers and know the Europe typical hotel room, so we knew what to expect.  Unfortunately, yes there is an elevator, but you must go up stair to get to it. Then up or down more stairs to get to our room. This was bummer but we made it work. 

The room was about 13X13 feet total. Not that unusual for Europe standards, we understand.  The two twin beds were in horrible shape and very uncomfortable. The AC did not actually blow cold air. You were not able to adjust it and it blew maybe 80 deg. air all day.  By 9 AM, the room was miserable. Again, Europe does not like AC like the West likes. The bathroom was small but it worked out fine.  

The room was so small there is no room to open a bag that's not on the bed. It was very hot, and the beds were a joke. The only positive was it had a bathroom. 

The location is right across from the train station and was good if that's what you need.  Plenty of stuff to do walking distance from this location. Coffee right across the street and tour bus stop a block away. The location was nice, the room was just okay for 1 night. 

We booked it for the elevator, AC, and bathroom. We actually got 1 out of 3 of those.  We won't go back.

author: nath330
title: Cozy cocoon
text:
From 02/21/26 to 02/25/26
We stayed in this magnificent hotel in the month of February. The staff is very kind and smiling. The room was very good, not very big, but functional. The bed is very comfortable and it is possible to raise the bottom of the bed. The breakfast was very good. The hotel is in the center, very close to Termini station.

author: jsali
title: Simple, clean hotel
text: Simple but very locally situated hotel! It is very clean and has great, ALWAYS helpful staff. Our personal highlight was the bed, where the legs and head were adjustable and it possessed a massage function.

author: CocoNS
title: Great place to stay!
text: We enjoyed our stay here, the room was larger than we expected for Rome. The room was comfortable and clean, AC and water pressure were excellent. The bed was extremely comfortable. Front desk was helpful. We did not eat breakfast here but it was available.

author: Stefan
title: Clean and central
text:
Simple, clean hotel. Rooms are relatively small and have seen better days. Nevertheless, the hotel is a good starting point for discovering Rome.
However, a 4-star rating is nonsense.

author: ひろ44
title: Hotels within walking distance of Termini Station
text:
It is within walking distance of Termini Station.
I got one because there was a map of the city of Rome by the front desk.
It also provides information on the two-story sightseeing bus and other services.
There are two elevators, one of which is located on a stepped surface, making it inconvenient to roll suitcases.
The room is beautiful.
It was inconvenient because there was only one electrical socket in the bathroom and one and two below the room, not around the pillow.
The bed mats seemed to be distinctive, and there were advertising posters in the hotel hallways.
It seems that I was able to recline, but I didn't know how to use it and did something wasteful.
The bathroom has a bathtub, but the partition glass plate is only half the width of the bathtub, so if you are not careful, the bathroom will be flooded.
The surrounding area is also a high-rise hotel, so the view from the windows is not good.
It's close to the station, but it's on a road that's one stop away, so I didn't mind the noise of the cars at all.
Breakfast is on the first floor.

author: Sam S
title: Great value for money
text: We booked a twin & double room for 3 adults staying 2 nights. The hotel was easy to get to from Euston. The reception staff were welcoming upon arrival. The double room was a good size. The twin room was a lot smaller which was disappointing as 2 adults were staying in this room, but for 2 nights it was acceptable & manageable! The location was good as there was a tube stop less than 5 min walk away, with Waterloo being only a 10min walk away. There is a 24hr newsagent next door & a Tesco express less than 5 mins away as well. Overall great stay for the price. Would def recommend & stay again but would make people aware that it sits in a corner with train tracks running down two sides. That being said the trains, whilst frequent, are more like white background noise when inside. Also deliveries happen to the shops underneath so if anyone is a light sleeper then this may wake them up in the early hours of the morning. Another note to be aware of is whilst they have blackout curtains, they still let light in from the top, bottom & sides, so the room is not pitch black. Just something to be aware of if you like it dark! These are things to make people aware of - they did not disrupt our stay at all. I would def consider staying again.

author: Thetickets
title: Would definitely stay again…..
text: Bit of a mix up with rooms to begin with but all staff very polite especially Jaz at breakfast who was so lovely - nothing was too much trouble and always happy. Kieran behind the bar was also very nice as well as the guy on reception who I didn’t manage to get the name of as well as the lady who helped him. 10 mins walk from Waterloo station and 3 mins walk from Southwark station so location was great. So many restaurants and a few pubs nearby so if you didn’t want to venture far is perfect. Would definitely stay here again.

author: Jemma D
title: Perfect for a short family break in London
text: Perfect for a short, budget family stay in London. The room was simple but clean and comfortable. Great for 2 adults and 2 children (12 & 8). Despite having a train line right next to it, it was quiet and we had no disruptions during our stay. In regards to location, we were a 10 minute walk from Waterloo in one direction and 10 minutes from Blackfriars in the other. The nearest underground was 2 minutes away and on the Jubilee Line. We could get anywhere we needed to be easily and quickly. Staff helpful & friendly. Will definitely be using again in the future.

author: Phoebe N
title: Great Stay
text: Had a great stay, everything was perfect, Thank you!

author: Richard B
title: Weekend stay
text: Nathan was especially helpful wi try all our requests. Rhianna was also helpful when planning our day. Highly recommend.

author: Dutkiewicz F
title: Great location!
text: Highly reconmend this hotel. Location is amazing and so is the staff! Our family trip to the big apple was so memorable and Luma was a big part of that.

author: Antoni18
title: Fantastic choice.
text: Excellent location, comfortable hotel, fast check-in and check-out.

author: Mario G
title: A wonderful stay at the Luma in the middle of Times Square.
text: The rooms are not the largest, but it is sufficient and for that you have a top location right at Times Square. The beds were very comfortable and with 2 adults and 2 children, the queen-size were completely fine. The breakfast was very good by American standards and very pleasant for us with kids. Anyone traveling alone naturally prefers to use the many breakfast offers in the city ;-).

author: julie w
title: Loved our Stay!!
text: Stayed at the Luma Hotel for a week for a girls trip. Great staff!! Loved our time there!

author: Shahliza J
title: Most modern hotel in New York with a robot!
text: Stayed at LUMA Hotel Times Square with the family and it exceeded expectations in every way. The suite was spacious and modern, with a proper kitchenette that made life easier having two kids with us, and the location right by Times Square meant everything was within walking distance. The standout moment of the whole trip, though, was ALINA, the hotel's robot butler, who arrived at our door completely unannounced with an activity pack for the children. They were absolutely fascinated and we found ourselves calling down for small requests just for the excuse to see her deliver them. On top of that, dinner at the in-house restaurant AperiBar was genuinely one of the best meals of our entire New York trip, every dish we ordered was excellent. Staff throughout the stay were friendly and attentive too. A brilliant, memorable hotel for anyone travelling with kids, ours are still talking about that robot.

author: Cuadrah1
title: Christopher’s Hostel Social
text: I booked a night at St. Christopher’s Paris-Canal. Tammany was very informative & also informed  me about a social gathering at 2100. We got a free drink to socialize with others. By the way! Ya may means “The living inside your heart!” Awesome name!!!

author: Cruiser43181521215
title: Great!

Tanmay 😘

author: Konjite A
title: Social

author: Laura R
title: Very good experience
text: Very good experience!! At night we got together to talk and drink for free; it really helped me connect with other travelers. Tan really cared about connecting the group!

author: Kathy H
title: last minute trip to Rome
text: my husband booked the accommodation and whilst I was expecting more of a hotel, this was more a b and b. Bed was comfortable and we did not lack anything. Breakfast was good. Gianluca was extremely helpful in his advice regarding sights and restaurants etc. My only complaint was that noise travelled through the walls from our neighbours' room (who were quite loud).

author: Liverpoolduo
title: Perfect stay in Rome
text:
We've recently spent a great week in Rome at Quod Libet. Host Gianluca was very friendly and helpful providing us with restaurant recommendations and tips for our visit. All the staff were very friendly. Clean and well maintained room with great breakfasts on the roof terrace. Great location for the Vatican and metro stop.  
We can highly recommend Quod Libet for a stay in Rome.

author: pas D
title: A B and B at the price in a hotel
text:
In this bed and breakfast, the price is too expensive (more than 2 times the price indicated in the rooms) and the services are not those of a hotel.
Breakfast is based on products bought at the nearest supermarket, premium quality and even coffee is not good. A loft for coffee country. The croissant in the morning has no taste is should be replaced by Italian cupcakes Plus if you stay a few days, breakfast will always be the same. Last point as the rooms are in an old apartment, they are equipped with platform to hide the pipes. So on the first day you're gonna bump into the steps. Finally, the fineness of the walls between the rooms does not guarantee any privacy. 
Avoid if you have a motor handicap. Breakfast is on the terrace in a walk-up shed

author: Jami R
title: We're so thankful we found this listing!
text:
I am going to preface this review with saying that I am not going to go into a lot of detail because I don't want to ruin any of the many wonderful surprises we experienced along the way.  

First off we would 100% stay here again.  With all of the places we have stayed over the years, Gianluca is without a doubt the best host we have ever had.  He did everything possible to ensure our stay in Rome was perfect.

Everything we wanted to see in Rome was walkable from QuodLibet.  The underground train is less than a block away if walking isn't your thing.  

The room was clean and had everything we needed for our stay.  The terrace was  beautiful.  

We're so thankful we found this listing!

author: bjia34
title: Definitely Recommended
text: This B&B was one of the top 2 places we stayed in our 2 week visit to Italy. The host is extremely thoughtful and helpful. The breakfast on the roof is also very good quality. We cannot recommend the QuodLibet enough.

author: Pat C
title: 40th street DbleTree. Outstanding
text: Most hospitable staff in NYC. Armani, Joanna, Naomi& Aaron. Sorry if i forgot anyone. All deserve a wage increase.

author: Mauro G
title: Unacceptable Front Desk Conduct
text:
Unfortunately, my experience with the Front Desk was extremely disappointing and, in one instance, completely unacceptable.
Throughout my stay, I encountered Front Desk employees who were consistently rude, poorly prepared, unprofessional, and unnecessarily hostile toward guests. Their attitude was not consistent with the level of courtesy and hospitality one would reasonably expect from a hotel operating under the Hilton brand.
More seriously, during one interaction, a Front Desk employee became aggressive to the point of physically grabbing my arm in what I perceived as an intimidating and threatening manner. Physical contact of this nature by a hotel employee toward a paying guest is completely unacceptable and, in my view, crosses a very serious line.

author: miriam s
title: The WORST service experience Ever
text:
The WORST service experience Ever. 
We booked 8 nights as Hilton Honors guests and we feel really disapponited about the service of the employees and all the infrastructure of the rooms. Since the first day, the air conditioned and the security box didnt work, as soon as I reported it, a mainteinance man came around and told he couldnt do anything about this problems. Until the fourth day, the front desk lady was able to chance us to another room. What did we got? A smaller room with a dirty restroom. The worst part of everything was the attitute of the Manager on Duty, a lady that simply told me: “I am sorry I havent been here for two days, I dont know what happened to you but I can send housekeeping, contact my Front Office Manager in the address below”.
If you dont want to waste your time and your money in a place where customer service experience is totally not existent, avoid this hotel.

author: Hamda W
title: Great location and amazing staff!
text: Super great hotel with the best staff! Loved the location as it is super close to metro stations and the staff were amazing. Kevin and Austin were super great and helped us out both with the rooms and with trying to locate a card my friend lost. Even more important was also their overall attitude and great service!

author: Kateryna S
title: A wonderful stay with thoughtful touches, a great rooftop view, and excellent value for the price!
text:
It was my wife’s birthday, and we were truly surprised by the beautiful birthday decorations. We were pleasantly surprised and touched by this thoughtful gesture. Thank you so much for Amalia Lobby decoration
The room was clean and comfortable, and the rooftop bar with its stunning view was absolutely amazing. Overall, an excellent place with a great balance of price and quality. Highly recommended!

author: santhosh k
title: Shout out to Steph
text: Our flight was cancelled to London due to the bad weather condition and had a very bad day and booked this hotel at very last minute and arrived at the hotel around 1am, Stephanie at the night she is a rock star and an asset to this business made us so relived welcoming. World needs more people like her so kind. Also offered a higher floor with an incredible view.

author: Jesus B
title: Disillusionment and disappointment
text:
Hotel with many floors, two elevators, little infrastructure, mediocre breakfast, and a receptionist named Williams who tells me he cannot guarantee that he will provide a towel for each of us in the family. The rooms are super small and are never cleaned, the outlets are almost falling out with barely any maintenance. They only make the bed. The best part was the service Fredie Rivera gave us; this man is capable of much more just because of the service he provides. 
I do not recommend this hotel.

author: Lisa E
title: Friendly staff and good experience!
text: We were very happy with our experience!  The location was good.  The staff was so friendly.  They communicated throughout our stay which was appreciated.  We had a warning that the motel was full our last night so prepare for long elevator lines so it was nice to be aware (we never encountered long waits though).  I searched for a lot of rooms in NYC and have stayed at several places.  I thought the deal for a spacious bed was good.

author: stuart w
title: Very average
text: A mixed review for my visit. Great location, not far off Times Square, check in was quick and the guy serving was super friendly and found the same each day as he said hello whenever I passed. 35 stories high, 6 rooms per floor and only 2 lifts so waiting on a lift was sometimes 20 minutes. Unhelpfully there  is no lights or indication where the lifts are on each floor so the lift constantly wizzes past your floor. New mattresses were being delivered and 1 lift taken out to deal with that so the whole hotel working with one small lift. Wasn’t good at all. Breakfast room is very congested, food choice was ok but 2 coffee machines took ages to serve coffee and the 2 toasters are $10 toasters from Walmart and totally hopeless for serving a couple hundred people each day. All utensils are individually wrapped in plastic so tremendous wastage. The rooms were a decent size and standard, AC was excellent. Bathroom was a good size but a tiny sink which was hanging at an angle so water constantly on the floor. Checkout girl barely looked up when I checked out. Very mixed experience, could have been so much better if some basics were fixed

author: Fabiana S
title: Nothing to complain
text:
We arrived early intending to drop off our bags (they offer free luggage storage, though we didn't use it), but to our surprise, our room was already ready for check-in at 11 a.m. The receptionist on May 6th was incredibly helpful. The $150 security deposit was refunded just three days after check-out, which was impressively fast.

Tip: Keep your room key away from your phone, credit cards, or OMNY card, as they demagnetize easily.

The Room: I stayed on the 11th floor and found it very quiet. The room is small and basic but comfortable. A huge plus was the pillows—they were extremely comfortable, and the pillowcases were labeled "firm" or "soft". There were also plenty of outlets and USB ports near the bed to charge all our devices. The AC worked great, and the Wi-Fi was fast and easy to connect. The room includes a coffee maker, iron, hair dryer, and safe (no microwave, mini-fridge, or kettle, but going downstairs for hot water was never an issue). Housekeeping organized the room daily, though the cleaning felt a bit superficial (the mirror stayed dirty for a few days). Also, the shower water pressure wasn't the best, but the water heated up very quickly.

Breakfast & Amenities: The breakfast selection was great (eggs, sausage, pastries, etc.) and constantly replenished. It gets busy, but going around 8:30 a.m. was perfect. The cinnamon rolls and pancakes were outstanding! A major bonus was the free bottled water, coffee, lemonade, and snacks always available in the lobby.

Location: Fantastic location, just a 5-minute walk to the 42nd St–Port Authority subway. Everything you need (Duane Reade, 7-Eleven, restaurants) is right around the corner. The neighborhood can look a bit rough at night with many homeless people, but I personally had no issues.

Overall, it’s not a luxury hotel, but it’s excellent value for money. I would definitely stay here again!

author: Professoressa78
title: High quality
text: Excellent hotel: far from the center but in a quiet area, reception and bar staff very professional, modern, clean and comfortable rooms, excellent sleep quality (only until the cleaning staff starts moving around, needs improvement), relaxing pool and convenient garage.

author: emanuele f
title: Hotel in the center of Rome
text: Excellent hotel in the center of Rome, welcoming, helpful and courteous staff

author: Allan S
title: Excellent Quality & Location .
text:
From the moment you walk into reception, you’re greeted with a warm smile and offered a welcome drink. Once you’ve checked in and have time to take in your surroundings, you can’t help but notice the incredible attention to detail and the hotel’s exceptional cleanliness — it’s absolutely spotless, which is a real credit to all the staff.
The rooms are immaculate and extremely well appointed . 
The Breakfast menu is excellent and will cater for everyone’s palate.
I would certainly recommend this hotel. It’s small enough to feel comfortable and welcoming, yet large enough to provide a true five-star service. A fantastic hotel with wonderful staff and a real attention to detail.

author: Frederic T
title: Excellent vacation.
text:
Great hotel, with available, responsive, efficient, and very friendly staff.
The services offered are very good.
Hot tub in the room is great!
Pool and gym very good. 
Room (junior suite) spacious and great.
The hotel even thought of a gift for my wife's birthday.
Restaurant and bar very good too. However, the service there was a bit slow.
But a great experience in a magnificent city.
We will be back!

author: Zoe P
title: Great hotel with lovely rooftop pool.
text:
We were greeted by very warm and welcoming staff, who were happy to give information on the local area, easy ways to get into Rome city centre and offered to help should we need anything during our stay.

Our room was clean and had what we needed, but relatively basic.

The rooftop pool was a good size, with a bar next to it.
The gym is small, but had everything I needed.
The restaurant is nice, with great service, delicious food and came out in good time. The cocktails were also delicious!

You can reach the nearest bus stop in roughly 5-minutes (walk) and then into Rome in 20 minutes. There is also a train station just a 5-10 minute walk away.
The hotel can also organise a taxi for 12 euros each way.

Overall, a great place to stay. We would recommend, and we would return.

author: Trisha E
title: The BEST hotel in NYC with breathtaking views and customer service
text: I was surprised with a overnight room reservation this past weekend , 8/22, by my family to celebrate my 50th birthday. I cannot begin to describe how amazing this hotel is. From arrival, the entire staff from the valet, to the front desk were so pleasant and kind and even wished me a Happy Birthday immediately.  But what blew me away was when I got into my room, and realized we had been upgraded to the penthouse suite. Wow, Wow, and Wow again. It was absolutely spectacular.  The view had me speechless. And to add, it was duplex with an upstairs private rooftop. I will never ever forget this Birthday and I wouldn't have wanted to bring it in any other way. Thank you to my family for gifting me this experience. I felt loved , seen and special on this special weekend. Thank you to the ENTIRE Ink 48 Hotel staff. And a special shout out and thank you to Sinam, Hotel Manager. She called me the next morning to introduce herself and to inquire how my experience was. I just had to meet her in person. Thank you Thank you Thank you again. I cannot wait to return to stay. This hotel is absolutely beautiful. Not to mention I ended up having a surprise dinner with family and close friends at Hudson Vu, the upstairs rooftop bar. Everything was top tier.  A weekend to remember. Thank you again and I will most likely be back before you even know it.

author: HENRY LEWIS
title: Victor is great!
text: I understand that during the summer, hotels can get very busy and I just wanted to say that Victor is a great employee! He went above and beyond Customer service to help us out when the other employees were lacking in service, he made up for everything a great service every single day. We appreciated our stay because Victor made it memorable. Promote him!

author: Seth P
title: Extra Care
text: It was a great experience. Had an issue with my room but Victor at the front desk worked with me and took great care of me. The management went above and beyond to make sure I was comfortable.

author: Eric H
title: Extra fee, loud property!
text:
Beware there is a $40 per night “Amenity Fee” charged.  Given there is no pool and fitness center is tiny, very disappointing to be charged this.  

Second, this property has a rooftop night club across the street that blares music from 3PM to 3AM.  Making the rooms very noisy and not suitable for light sleepers. 

Black out blinds were non operational.  Furniture and lamp controls were broken. 

The rooftop bar is beautiful, but you need reservations and hotel guests DO NOT get priority. 

The positives.   The wine bar on main floor is awesome.  Ian and the other bartenders are fun, friendly, well versed on the wines and make excellent cocktails.

The bed is comfortable.  Water pressure in shower is amazing.  

Location makes it easy to get around.  Walking distance to cruise terminal for those cruising. 

Don’t see how this got rated a 4 star hotel. It’s 2 - 3 Star at best.

author: Tania Baille
title: Great Hotel
text: Great Hotel we go there every time, spacious room in the Hell’s Kitchen neighborhood I highly recommend

author: Julius L
title: Wonderful Staff Who Made Our Stay Memorable
text:
Our room was not in the best location. I had specifically requested a corner room, but I did not realize that it would be right beside the parking garage and directly above the loading dock entrance. Unfortunately, the early-morning deliveries meant that we were often awakened around 6:00 AM by the loading and unloading of towels and other hotel supplies, as well as the coming and going of cars. This was definitely the one downside of our stay.

However, this negative experience was completely overshadowed by the magnificent staff at NH Collection Roma Giustiniano. Their warmth, kindness, and willingness to go above and beyond made our stay truly special.

When we first checked in and entered our room, **Maricetta** called us personally to make sure everything was in order and asked if there was anything else we needed. That small gesture immediately made us feel welcomed and cared for.

The following morning, we needed to leave very early—around 6:30 AM—for our Papal Audience tour. I went downstairs to ask if it would be possible to have some breakfast to take with us, even though the kitchen was not open yet. **Allen and Ali** went above and beyond and prepared a wonderful breakfast for us, including sandwiches, croissants, biscuits, orange juice, and bottled water. We were incredibly grateful!

**Ian** was also exceptionally thoughtful. Since the hotel did not have an ice vending machine, he would always offer us ice and cold water whenever he saw us. It was such a simple gesture, but it showed how attentive he was to the guests.

On our last day, I asked **Michelle** if she could recommend some good coffee shops. She could have simply given me a few names, but instead, she went the extra mile by actually calling the shops to make sure they were open before recommending them to us. That level of service was truly impressive.

And then there was **Roberto**, who worked at the bar. We arrived knowing the bar was closing in about 10 minutes, and he could have simply served us a beer or wine and sent us on our way. Instead, he happily prepared cocktails for us and spent nearly half an hour chatting with us. There were also families in the lounge who ordered drinks, and he continued to serve them graciously without making anyone feel rushed because of closing time.

Finally, **Marco**, one of the funniest and most cheerful front-desk receptionists, gave us such a memorable farewell—singing and dancing as we left!

Last but certainly not least, **Saadia at the breakfast bar** deserves a special mention. Every morning, she warmly welcomed everyone who came in and made us feel genuinely cared for. She was incredibly attentive to all the guests, quietly clearing and resetting our tables whenever we finished and offering us coffee. Her warm smile and thoughtful service were such a lovely way to start each morning. She truly added to the wonderful experience we had at the hotel.

The room location was certainly not ideal, but honestly, **the staff completely wiped out the negative experience**. They are among the friendliest, most accommodating, and genuinely caring hotel staff we have ever encountered. Every person we interacted with made us feel welcome and valued.

We know we will be back in Rome, and **I would absolutely stay at NH Collection Roma Giustiniano again—especially if this wonderful team is still there.** They are truly what made our stay memorable.

**Thank you to the entire team for making us feel so welcomed in Rome!**

Julius and Aileen (Canada)

author: Roving40504247142

text:
Front desk handled and help promptly, correctly, clearly and completely...
Front desk staff includes Maria concerta,Michelle, Mohammad ali and all during our stay.
Guest relation ladies were superb, listened our request carefully and guided clearly.

author: Nicole W
title: Roberto is the BEST!
text: Roberto’s service is AMAZING! He is so attentive and make sure you love everything.  I would come  back just because of his service.

author: Carleen C
title: Amazing Stay!!
text: Excellent stay! Highly recommend. The staff were amazing. Top class service! Extremely attentive and helpful and nothing was ever too much bother. A special mention to Marco and Michelle, front of house on our arrival who were exceptional. Marco on the bar was also brilliant and very kind and Ali on check out who assisted us. Hotel beautiful and rooms exceptional. I couldn’t recommended this hotel enough. Thank you NH Giustiniano.

author: Elaine P
title: Absolutely Outstanding Stay Before Our Cruise! ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐
text:
We stayed at NH Collection Roma Giustiniano for two nights before our cruise from Rome, travelling over from Ireland, and we honestly couldn’t have asked for a better experience.

From the moment we arrived, the hotel couldn’t have done enough for us. We were delighted to all be upgraded to Junior Suites, which was absolutely stunning. The room was beautifully clean, spacious and had a lovely balcony. The fully stocked minibar and thoughtful extra touches really made our stay feel special.

The hotel is in a perfect location for exploring Rome, and everywhere was exceptionally clean. Every member of staff we met was so friendly, welcoming and went above and beyond to make our stay enjoyable.

A special thank you to Marco and Michelle at check-in, and Ali and Marco when we were leaving. Your kindness and helpfulness really stood out and made us feel so welcome.

We also loved the little touches in the lobby in the evenings, with complimentary nuts, crisps and snacks while relaxing after a day in Rome.

The hotel also kindly organised a minibus to take our party of eight to the cruise port, which made the start of our holiday completely stress-free.

We would highly recommend NH Collection Roma Giustiniano and would absolutely stay here again if returning to Rome. Thank you to the whole team for making our two-night stay so memorable! 🇮🇹❤️

author: Rachel_flux
title: Not 4* hotel
text:
We recently stayed in room 113, the room was very noisy, as it was located right by the main road, bar and lift, so we could hear a lot of noise throughout our stay. There was also a slight damp smell in  the bathroom. The room itself could definitely use some TLC, with tiles coming away from the bathroom walls and some holes that needed attention. Overall, we wouldn’t say the room met the standard we would expect from a 4-star hotel.

On the positive note, the location was great and within walking distance of the main attractions. The surrounding area was a little run down, but we felt safe walking around. The staff were also very friendly and helpful throughout our stay, which we really appreciated.

author: Lauren M
title: Happily recommend
text:
Good hotel. Location was ok as was a 30 min walk from the colosseum. 

Hotel was clean and had everything we needed. Staff were all very nice and kind 

I would recommend and the previous comments on the area should not be taken into consideration as this was not an issue for us

author: Sam S
title: Terrible rooms… not a 4 star
text:
The Rooms we were allocated were absolutely terrible, we had black mold on the cleaning, with a broken AC… and not even enough water pressure to flush the toilet, all with no windows. 
The noise level around our room was high, due to it being located right on a back alleyway, with people leaving bottles of something on the window.

The location is decent… with a reasonable way into Rome

author: James883
title: Well situated for ease of visiting key sites and really helpful
text: We stayed 2 nights pre going on a cruise so we could visit the sites in Rome. It wasn't in the nicest areas of Rome but it was actually very close to be able to get around. The staff were really helpful and guided us through what to do and how to get the Metro, which set us up well and gave us confidence to use it. On our second night there was the gay festival party going on directly outside our bedroom window, but they were great a moved us (we left all our stuff in the room) so we could have a peaceful nights sleep. While were were on the cruise my wife realised she had left her brand new shoes in the room. I emailed them and they found them and posted them back to us in the UK ! They arrived safely on return from our holiday. If I am honest the rooms were acceptable and clean, the shower was a bit of a dribble but all things said, they really did do a great job to make our stay good and put the extra in to get the shoes to us and get a good nights sleep. They offered us breakfast for a small charge each and I am pleased we did this as the pastries were lovely and a good range was provided. Value was good and proximity to the sites was also really good.

author: 2015Minnie
title: Standard hotel at accessible location
text:
It definitely is not a 4 star hotel but a decent standard hotel. The rooms and bathrooms are small but very neat and clean. The room was cleaned daily and towels replaced daily. Rohit at the reception was very polite helpful and guided us for the modes of transport to undertake sight seeing.
The breakfast is kind off ok and the same everyday similar to what you can find in other Italy hotels. 

The location though near by major transport options like tram, bus and metro  stations but does not seem very safe for late nights. But definitely convenient in terms of moving around the city for sight seeing.

author: Isabella G
text: The hotel is very well located, super clean, and the staff is very kind! Thank you Samantha!

author: Ciara A

text: Romaine was so incredibly personable and helpful during our stay. 10/10!

author: Imperium O

author: carlos l
title: Above and beyond
text: Excelent service from all personnel. Shout out to Natalia R. She went above and beyond to make us feel comfortable. Our room was always clean with new towels and sheets. 20 out of 10.

author: Benjamin L
title: Great stay with cookies on top

text:

Most employees are friendly, except for one who was not welcoming during check-in.
The main reason for the 1-star review is the charge. We booked the room directly from the Hilton website. 3 days before the check-in, we saw 2 changes from the hotel (probably the first high as “guaranteed”). Once we checked in, we were charged the full amount for the rooms; however, the previous charge had not been cancelled yet. Once we checked out, the initial charge was cancelled; however, 2 new charges were made, without any explanation, consent or invoice, and they were above the amount of the reservation.
We emailed Hilton, and they told us the hotel would contact us within 48 hours, but no one from the hotel contacted us to explain the overcharge. 
Hotels should be more transparent about their charging mechanism and explain to customers each additional charge above the agreed amount in the reservation.

author: Lindsay W
title: Super clean, great budget hotel
text:
Initially I was concerned about the booking made through Expedia.  I'd paid upfront for two single rooms months in advance. From the hotel I only got confirmation for one room and attempts to confirm the two rooms were conflicting.  As Expedia assured me that all was well I trusted them and rolled with it.  I needn't have worried as all was in order on arrival where my companion and I were greeted by a lovely young, well mannered receptionist. The area was  less salubrious than its neighbouring ones but it was lively and busy with people and travellers of all nations. Conveniently placed opposite was the Metro Barbes-Rouchechouart from where we were able to reach all parts of Paris. And even more conveniently placed was the Brasserie Barbes which was excellent. Downstairs was casual bar food and upstairs was more for dining with good French cuisine with a great ambience. The single rooms we'd booked were small, as expected, but the beds were double. The decor was a little dated with chipped paint on the corners but I have to say it was all incredibly clean. The pillows were plump and the bedding new, clean and brilliantly white. The shower and w.c. were separate and the sink was the smallest I'd ever seen, but cute.  I didn't have a wardrobe but I did have hangers and pegs with a couple of shelves which were perfectly adequate for the lighter traveller. There was a tv but no English channels.. not even BBC world news but that wasn't a problem as the wifi was strong and I used 
my phone to get what I wanted. As with the older hotels there was no lift so bear in mind that the spiral staircase could be a problem if you're not very mobile. Features like this are typically French which is what I love. Breakfasts were very good with a selection of baguette, croissant, pastry, cheese, ham, scrambled and boiled egg, Frankfurter, cereal, yoghurt, fruit, jams, teas and coffees... more choice than other Paris hotels I've stayed in and all for 12 euro, which is really good value.
Overall I would recommend this hotel as long as you manage your expectations.  It's 3 star so don't expect 5 star!  It's super clean, very friendly staff, run extremely efficiently with no waste whatsoever. Cost for a single room was £90.34/night staying in June.
I will be returning!

author: clairemsmith
title: Five-Star Price, Three-Star Experience
text:
Five-Star Price, Three-Star Experience

I chose this hotel expecting the level of comfort, service and attention to detail normally associated with a five-star property. Unfortunately, it fell well short of those expectations and felt tired, dated and in need of significant refurbishment.

The room décor was worn and tatty, with many areas showing obvious signs of age and lack of maintenance. While I appreciate that not every luxury hotel needs to be ultra-modern, there is a difference between classic elegance and simply looking neglected.

One of the biggest disappointments was the lack of tea and coffee making facilities in the room. Given the price point and five-star rating, this felt like a basic amenity that should have been provided as standard. Although there was a paid minibar, there were no glasses available to use with any of the drinks. When I requested a kettle and cups, a kettle was eventually provided, but it was unsafe as the handle was loose and caused the lid to flip open every time it was lifted up. To make matters worse, the cups were removed during housekeeping the following morning, leaving the kettle unusable.

The most serious issue occurred when the hotel lost hot water for approximately eight hours. Guests received no advance warning, and communication only came after the problem had already arisen. For a luxury hotel charging premium rates, the lack of proactive communication and contingency planning was extremely disappointing. Being unable to shower or use hot water for such a prolonged period had a significant impact on our stay.

While some members of staff were polite and tried to help where possible, the overall experience did not justify either the hotel’s five-star status or the rates charged. The property has potential due to its location and reputation, but it urgently needs investment, improved maintenance and a greater focus on guest experience.

Based on this stay, I would not consider it good value for money and would struggle to recommend it to travellers seeking a genuine five-star experience.

author: Nusrat P
title: Stay at the Aliz
text:
The hotel is in a good location and within walking distance of Broadway and Times Square. There are also plenty of coffee shops, food stops, money exchange places and other conveniences nearby. A 7-Eleven is just a stone’s throw from the hotel, which is very convenient.

The rooms are on the small side but come with a coffee machine and a steam iron for your clothes. The rooms are quite dark, and the lighting could definitely be better. The air conditioning is also very noisy and loud. Unfortunately, the beds are quite uncomfortable, as are the pillows, but if you are mainly using the hotel as somewhere to sleep, then it is manageable.

Breakfast is fairly standard and nothing too exciting. The hotel provides one $25 token per room, which can be spent on beverages or put towards breakfast or dinner. Breakfast costs $35, so you have to pay the difference, which isn’t too bad. Alternatively, you can buy drinks, snacks and other bits and pieces from the downstairs bar using your token. 

The hotel also has a good viewpoint on the 40th floor. However, if you are travelling with children, they cannot access the viewpoint because you have to be 21 or over due to the bar being located there.

You are provided with two complimentary bottles of water per day per room, with no extras included. If you need more water, you can fill up bottles from the fountain on the lower ground floor or buy your own.

Housekeeping was good throughout our stay. Overall, we had a good stay and the location is definitely one of the hotel’s biggest advantages.

One thing to mention is that some of the reception staff can be quite abrasive. However, there were also staff members who were very helpful. In particular, there was one guy at reception with blonde highlights in his hair who was extremely helpful, although unfortunately I can’t remember his name.

Overall, I would say this is a good hotel if location and convenience are your priorities. The rooms and beds could be more comfortable, and the lighting and air conditioning could certainly be improved, but overall it was a good stay.

author: May27Tenerife
title: A great hotel in Times Square
text: Thanks to this hotel, the experience in New York was unbeatable. The views from the room were impressive. The hotel was centrally located without being in the noisiest area. Everything was super clean and the staff's service was fantastic. One night we had dinner there and everything we tried was really good. They made me feel at home; I find it incredible that in the heart of Manhattan there could be a hotel so attentive to its guests (at least that was the case with us at all times). I don't have a single complaint, totally recommended. If I were to return to NY, I would choose it again without hesitation.

author: Lara
title: Convenient location & nice views!
text:
The location of this hotel is very convenient, with the subway literally down the road (42nd street). It is in the middle of Times Square. 
Staff were always polite, helpful and courteous - nothing was too much trouble. 
The room itself was not very spacious but it was very nicely decorated. We got moved and upgraded to a deluxe room on our 2nd day due to our air-con breaking, and the view was amazing!
We also got a 25$ chip to spend on food/drinks in the downstairs bar, as well as 2 free welcome drinks. The staff also do wellness checks if you stay with them for more than a couple of days, and they held our luggage for us after we checked out.
The only downside I would say is being over 40 floors and 3 lifts, they are slow - but you’d get that anywhere lol. 
A very nice hotel overall!

author: Elodie G
title: Beautiful experience in New York
text:
Superb view and close to everything! 😁
The rooms are small for 4 but we manage and it works out. We enjoyed our stay as well as the staff, who were always pleasant. The food is good and the rooftop has a magnificent view of the city and its skyscrapers.

author: Trip02897820829

author: Lakshmi Priya G
title: Great location but very subpar service
text:
I stayed at the hotel for 3 days. The rooms are great and the hotel is surprisingly quiet given its location. If you have no other requirements, this place is great. Unfortunately that's where the positives end.

Day 1
I bought an upgrade on check-in, and when I reached my room, the Chromecast option didn't work. The casting was one of the main reasons I booked here, so I asked help at the front desk. The technician who came by the first night said he couldn't fix it, but he'd have it fixed by the next day, which was OK with me.

Day 2
The next evening when I returned, the Chromecast was still not fixed so I went to the front desk to follow-up. They said unfortunately they couldn't fix it and didn't offer any alternative. At this point, it was 10:30 PM so I asked to be moved to another room that worked. They said they were fully sold out. I pushed to escalate to a manager, and the manager to his credit offered a downgraded room which I accepted. The manager apologized, confirmed I wouldn't be charged for the upgrade and offered some IHG points as compensation which I gratefully accepted.

- At checkout, I noticed I was still charged for the upgrade so had to remind the agent to get that removed.
- I had a small package shipped to the hotel by accident, and when I called to figure it out, the front desk routed me to the security team, which just dropped my call after several minutes. I just gave up on that.
- Two weeks later, I realized the compensation points still haven't shown up in my account. I've had multiple back and forths with IHG customer care who have said that there is no record of the compensation being offered to me. I'm giving up on that as well.
Overall, this place does work if you just need a place to crash in. For anything beyond that or customer service, I'd avoid.
