author: Chris L
title: Perfect 40th anniversary stay at Le Patio Bastille
text: Lovely hotel in the quieter part of Paris with easy metro links to all popular areas and attractions. We were 2 couples travelling to Paris to both celebrating our 40th wedding anniversaries and stayed at Le Patio Bastille for 3 nights from 20th August. The Hotel is very deceptive as it has a small front entrance that opens up to the large hotel hidden behind the main facade. Lovely well maintained hotel with very helpful reception staff, clean spacious air conditioned rooms with a small kitchenette, large very comfy beds and nice clean bathrooms with hot showers. We had breakfast included in our stay making starting each day easier and it was fresh produce every day with fruit, breads, meats and cheeses, yogurts, cereals, fruit juices, tea and coffee, cooked breakfast items, pastries and jams all very nice. Reception staff get bonus points for being lovely, very patient and very helpful especially showing us how to us the RAPT app on our phones to buy metro tickets and getting around. Hotel is well situated for a good nights sleep as its in the quieter 11th Arrondissement but an easy 5 minute walk to a wide range of bars, cafes, bakeries, shops etc. We all highly recommend this hotel for a relaxing stay in a quieter area whilst maintaining easy access to all parts of the city whilst guaranteeing a restful nights sleep to recharge and a good breakfast to set you up for each days activities.

author: lore_at06
title: Really nice hotel
text:
It has really comfy beds.
It is located a little far from city center, but well communicated with metro stations and bus stops nearby

author: seankirkby31
title: An Ideally Located and Pleasant Hotel With Exceptional Staff
text:
I've now stayed at Le Patio Bastille on two seperate occassions and each time the staff have made sure that everything went well.
On my first trip there were some issues with the booking - I did that through a third party and it was in no way the fault of the hotel - but the reception staff were able to resolve that for me.
For my 2nd trip I booked directly with the hotel and it was so much easier with the ability to complete some parts of check-in before I arrived. During my visit, i received a couple of WhatsApp messages just making sure that I knew they were there to help - a nice little touch I thought.
The hotel is ideally situated with 3 metro stations within a 5 minute walk - this gives you 5 different metro lines to choose from, meaning most attractions are within easy reach.
Within the grounds of the hotel are areas where you can sit out and finish the day off enjoying a nice glass of wine.

author: Paul M
title: Clean And Tidy
text: Staff friendly and helpful. Establishment clean tidy, rooms clean & presentable. Check in & check out easy no issues, cleanliness of the whole site makes the difference. Getting to hotel from airport was easier wee thought easy to find.  Easy to to and from places plenty of restaurants Bars food places in surrounding areas

author: Livia A
title: Very well-connected hotel that offers very good service.
text:
It is a hotel that offers more than its category indicates. Very good air conditioning, excellent service, very clean, and it features a kitchenette in the rooms.
It is very close to the Nation transport hub and is also next to the city bus stop.
The staff is very attentive and professional.

author: Luc
title: Parisian stopover
text: Good location for reaching Notre Dame in the Marais district and a few steps from the Bastille. A beautiful interior garden equipped with small tables and corners for a break. Our garden-view room was spacious and had all the comforts. We did not test the breakfast because we preferred the Parisian boulangeries.

author: Joanne D
title: Enjoyable with amenities within walking distance.
text: My husband and I were on a short get away. The front desk and restaurant staff were attentive and friendly. The room was perfect and housekeeping was great. The hotel is close to shops including a pharmacy and a grocery store, very handy. Strongly recommend.

author: Wibbs
title: Anniversary stay
text:
We booked a 4 night break to celebrate our 30th wedding anniversary and we had a fantastic stay from start to finish.
The check in was very smooth and quick and we were very impressed with our room overlooking the courtyard.
The beds were a great size and very comfy.
We went for breakfast the first morning and was really impressed with the decor of the breakfast room and the food offering.
The hotel is very close to some great bars and restaurants and also close to the metro to visit all the landmarks.
I would recommend this as a great place to stay to visit all the Paris Landmarks.

author: Alexandra A
title: Our stay was a big disappointment, poor service, inadequate organization, an unkempt and outdat
text:
This hotel was a big disappointment.
Even before our arrival, we had reserved a table for dinner, but never received a response. Upon our arrival, we discovered that the hotel restaurant was closed. The parking space reserved for us was also already occupied by another vehicle.
The elevator in the building where our room was located seemed to have been out of service for weeks. So we had to walk the way to the 4th floor every time in the intense heat. Manage the floor via a very unattractive staircase. The employee dragged and hauled our suitcases up the stairs. Given the way they were dragged over the steps, one almost got the impression that the staircase was being intentionally wiped down at the same time. 
The room was old, worn out, and in poor condition.
The low point, however, was the breakfast: In the breakfast room in the basement, the same rags used to wipe the tables were subsequently used for the floor as well. That seemed extremely unhygienic and unappetizing.
How this hotel got its four stars remains a mystery to me. Unfortunately, we cannot recommend this hotel.

author: Aisling C
title: Perfect hotel in perfect location
text:
Wow! Perfect hotel. For some reason we walked from the train station ( via everywhere) a good 60 minute walk. Supermarket 1 minute walk from the hotel.
The reception was having work done but no bother to is. The courtyard was stunning as we walked to the room. 
Oh my what an amazing room!!
Kitchenette, fridge, bath, and such a comfortable bed!!
Clean and perfect. Staff were amazing and helpful. 
Great location. Quite in your room with bustling bars and cafes surrounding. 
Highly recommend. .

author: simone Francalanci
title: Paris is always worth a mass
text: Clean hotel and logistically well-placed, near the Seine, with the subway very close. Room up to Ibis standards, but super comfortable bed complete with a topper. The policy of only one large towel per person does not satisfy us much, but by now we have gotten used to it. If we really want to find a flaw, the luggage storage service pre-check-in or post-check-out is for a fee via automatic lockers.

author: Sabrina B
title: Perfect stay.
text: Excellent location, small room but functional for two people. Perfect breakfast with plenty of choices between sweet and savory. The hotel lobby is very welcoming, fast check-in. Possibility to leave luggage after check-out.

author: CaronIan
title: Two night stay
text: We had a fantastic 2 night stay here while in Paris. The hotel is just a short walk from the metro stations with good connections to the airport and central Paris. We arrived quite early but there was a room ready so we were able to check in earlier than we should have. There are 300 rooms at this hotel! The room had aircon which was adequate. A small bathroom which was ok and the room was very clean. Staff here were so helpful and friendly. There are chargeable lockers if you need to store luggage and there are safe deposit boxes that are free to use all in a seperate location behind the check in desks. Breafast was a great experience all the standard cheese ham etc. The bar was very resonable with the prices and they have an happy hour. Nice coaktails too. Our room was on the top floor with a great view of the Bastille column. A pefect stay.

author: Gia
title: Excellent experience.
text: Very well served by public transport. Small room and small bathroom. Good breakfast. Super kind staff.

author: CJ
title: Great stay for 2 weeks
text:
I was a bit concerned having read previous reviews, but I would absolutely stay here again! I stayed for two weeks for a business trip. The location is absolutely outstanding - close to so many different eateries, grocery stores, pharmacies, metro stations etc. A great market is just down the street each Thursday and Sunday. 

I stayed on the 7th (top) floor. The room was impeccably clean and the air conditioning was great! Comfy bed and ample space to hang clothing, unpack, and a good sized desk/chair to work from if necessary. Lots of outlets and lighting options too. I do agree that the bathroom is an odd layout/quite small, but for a solo stay it was not a problem at all. 

It does seem like there are some rooms right next to the elevators, so I'd ask for one away from these. The breakfast is repetitive, but if it is included in your rate I'm not sure I would pay extra to have the breakfast when there are so many other options in the area. Note that they do not have irons/ironing boards in the rooms - they instead have an ironing room on the fourth floor which is not suitable (iron was dirty, board needs replaced, not a pleasant smell in the ironing room). This needs to be improved.

Other than that, great location and I'll stay here again next time I'm in Paris.

author: KGav67
title: My first choice
text: Grand Hotel Français is my first choice when visiting Paris. This is a quality hotel which is quiet, clean and comfortable and well-situated for local commerce and for transport to all areas of Paris. The staff are professional and helpful and you are made to feel welcome. Any issues are resolved immediately. Special thanks to Assia and Bryan for their professional and friendly service and to the manager for his generosity. I look forward to my next visit.

author: Παναγιωτα Χ
title: EXCELLENT
text: We had a very pleasant stay at this hotel. Everything was great, very clean, the staff was very friendly and polite and always willing to help. Also, metro is very close and it was very convenient for us.

author: Odyssey28147835271
title: Nothing to report
text: Pretty good and consistent with the establishment

author: Ehsan K
title: I had a very pleasant stay at this hotel.
text:
I had a very pleasant stay at this hotel.

Pros:
The staff were extremely friendly, professional, and always responsive to any requests or questions.
The location is excellent and very convenient for getting around.
 The hotel was clean, and the facilities were good considering the price.
 It offers great value for money.

Cons:

The only downside was that it could be a bit noisy at times.

Overall, I would definitely recommend this hotel, especially if you’re looking for a comfortable stay with a great location and excellent service at a reasonable price.

author: Mobile19229781170
title: Excellent Stay
text:
We had a lovely stay at this small hotel. The rooms were comfortable, the breakfast was delicious with a good selection, and the staff were incredibly friendly, welcoming, and always happy to help.

The location is excellent, just a few steps from the metro, making it very easy to explore Paris.

We really enjoyed our stay and would definitely return. Highly recommended! ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

author: Nicola P
title: A good position.
text:
We spent three nights here in our campervan and overall, had a good experience. The pitch was an ample size and on the outskirts of the site. Navigating pulling onto the pitch was made a little stressful by children running around or riding bikes without consideration for the hazards all around them.
Reception staff were friendly and helpful plus the shuttle bus took us into the city centre as expected and for just a small cost.
The toilet area wasn't always very clean but much of this is down to the timings of servicing and how the site's occupants are prepared to leave the facilities after their own use.. As guests, I believe we have a responsibility to each other to leave as we would expect to find.

author: alessia
title: Excellent
text:
The campsite is located on the outskirts of Paris, in the Bois de Boulogne area, a wooded area much quieter than the city. It is still convenient for sightseeing. You can reach line 1 of the Metro with the campsite shuttle or by public bus in 15 minutes. 
We stayed in the Roulotte mobile home with 4 beds for a week. The facility is comfortable and clean. Inside the little house there is everything you need, including 2 fans and a table for eating outside. 
Inside the campsite there is a bar-restaurant that we did not try with a relaxation area with TV, foosball and pool table, a small market and a large playground for children. There is also a small laundry room, with coin-operated washing machines 
The atmosphere is very relaxing because there are comfortable tables and chairs on which you can sit.
The only drawback is that the Wi-Fi almost never worked

author: Anjw N
title: Poor accommodation
text:
Nice base to explore Paris 
Shuttle bus is convenient, but not free. A day ticket for metro and bus is cheaper. Our 4 person tent was outdated and in poor condition. The fridge smelled bad, the zipper of the awning was broken and the tent was dirty.  This was very disappointing. The other tents on the campsite were in good condition. We have filed a complaint, but nothing has been done about it. The plumbing is not always clean. Restaurant is fine.

author: Simone F
title: Good location, the rest disappointing
text:
The location is clearly the biggest plus point of this campsite. Paris is easily accessible by shuttle, Uber, taxi, or bicycle. The site is located directly on the Seine, is easy to reach, offers plenty of shade, and a nice playground. Communication before arrival was also fast and uncomplicated.

Unfortunately, that is almost where the positives end. Despite the stated size of our rig, we were given a pitch that was far too small. The sanitary facilities were disappointing: cold showers with no water pressure, constantly clogged toilets, and sometimes a strong smell of decay at the washhouse. Anyone who gets a pitch near the RV dump station has to endure an unbearable stench every time a tank is emptied.

The security situation was particularly negative: An air fryer was stolen from our awning at night, and during our stay, e-bikes including a trailer were stolen from other guests. The reception showed hardly any interest in this and merely referred us to the police. Even promised checks of the surveillance cameras came to nothing.

The bike rental was also poorly organized, as there were almost never enough bikes available. Overall, this campsite lives almost exclusively off its good location – unfortunately, that is not enough for us.

author: Audun Vassbotn
title: Extremely Disappointing Stay
text:
This was by far the worst accommodation we have ever stayed in. The chalet was clearly not cleaned before our arrival. It was full of dust, with cobwebs everywhere 🕸️, several spiders 🕷️, and even spider nests in different areas of the chalet. It felt neglected and very unhygienic.

To make matters worse, there was no air conditioning, which made the chalet unbearably hot. The only two fans provided were covered in dust and dirt, making them unpleasant to use.

The most shocking discovery was finding a tube of personal hemorrhoid cream left behind in one of the cupboards 🤮. This should have been removed during cleaning and was completely unacceptable.

Overall, the chalet was dirty, poorly maintained, and far below the standard we expected. We left as soon as we could because we simply didn’t feel comfortable staying there.

I would not recommend this place to anyone and definitely would not stay here again.

author: Baaba W
title: Great Location and a Pleasant Stay
text:
We had a really good time at the Novotel. The location was great and very convenient, although I don’t know why Uber and Bolt drivers seemed to get lost every single time! 😂 It was honestly a little frustrating, so I’d recommend booking your rides early and giving yourself some extra time.
The pool was lovely. It’s on the smaller side, but honestly, in this heat, it’s definitely better than having no pool at all! ☀️
The rooms were okay. The beds in the standard rooms are quite small, so if you’re travelling with children or sharing a room, I’d recommend booking a larger room for a bit more comfort. I also didn’t experience any noise during our stay, which was a plus.
Breakfast was good, with a nice selection. We especially enjoyed the croissants and espresso coffees, and it was great to see gluten-free options available as well.
There are also plenty of places to eat around the hotel, and we had dinner nearby a few times, which was really good.
Overall, we had a pleasant stay and enjoyed our time at the Novotel. I’d definitely consider staying there again.

author: Parsa Sharif
title: Fantastic
text:
It was interesting!
Train and bus were near and available!
The breakfast was fantastic and delicious🥐☕️
The employees couldn’t speak English.
The train station is the front of Novotel and the transportation is very fast and easy!
We payed city taxes but it was cheaper than other hotels and city’s.

author: Audrey D
title: TOP-NOTCH STAY
text:
Clean hotel, very well located, the staff is very friendly.
The breakfast selection is very good; everyone finds something they like.
The pool is pleasant after long days of walking around Paris.
Every day, there is a restocking of products in the minibar, which is very pleasant during a heatwave.

author: Mirana R
title: Abusive practices, blackmail, and double billing, AVOID AT ALL COSTS!
text:
A scandalous and deeply traumatic experience at this hotel. After paying for my first night and parking on-site (€321), the front desk claimed the next day that they had 'refunded me by mistake' due to a bug in their system.
Having received no refund to my bank account (the €321 charge having indeed gone through), I refused to pay a second time. Taking advantage of the fact that I had booked a second consecutive night with them, the person who was at the front desk (Julie) exerted unacceptable pressure: she threatened to block my access to my room and to withhold my luggage and personal effects as long as I did not pay again.
Taken hostage and under duress, I had to give in to this blackmail and pay a second sum of €286 to be able to retrieve my private belongings. They therefore extorted €286 too much from me, while half-admitting that the first payment had indeed been received.
Withholding a guest's belongings to force them to pay for the malfunction of their own computer system is totally illegal.

author: Kalain_69
title: Hotel to check off for a visit to Paris
text: A great hotel for visiting Paris when arriving from Lyon. You can drop off your things upon arrival in Paris to go visit the capital. The hotel is great, the rooms are very spacious, the bedding is super. The bathroom is also large and nice with glass that tints for the shower that overlooks the room. The best part of the hotel is a beautiful pool with a tropical ambiance to relax after your day of sightseeing.

author: viaggianteCaserta
title: Excellent location and excellent service
text: Excellent location a few steps from the subway, clean rooms with daily towel change, hairdryer available, rooms with air conditioning, wide sweet and savory breakfast, vending machines for fresh water, definitely an excellent hotel chain 👍

author: Crispatu
title: Good location, great breakfast
text:
Good location for any gig at the Accor Arena which is right next door.

They checked us in early.

Very varied breakfast of good quality

author: Romain
title: Plan for improvements / renovations
text:
The staff is very pleasant, the bedding is good, however the bathroom needs to be renovated: 
-smells coming up from the sink
-the shower head is leaking
-when showering, the water is hot one moment and cold the next 
-the toilet flush is not powerful enough

The breakfast is very good. 
A few improvements to make the stay more pleasant.

author: Mandy Burton
title: Fabulous Stay
text: Cannot fault this hotel. Stayed for 4 nights as we flew from the UK for the magnificent Guns n Roses concert next door at the Accor Arena. The beds and pillows are so comfortable we never wanted to get up!! Lovely breakfast, I am gluten and dairy free and was well catered for. The rooms are small but manageable. My only problem was there were no drawers to put clothes in but we managed. Couldn't believe how quiet the room was especially being next door to the Arena as well.  Brilliant row of restaurants across the road, a small shop and brilliant Indian restaurant just round the corner. All in all a great stay away from the hussle and bussle of the city centre which is easily accessible by the metro outside the hotel or by taxi. Bercy is a lovely area and I highly recommend it.

author: julie
title: Mixed feelings
text:
The hotel is ideally located on metro line 14, just steps from the Accor Arena and on the line that leads to the Stade de France. 

Room small, simple... rather acceptable for a short stay.

The breakfast could be improved. 

Negative points: dirty terrace tables... we arrive for breakfast and find ourselves amidst overflowing ashtrays, empty beer cans, and pizza pieces on the ground...

author: Pia Kennedy
title: The great, good and not so good
text: The location was wonderful within walking distance of many good places. The bar was fantastic due to Gabriel and Others.  The restaurant was nice with very limited good food  I tried most things on the menu and they were all most mediocre, however the service did replace the disappointment it was excellent. When the restaurant turned into a nightclub at night it was fun.  Ut was a delightful little hotel but my billing was doubled at one point and never returned.

author: Leah H
title: Grey hotel and location
text: Great hotel. Very centrally located. Staff was very helpful and accommodating w our families needs throughout the stay.

author: Couple_from_Japan
title: Changed room without confirmation
text:
We internationally booked two separate rooms (White Cover Suite for 2 nights, and Gilded Lounge Suite for 2 nights) to enjoy different tastes of the fashionable hotel, and paid upfront.
However, the hotel changed the reservation by making all the stay (4 nights) at the same (Gilded Lounge Suite) room without confirming anything with us. 
It was very disappointing and unacceptable at this level of hotel (not cheap hotel) because we booked White Cover Suite 6 month ago and were really looking forward to staying at the room.
And, the hotel didn't give any acceptable reasons (just said they thought we wanted to stay at the same room without moving).
I have never had this kind of poor experience at this level of hotels globally for 40+ years.

author: HBHouston
title: Birthday Trip of my Dreams!
text: My ladies and I had the loveliest time in Paris and our dreamy hotel La Maison Champs Elysees was the BEST part of the trip.  Emilie and her team did an amazing job welcoming us... from making sure our rooms were close to one another to decorating my room and surprising me for my 50th Birthday.  I loved the entire team, from Omar who took care of all our endless questions and requests to the staff at Frivole who helped us find a missing wallet!  The rooms were immaculate, beautiful, spacious and had the best decor... love, love our shopping bag trash bin!  Too cute!  Centrally located to amazing shops and bistros, we will certainly come back to LMCE for our next trip to Paris!  THANK YOU for helping make such an important trip that much more memorable!

author: José Miguel B
title: It is a very nice hotel, with great service from the staff, the facilities and the air conditioning are very good
text: It is a very nice hotel, with great service from the staff, the facilities and the air conditioning are very good, all shops are nearby because you are two blocks from the Champs-Élysées, but you also have the Grand Palais on the corner, the Tuileries Garden, walking you arrive at the Louvre Museum, the Les Invalides museum, the Eiffel Tower, the Arc de Triomphe, the Seine River, the location is very remarkable

author: GabriRossi71
title: excellent experience
text: Stayed here for 4 nights, excellent hotel for quality/price, very clean, very helpful and courteous staff, quiet location and close to the Place d'Italie metro station, recommended for sleeping, breakfast is optional

author: Otavio Z
title: Stay in France
text: It was a great experience, good and clean rooms. The team gave tips on what to do in the city. The entire team was extremely attentive and helpful. Near a shopping mall with a large market and a very close train station as well. It is an extremely recommendable hotel.

author: Sparmenion
title: Excellent hotel
text:
Two nights spent in this hotel. The room was perfect. The bedding as well. Bathroom was spotless. The towels were nice and thick and of good quality, I find that important.
Excellent breakfast. All the staff are very pleasant and smiling.
Finally, the hotel is a few steps from a subway entrance and is surrounded by restaurants.

author: Helen D
title: Great location, highly recommend
text: We had a fabulous stay at Hotel la Manufacture. We had interconnecting rooms. Rooms are compact but had everything we needed, pod coffee making machine was excellent. Rooms were clean and serviced daily. Beds very comfortable. We enjoyed the breakfast 3 mornings, lots of choice and well stocked up. Staff very helpful and friendly throughout the hotel. It is a minute walk to Place d'italie metro with excellent links. Highly recommend this hotel.

author: CrisJesusBurgos
title: PERFECT, as always
text:
A perfect week in Paris, the hotel is magnificent, perfect location, cleanliness, service...a special mention to Queen and Becky who made our breakfasts happy every day...the best in the hotel.
Thanks to Miha, she is a delight!! 10/10

author: Alain G
title: Very pleasant stay.
text: Very well-located hotel, very comfortable room, hearty and varied breakfast, welcoming staff.

author: Alex B
title: Perfect place to stay in Paris
text: We loved our stay here. The staff were friendly and nothing was too much trouble. Annabelle especially took good care of us and made our dream trip to Paris very special by giving us a room with a perfect view of the Eiffel Tower. The room was clean and quiet with great amenities. Breakfast was great too.

author: Acc.R
title: good
text:
cute decorated and quite spacious rooms .
Beds were comfortable all things considered.
Kind staff.
At breakfast you will find few varieties to choose from, but you can adapt.

author: gabri
title: Good hotel, but some maintenance issues
text:
The hotel's strong point is definitely the location: it is located in a very convenient area of Paris, near Montmartre, the Moulin Rouge, and with several metro stops easily reachable. This allows you to get around easily to visit the city without wasting too much time traveling.

Breakfast was 
 good, with a good variety of products and satisfactory overall quality. The hotel's common areas are also pleasant and the staff proved to be helpful in resolving issues.

Unfortunately, the initial room had a problem with the shower, which was not working properly, so we had to ask for a room change. In the second room, however, we encountered another issue: the television did not work. These episodes were a bit disappointing considering the level and category of the hotel. However, the rooms were overall welcoming, with very comfortable beds and a good level of general comfort.

Another small detail concerns the water dispenser: it was indicated that sparkling water was also available, but in reality, it only dispensed cold still water.

The hotel, considering the structure and services offered, would have the characteristics to deserve a 4-star rating, but the inconveniences encountered during the stay lead me to give it 3 stars.

author: Voyage07878210022
title: Very good stay!
text: I had a very good stay, spacious and very clean room! A top-notch welcome

author: Rachele B
title: Broken elevator and lies
text:
Elevator constantly broken. 
When you arrive on the first day, they tell you that it broke that day and they will take care of it the next day
I have been here for 3 days and they always say: "The technician is coming tomorrow"
It is not true! 
Going down the spiral staircase from the fourth floor multiple times a day is torture...

author: Ann M
title: To hot to sleep tiny twin beds with basic matteress
text: Hot Hot 🥵🔥 Hot. We had to move hotels. No air-conditioning in hot Paris weather. We had no sleep. The bed was tiny, I felt like I was going to fall out of the bed. We booked three nights and had to leave after two. The staff didn't even ask why. Other people arriving where worried about how they would sleep without a fan or aircon. We are Aussie and couldn't.

author: LiT
title: Simple but effective
text:
It is beautiful, but it is old and unpretentious. 

I think it is important to keep in mind that this is not a luxury hotel. 

Someone wrote in another review that this establishment was more like a youth hostel. I would not go so far as to say that, but it is a very "do-it-yourself" hotel experience. 

No room service, unless you request it, before the 7th day. 

We had an apartment on the 5th floor, which was quite quiet and clean. Unfortunately, we stayed there during the recent unusual heat wave that hit Paris. On that note, please note that they provide fans. Do not hesitate to ask for one to cool off. To our great delight, we also had beautiful, large windows that opened. We were not always able to take advantage of them because of our young child.

A remark regarding safety. We had the top-floor apartment, whose windows open completely. There is a small railing, but if you have young children, it would take very little for them to get hurt if they have a tendency to climb. Likewise, in the mezzanine of this apartment, although our little one managed the spiral staircase quite well, there was a wide space between the bars at the top that could perhaps be filled by an additional railing or a plexiglass panel for more safety (my child could squeeze through the bars). 

Roman's service was exceptional. The woman who brought us our pre-ordered breakfast in the morning was also very kind. Place your order at the front desk or scan the QR code. 

If you request a late checkout via the app, it does not constitute a guarantee. We unfortunately learned this very late in our stay. One of our return flights was not scheduled until late in the evening. 

Try to speak a little French or, at least, make the effort to improve. Roman managed very well with my spouse in English, but the woman who handled our check-in, although very kind to French guests, was clearly either unhappy with my insufficient French or nervous about her insufficient English. The friendliness of the staff varies. 

The hotel is simple. And yes, there is no air conditioning. But the location is excellent. And all things considered, we enjoyed our stay. It is a charming building.
 

Yes, there are homeless people in the area. Welcome to every major city in 2026. Honestly, they posed no threat to us during our stay. It may not be very pleasant to see, but it is part of city life. 

The extra bedding was in baskets near the door. Other extra bedding items were stored in the mezzanine closet. We enjoyed our room on the fifth floor. We would gladly come back here, but hope it is not during a heat wave!

author: Edward K
title: AVOID
text:
This was one of the worst hotel experiences I have ever had, and I am genuinely shocked that this property is advertised as a 4-star hotel.

The only redeeming feature is the location. Beyond that, everything was deeply disappointing. The area directly outside the hotel was absolutely disgusting. On multiple occasions there were homeless people openly injecting drugs right outside the entrance, and the streets around the hotel constantly smelled of urine. It felt unsafe, unpleasant, and completely unacceptable for any hotel claiming to offer a quality guest experience.

The hotel itself was equally poor. There is no air conditioning, which made the rooms unbearably uncomfortable. The facilities are tired, basic, and nowhere near the standard expected of a 4-star property. In reality, this hotel is closer to a budget 1- or 2-star hotel than anything remotely deserving of 4 stars.

What is most frustrating is the misleading rating. Had I known the true condition of both the hotel and its immediate surroundings, I would never have booked it. The photographs and star classification create expectations that the hotel simply cannot meet.

I would not stay here again under any circumstances and would strongly advise other travellers to look elsewhere. Paris has countless accommodation options, and this hotel should be avoided.

author: Tiago L
title: Terrible front office staff
text:
Terrible front office service during the night. Unable to perform a proper check in. Second night, at 10PM with a full lobby and 2 staff members available I was loudly called to attention for forgetting the door code (main door was closed even with 2 staff members available)  
When faced with a complain about the behavior, insinuated I was not treating them properly “in their city” (which seemed a veiled insulation of racism, which I find highly offensive).  Kept talking over me disrespectfully, telling me I used the f* word (which I never did). Worse experience ever in an Accor hotel.

author: cte
title: Great stay
text: Wonderful location for exploring Paris. Walkable to sites and easy metro access. Club lounge is excellent-one of the best I have been to. Staff at the lounge were so friendly and kind. Appreciated being able to check in early after a flight from the US.

author: Ryeman51
title: Marriott Ambassador
text: The hotel stay was beyond our expectations.  We will recommend that others stay hete as it is well located snd service was impeccable, especially Rajeeb in the Executive Lounge.  Also, the hotel manager took it upon  himself personally to see our stay was enjoyable.  This is one of the top five Marriott hotels in which we have stayed.

author: Salkhalb
title: Great quick staff in Oatic
text:
Great location with very spacious rooms and the best part is the staff of the hotel from checking in to the check out all of them are very nice and friendly and special thanks for Mrs Hyriam. T 

Regards,

author: catp79
title: Lovely hotel
text:
We stayed at the Marriott Opera for three nights.  

Our room was clean and comfortable with a view of the Eiffel Tower.  No noise from adjoining rooms or the floor above.

As Platinum Members, we had access to the Executive Lounge which also had views of the Eiffel Tower.  Plenty of food choices throughout the day/evening; wine and beer available in the evenings (no spirits).

Breakfast was really busy but plenty of choice.  We also ate in the bar which was good and reasonably priced.

All of the staff we encountered were very friendly and helpful.  

Great location - a short walk from The Louvre.  Plenty of bars and restaurants in the area but we did struggle to find a shop nearby for water etc.

We thoroughly enjoyed our stay and hope to return one day!

author: Sarah K
title: Will definitely come back
text:
I enjoyed my experience at Opera Ambassador hotel 10/10
Breakfast was great, amazing hospitality especially from Diaguly 
Thank you

author: TERRYPINK
title: A bit disappointed
text: I stayed at this hotel for the third time and, unfortunately, this time I was a bit disappointed. The location remains magnificent and is the main reason why I chose this property again. However, three years after my last visit, I found the hotel rather neglected, with several signs of wear and tear and room maintenance that leaves something to be desired. As I had already pointed out in the past, only one small bottle of water per guest is provided in the room, and no other toiletries or slippers are available. A positive aspect is the common room, where drinks and sweets are offered for free in the afternoon, a touch that is certainly appreciated. However, overall, I had the feeling that the quality of the property has worsened compared to my previous stays.

author: Judi N
title: No Concern for Customers, No Good Will Effort
text: I had booked a non-cancelable room directly with this hotel for 26 and 27 June, 2026, during the big heat wave.  Our Eurostar from Brussels to Paris was cancelled with less than 3 hours notice.  No Eurostar was available either for the rest of that day or for the next day.  I immediately called the hotel and asked about changing the reservation to another weekend and was told by the desk clerk that he could do nothing, and I would have to write their management--this was around 13h15 on a Friday.  I wrote the management an email.  When I made a follow-up call asking why I'd had no response to my email, I was told that no one would respond until Monday.  I was then told that the reservation was non-cancelable and non-modifiable.  There was NOTHING in the information I was given that said the reservation was non-modifiable, and given these incredibly extenuating circumstances, I would expect some kind of relief.  I offered to come at another time of year when the hotel was slow and to stay extra days.  Their answer was still that the reservation was non-modifiable.  When I wrote questioning this, as I find this nowhere in the information I have received or on their website, I was told that it was in the terms and conditions.  I have not seen this in the terms and conditions and asked to be directed to it.  I received no answer to that email request.  I wrote a few days later asking for a response.  Still no response from the hotel's management.  The fact that the hotel management can not even be bothered to respond to an email asking them to justify their contention that the reservation is non-modifiable speaks volumes to the lack of concern they have for their customers.  As a seasoned traveler, I find this very short sighted and evidence of a total lack of compassion for their customer.  Note that the hotel charged me for TWO days, not just one, and made no effort to offer any compromise measure of any sort even though I have little doubt that given the fact that they supposedly have air conditioning, they were able to let that room both days.  I will never reserve here, or at any Best Western, again.

author: Guillaume B
title: This hotel has to be closed !
text:
Simply disgusting !
Very small rooms with ridiculous bathroom !

author: Go605596
title: Great location! On the street of theaters
text: Hotel right across from the "Grands Boulevards" metro station! In the buildings of the Passage Jouffroy where the Grevin museum is located! Comfortable rooms with everything working! Italian shower with hot water, while in many hotels, it's optional! Unpretentious breakfast but very, very decent!!!! Unlimited coffee in a designated room for that purpose! Very friendly staff, also a miracle in Paris! Only downside: the soundproofing is not up to par! The hallways need a refresh as soon as possible! Walking along them, you expect the worst while the rooms are very nice! Considering the services and the location: highly recommended!

author: Muriel P
title: Good deal
text: Just a small downside, we could hear the people in the next room quite well. Otherwise, everything was perfect, thank you and see you soon. Do not hesitate to book.

author: SaraCasJ
title: Extremely disappointing stay — avoid if you expect basic comfort or honesty
text:
This has been one of the worst hotel experiences I have ever had.

When we arrived, we were told that because a large family needed to be accommodated together, we had been put in a room that “people didn’t love”, but we were assured it would only be for one night. The next day, we were told we could not be moved because the hotel was fully booked. Later, when we asked again, staff seemed unaware of the situation and only said they would leave a note for the manager.

That night, the air conditioning stopped working properly. The unit was on, the windows were closed, and it was set to 20°C, but it was only blowing room-temperature air. The room temperature kept rising to around 29°C in the middle of the night, making it impossible to sleep. When we spoke to reception at around 3:30am, we were told nothing could be done that night, but suddenly they said we could be moved to another room the next day — despite telling us twice earlier that the hotel was fully booked.

The whole experience felt disorganised, dishonest, and extremely uncomfortable. We were given a poor room, promised it would only be temporary, then left to deal with a hot room and no real solution during the night. A hotel should at least provide a clean, comfortable room where guests can sleep. This did not happen.

I would not recommend this hotel.

author: Sandra D
title: Great location with everything you need at a reasonable price.
text: Great location. Close to a metro station with 3 lines. Excellent service. Samuel at the front desk greeted me when I arrived in the morning and had a room available. Remembered my name every time I saw him he asked how things were. The cleaning lady, Djenevou, did a very nice job and quickly cleaned my room. Leslie the manager was also very pleasant. I have been staying at Ibis hotels for years. Always at  good location and not fancy but have everything you need at a reasonable price.

author: Christophe Nancy
title: Home topissimo
text: Welcome to the top of this hotel particularly well located near Gare de l'Est. Upstream to prepare my coming professional and effective exchange by email with Samuel. As soon as we arrived, before 10am, we had the chance to find Samuel and enjoy a smiling and kind welcome, worthy of the biggest palaces. Our room quickly enough available thanks to Adelaide and her fellow housekeepers particularly attentive to the customer that we are. The "feel welcome" is really there with possibility offered by Samuel to choose our room. The room, the 602, renovated, 6th floor on street but very quiet, clean and very well appointed. Widescreen wall TV with French and foreign channels. Small office. Multitake. Proper air conditioning. Bathroom with two bath towels and large shower. Cookies (2) offered. Two more pillows. Comfortable bedding. Blackout curtains. Luggage weighing in the lobby (€1), tea and kettle available and bowl of cornflakes. Nothing changed everything is topsimous. We will definitely be back.

author: Fbuzzard
title: Basic
text:
I have stayed in Ibis hotels before and knew they were cheap and cheerful. The room was tiny for me and my daughter but the beds were comfortable and it was clean.
The room was freezing cold for the entire three night stay and the heating system did not work, the bath was against the window and you had to squeeze around the shower door which did not fully open in order to enter it, a larger person would certainly not fit, I struggled as a UK size 14. We were only provided one very thin towel each, the carpet was stained with bleach.
The shower head was too heavy for the bracket and wouldn’t hold up on the wall so we had to hold the head of the shower, water pressure was good and the water was hot.
Breakfast - do not pay the rip off price of €13, go to the little cafe next door where breakfast is much better for half the cost. Ham and cheese at the hotel breakfast ran out, juice ran out, you were only allowed to have one clean glass, cup, plate and cutlery each and you have to clear your own place setting after breakfast. The breakfast room is tiny and very cramped.
The location is good for travel however, very close to Gare du Nord and Gare de l’Est with a metro stop next to the hotel. There are several supermarkets, bakeries and restaurants nearby.
I would choose this hotel for a single night stay on the way to somewhere else, but would not wish to stay here for many nights in a row.

author: Bruce C
title: Great Location and good price for Paris
text:
Good hotel for location next to Gare du l'est and just down the road from Gare Du Nord which for a couple of overnight stays for a day trip and to travel on was great, the price for a central Paris hotel was also very competitive.
Rooms are great good size bed everything you need, except drinks/kettle etc in room which we always like.
For a central hotel with lots of people coming and going it was quiet at night with no disturb sleep, breakfast was good better than expected, with self cooked hot options on offer a great selection of cheese/cold meat and pastries.
We would use again for a stop over.

author: Trail67284308070
title: Professionalism and courtesy were present.
text: Upon our arrival at the Ibis hotel at 1:09 AM, we were warmly welcomed by Mr. Abdallah. His professionalism, courtesy, and sense of hospitality immediately contributed to making our arrival pleasant and reassuring. We sincerely thank him for the quality of his service.

author: cedricmr
title: Ideally located.
text:
In the immediate vicinity of the Gare du Nord and the Gare de l'Est.
Establishment of the Gaëlle ibis. Well-maintained.
Efficient welcome. A small terrace... For smokers :-(
Complete breakfast in buffet form (bad orange juice).

author: Sabine H
title: I recommend it!
text:
Hotel located a 5-minute walk from the Gare du Nord.
Quiet neighborhood.
Welcomed with a smile by the young woman at the front desk.
Arriving at 11:30 AM, our room was supposed to be ready at 2:00 PM because I had requested a room with two separate beds. By changing this option we were able to get a room with a large bed immediately. Which is nice for settling in and visiting Paris right after. A paid luggage storage area in the basement is available. It is not excessive. 
A water fountain, a kettle, and coffee, tea, and herbal tea are available for free in the reception lobby. I was able to leave my ice packs in the bar's freezer. I appreciated that, especially with the heat. 
The prices for drinks at the bar are excessive. Small neighborhood supermarkets sell chilled bottles of water at a lower price.
Air conditioning in the room.
Housekeeping perfectly performed by the room attendant - 6th floor.
It is possible to order pizzas delivered to the hotel.
I preferred to go to an Italian restaurant - rue du chateau Landon offering takeout. 
I recommend this hotel near Grévin, Montmartre, Canal St Martin, and Père Lachaise.

author: cmalvern
title: Ok but not great
text: This hotel is ok but having just stayed at the Ibis Hotel Gare de Lyon Ledru for the same money, I have to say this hotel had much smaller rooms and less good air con, and much less in the way of communal areas. We had an issue of the fire alarm going off in the night, and there was little information from staff (and no apology for having to leave our rooms for an hour in the middle of the night!). I wouldn't stay here again.

author: Juan R
title: Correct, nothing more.
text:
The hotel is very basic. The room was large but without relevant details. The air conditioning wasn't even noticeable (we were in a heat wave). We didn't have a refrigerator. 
The bathroom, clean, nothing more. 
As for the location, it was great, very central and a few meters from the train and the subway. 
Correct, no frills.

author: asmcm17
title: Very good stay in Paris
text: Great hotel well located for visiting Paris. The rooftop bar is magnificent with a superb view of the Eiffel Tower. Pleasant and helpful staff. Excellent bedding we were in a suite on the top floor

author: Bev F
title: Lacking!
text: Dark, gloomy rooms. No shelf in bathroom to put anything. No way to hang a towel. Pillows like concrete  PAPER cups no china or even one glass.  Basin did not hold water.  Cutlery in restaurant fit for the bin.

author: Nora
title: Personal item missing after return
text: A personal item went missing after we returned to our room. I contacted the hotel and still await an update. This is the first time something like this happened to me. I feel extremely upset about this.

author: Leemabon
title: AVOID unsafe
text:
We booked a family room for 2 young children/infant and 2 adults to share the same room. We arrived to a broken and unsafe bed. We told reception immediately and was informed they would get someone to deal with it. We got back at 2200 to find they could not fix it and only offered a blanket at the time to fix it which clearly does not fix a completely broken bed. They wouldn’t give us another room as they did not have any family rooms available. The only option was to separate us on two completely different floors as it was so late we had no choice. Our original room that my wife and other child stayed in wasn’t the cleanest either. The balcony hadn’t been cleaned and was covered in bird faeces. In the morning we found our towels or where the towels were kept had a clump of black hair (none of us have black hair) and a large hair in the shower. Completely unsatisfied we had other options of hotel rooms and even more if we were willing to separate elsewhere but we went with Novotel as we felt it should have been a safe choice but that was not the case. 

No manager on site and does not reply to emails. We booked through hotels.com and they have said if the manager ignores the emails there’s nothing they can do so my advice AVOID

author: Jonsonwhanau
title: Disappointing stay
text:
The hotel has a fantastic location, with easy access to transport and within walking distance of the Eiffel Tower. The bar also has a wonderful view of the Eiffel Tower, which was a lovely feature.

Unfortunately, our experience with the hotel itself was very disappointing. The rooms were quite small, which is understandable for Paris, but the biggest issue was the extremely strong chemical smell in our room when we arrived. As soon as we entered, the smell was overwhelming and our daughter struggled to breathe. We immediately went to reception for help, but unfortunately they were not very helpful.

Because of the smell, we had to sit in the bar area for over an hour while we left the window open to try and air the room out. We even approached management around midnight, but were told there was nothing they could do. With it being so late, we had no other option but to stay.

The chemical smell never disappeared during our entire four-night stay. We had to sleep with the window open every night, and all three of us experienced breathing issues throughout our stay.

We also requested an iron three times and never received one, which was frustrating.

While the location and Eiffel Tower views are excellent, the lack of assistance from staff and the unresolved room issue significantly impacted our stay. A great location, but unfortunately the service and room experience did not meet expectations.

author: Elizabeth M
title: Lovely stay
text: We had a lovely stay at Hotel Ares Eiffel.  The rooms are comfortable, clean, and lovely.  The staff are welcoming and kind, especially Enzo and Roberto.  Highly recommend.  Location is great.

author: Irene C
title: Our new home 🏠 in Paris 🥰!
text:
A simply unforgettable experience!
We discovered Hotel Ares by pure chance during our trip, and it has become one of the reasons why Paris will forever remain among our most beautiful memories 😍!
What makes the real difference is the owner Enrico: a person of rare kindness, warmth, and hospitality. Together with the whole staff, always alert, attentive, and incredibly helpful, he made us feel welcomed and pampered from the first to the last moment!
The hotel boasts a truly strategic location, very convenient to the subway and a stone's throw from the Eiffel Tower, perfect for treating ourselves to wonderful and romantic evening walks 💕! The price-quality ratio is exceptional, with a very high level of service and a truly delicious, rich, and well-cared-for breakfast 😋!
From now on I won't have to look for where to sleep anymore: we have finally found our second home in Paris 🏠!
A heartfelt thank you to Enrico and the entire extraordinary team at Hotel Ares. See you very soon❤️!

author: Suzanne C
title: Great Stay!
text: Wonderful stay! Nice personnel. Excellent air-conditioning.! comfortable beds!

author: Marcella T
title: 5 stars for the location, 10 minutes from the Eiffel Tower and much more, but for the rest, the hotel gets lost in important details
text: Hotel note: 5 stars for its exceptional location; false advertising because the website offers the classic double room at 14/16 and the superior at 16/18, while in reality, the hotel is dishonest and deceptive because it assigns guests who have booked and paid in advance via an agency the 12 m² classic room, which is really small and is clearly a single room presented as a double room. After our complaints, they changed our room… a little bigger, but the toilet was separate from the bathroom and there was no bidet; the tiny 30 x 30 cm closet, intended for storing shirts and other clothes, was occupied by the refrigerator and the safe; the bedside tables are stools without drawers for underwear, unlike what is usually done in other hotels, even 3-star ones; the bathroom fan has been out of order for 7 days; the lightbulb in the wall-mounted magnifying mirror is burnt out; there are no hooks; no vanity unit under the sink to store toiletries… In short! Negative note: 1 star. The reception staff was kind and helpful, but the Italian owner never came to help us translate or to show us to our small room. It's a shame, because the building is magnificent and the hotel is elegant, with an Italian design that, unfortunately, gets lost in the important details.

author: Mariana M
title: Paris 2026
text: The staff is super friendly, rooms are nice and clean, located steps away from the Eiffel Tower

author: Hayley G
title: Great location & comfy beds!
text: Stayed here for 4 nights with my daughter. Room cleaned everyday, fresh towels everyday, beds super comfy! Yes the bathroom is small but definitely usable! Tv & air con good. The breakfast was open from 6am which was great as we were getting picked up for our flight home at 6.30am. Plenty of choice   fresh bakery , choice of hot & cold drinks. Location good   lots of restaurants nearby, 10 min walk to the Eiffel tower.  I would strongly recommend downloading the Uber app & using that to get about..very cheap compared to normal taxis.  Staff were friendly enough but no helpful when asked questions about the city & where to go etc. .overall I would definitely recommend staying here. Thanks for having us. 26/082026.  Guzel family.

author: Amy F
title: Ok for £
text:
Let start with the positives- 
Clean
Comfortable
Modern
Nice check out experience
Great location!

Negatives-
Tiny room and bathroom was comparable to an airplane toilet, not pleasant although very clean. However online photos do not reflect this size at all.

author: Florence G
title: Catastrophic.
text: We tried to postpone our stay several times, the first time a month before the date. Then 1 week before. They all refused. In addition to taking the money, he adds a 29 euro tax and obviously the rental fee.

author: Melisa C
title: Berbat
text: The reception staff were completely unhelpful; we booked this place trusting the Ibis brand, but we regretted it. The double rooms were tiny—it was impossible to fit inside the shower cubicle—and the sink was dirty. The room also reeked of strong detergent. We asked to change rooms, but they refused; the receptionist even snapped at us, telling us we should have read the details when making the reservation. I would never recommend this place. And there is no freezer and water

author: addictedtotravel2015
title: Excellent location.
text:
A quiet, comfortable and very well-appointed hotel. It is perfect for visiting Les Invalides, Rodin, Eiffel Tower and Grand and Petit Palais. The champs de Elysées and Arc de Triomphe are both within walking distance and there are lots of good restaurants within close proximity. It is also very close to the Metro stop, so easy to get to. This is not my first visit and despite what I will say next, I would still use it again, as it so well positioned.

However, despite the positioning and comfort, there are a number of issues that Ibis/Accor might want to consider.

I was surprised that a few days before I was due to arrive, I had a deposit charged to my credit card, which was the equivalent of one night’s visit. That is fine, especially if it then comes off the final bill when you pay that. However, it is only refunded after you check-out. So, upon arrival at the hotel I paid for the two nights I was staying alongside the deposit. I am glad that I used my credit card to pay rather than a debit card, otherwise I would have been £100 out of pocket. I am surprised that the deposit is not used as part payment toward the actual stay. Perhaps, something the multi-billion-dollar business can investigate improving.

Upon arriving after a day of exploring on my second evening, I boarded an elevator with one of the employees of the hotel. The lift broke down and did not move. He called the emergency number but that was engaged, I pressed the emergency alarm but that was ignored or did not work. The employee then started to bang on the door and shout loudly for help to no avail. Eventually, I forced the door open, escaped and let the employee out. He went to find his colleague and I spoke to reception. The response of the receptionist, other than a look of disbelief left a lot to be desired. No apologies, no offer of compensation, a drink at the bar on the House. Instead, she went out to find the maintenance chaps who were outside. By the time I returned there was a sign on the lift confirming it was faulty.

Finally, be prepared to have to fork out €6 to store your luggage in a locker in the hotel basement, if there are any available. By the time I went down at about 10.30 they were all full and people were abandoning their bags around the luggage room. Given the hotel has over 500 rooms, I cannot believe they do not have better provision for left luggage and do not expect people to pay for the most basic of services. 

So, despite all of this, I am looking forward to my next visit and hopefully a visit to Grand and Petit Palais.

author: stylishmodeon
title: Eiffel Tower view
text: Spacious room! Excellent breakfast. Pleasant hotel! Availability from the concierges for luggage storage! A few steps from the Eiffel Tower! Truly pleasant.

author: jessykyna
title: Excellent location!
text:
Very convenient hotel, 10 min and you are under the Eiffel Tower. 
The only downside is the limited choice for breakfast. The staff is super kind!

author: Ella K
title: Amazing view
text:
Crine was a real highlight of our stay—always so welcoming, smiley, and genuinely lovely. In fact, all the staff were absolutely delightful and made us feel very comfortable throughout.
The location is gorgeous, and being able to see the Eiffel Tower from our window was a special touch. Breakfast was also really nice—simple, but very tasty.

However, there were a few downsides. The lift broke down three times during our stay, including once while we were inside, which meant we had to do a lot of stair climbing up to our room on the fifth floor. The room itself was also much smaller than we expected and felt very tight for the price we paid. Unfortunately, we don’t feel it was good value overall.

author: Mark T
title: Memorable Paris stay
text:
Hotel 15-20 min walk to Eiffel Tower. 200 mts from Metro (trains).  Within 2 blocks many Cafes & Restaurants. Small Hotel, but met our needs, clean, comfortable. Close tour pickup points, enabling plenty of time for sightseeing.
Night time photo of Eiffel Tower from outside Hotel.

author: Florian D
title: A stay at the top!
text:
Very nice stay at this hotel!
The property is nice, clean and perfectly maintained. It feels good from the arrival.

The staff is welcoming, professional and always available, making the stay even more enjoyable.

The room was comfortable, well equipped and ideal for resting after a busy day.

I recommend this hotel without hesitation and will be back with pleasure!

author: Andrea G
title: Great for business travellers
text: A regular hotel for a reason and with friendly staff, a modern aesthetic, lovely rooms with a handy good quality restaurant if you're not going out. Such a difference from the larger chains that can feel impersonal. Yes, there's a small gym too. Highly recommend for business.

author: Naomi W
title: Great find, fabulous location
text:
This is a great find. Minutes from Euston, Roos a decent size for central London although we did go for the slightly bigger deluxe room. Coffee machine, iron, lovely robes and bed linen, would recommend highly. Bar are is love,y, staff really friendly. 
Could do with more toiletries and the breakfast selection could be bigger. Would definitely stay again.

author: LauraBassford
title: Room claustrophobic
text:
Room and bed far too small - booked a double room but felt like a three quarter bed — very claustrophobic I’m afraid. Was in room 613 - avoid if you like a bit of spaces.

Otherwise good positioned hotel not far from the train station and very clean

author: Imogen B
title: Bad deposit experience - check other reviews
text: Stayed here for a concert last Friday with my friend. Room was nice and so were staff, location was great. But they’ve taken a deposit of £50 on top of the full amount paid. I am yet to get it back and it’s been almost a week. When leaving I was told it could be up to 10 days before being refunded which is ridiculous in all honesty. I’m beginning to worry as other reviews have said similar and some people have waited longer than 10 days. This hotel should rethink their deposit system as it’s genuinely put me off staying here again.

author: Neil A
title: All round great experience
text: Bright and welcoming hotel, very friendly staff

author: Twinkle
title: Unfortunately disappointing
text: Booked this hotel on the day of travel and having stayed at a Berjaya some years previously (albeit in the Seychelles) I expected a similar standard - budget but clean and comfortable. Initial impressions were favourable when I dropped my luggage too early for check-in. The reception is light and there were fresh flowers and very friendly staff. The hotel is situated a few minutes walk from both Bayswater and Queensway tube stations and is surrounded by shops, bars and restaurants. I returned late that evening to check in and was given a basement room in an area of the hotel accessed by an unappealing corridor clearly in need of renovation. I fully appreciate I was in a single room at a reasonable price (for that particular date in central London compared to other available hotels) and I had booked last minute. However the room was well below the acceptable standard of its type. There was grime and debris around the window in the basement which was clearly overlooked by pedestrians on the street above. There was a tatty curtain and I had a direct view of the semi naked occupant of the room at right angles to mine who had not drawn their torn curtain and was laid in full view on the bed. As it was so late I slept there the first night. The shower room the next morning proved to have a dirty window with no blind in the shower area and an unhygienic looking shower curtain, a tiny utility room sized sink and a toilet all crammed into a cupboard sized space. The staff were very accommodating when I asked for another room for my second night and this one was basic but sufficient for one late night sleep post-theatre. Despite it’s excellent location and good staff I would not stay here again or recommend this hotel. It needs a through renovation and rooms the standard of my first one should not be sold to guests under any circumstances. The loss of revenue for a substandard room is considerably less detrimental to a hotel than a negative review I would think.
