author: Catherine F
title: A great find
text: A gem of a find. Superb location no more than five mins from two tube stations. Plenty of shops bars and restaurants around. We were in a newly renovated room which was ideal as a base for the weekend. So pleased we have already booked for December.

author: Annalisa C
title: An experience I do not recommend!
text: The room does not match the hotel's room photos; it is located in a basement, small and unpleasant, there is not even drinking water, and we had to buy bottled water to brush our teeth.

author: Dave
title: Decent hotel centre if London
text: Stayed here a few times nice central hotel convenient for everything in London near tubes car park etc . Good breakfast in side conservatory

author: Craig R
title: One night's acceptable
text: Room 230 Very creeky floors and maze like building.. Windows have huge gaps allowing in all the noice and the curtains let in all the light. I was woken up at 6am every morning! By light or noice For 4x nights. Doors slamming is a issues was woken up at 3am and 4 am 2 nights from guests slamming closed their doors. The light and noise gets in as if I'm sleeping in a tent! Even the door has gaps... Issues with TV goin black it times out or if u keep searching channels it goes black u have to restart the TV. house keeping was above and beyond that was impressive but god help u if they clean the next room very noisy at 9am! Very! .. Front desk good too customer service is valued here. The ac unit in upgraded rooms is good if not a little unresponsive . First checked in I unpacked which took an hour then tried to to take a shower.. No hot water I had to pack and unpack again to change rooms on another floor to access hot water.  the shower is either too hot or too cold it's very hard to regulate a temperature you want. Paid 80.00 a night I can't stay here again as the basics noise and light was way way to much this is a one night hotel only for those reason.

author: Connector53506714354
title: Really bad service by reception!!
text:
Very disappointed with the staff
I’ve been sent a package which arrived after my departure, trying to talk with the staff nonstop through WhatsApp, booking and mail but couldn’t get a hold from them for days! When I did get a response back I’ve been told to send a parcel and they’ll help with the delivery, I paid 70£ to send a percal and they are avoiding it and not answering.
Really frustrating and disappointing

author: Tufty59
title: Another great stay
text:
Another great stay here. Renovated rooms are great and so well equipped with fridge, safe etc.. Staff at check in so delightful.
Breakfast in bed for a second time as the restaurant has not yet finished being renovated. Great choices which you give to reception the night before and choose your time for breakfast. Could not be faulted.
Location perfect.
Just one disappointment as I was not given my discount in the bar for being a Club member. I was told I did not qualify. Bar staff were incorrect.
Look forward to my next stay. Thank you all.

author: MaxPaul
title: An excellent stay.  Great value & newly renovated.
text: Despite this hotel currently undergoing a full renovation my 80 year old Mum and I had a wonderful 2 night stay.  All the staff, without exception were friendly and super helpful.  Our room (307), a superior king size was beautiful for a 4 star hotel.  Newly refurbished it was impeccably clean and had all conveniences needed.  The room was large and airy with air conditioning.  The breakfast room was out of action due to the renovations but breakfast was delivered promptly to our room at the time we ordered & the food was warm & well presented.  Breakfast in bed was a bit of a treat!  The was NO noise associated with the renovations.  The location of this hotel is excellent especially for discovering the gorgeous Marylebone, Mayfair, Bond Street, Regent Street & Oxford Street areas.  All in all an excellent experience and I will definitely use this hotel again in the future.

author: RAJ KUMAR S
title: Feedback: Radisson Blu Bond Street – Front Desk Conduct
text:
I am writing to raise a serious concern about the conduct of two front desk staff members, Yvonne and Jerian, during our stay on 31st July (Rooms 710 and 412).

The day before checkout, we informed the hotel that we would need a late checkout at 1pm due to a medical reason. Unfortunately, this information was not communicated by the night duty staff to Yvonne and Jerian on the following shift.

When we mentioned the late checkout again on our way out for breakfast that morning, Jerian responded very rudely and even said they would have us removed from the hotel. Yvonne was also present during this interaction and showed no acknowledgement or apology for how we were being spoken to, despite the situation clearly being handled poorly.

To make matters worse, when we returned to the hotel at 11:15am, we found that our room keys had already been disabled, despite it still being well before the checkout time we had discussed.

We also felt that we were treated noticeably differently from other, non-Asian guests during this interaction, which raised concerns about possible discriminatory treatment.

Given this experience, I cannot recommend this hotel to others, as the front desk staff's behaviour fell well short of the standard expected of a Radisson property.

I would appreciate a formal response addressing this incident.

author: Ian12505
title: Top dollar price, mid range service at best.
text: The hotel is undergoing a refurbishment and of course they fail to mention this when you book a room. On the good side our room was in excellent condition, although lacking a table/desk. On the bad side all breakfasts had to be delivered to the room - this would have been okay if there was a table, but having to eat a full English sitting perched on the sofa was not what we had expected from a four star hotel. The reception was woefully under-staffed, with just one receptionist on duty when we checked in. It was chaotic and they had lost record of the extras we had booked. Nine hours later when we came back from an evening out, the same receptionist was still dutifully manning reception with no assistance.  For the price charged this wasn't a great experience.

author: Julie B
title: This is not a Hilton anymore
text:
This is not a Hilton hotel anymore it’s ao
Hostels. So as it’s changed hands there is no hairdryer, fridge or iron in room
And no tea or coffee facilities. No facilities for towel changes etc unless you book in online. Breakfast is now diy!! Coffee is rubbish. Bar is hardly open,  nowhere to refill water bottles (we stayed in 40 degree heatwave). The aircon didn’t work, couldn’t cancel
Room to
Move, no fans. No gym or swimming anymore. 
Ao have ruined a lovely hotel where we have stayed many times but will never stay again!!!

author: PENNY W
title: This hotel will be my one of choice now for Excel visits as staff were wonderful
text: Staff were accommodating with travelling with unwell child and so helpful - room was lovely with a great view and breakfast was excellent - will stay again

author: M K
title: Hilton did not hit the Heights . .
text: Stayed over the weekend of 09/01/26 for couple of days, outside first impressions were good, views of the river were nice, walked through into reception, sadly not greeted with a hello or welcome by the indian staff member. He simply asked the name room was booked under, he then asked if we had a car, I gave my registration which is 5 letters, once, staff member did'nt get it said it twice, still did not get it then a third time, at this point I was like what is this guy on, he cannot understand 5 letters, the staff member then loked at us and said I'm only trying to help yeah, as I don't have to enter you're car details on our system, I said hand on mate, I have already paid for 24 hour parking so there is no need for you to give us this attitude of yours. Staff member said you want my help or not, I was like 'WOW' this is how Hilton Doubletree train their staff in speaking with guests. After this start we both did not really want to stay there. but we heeded up to our room anyways. Room was ok not greta as advertised on their website, but hey, such is life. The heating in room was loud and noisey, and did not help with sleep. Checkout day, head down dfor breakfast, and sadly the food under the lights was not set right as most of the food was dry and overcooked, scrambled eggs were dry and wet underneath, fried eggs where more like bolied eggs and the beans were rock hard and dry, had to settle for a cup of tea and toast instead. Like I said not a great let alone a good experience at Hilton Doubletree in Docklands, I would not recommend this to anyone.

author: JeanMichelle
title: Good report Price / Quality
text: Went there on the 25'th and 26'th December 2025. Dead quiet (how I wanted to be). Clean place, nice voew and ... 24/7 bar. If you are looking for a place to hide for few days.. this is the one.

author: Matt L
title: Hero to Zero…
text:
Never in the field of hospitality, has a hotel sunk so far, so fast.

As a Hilton Doubletree this place was fantastic - great service, nice rooms, decent gym, A1 breakfast.

As an A&O Hostel (??? 😬) it’s all very basic.  

Self check in using a scan QR code and then filling out a web page - even though the desk is staffed and they need you to provide details to issue the room key 🤷‍♂️

Rooms - very basic, all the nice bits gone - complementary water, WiFi etc.

Gym - gone.

Breakfast - they give you a paper QR code to scan so you can get a ‘hostel’ breakfast from the bar.

When you check out, they charge you despite the company having paid the booking already ‘because that was with Hilton’ (…🤔).  If it was my money, I’d have kicked off - but the company will claw it back anyway.

In sum, avoid.  What a tragedy - this place was proper class but is now very basic.

author: Susan H
title: Exceptional Hotel, Even More Exceptional Staff
text:
I truly can’t say enough good things about our stay at The Rubens at the Palace. The location is wonderful, but what really sets this hotel apart is the staff. They were absolutely spectacular and made our entire experience feel special from beginning to end.

We were traveling as a family with three young children, and the little touches for kids were amazing. From their own check-in experience to the complimentary pastry experience, it was clear that the hotel genuinely thinks about how to make younger guests feel welcome, too. After Shristi brought our kids back from their time in the kitchen, my daughter excitedly announced that she needed to be back at work the next morning at 6 a.m.! She and her brother were absolutely thrilled, and it was one of those little vacation memories I know we'll be talking about for a long time.

As a larger family, we booked two suites, and we were incredibly fortunate to have one of them upgraded to the King’s Suite. It was spectacular. We joked that we truly did feel like kings staying there!

But as lovely as the hotel itself is, it really was the people who made our stay so memorable. Everyone we encountered was warm, gracious, and seemed genuinely interested in making sure our family had a wonderful time.

The Rubens was one of the highlights of our trip to London. I sincerely hope we have the opportunity to return someday as I wouldn’t hesitate for a second to stay here again!

author: LuLu322
title: Lovely Hotel In A Perfect Location
text:
We had a really lovely time staying at The Rubens At The Palace Hotel.

It's a lovely comfortable hotel and the staff are very pleasant, friendly and accommodating.  

It's perfectly located for sightseeing in London and we would definitely recommend and would return.

author: Victoria L
title: The Rubens at the Palace  set the Bar of Excellence High
text: The Rubens was lovely accommodations from the moment Pascal opened the door. Joe and Sophie’s Customer Service at the front desk was extraordinary. It was an incredible stay where every detail that I requested was fulfilled.  The decor and the attention to detail for the comfort of the guests was exactly like the photos. The location in the Victoria area was steps away from the palace and also the tube which was very convenient. Whenever I’m in London, I will be staying at the Ruben‘s❣️

author: John P
title: They’re thieves
text:
We stayed with our family at the Ruben..… it was nice and clean…BUT, I got hurt getting out of a metal chair the second night.. I’m 82 and take blood thinner’s…I bled on the bed and mattress with no fault of mine… you can’t control your bleeding…I had my cut wrapped real well but it bled through….cleaning lady assured me she had gotten the blood cleaned up so I didn’t think anything else about it… we stayed several more nights… when we checked out and looked at our bill, they had charged us 1040.00 dollars for the Mattress… we argued with them and even talked to the manager but they would not give our money back…I would definitely advise NO ONE TO STAY THERE!!!!!!!  Many people that stay there after paying for their trip cannot afford the extra expense… they said they charged us because it was bodily fluids… it cannot be helped if you sleep on a bed to leave some type of bodily fluids… again DO NOT STAY AT THE RUBEN HOTEL because every person leaves behind “bodily fluids”…and you might get charged for a mattress!!!!
J. Purvis

author: Sightsee22471742855
title: Best hotel experience
text: Excellent concierge Taylor Masters, doorman Traves, Robert made our stay very comfortable

author: Xavier d
title: ZEDWELL PICADILLY CIRCUS
text: Very close to Piccadilly Circus and near underground, Zedwell is very well situated. rather confortable but not very cocooning. I would recommend the place if you are looking for a medium class hotel to sleep in and visit London.

author: Scarlett R
title: Disrespectful staff and hidden fees, not worth the money!!
text:
We stayed for 2 nights this week and decided never again!

We came here for the first time in 2021 and it was lovely, returning this year though we were met with a very different atmosphere. Staff were ridiculously rude, not even bothering to listen to us speak when we arrived earlier than check in time before interrupting telling us we must pay £40 to stay in the hotel before 2:30 or pay £15 for them to store our suitcase for 45 minutes. 

We then got given a room that looked like a prison cell, a massive room with two beds and a mirror, nothing else and definitely nothing like the pictures. After arguing with staff we eventually got moved to a better room that actually held some resemblance to what we expected, they only listened to what I had to say because I told them I had stayed there before and the room was not like that.

This hotel is ridiculously expensive for what it is and there are so many hidden fees such as £50 for an extra 2 hours in the room. The only plus of this hotel is the location but it still is not worth it, the room was clean but the soaps were almost entirely empty and the toilet was disgusting.

This was a lovely place to stay until they hired rude staff and became money grabbing instead of having any regard for guests comfort. especially at such a high initial price for a room with nothing in  we will definitely not return to this hotel again

author: TomitheFinn
title: Tranquil setting in a fantastic location
text: Great tranquil setting in the heart of piccadily circus. Helpful and friendly staff and comfortable double beds and no noise. Kids loved the cocoon 8 room set up

author: Antrea C
title: TERRIBLE- BED BUGS
text: DONT GO THERE I STAYED THERE WITH MY PARTNER FOR TWO NIGHTS AND WE SAW A BED BUG, we are both covered in BED BITES and we had to spend a lot of money to deal with it

author: Arta R
title: Trip to London
text: Very good located hotel near everything. With easy check-in and check-out. The only thing that has to improve it's the cleaning. The room was not vacuumed and the sink in the restroom was dirty.

author: Carmen Garcia
title: Mama Mia
text: Hotel very well located, it is close to the entrance to the Vatican Museum, it is close to several restaurants, breakfast is included in the reservation, we stayed for 3 days, a pity that the Wi-Fi only reopened a day before we left, out of that the hotel is very good, a suggestion: exchange the beds for more modern beds!

author: Oscar R
title: Hotel disappointment
text:
The good thing is that it is well located, but we left unhappy, why?
Because we have been on a week-long trip at this same hotel, they have not changed our sheets all week, they have not cleaned the room floor at all, they have not cleaned anything in the bathroom, and one day they didn't even come in because they didn't even take the trash bag; the only good thing is that they changed our towels daily.

Dirty bathroom, dirty and very small shower; a person of normal build can shower but not comfortably, the shower head looked white from limescale, dampness on the ceiling.

The buffet is... it's like a cafeteria, with little variety but good; you can have a reasonably good breakfast.

Magnificent customer service from the people who control access to the hotel.

Failure of the card to enter the room; in one week I have had to go down 3 times to have the card reactivated because it kept deactivating on its own.

Regarding the cleaning... the room has a refrigerator, well, they didn't even clean it before we checked in, because when opening the refrigerator we saw a yellow dirt mark, we didn't know what it was, but after 3 days I wanted to open the freezer to put water in, and we found an ice cream and a bottle of water from the previous guests who were in that same room, added to the fact that the refrigerator also had its dirty shelf.

Regarding the beds and bedding... they had dirt stains, the pillow was unbearable.

I consider that it really has more of a one-to-two-star hotel condition, in my opinion.

In other words, an experience not to be repeated; the only good thing this hotel has, in our opinion, is the location, which is 5 minutes from the Vatican and another 5 from the Ottaviano station, from which you can get to Roma Termini and from there take any train or bus if necessary.

To finish, we understand that sheets cannot be changed daily, or a deep cleaning done daily, we understand that, but changing the sheets every 3-4 days (once a week… we are not asking for much), we also understand that they do not sweep every day, but every two days, cleaning the mirror… I do not want it cleaned every day, but every two or three days would be fine; that is to say, we are not people who are always looking for dirt, but it is true that we had to complain since many parts of the room were truly disgusting. 

I hope this review serves to improve everything so that future guests can enjoy it 100%.

author: Leilani P
title: Amazing
text: I had a wonderful stay at this hotel. The accommodations were clean, comfortable, and well-maintained, making my visit very relaxing. The staff was friendly, professional, and always willing to help with anything I needed.

author: Allison G
title: Great hotel and amazing staff.
text: Lovely clean hotel with fantastic and helpful staff. Nothing was too much trouble for them, they went above and beyond to help us. The rooms were cool and spacious, (the air con was a blessing), and the rooms were cleaned meticulously. This hotel is perfectly placed for eating out and exploring the city, easy walk to the tube station, and Lime bikes were always available close by for early morning city bike rides.

author: Arjonarocio
title: End-of-year trip
text: Bad hotel for an end-of-year trip; on the second night they blocked the doors of the rooms, and the children had to sleep outside the room, relocating to other rooms and sleeping on the floor. If they are not prepared to accommodate 16-year-old teenagers, they should cater to a different type of clientele.

author: Cui
title: Fair
text: Poor customer service and the location is not ideal for walking around the city. One thing that caught our attention is that they charge for ice! And the concierge was very inattentive.

author: Priscila M
title: Excellent!!
text: We were on an excursion. Excellent service.  Very good room, clean, comfortable bed, shower, air conditioning, excellent breakfast.

author: Guillermo S
title: Comfortable
text: Room could be a bit more spacious but it was nice. Also air conditioning could be a little better.

author: Arham F
title: My First NH Hotel Stay
text: Good location, although the nearby Metro is closed, it is still walkable distance from nearby attraction. Modern building and facilities. Staff is very nice and welcoming. Breakfast is among one of the better one in vicinity. If you choose the room with view, you can get a clear view of Saint Peter’s Basilica.

author: Bernard Chambré
title: Excellent place to sleep and eat!
text:
Everything is perfect. Welcome, services, gastronomy... excellent!
Don't miss the warm bread that you dip in olive oil!

author: Fatima Iannini de Arede
title: Rome doesn't deserve a hotel as bad as this
text:
The box barely gives a person to take a shower, The shower doesn't work, The bar fridge doesn't open and doesn't freeze, I ask the staff for assistance, Horrible breakfast, You're charged €10 to use the pool.
Air conditioning does not work and does not freeze.
We had to change apartments because of the air conditioning and we were placed in another room that also does not work. Responsible for the maintenance said that the minimum air temperature is 24° which means we have to stay in a muggy, warm closed room. I took pictures to approve of everything I'm saying. The shower doesn't get stuck. The room is minimal we can barely get to the window. It has an elevator for four people and numerous apartments.

author: Sertaç K
title: DONT Come This Hotel
text:
Our stay at this hotel was a complete disappointment. The quality of service was extremely poor. There was not even a coffee machine in the room, although this is now considered a basic facility in many hotels.
The breakfast was very poor in both quality and variety. What was even more disturbing was that, as Turkish guests, we were directed to a separate seating area during breakfast. This made us feel discriminated against and was completely unacceptable. All guests should be treated equally, regardless of their nationality.
In addition, while we were leaving the hotel by bus, a theft occurred in the hotel’s garden area. This raised serious concerns about the adequacy of the hotel’s security measures.
In summary, the breakfast quality was terrible, the service was practically nonexistent, security was inadequate, and the attitude toward guests was deeply uncomfortable. We were extremely dissatisfied with our experience at Belstay Roma Aurelia. I definitely do not recommend this hotel.

author: Mariacristina67
title: Terrible youth hostel
text:
Hotel rated 4 stars on paper… two were given, rather bought. 
Hotel at the limits of decency; I would define it at most as a hostel. Outdated, terrible cleanliness, horrible carpet everywhere with huge stains, bad smell both in the elevators and in the areas. 
Overrun by hordes of screaming kids day and night, staying there for sports reasons. The room was not clean; upon arrival, there was a malfunction in the bathroom, the products were never renewed, a disaster. I refrain from commenting on the food because I would become vulgar. The location is terrible, far from any possible communication with civilization. I am attaching funny photos, especially the last one...

author: agostinomaria t
title: Conference. Medical.
text: I worked at a meeting, I found Massimo the technician, very kind and well-prepared; the food was excellent and the room was very comfortable. I recommend it.

author: Miromini
title: Nice but decentralized.
text:
The hotel is very decentralized, although there is a free shuttle available twice in the morning and other times in the afternoon to the nearest metro station.
Very large and modern hotel.
Good breakfast, spacious rooms, and bathroom.
Excellent check-in and check-out service.
Unfortunately, the in-house restaurant is not of the same quality, and it is a shame because there are no nearby restaurants as an alternative.

author: Maaanonjs
title: Perfect
text:
Spacious, comfortable, very clean rooms, bathtub, fridge PERFECT, tea and coffee provided every day along with housekeeping 
Heated, supervised pools and towels available! The breakfast is of varied quality and very good! The staff is very pleasant, attentive, and smiling! A 5-minute walk from the Muratella station which takes you into Rome (48h pass €15/adult)

author: Cleo P
title: Exceptional stay with just a few small details to smooth out.
text:
We had a truly very pleasant stay at this hotel, a very comfortable property equipped with excellent services.
 The interior spaces are large and bright, and the private car parking is a big plus in terms of convenience. The pool is well-maintained, clean, and perfect for relaxation.
 Dining: The absolute strong point! We both had lunch and dinner at the restaurant, enjoying truly excellent and well-prepared dishes. The breakfast is simply amazing: a rich buffet with a huge selection of both sweet and savory options.
 Rooms, spacious and livable, even if you can tell from the decor that they are a bit dated. Overall, however, they are clean and functional.
 Staff: Overall, we found the staff to be kind and helpful. The only sour note concerns the restaurant dining room manager (the gentleman in the black suit): a little more politeness wouldn't hurt, especially when interacting with customers. First of all, you greet people, and only then do you ask if you can be of help.
Overall, it is an excellent property where I would gladly return. A touch more courtesy in the dining room and a restyling of the rooms would be enough to reach perfection.

author: canadatraveller72
title: Perfect Last Day Hotel in Rome
text: This is a North American style hotel. Rooms are large with excellent air conditioning. Great amenities with a pool, fitness center, snack bar, and restaurant. Close to airport which makes it the perfect last day hotel in Rome.

author: jenniferlynne21
title: Swimming caps required for everyone at the pool
text: Location is near the airport so it’s convenient for a one night stay for a flight home. We are here now (August 11, 2026) and apparently it is common in Italy for pools to require bathing caps- they do here. I get that it’s a rule, but I can’t make myself do it haha. Lifeguard said it’s a government rule  but interestingly enough the hotel I just left in Tuscany today did not require it and neither did our hotel in Sorrento a few days before that. I did some reading online and higher-end hotels and resorts often waive this rule for aesthetic reasons.  I don’t know many grown adults that will willingly don one of these awful things. So keep that in mind before you book!

author: super paolone
title: Birthday
text: We celebrated the birthday of my dear friend Marco in a very beautiful location where everything was perfect.

author: tdornber
title: Nice Note, Bad Location
text: We just came home from Rome, staying at the Hotel Morgana.  My thoughts on this hotel are not bad but they're not great either.  Don't get me wrong, the hotel is nice, clean, but it wasn't a great hotel.  First the good.  Like I said, the room was clean.  We had a nice view overseeing the front street.  The rooms on the inner side of the hotel have a horrible view.  The breakfast buffet was also fine, not great.  Now for the bad.  The hotel is very small, outdated, and is in a very BAD part of town.  How small?  Well you ever get on an elevator and see the sign that says capacity is like 25 or 30 people.  This hotel had an elevator with a capacity of THREE.  My wife and I got on with our two suitcases and there wasn't any more room.  I'm talking small.  The hotel buffet was ok but the eggs tasted like fish.  Not sure if that's a European thing or not but I tasted like they cooked salmon just before scrambling the eggs.  They also had hotdogs and chicken wings on the BREAKFAST buffet.  And the location was terrible.  There was a homeless campsite 1/2 block up the street and we witnessed two fist fights right in front of the hotel.  The smell of urine hit you immediately upon leaving the hotel.  And the hotel kept their main door locked at all times.  You had to be buzzed in every time.  But the staff were very nice, polite, and helpful.  So my bottom line on the Hotel Morgana is.......nice hotel, very bad location.  Would I stay here again?  Definitely not.

author: kiddies03
title: most disappointing hotel experiences we have had in our many years of traveling.
text:
This was by far one of the most disappointing hotel experiences we have had in our many years of traveling.

The location felt unsafe and was nothing like what we expected from a hotel claiming to be in the 4- or 5-star category. The surrounding area was covered in graffiti and frequented by questionable characters, making us uncomfortable every time we left or returned to the hotel.

The hotel itself is extremely dated and in need of significant renovation. Our room overlooked a dirty, rundown courtyard that was anything but relaxing. Every morning, we were awakened by the constant noise of kitchen staff banging pots, pans, and dishes while preparing breakfast.

What made the experience even worse was the attitude of the front desk staff. They were consistently rude, cold, and unfriendly. During our entire stay, we never felt welcomed. I have never stayed at a hotel where guests are not greeted with a simple smile or even a basic "hello."

The breakfast was mediocre at best, with very limited choices and nothing memorable. Overall, the atmosphere lacked warmth, hospitality, and the quality one would expect from a higher-rated property.

We spent three days in Rome, one of the most beautiful cities in the world, yet I literally could not wait to leave this hotel. Based on our experience, this property is nowhere near a 4- or 5-star standard. At best, I would rate it a 2-star hotel.

I would not stay here again and cannot recommend it to other travelers.

author: Scott N
title: clean, well-maintained hotel with easy access to public transportation
text:
I enjoyed my stay here.  The hotel is located near Roma Termini (the main train station), and is an easy walk from there.  This area can be a bit seedy at night, but the hotel itself seemed very safe, with attentive, 24-hour front desk staff.  Easy access to public transportation is a major benefit of this hotel.

The staff all spoke English well (helpful for this American traveler).  My room was small, but clean, comfortable, and functional.  Breakfast was not included with my room, but was reasonably priced, and the buffet offered some good choices.  Service at breakfast was very good.

author: André S
title: Good hotel, great experience
text: After reading many reviews, I confess that I was afraid. However, I think people make some demands and criticism very nothing to do. Our stay was great, the breakfast was very good, complete, everything organized and clean, with attentive staff. The room is old yes, but of good size, with a classic decor, air conditioning, heater, a good bed, tv, safe, fridge bar, coffee, hot and full water. The location is good too, close to the train station, many restaurants (destack to the Trattoria do Giovani in front), souvenir shops, close to the Santa Maria Maggiore and up to the Coliseum walking we went, thing of 15 minutes enjoying the streets. Reserve without fear.

author: GC11
title: A horrible weekend in Rome.
text:
Having come to Rome for a couple's visit with my girlfriend, we decided to choose this hotel because 
 we thought it was in a fairly strategic position to visit the city, it seemed like a great deal... but instead... a terrible choice!!
Upon arrival, we were greeted rudely and assigned a double room that smelled like a storage closet; we could barely fit our luggage and personal items inside the room. (A small bag and a small suitcase) 
Moreover, the room was dirty and the TV did not work. 
I am sorry because I had quite high expectations for this hotel, but I had to change my mind.

author: trahawk
title: Amazing staff, clean & comfy room, wonderful stay!
text: During planning, Frederica and the rest of the front desk team emailed back & forth with me many times over the course of months answering questions, offering suggestions, and making arrangements for me.  They booked our transfer from FCO to the hotel, the transfer from the hotel to pier, and a golf cart tour- which was awesome!  We highly recommend staying here - the staff is top notch and our room was clean and comfortable!

author: Tourist802139
title: Perfect located Rome stop
text:
Comfortable beds and two tier bedroom with delux. Fabulous breakfast with fresh cooked omelette made well and catering for myself dairy free. Staff very helpful and friendly, knowledgeable on  transportation to port and travel in Rome. 
Couple of tweets 
Gym all equipment should be 100% and steps in room creaky 
Love to stay will return

author: Love4Sea3
title: Great location in Rome!!
text: We were greeted by Gabriel he was very helpful in advising/recommending restaurants walking distance and he was correct. Rooms are nice and spacious we had room with three beds only needed two.  They offer breakfast at an additional charge if you like to stay.  Now I did have one mishap the shower door opens out and is not like me home where glass is locked.  I fell out of shower while it was not too bad and I recovered my elbow still hurts.  Took baths remaining of my stay.  I would recommend staying this is my third stay and not my last.

author: ryan212121
title: Highly recommended for the Termini area
text: Lovely service, convenient location, comfortable rooms, and a great rooftop bar.

author: spqr1903
title: Our Central, Comfortable Home-Away-From-Home in Roma
text: I continue to agree with the TripAdvisor review of this hotel I wrote in September 2025 -- this multi-faceted big city hotel has a friendly small town feel to it. From Anna and her colleagues at the front desk to breakfast service manager Monica and her fine service team, the staff is top notch.  The location -- close to Termini Station, Teatro dell' Opera di Roma, the Baths of Diocletian and more -- is very central. And yet the side streets facing the hotel are relatively quiet.  The breakfast offerings are very extensive, including fresh-squeezed orange juice (spremuta), and well-served; the fitness center is a rarity for a hotel in central Rome; and from our (extensive) experience here, the rooms in this solid old building are quiet.  This is not a budget hotel, but the room rates are competitive for this expensive city (it helps to be a Triple A or Best Western Rewards member).  Recommended for all, we look forward to staying here again in September of this year.

author: warrenejones1958
title: Great service.
text: I would like to Give 5 stars to the service I received by the staff. Especially Megan the customer service agent at the desk. I am a retired Hospitality manager 33 years service.  Megan assisted us and gave us a upgraded room. It was our anniversary and she made our stay exceptional. She is caring and attentive. She displayed all the core values of being a valued team member in the Hilton corporation. Hilton is very fortunate to have  her as a team member.

author: Lorenzo L
title: Excellent service and location
text: I stayed with my girlfriend and the service was excellent. The rooms are well-maintained, the breakfast has a huge variety, and the property's location is excellent. Very close to the Manzoni metro and a 15-minute walk from the Colosseum. A special thanks goes to Megan who made our stay unforgettable.

author: Tyronne W
title: Perfect location to explore Rome
text:
I have been to Italy 8 times, and to Rome four times, and I believe this is the best location by a country mile. The hotel is situated just 50 to 100 meters from the Manzoni metro station. It is quite convenient to arrive here from Roma Termini station by taking the metro on line  A (red line) towards Anagnina and getting off at the Manzoni station. Just two stops from Rome Termini. The place is safe, and there's also a nearby tram station and a bus stop. Thus, the location was the main reason for me to book this hotel. However, the hotel ticked the other facets. 

The staff are helpful and courteous. The room was clean and spacious, as was the washroom. The self-operated laundry was excellent; I wish other hotels would follow this trend so customers can clean their delicate garments with care. There is no need to worry about laundry staff ruining expensive clothes by using the wrong wash or dry cycle. The hotel has installed Miele products, and a full washing and drying cycle costs just 15 euros. The price during peak summer was reasonable. The rooms are quiet, and the sleep quality is very good.

author: Sarika G
title: A Perfect Home Base for Exploring Rome
text:
⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

My stay at the Hilton Garden Inn Rome Colosseum was outstanding from start to finish. The hotel is modern, spotless, and in a fantastic location, making it easy to explore Rome's most iconic attractions while still enjoying a peaceful and comfortable atmosphere.

The rooms were spacious, well-appointed, and exceptionally clean, with comfortable beds that made it easy to relax after a day of sightseeing. The breakfast offered a great variety of fresh, delicious options, and every member of the staff was friendly, professional, and eager to help with recommendations and any requests.

What really made the stay memorable was the genuine hospitality of the team. Everyone went out of their way to make us feel welcome and ensure we had a wonderful experience.

I highly recommend the Hilton Garden Inn Rome Colosseum to anyone visiting Rome and would gladly stay here again on my next trip.

author: Iesha
title: Great location & Great Staff
text:
Incredible location! It’s just a brief walk to all the major attractions, and public transport options, including train and bus stations, are merely a minute away on foot. The staff here are outstanding and incredibly attentive. We were so impressed with our experience that we chose to cancel our reservations at another hotel and extend our stay with them for the last few nights of our trip to Rome. We enjoyed three days here, left for ten, and can’t wait to return for another three days. The service is truly exceptional! 

The rooms are clean, the beds are comfortable, and overall, it’s just fantastic.

A few things to keep in mind: 
The elevators are quite small, so if you're traveling with more than 2-3 people and luggage, you may need to make a separate trip. However, this isn't a downside as the elevators are quick—just a heads up.

The staff is ready to assist with anything you need. Need transportation? They arranged our airport transfer. Plus, they provided guidance on using the buses and trains. 
Looking for food recommendations? They helped me discover some delicious dining options. 
Want to book tours? They’re more than willing to assist with that too. 
And if you're in the mood for a chat, they greet you warmly and bid you goodnight. They truly excel in every aspect. Overall, it’s an amazing place!

author: Jet03696881819
title: The Hotel That Gave Me a Bad First Impression of Rome
text:
We checked in late at night. I’m not sure whether there was some miscommunication between the hotel staff, but our experience started off quite confusingly.

I had originally booked one night and later added a second night. Before arriving, I contacted the hotel in advance and specifically asked whether we could stay in the same room for both nights. The hotel confirmed that this would be possible. However, when we checked in, we were asked whether we had only booked one night, which was confusing considering that this had already been discussed and confirmed with the hotel.

What concerned us much more was the first room we were assigned. After taking the elevator to the fourth floor, we had to walk up another half-flight of stairs to reach it. As soon as we entered, the room was extremely hot and humid, and the air conditioning did not seem to be functioning properly.

More importantly, there was a dead small fly on the bed, and there were numerous ants crawling around the room. The bedding itself did not feel particularly clean either. Overall, the room gave us the impression that it had not been regularly used or properly prepared for guests.

To make matters worse, the bathtub drain was broken, so we could not even shower properly. When we reported the problem, we initially received an explanation about which side was hot water and which side was cold water, which had nothing to do with the actual issue. Eventually, a staff member came up to the room, checked it, and confirmed that the drain was indeed broken.

I also mentioned how unusually hot and humid the room was and asked whether there might be a problem with the air conditioning. We were then offered a room change.

The replacement room was completely normal and in significantly better condition. This actually made the situation even more difficult to understand. If a normal room was available, why were we initially assigned a hot and humid room with numerous ants, a dead insect on the bed, questionable cleanliness, and a broken bathtub drain?

I obviously cannot know the reason, but the difference between the two rooms was so significant that I genuinely found myself wondering why we had been given the first room in the first place — and even whether the fact that we are Asian had anything to do with it. I am not claiming that this was the reason, but the experience was uncomfortable enough to leave me with that question.

There was another interaction that added to my negative impression.

At check-out, I paid an additional €40 and was given an explanation of the charges at the time. However, after thinking about the amount again, I wanted to make sure I had understood the breakdown correctly. The city tax was €7.50 per person per night, so for two people staying two nights, that would be €30. Since the total was €40, I was unsure what the remaining €10 was for.

We had purchased some bottled water during our stay, which I understood to cost around €2 per bottle, and there were also bottles of water provided in the room. I therefore politely contacted the hotel afterward to ask for a detailed breakdown of the €40 and to clarify whether the water provided in the room was also chargeable.

The hotel explained that the €40 consisted of €30 in city tax and €10 for four bottles of water at €2.50 each. Once this was explained, I understood the charge and had no issue with the amount itself.

What bothered me was the tone of the response. It began with “As I said…” and ended with “You can check the receipt.” I fully understand that the charges had already been explained to me at check-out, but I was simply asking for clarification because I had not fully understood which bottles of water were included in the charge.

Considering that my message was polite and was only asking for a breakdown, I found the response unnecessarily dismissive and condescending. A simple clarification of the charges would have been sufficient.

I understand that maintenance issues can happen at any hotel. However, this is a four-star property charging a city tax of €7.50 per person per night, so I expected a considerably better standard of room preparation and guest service.

Being initially assigned a poorly maintained room with ants, a dead insect on the bed, a broken bathtub drain, and apparent air-conditioning issues was disappointing enough. The confusing communication and the way my later inquiry was handled made the overall experience even worse.

Unfortunately, I would not choose to stay here again.

author: LondonLassE1
title: Good hotel, spacious rooms
text: Good location for Termini station - about 10 mins walk. It's good to be near Termini station for arriving from the airport and taking the metro. It's walkable to some main signs in about 30 mins, but need to take the metro to other places like the Vatican. The staff are friendly and rooms are spacious. It's all very clean. The bathrooms are a little dated in terms of decor but a good size and the shower is good. The lifts are a little small and old fashioned but it's a fun experience!

author: ynguy
title: What A Joy
text:
A smallish BW hotel within a 12 minute walking distance of Termini (main station).
I was welcomed by an amazing friendly and welcoming gentleman. His name badge divulged his name, but I guess an alias, as Joy. How appropriate.
I had for the first time in my life reserved  a single occupancy room. When I inspected the room and bathroom. I  thought it was quite amazing that everything was there. Closet with enough hangers and a minibar too. The shower room was well equipped.
I called it a cosy room. Airco working very well. Housekeeping standards very high. The room it self looked as new, apart from desk and bedside cabinet which were quite dated. I was told that next year the whole floor would be renovated. as they have already done 2nd and 3rd floor. As far as I see it they only have to replace desk and bedside cabinet.
I had a few requests and they were dealt with by Joy quickly. This receptionist is a huge asset for this property . He certainly deserves a good raise.

author: Anthony S
title: Not what's in reviews is reality
text: Hotel is very far from Termini Station. Furniture was at least 50 years old. Breakfast surely not of a 4 star hotel, nothing you see in the pictures. Only I lift which can fit 2 adults.

author: Sharon D
title: Enjoyable experience
text:
So friendly 
Joy was very helpful 
The breakfast was amazing 
Definitely recommend this hotel

author: juliamb692026
title: Excellent in general, the attention from the staff who are very kind, the room cleanliness, and the breakfast is good.
text: Excellent in general, the attention from the hotel staff who are very kind to the guests, the room cleanliness, and the breakfast which is also very good.

author: Feloleon
title: One night in Rome
text: The hotel is very well situated, closer to great restaurants and public transportation.  The room had all we needed, very clean, comfortable amd quiet.

author: yblinovayulia
title: Great hotel.
text: Price ratio quality👍 excellent location - nearby shops, cafes, subway! Room service every day at A+, breakfasts are monotonous, but everything is fresh! If we still go to Rome, we'll stay in this hotel!

author: Family M
title: Hotel Kennedy in Rome.
text:
Hotel with a location close to the train station and next to a park.
Do not hesitate to stroll around the neighborhood to discover restaurants.
Italian-style decoration.
Friendly reception and pleasant staff.
Breakfast was not abundant despite an impressive cappuccino.

author: Laurent M
title: Disappointing.
text: Located near Termini Station and Via Cavour (a major thoroughfare that crosses the main tourist sites of Rome), this hotel seems frozen in an ancient time. The rooms are modest, the decor is aging, the bathrooms are cramped and not very functional, the shower is quite dirty and narrow, and the locks are not very secure. Lack of a safe and mini fridge to keep water cool. The staff is very helpful and pleasant, both at the reception during the day and night, as well as in the dining area. However, a major downside is the breakfast: powdered fruit juices (considering Italy has an abundance of citrus...), a thermos of coffee (again, Italy is known for the quality of its coffee), lack of savory foods (eggs, bacon, cold cuts, cheeses, ...), pastries that are more than mediocre, random absence of bread, and no fresh fruits. In conclusion, I would say that in its current state, this hotel is far from the European 3-star standard it claims to have.

author: Giancarla R
title: Fantastic stay
text:
Fantastic stay in a hotel in an exceptional location, very close to the most important monuments in Rome. The staff was very kind and very professional: they gave us precise information on what to visit and how to get around. The absolute strong point is the terrace, with a spectacular view. Highly recommended both for those coming to Rome for the first time and for those who want to stay comfortably in the center.
Excellent value for money.

author: Sandy V
title: Do not stay here! I wish I could get my money back.
text: First we checked in and were given room 505, while unpacking I felt something drip on me. I looked up and saw a big moldy spot in the ceiling that was dripping. I packed everything back up and went to the reception desk and was then given room 502. I checked the ceiling and it was clear but then noticed mold on the wallpaper and hair on the shower wall. Exhausted from a long day, we decided to just deal with it but only unpack what we needed for the 1 night. When leaving the next morning, we walked past room 505 and noticed they painted over the moldy spot on the ceiling. So bad!

author: ayse dilek A
title: A comfortable hotel.
text: Very close to Piazza Navona, many places are within walking distance, the rooms are comfortable, and the reception staff are friendly and helpful.

author: Ma DOLORES R
title: Terribly terrible
text: The breakfast was terrible, the room was very old with very few outlets, the bathroom was even worse, the shower would turn cold and suddenly it would turn boiling hot without touching it and it burned me. Very bad.

author: Carla F
title: Very bad experience!
text:
On arrival there was no service to carry the luggage to the room. We arrived tired and had to carry our bags ourselves to the 2nd floor.
Old elevator and gives several bumps, very bad! 
Bad breakfast, dark and old room, bathroom water from the box did not go down and finally the air conditioning did not work right, with the heat that was in Rome, we cooked during the night (one hour we stayed in the hotel).
Bad experience, I do not recommend.

author: serge t
title: Disappointed
text: Very outdated bathroom, plumbing needs to be reviewed, plus a sewer smell, cramped room, double curtain detached and not functioning, only 3 TV channels. Breakfast is fairly decent, bar service is nonexistent, staff is okay but does not speak French, cleanliness is acceptable. Does not deserve a 4-star rating. On the other hand, very well located, close to the train station and the subway.

author: shansen645
title: Best affordable hotel in Rome
text: One of the best affordable hotels we stayed at in Rome. Very helpful and friendly staff! Great breakfast with fresh, local fruits, cheeses, breads, and of course coffee. Excellent AC in our room! Great walkable neighborhood with some really lovely trattorias within a block or two.

author: Scott R
title: Extremely friendly and ideally located hotel
text:
Having read a few harsh comments on here, I had to leave a review on the hotel. The first thing to mention are the staff who are absolutely fantastic, each and everyone we spoke to were really friendly and couldn't do enough for you. The location, in my opinion is excellent with its proximity to Termini and having multiple bus stops within a couple of a minutes walk. 

In relation to the comments about Termini and surrounding areas, we travelled back to the station each night after midnight and walked the 7 or 8 minutes to the hotel without any issue whatsoever. 

The hotel reception and bar area are really modern and spotless with excellent air con, which was much welcomed after trailing around the city all day. 

The rooms are a little dated and could do with an update but were more than adequate for the amount of time we spent in there. It was cleaned daily with fresh towels and for the price, we couldn't have asked for more. 

I would absolutely recommend Hotel Villafranca for a few days city break and wouldn't think twice about returning.

author: Travel Planet Azul
title: I won't come back.
text: I stayed at Hotel Villafranca di Roma and, overall, I had a good experience. The structure of the hotel is nice, the service was friendly and the Mood is quiet, ideal for rest. However, one negative point marked the stay: the strong bad odor coming from the tubing of the bathroom, which caused even nausea. This problem greatly compromised sleep and comfort, especially in the bedroom. If this aspect is resolved, the hotel surely offers a good accommodation option in the area.

author: Hannah Dwyer
title: First family trip to Rome
text: Just returned back from a fantastic family 4 night stay here. We booked a quadruple room as we have 2 older kids. Both had separate beds. The location is great, we got taxis to the venues which reception will help get for you and then would walk back. The colosseum is around 30 minutes walk and Vatican Museum just over an hour. The breakfast is excellent, one of the best I've had so much selection, even my fussy daughter found something to have. Fresh fruits, yogurts, eggs, croissants and more. Cold fresh water and sparkling water is free so bring a reusable bottle to refill, you will need one if you visit in summer, the heat is no joke but the rooms do have AC which is nice to return to. There's toothbrushes in the room with a small toothpaste in each. There's a kettle in the room with teas and coffee. Overall this was a fantastic hotel with welcoming staff. I would definitely recommend this hotel.

author: Thebridge
title: Lovely hotel
text:
Really lovely hotel. Clean, friendly, good metro connections, great for termini.

Nothing was too much of a problem. 
Room was clean, comfortable (no fridge), great shower, effective aircon, regularly freshened up if needed and well decorated. We were ‘room only’ guests so I can’t comment on the food but it smelt good.

We were allowed to check in slightly earlier than expected and we could  leave luggage with them on the day of our departure.  English speaking and happy to advise.

It’s quite near the man station which is great for travel but I would advise using the metro to get to the tourist destinations (it’s walkable though). We felt safe enough but I wouldn’t walk around on my own after 9pm (female).

We even were able to order in food for my teenagers.

I would definitely stay here again.

author: bonapuella
title: The hotel is great.
text: Excellent hotel in the centre of attractions and very close to Termini Station. The hotel is above average and very decent, the breakfasts were great. It turned out to be a great holiday in Italy and the first introduction took place and started with such a beautiful hotel.

author: Dream07831860293
title: Great Hotel
text: I stayed at this hotel about 2 weeks ago for a couple of days with my dad, and it was very nice. The location of the hotel is very good since it's very close to a lot of the old historical buildings I was looking forward to seeing. The rooms were very clean and comfortable, they even allowed us to keep a spare card to keep the AC running while I was out sightseeing. The receptionists were also very kind and helpful, informing us about where to find any places, including nearby restaurants or convenience stores.

author: Gordon C
title: Impressed
text: Room was hot, but the that was the only fault I could see. They even gave us a complementary wine (I cannot actually drink, but it’s the thought that counts). The service was friendly and helpful. I’m honestly I’m impressed.

author: NorthStar53576833882
title: Best hotel in Italy!🇮🇹
text: The hotel was outside of the main hustle and bustle of Rome, next to a park. Beautiful traditional furnishings. I loved our room. The comfortable bed, double doors of privacy, black out curtains. The outdoor and indoor pools were incredible! I’ve never seen an indoor hot tub jacuzzi as massive as this one! There was a polar and hot plunge pool as well. Restaurant on the top floor was beautiful! With gorgeous views! Our waitress was soo sweet and friendly. Food was amazing! Customer service was top notch throughout the entire hotel and stay. From the bell men to the pool attendants! We stayed in a lot of 5 star hotels in Italy and this was my favorite! It was absolutely perfect!!!

author: Oscar H
title: Beware extra charges
text: A great hotel broadly speaking. But an aggressive charging protocol that came to a head when I saw various charges on my card that hasn’t been authorised. They attempted to charge me for Euro 125 for a single bottle of champagne from the mini bar. In fact the champagne cost 36 euros which I’d already been charged for. The 125 was entirely invented. It took 3 members of staff to get a refund and several days to receive it. Had I not have pushed to resolve and checked my card statement the fraudulent charge would have gone unnoticed. It spoilt an otherwise enjoyable stay.

author: Christian Gb
title: Great place for visiting Rome
text: The property is beautiful,  located near the park Villa Bourguese.  You are almost in central Rome but you feel a vacation atmosphere as being in a far and relaxing place.  The outdoor area is beautiful and same is the whole indoor SPA area. Staff is very friendly and helpful and the services are very good ! A very nice place to stay when visiting Rome !

author: Mary2018212
title: Wonderful hotel. Incredible staff
text:
After spending an incredible month traveling throughout Italy, we always choose to end our trip at Parco dei Principi in Rome. It's become a tradition, and every year we're reminded why we keep coming back. This hotel truly feels like our home away from home.
During this visit, Italy was experiencing temperatures well over 100°F, and the hotel's magnificent pool was an absolute lifesaver. Being just a 10-minute walk and a 2 minute taxi ride from the Spanish Steps means you can easily explore the city, then return in the afternoon when many places close and relax by the pool. It's the perfect combination of sightseeing and tranquility.
As wonderful as the property is, it's the people who make this hotel so special. Over the years, so many of the staff have become like family to us.
A very special thank you goes to the incredible team at breakfast at the hotel Restaurant. What a spread. It will not disappoint you. Both Ariana Senior and Ariana Junior (yes, there are two!), along with Catia and Gabriellino, made every meal a pleasure. Their kindness, warmth, and exceptional service were truly phenomenal. They are the heart and soul of the restaurant and have an amazing gift for making every guest feel at home.
The exceptional experience begins the moment you arrive. The valet staff always greet us with genuine smiles and warm welcomes. Daniel is always there with a big hug when we arrive, and it's something we've come to look forward to every year. Alessandro, Vincenzo (my paisano!), and Facchino are equally wonderful and always make us feel like valued friends rather than guests.
The front desk team consistently goes above and beyond to ensure every stay is perfect. No request is ever too much trouble. I especially want to thank Monia, who immediately understood how exhausted and overheated we were after our travels and did everything possible to make sure our room was as cool and comfortable as it could be. That level of thoughtfulness is something you never forget.
Finally, a very well-deserved shout-out to Adriano, the hotel's chief of maintenance. When we arrived, our air conditioning wasn't working, and just as he did last year, he responded immediately and had everything fixed in no time. Adriano, you're simply the best!

author: Wilma D
title: Excellent hotel
text: What a beautiful hotel!  It was very comfortable and tastefully decorated.  This hotel is next to the Borghese garden which makes it feel like you are outside of the city. There is a fabulous indoor pool/spa and a lovely outdoor pool which were very enjoyable after a day of sightseeing. The breakfast was very good. The staff was helpful and friendly. We look forward to staying there again the next time we are in Rome!

author: Veronica R
title: Holidays
text:
We had a really beautiful stay at Bernini Bristol! The hotel is beautiful, elegant and above all in a perfect location to experience Rome.

The rooftop is spectacular: the perfect place to have a drink at sunset, enjoying a wonderful view of the city.

But what made our stay even more special was the extraordinary kindness of the staff. Special thanks to Jorge from the reception and to the person who welcomed us and took care of our luggage: always warm, helpful, smiling and ready to help us at all times. They made us feel really pampered.

A super recommended hotel, not only for the beauty and location, but especially for the people who work there and who really make a difference.

No doubt, when we return to Rome, we will come back here! ❤️🇮🇹 Room 514

author: Marilisa B
title: Excellent organization of the event on the rooftop with Lucrezia.
text: I met Lucrezia, Location Manager of the rooftop Il Vizio, to organize an important private event. After she spoke very highly of the hotel to me and showed me the entire property, I decided to return to stay overnight as well. It was a fantastic experience! The design is splendid, the welcome is excellent, and both the rooms and all the food & beverage services are excellent. A special thanks to all the hotel and restaurant staff, and thanks to Lucrezia for letting us experience Rome in a fantastic way!

author: Walt D.
title: Great Experience
text: We traveled here with our family in early August.  The hotel met every expectation.  The rooms were spacious and clean, and the hotel itself was much nicer than I expected.  Not sure what I expected, but it was on par with the nicer hotels in the US.  The hotel had a breakfast buffet every morning upstairs with an assortment of options, which was perfect before going out sightseeing.  There was something for everyone on the menu or buffet, which was very convenient and appreciated.  Finally, not being all that familiar with Rome, it felt like we were centrally located.  We walked to and from Spanish Steps and Trevi Fountain, and there were an ample selection of nice restaurants around us (though I think you can say that about anywhere in Rome).  All in all, I was really pleased with our visit here.

author: sdemaree2013
title: Great stay
text: We had a great experience here. The location was good, bed was extremely comfortable, water pressure amazing, staff helpful.

author: Millie M
title: Perfect Rome trip with Sina Bernini!
text: Wonderful hotel! Attentive and helpful staff! GREAT location. Walk to colosseum, Vatican City, and shopping. Phenomenal view from rooftop bar……and fine drinks!

Great to watch life!", "photo_id": "874586371"}]

author: Guide38039057265
title: Unpleasant and unsafe
text: Bad experience and not recommended at all. On the first day, they entered the room without permission, and all they did was make the bed and steal a jacket from the closet. From the very first moment, it generated distrust; we had to carry our belongings and documents with us, total distrust. Regarding the service, the breakfast was very scarce: sliced bread and cheese, industrial pastries, and a machine coffee that is preferable to that of a hospital, in addition to a waitress who made you feel observed about what you added to your plate. The room had little ventilation and was dirty (marks on the walls) and various insects like spiders and mosquitoes. In short, I would not return due to the anger and distrust of the hotel staff, poor breakfast, and conditions. I regret writing this review; keep looking for more hotels to spend more comfortable days in Rome.

author: Ann N
title: Shocking
text:
Location was awful but that’s my fault - I thought booking near the termini would be good for getting about …there was graffiti where ever you looked and just felt dirty ….
Staff were very unhelpful - especially the breakfast lady and one lady on reception , felt like I was putting them out every time I asked a question or collected my room key (room key MUST be left at reception when leaving the building)
Rooms WOW very basic room 113 was like a shoe box, very tatty furniture (chair, dresser and a little table ) the chair was filthy the furniture battered two single beds put together to make a double that kept separating…. However the room/beds were clean can’t fault the housekeeping …
When we arrived we had no tea/coffee facilities…. A fridge that didn’t work .Just awful I would not recommend at all….
I cried when I arrived as I was so disappointed- I didn’t expect it to be all singing and dancing however I did expect a decent room

author: Mark K
title: Terrible experience that ruined my visit to such a beautiful city
text:

text: So here we go. The hotel is located close to Termini Station , well this is where the advantages of the hotel and end . Instead of room standard double , provided room with one small bed, to my question why I am provided room of another category , referred that they cannot change the room because there are no places . Replenish rarely buffet, come late and you get leftovers and need to wait for the plate, they are in short supply. As for the guests, they will not allow you to bring the reception because if you booked room 1 here and live alone. Wanted to go out after 12:00 a.m. ... well, that's your problem as you get back to the hotel (it's closed for the night , the gates are really closed and not allowed in ), although it says the reception is open 24/7. ... experience is not great, the hotel does not recommend.

The location is very easy for walking distance amazing value at the hotel. The rooms are amazing just love the hotel and all the stuff to be honest not one of them. You could complain about it’s very quiet hotel. everything you require is available at the hotel. author: Katie D

author: Hollie C

author: Ann-Marie W
title: Our honeymoon at the Marcella Royal Hotel

The were plenty of options for breakfast and the roof terrace was gorgeous in the morning and evening. All of the staff we interacted with were friendly and helpful. I would highly recommend this hotel to stay in

author: Michelle C
title: Solo female traveller Rome August 2026
text: Lovely hotel with great amenities, close to Termini station, metro, bus tours etc. I would definitely stay here again. The room was compact but perfect, clean and quiet

author: Jennifer D
title: What a wonderful place!
text:
I found this hotel through AmEx travel, for a quick trip to Rome after a cruise that ended in Civitavecchia. This hotel is beautiful, friendly and lovely. The staff pays a lot of attention to their guests! My birthday was on the 2nd day of my stay, and the hotel surprised me at breakfast with a birthday pastry and a gift of chocolates in my room. We had breakfast at the hotel each morning, which was delicious and well organized. When we informed the hotel that we would need to check out before breakfast was served on our last day, they left us to go bags of juice, water and pastries for breakfast during our car trip to the airport. Amazing and very much appreciated.
The hotel is in a wonderful location, far enough away from the busy area around the Trevi fountain, but close enough to walk to it. It is around the corner from the metro. It is also within walking distance of the Palazzo Barbarini and its lovely museum and two movie theaters. We loved our stay at this hotel and will absolutely stay again when we return to Rome!

author: Emame A
title: Hotel Barocco, Rome – August 2026 - Not what I was expecting
text:
Hotel Barocco, Rome – August 2026

Overall Rating: 3/5

Hotel Barocco has an excellent central location and friendly staff, but unfortunately, I found the hotel itself disappointing for a property advertised as four-star. The biggest issue was the size and standard of the room, which did not reflect what I expected based on the photos online or the price paid.

Location: 4.5/5 – Very Good
The location is definitely one of the hotel's strongest points. It is very central and within easy reach of many of Rome's major attractions, including the Trevi Fountain. There is also a metro station very close by, which makes getting around Rome convenient. If location is your main priority, Hotel Barocco does very well here.

Atmosphere: 3/5 – Fair
We visited in August, at the height of the tourist season, so the surrounding area was understandably extremely busy and crowded. Inside the hotel itself, however, it was relatively calm and did not feel particularly overcrowded.

The hotel has an older, somewhat quirky layout. Rather than feeling like a purpose-designed four-star hotel, it felt more like an older apartment or residential building that had been converted into a hotel. There are narrow corridors and some unusual staircases leading to the rooms. Although there is a lift, navigating the property with larger luggage can still be awkward.

Rooms: 2/5 – Poor
This was by far the most disappointing part of the stay. The standard room was extremely small, and I did not feel that the photographs online accurately represented what we actually received.

The room felt considerably smaller than what I would normally expect from a four-star hotel. In fact, I have stayed in standard Holiday Inn rooms that were noticeably larger and more comfortable. Everything felt very compressed, and there was very little space to comfortably move around or manage luggage.

The facilities also felt somewhat dated. For example, there are no electronic key cards. Instead, you are given a traditional physical room key. The bed itself was fine and reasonably comfortable, but otherwise there was nothing about the room that felt particularly luxurious or four-star.

Value: 2/5 – Poor
For the price, I did not think Hotel Barocco represented particularly good value. The location undoubtedly carries a premium, but considering the very small room and fairly basic facilities, I think there are likely better boutique hotel options in Rome at a similar price point.

For what we paid, I expected a noticeably higher standard of accommodation.

Cleanliness: 4/5 – Good
Cleanliness was good overall. The room and common areas appeared well maintained from a housekeeping perspective, and I had no particular concerns regarding cleanliness during the stay.

Noise Level: 3.5/5 – Fair to Good
The noise level was reasonable considering the hotel's very central location. You are staying in the middle of Rome during peak tourist season, so some city noise is to be expected. Overall, I did not find noise to be a major problem.

Service: 3.5/5 – Good
The staff made an effort to be friendly and helpful. The reception staff were pleasant, and the restaurant staff were also welcoming.

Breakfast, however, felt somewhat rushed and overly structured. There is no traditional breakfast buffet. Instead, you have to book a breakfast time slot and then order from a menu. I understand that this is probably intended to manage the limited space and ensure all guests can be accommodated, but I personally found the system restrictive and a little off-putting. It was not the relaxed breakfast experience I expected from a four-star hotel.

Amenities: 2.5/5 – Basic
The amenities were fairly standard and there was nothing particularly memorable or luxurious about them. They were adequate for a city stay, but again, they did not feel consistent with what I would personally expect from a four-star hotel.

Overall Impression
Hotel Barocco's greatest advantage is unquestionably its excellent central Rome location, particularly if you want to be close to attractions such as the Trevi Fountain and have convenient access to the metro. The staff were also friendly, the hotel was clean, and noise levels were reasonable.

However, I was disappointed by the accommodation itself. The standard room was exceptionally small, the facilities felt dated, and the photographs online gave me a very different impression of the room size. The narrow corridors, awkward staircases and overall layout also made the property feel more like a converted residential building than a thoughtfully designed four-star hotel.

For me, the experience was closer to what I would expect from a three-star hotel rather than a four-star property. Given the price, I would probably choose a different boutique hotel in Rome on a future visit. If you are considering Hotel Barocco primarily because of the photos of the rooms, I would strongly recommend confirming the exact room category, size and layout before booking.

author: Lisa F
title: Great hotel
text: Hotel Barocco is a hidden gem.  We had  a wonderful stay. The staff communicates with you before you arrive making suggestions for transportation and other potential issues.  Once you arrive the front desk staff, breakfast and bar staff are all wonderful.  Extremely helpful to ensure you have a great stay.  The lobby can get a bit congested at times with guests coming and going but the staff remains friendly and professional.  We loved our room which was quite spacious by European standards.  The breakfast is amazing.  We highly recommend.

author: Deborah M
title: Lovely Second Visit, what an oasis of calm.
text:
This hotel is a lovely oasis of calm and cool in busy and very hot Rome.  It was my second stay here and everything was just as perfect this year.  
We were greeted so warmly and efficiently by Daniel although we arrived very late, as our plane was delayed and immigration was very slow.   We had prearranged a driver from the Airport with tbe hotel and this worked really well, especially at such a late hour.
Breakfast was lovely and the tea, so necessary for English people, just right.  We needed an early breakfast the second day as we had an early tour and so prearranged by WhatsApp, which worked brilliantly.  We arranged a driver with the hotel to the port, again very easy. Extremely nice vehicle and a smooth transit.  Thank you for making our stay so lovely.

author: Dave0365
title: The most amazing service
text: We had 3 nights here in a junior suite with pool and sauna in August. This is the PERFECT room for the hot days of a Roman summer. Nothing like walking the streets all day and returning to your room to relax in a freshly filled balcony “pool” to cool down. Note that it is not a plunge pool but more like a square bath approx 18” deep. Still perfect. Then relax on your private balcony on the two lay downs while enjoying a glass of wine with bar snacks. The service at this hotel is EXEMPLARY. We have stayed in many 5 star hotels around the world and haven’t experienced such personalised friendly service from EVERY person we made contact with. They are genuinely happy to have you stay and can’t help enough. The location was perfect to be able to walk to all the standard sight seeing areas. Breakfast was a great way to start the day - freshly cooked eggs along with personal tower of fruit, pastries, meats/cheese. Piazza Barberini is a stop for the Hop on Hop off Bus, so easy to return if you do that. About 250m around the corner on Via Sistina is a fantastic restaurant Sistina 52. Best lasagna we have tried and fantastic service.

author: Erica R
title: Great Hotel Choice
text: Great hotel with a friendly staff, clean and spacious rooms, great breakfast, and great location.  They also offer luggage storage if needed.

author: Caileigh H
title: Rude Staff
text:
Rude staff, small rooms, hotel stinks, closest Cafes are 15-30 min walks. 

Gets recommended by the cruise line, pick another hotel

author: JxTx_Si
title: Mid-level hotel, decent food

Check-in staff were passable, but gave little to no direction for baggage storage prior to check in, then, once it was found, my party was berated for accessing it without permission. Wait staff at breakfast also took no time to clean the area, which made us lose our breakfasts and had to get our food a second time.
