On top of that, her smile is so genuine and infectious, it truly brightens up my New York trip. And the front desk Sophie, Brandon and Manager Armani are equally amazing—they’re so friendly and talkative; chatting with her feels so warm and welcoming. Highly recommend stopping by—this team makes every visit a true pleasure! :)

author: Trisha F
title: Beautiful views
text: Super nice hotel maybe the couch could use a deep cleaning but overall everything was beautiful! Thank You Marva!

author: Vinit P
title: Staff is very warm.
text: The restaurant and the staff is very helpful especially Ms Albana and Mr Mohammed, always smiling and ready to help out, wish them lots of luck. Regards.

author: Carneddau
title: Great family stay
text:
This is a perfect base for exploring London. It’s close to Waterloo station, which itself is easy to reach from Euston. 
Rooms are clean, have a great shower and comfy bed.  I’ve come away  from my stay reflecting on how great the staff are there . They really do go above and beyond to make you feel welcome. Thanks

author: Ian L
title: Great Hotel
text: Great hotel in a perfect location, stayed many times always very good. The staff are very professional and helpful, always having time to help.

author: mary m
title: Cream of the Premier inns
text: Excellent hotel and staff, the staff are pleasant and very willing to help very clean with Excellent food package, Excellent showers and bedrooms. fantastic position so close to many of the sites

author: silvia m
title: Recommend
text: Amazing location, outstanding staff🔆

author: Darren
title: Good, and Bad
text:
The hotel is in a great location, right next to the London Eye and Waterloo station.
The rooms are big, but dated. We were at the front, it was very noisy most night, to the early hours. Sounded like a motor bike race each night and one night 2.20am a football match. So lacked on sleep.
The bar are is great and not busy, with a good view to people watch.
Staff were very good especially Fay, helpful, chatty and friendly.

author: Elle S
title: Great little hotel
text:
Fabulous little hotel - highly recommend! Stayed here for one night in between returning from Disney and travelling home.

Polite staff, clean room, greet location and price.

author: Simran K
title: Really love this hotel
text: I loved my stay here I even made a video about it too . Staff were very friendly room was small but cozy and super comfortable bed . Glad it had Netflix on the tv too and water refill in the hallway . Super affordable and would definitely stay here again when I’m in London

author: Lee-Ann M
title: Good stay
text: Very quick and easy check in. Staff really friendly. Rooms clean and well equipped but a little on the small side.

author: Mauritius Delicious
title: Excellent choice for an overnight stay
text: I was seriously impressed. Whilst small, the room was well furnished, the whole hotel looked in great condition, comfortable bed and excellent air conditioning. Perfect for an overnight stay, and likely to become my new first choice in the area. I didn't actually believe all the positive reviews I'd read given how well priced it was but they were fully merited.

author: holidaysaregreat8
title: Overnight stay
text: Spotlessly clean! The bathroom is beautiful. Room is snug but has everything you need. Great location between three tube stops. Staff are very friendly and helpful. Would stay again.

author: James J
title: Not designed for anyone over 35.
text: First time in NYC. Hotel is in a great location. Friendly staff and great drinks. Lovley rooftop bar. The hotel itself however is not designed for anyone over 35. Dark halls and low to the floor beds makes navigating the place difficult. Everything is placed in the room in the most difficult to access areas. Like the hotel phone on the wall next to the bed that u have to crawl to get to. The lamps in the rooms all have different ways to turn them on so its a game of how do I get this to work just to get lighting on and off. No towel racks near the shower and the shower is see thru from the bed area.its all very cool to look at but not functional to stay in. Makes for great pictures but you risk your life trying to get up and use the bathroom during the night. I would recommend for the younger crowd but not for anyone over 35.

author: Sarah G
title: Horrible; Avoid AT ALL COSTS
text:
Hotel Alameda looked promising, but the experience dealing with their staff and policies was unbelievably frustrating.

Their cancellation policy is vague, confusing, and seemingly designed to prevent guests from understanding what they’re actually agreeing to. I tried repeatedly to get a straight answer about cancellation terms and refund eligibility, and it was nearly impossible to get anyone competent on the phone. Calls went unanswered, messages weren’t returned, and when I finally did reach someone, I got conflicting information every single time.

For a hotel charging premium New York prices, the customer service was shockingly bad. Transparency should be the bare minimum in hospitality, especially when guests are making expensive travel decisions. Instead, Hotel Alameda created an experience that felt evasive, disorganized, and completely indifferent to customer concerns.

A reputable hotel makes policies clear and treats guests with professionalism. Hotel Alameda did neither. If you value honest communication and responsive service, book elsewhere.

author: Jonathan C
title: Terrible!
text: Terrible, terrible service. First, we asked for service to fix lights that were not working. We were told, "no problem"..but no one came! W e asked for a quite room. We were told this would not be a problem. The noise/dance music was SO loud, we could havre been dancing. We called (i) the service desk repeatedly and then, (ii) the outline "landline"... and NO ONE answered. Terrible! book at your own risk. Jon C 5/10/2026

author: Jennifer G
title: Do not stay here!!
text:
Edited to warn: They also charged me $1,149.95 inexplicably and when I inquired why, I got no response. I have had to move the matter to the police & better business bureau. DO NOT STAY HERE.

Original review: I can say, unequivocally, that you should never stay at this hotel. I booked the loft, Suite, AND deluxe room for me and my party in June 2025--for a trip in May 2026. I reached out a week before arrival to ask to switch the suite and loft reservations. Instead of replying, they canceled the Loft and rebooked to someone else. So, first clue is that a reservation at this hotel, even one made it advance, does not matter. It also doesn't matter if you are bringing in multiple customers. Upon learning this at check-in, I requested to speak to the manager, who looked me in the eyes after reviewing my numerous communications with the hotel, and said "what do you expect me to do?" I asked to honor MY reservation from a year ago and he let me know he wouldn't and that there was nothing else to do or say. I have never been treated like this at a hotel. If you want to be sure your trip starts off poorly and continues that way... this is the place. Aside from that, the bed caused intense back pain, anytime I had a question for the front desk they were rude, and I am usually happy to pay a resort fee, but at this hotel, it literally provides nothing. Just another money grab because this place is so horrible they wouldn't be able to stay in business without charging fake fees. Stay away. There are tons of boutique hotels that actually care about customer service

author: Scott T
title: Terrible Experience! Way Overpriced! Poor Quality
text:
I stayed at Hotel Alameda for two nights. Thursday and Friday, April 23-25, checked out today, Saturday.
My room rate was $629.00 for each night. I booked this in November and did not see lower prices listed for those dates which I reserved last November. I was expecting excellence and luxury, a splurge for my retirement. Not quite! The Hotel offered little to no complimentary amenities. The room was very basic. The rooftop bar was closed for my first night for a private party so there was no access my first evening. I saw a mouse or a rat early in the morning in the hotel lobby. When I told the hotel clerk, he said, “yeah, it’s Manhattan”.
I did write an email to hotel management about the above incident and my dissatisfaction with the hotel services, that I was paying  $629. Plus taxes and fees for each night. The hotel took off 10 percent of my first night’s stay since there was no rooftop access. I thought this was minimal at best. In addition on Friday afternoon I came back to my hotel room to find it open. The lock was resting against the door. There was no cleaning staff still on floor but apparently they had forgotten to close and lock my door. Good thing I hadn’t left any valuables in the room. The hotel staff and management offered no apologies. The unapologetic manager did take off $70.00 dollars from the resort fees. They took a total $180 off my original bill. Minimal. This was a very stressful, unsatisfying stay. For the price it was a complete rip off. I have stayed in other hotels in New York for less money that have offered far superior experiences. I would not recommend staying here.

author: Kodama E
title: Good option for families due to great location and good breakfast.
text: Great central location close to Kings Cross Station and Euston stations. Easy check in and check out procedures and a very good breakfast spread.

author: Caroline
title: Grim. Not very clean.
text: I chose this hotel because it is very close to London Euston train station. That's really about all it has going for it. It's dated,  not very clean at all, the curtain in my room wasnt properly attached at one end, the lift didnt work when I arrived and the stairs were dark and hadn't apparentlybeen cleaned for some time. There were very few visible staff, I'd paid for early check in but by the time it took for the single receptionist to explain to some people who hadnt that they couldnt check in yet, I may as well have not bothered. There was no air conditioning (and it was very warm) -  this wasnt made clear when I booked, just mentioned nervously by reception when I checked in. The room came with a kettle, two glass mugs and a sticky teaspoon. The handsoap (over the toilet because that's just where you need it) didnt work so i had to use shower gel to wash my hands. The room was tired and dusty. I know that hotel chains like to upsell but is it really necessary to lower standards to such an extent that you can only get a room at Premier Inn that meets basic acceptable hygiene standards if you upgrade to a Premier Plus room? I booked with Premier Inn in part to avoid Travelodge (I was travelling alone) but this experience genuinely makes me wonder how bad they could really be.

author: Keith S
title: Dreadful
text:
A few years since we last stayed in a Premier Inn but have never before had any complaint.
What has happened to the company????
The rooms were shabby and the bathrooms in dire need of refurbishment. Stayed at Duke Street, Euston for 3 nights.
Arrived early and paid £15 for early check in. Was not given any information about restaurant, bar or the breakfasts we had pre- booked.
After unpacking we headed into the city not returning until 10:30pm. The heat hit us as we entered the room . The slightly open window and the fan provided did nothing to reduce the room temperature of over 30degrees.
Upon visiting Reception was told that all rooms were the same, the air conditioning didn’t work and to roam the corridors for spare fans! None to be found.
After less than 4 hours sleep and after complaining at length, the manager finally agreed to move us to a ground floor room which did have air conditioning and had just become available.
Do not book this location if like us you have health conditions which are exacerbated and possibly life threatening during high temperatures.

author: Grant S
title: Not up to expected standard
text:
The location is about the only good thing at this hotel.
We arrived on Thursday having booked and paid for early check in from 11am to be told they didn’t have that and come back after 3pm. We were able to leave luggage. When we did check in , they couldn’t confirm if we’d be refunded for lack of early check in . 
Once in room, it was like walking into a sauna , temperature over 30 degrees, apparently the air con is broken and has been for some considerable time. The provided fan blew hot air around, the small gap from opening the windows provided no relief. 
The room itself was basic and functional, if dated in appearance. Bed was comfortable enough when finally fell asleep. Having to keep the window open in the  hope of cooling air meant we had the constant noise of a main road. 
Tea and coffee facilities were provided in the room , the UHT milk was off. 
Bathroom - shower worked. Single sheets of toilet paper from a dispenser rather than a toilet roll. 
Breakfast was decent , staff there friendly. 
On checking out on Saturday, witnessed a number of people checking in early. When duty manager did eventually appear to approve refund , she couldn’t understand why we didn’t get the sevice on Thursday. Still waiting to see if promised refund hits my card.
Overall, would not recommend and certainly puts me off booking another Premier Inn if this is their standard. A million miles from their flashy TV  advert.

author: Sueandsteve9
title: Dreadful experience
text:
Staff lovely but DO NOT STAY HERE IF THE WEATHRT IS HOT 
No air conditioning fan only in room need the windows open but this hotel is on a very busy and nousy road. We were awake most of the night with traffic noise as we couldn't close the windows as it was so hot in the room.. Dreadful experience

author: svjames
title: Many other choices in the city
text: Had to book the night before to secure room for red eye flight.  The person in front of us was granted their room (8am) no question asked.  when I asked I was denied since I had paid for the night prior as I was told that was the only option.  No remedy after several unfruitful email exchanges with their host team.

author: Voyager56808920480
title: Great hotel, great staff
text: Great accommodations and staff. Stay in the rooms that face the pool vs the street though. The rooms that face the street are very noisy. they provide ear plugs and white noise generator, but didnt help me.

author: Karen S
title: Only book if you  like sleeping in nightclub
text: Don’t book this hotel if you want to sleep. Crazy loud people yelling in halls for four hours!! Lasted till 4 am.  Unfortunately the priority was on the club and not the hotel

author: S M
title: The Mold by the Hyatt
text: This was the most filthy hotel experience ive had in my life. The room felt dirty surfaces greasy floors as well. Worst of all was the bathroom the shower was covered in black mold. Thank god i had slides so i was able to shower. I only stayed for one night so when i checked in late i didn’t notice this but when i woke up and looked around it was horrifying. I felt uncomfortable walking around the room in my socks. The bathroom also had stains all over the glass that looked like human body parts were pressed on it. I would have kept my mouth shut and dealt with this honestly if had been able to spend my morning relaxing in the pool as i planned but the pool was a horror scene. I have extensive experience with pool management and these kind of conditions only come from tremendous neglect! Black and green algae EVERYWHERE!! you know how bad that is for your skin? Thats like a guaranteed rash, or worse.  One of the reasons this hotel is at that price point is because of the pool. When i complained to the front desk they said that they cant do anything that i have to go through booking and that they wont charge the resort fee. A week later ive been charged the 150 dollar hold not just the resort fee, the hotel is avoiding both mine and bookings calls. You call them and they just don't answer ive never experienced in my life!! Do not spend your money here! Its a joke that this place is affiliated with the Hyatt, by far the worst Hyatt affiliated hotel ive seen. Ive had better conditions at best westerns, would give a 0/10 if i can.

author: Heather J
title: Rudest staff member ever, management did nothing to rectify other than giving me drink coupon coupons.
text:
This is my fourth stay at this property, and every single time something goes wrong. This visit was genuinely unacceptable and I expect a real response, not a form letter.

At check in, my debit card was charged the full room cost plus a $300 deposit. Hours later, when I actually checked into my room, staff tried to charge ANOTHER $300 deposit on top of that, nearly $1,300 pulled from my account. I had to stand at the front desk and prove the duplicate charge myself before anyone fixed it. I was also told I'd get a text when my room was ready. That never happened. I wasted three hours walking around waiting on a text message that was never sent, only to find out by chance my room had been ready for some time.

Once I finally got into the room, nothing worked. No WiFi, no TV, no Netflix. I reported it and was told someone would come within the hour. I sat at the bar waiting and no one showed for over 90 minutes. When an engineer finally arrived near midnight, he didn't greet me, didn't ask what was wrong, and instead immediately told me he couldn't fix anything and didn't understand why he'd even been sent, with open attitude toward a paying guest at midnight. I have this interaction recorded on my phone. I had him removed from my room and demanded a manager.

I was there partly for SpaceX/Tesla business. I have already told our hospitality team to remove this property from our approved list and told colleagues directly not to stay here.

Here is what should have happened, at every single step: the text should have been sent when promised. The system should have flagged that a deposit was already on file instead of a front desk agent charging it again blind. Once I reported the WiFi and TV outage, "within the hour" should have meant within the hour, or someone should have called to update me instead of leaving me to chase it down myself at midnight. And any staff member entering a paying guest's room should open with a greeting and ask what the issue is, not walk in with excuses and attitude, which I have on record.

Two drink coupons are an insult, not a resolution, for repeated billing failures, zero communication, and a staff member who treated a guest with open contempt. I expect a real explanation of how this is being made right, financially and otherwise, and how you are holding this employee accountable. Not a generic apology.

author: Van der Kapiz
title: Very satisfied
text: Spent few days with family; very positively impressed by the hotel; staff is very kind and supportive; rooms reflect the reality seen on web pages, so well decorated, clean and spacious. Breakfast room is also very pleasant, old style NYC brasserie. And then location…which is superb given proximity to Library/Bryant Park, 5th av, Madison and Park av. On the negative notes to reflections: room have poor natural light, which is due to the building proximity and breakfast waiting time which is too long.

author: mari l
title: Wonderful staff that goes above and beyond make your stay so special
text: Before we have even arrived the staff at this hotel are Devine. Specifically, Uriel, who had gone above and beyond, way way way BEYOND, before we have even arrived to help make this trip a magical memorable fun weekend to celebrate my daughter's 21st birthday. Uriel has helped to ensure our junior suite will be perfect and helped put together a birthday surprise package for my daughter for when we arrived so that when my daughter enters the room, there will be fresh flowers, a chilled bottle of Prosecco balloons, a birthday banner, a special note and chocolate covered strawberries. None of which my daughter will be expecting. It'll just be waiting and set up in the room for us. He has gone out of his way to put together the special package for my daughter, as well as has helped me navigate easy ways to get to MetLife Stadium for the Bruno Mars concert using the bus rather than taking a lift or an Uber saving us hundreds and hundreds of dollars and still getting there in about 20 minutes versus an hour on the train. Again, Uriel has gone above and beyond. I'm so excited for our stay. I'll put another review in following our stay, but I just want everyone to know just how much they go out of their way to make your stay super special before you even step foot on their property. Thank you, Uriel and to the rest of the staff we're so excited to come and celebrate my daughter's birthday.

author: Natalia
title: Excellent!
text: The  location is perfect making it incredibly easy to explore the main attractions in NY, confortable rooms, nice restaurant  and  very good gym, excellent team!, everyone was friendly, always ready to help with recommendations. We’ll highly recommend it to anyone visiting New York.

author: Stacey P
title: The BEST Hotel in NYC!
text: We had an excellent stay at The Chemists Club Hotel! The location was very good. You can walk to anything! Grand Central Market was right there as well as Grand Central Station. The hotel was spotless and absolutely beautiful. The room was beautiful as well. There was a full gym also! What really stood out was the EXCEPTIONAL service! The minute we walked up to the entrance, we were greeted by the bell cap. He took over getting our luggage into the front door. The lobby was beautiful. We were then greeted by Uriel and directed to have a seat at his desk to check in. Very fancy! He is their MVP! He was amazing for our entire stay! He remembered my name and greeted me every single time I exited and entered the hotel! That made me feel very special! He made everything about our stay better! He made great suggestions when we needed them. He got us anything we needed. When it was time for me to leave, he took the time to walk me and my luggage to the train station and beyond!! I let him know that The Chemists Club is now my go-to hotel and that I will be recommending it highly to anyone staying in the City!! Thank you, Uriel!!

author: Ricardo B
title: Perfect for a family in NYC
text:
Very good hotel located in a modernized historic building. The location next to Grand Central Station makes it easy to reach anywhere in the city. Despite the central location the hotel is in a very quiet street with little vehicle traffic. The anti-noise windows work perfectly. 
The room has good size and has all the necessary features for a good stay and we always find everything very clean and organized. The gentleness of water bottles and coffee capsules is a difference.  
The care of all staff (porters, receptionists, waitresses) was extremely attentive at all times.

author: Simon T
title: Not good at all
text: Rubbish outside front of hotel, poor fitting glass tops to bedside units and a filthy window with bird droppings and stains on window. Tried to upgrade but said was largest room . Not a nice hotel

author: Will G
title: Terrible customer service- they just did not care!
text:
There was an issue with our booking.                 (Booked with booking.com). The hotel claimed they did not have it even though booking.com confirmed the hotel had the reservation and there was no issue.

The person (male team member) on the desk needs re-training as he had no customer service skills whatsoever, rude and did not care. He gave the impression he had no idea what he was doing as he went back and forth from the the office asking someone else in the office for log in details.  

We were told the supervisor was on his way to 'sort it out', this was a hour and a half and still left waiting so we just left and booked another hotel down the road.  We are pursuing a refund through booking.com. But the lack of customer service was appalling as it was 11:30pm at night when we gave up and left. Disgraceful.

author: renata1969
title: Terrible property
text:
The category is 4 stars, but for the quality of services offered, it should be 3.
Dated property that absolutely needs to be renovated.
Our room on the first floor without an elevator, small and uncomfortable, cramped entrance and with 5 narrow steps to get to the bed. Mattress worn on one side that created a dip (a real treat for the back!). Window glass filthy, with bird droppings. You could hear every single step taken by the occupants of the room above because their floor creaked loudly. To reach the bathroom (which is tiny) you had to go down 5 steps, which makes everything very inconvenient at night and it is necessary to turn on the light (disturbing sleep) to avoid falling. The bathroom door did not open completely because the towel rack blocked it. The only positive note about the bathroom is the size of the shower stall, which is comfortable. We should have had air conditioning in the room, but it did not work. When I pointed this out at the front desk, they told me that the malfunction was due to dust (which is not plausible because the wall controls wouldn't even turn on) and they offered to change my room, but they had no others available.
Very slow Wi-Fi network.
Breakfast: quite varied, especially for savory options, but little attention to service and cleanliness.
Very convenient location for the Queensway and Bayswater subway stations, just a few minutes' walk away, and located across from Kensington Gardens.
For £154/night (€180) B&B, I definitely expect much better.
I will never choose this property again in the future and I strongly advise against it.

author: Mark
title: Beautiful hotel, shame about our supposedly superior room
text: Idea location short walk to the tube/bus etc. The hotel communal areas are beautiful with original stairways, original ‘theatre’ bar and lots of engravings, the frontage is stunning and welcoming. Our room, however, was tiny, cramped and hot, the air con didn’t work. The shower sprayed everywhere as shower screen too small. It was, however value for money and ok for one night. Whole place was very clean. Being in a side street hotel was reasonably quiet although our room had a very noisy extractor which we could not turn off. Staff were very attentive and polite especially the breakfast crew. Breakfast was lovely, lots of choice, very tasty, hot food was hot and there was plenty of it.

author: Beazie
title: Don't chance a booking with this hotel.
text: We booked two rooms at this hotel for our family, one was suppose to  be a club level.  After our long flight from the states, we walked .8 miles from Paddington Station with our luggage, in the heat to this hotel, to be informed rudely and unapologetically, that they had rebooked us to their "sister" hotel, the Inhabit Queens Garden.  They told us that they had emailed us about the change, while we were in flight!  There was no offer to transport us to this  other hotel and so, we had to schlep our luggage an additional .6 miles to the new hotel.  We had originally planned on taking a two day trip to Paris and return to the Grand Royale Hyde Park, but due to our lack of confidence in this hotel, we cancelled out booking right away and stayed at a different hotel all together.   We have a travel agent who was on hold for hours trying to get our booking straighten out, with no response.  Never going to attempt staying at this hotel ever again.

author: Alex T
title: Well located yet peaceful
text: Quiet location but close to vibrant areas and different metros for easy access to all of Paris. Clean, friendly staff, decent breakfast.

author: MrF96
title: Excellent stay at this well run & conveniently located hotel.
text: We enjoyed a perfect two night stay here. The staff are friendly & very helpful, the rooms are small but clean. Breakfast was more than adequate and items were frequently replenished. Most importantly, the coffee is good! There are also complimentary drinks & snacks in the lobby. The proximity of the hotel to Gare du Nord is a real plus. Overall then, highly recommended!

author: Ahmed Mohamed Eid
title: Wonderful stay - clean, comfortable, great location, and excellent hospitality.
text: I stayed at ibis Styles Paris Cadet Lafayette from 29 August to 5 September 2025 and had a fantastic experience. The hotel is clean, comfortable, and well located. A special thanks to Mr. Khemais, Ms. Merfat, and Mr. Alam for their exceptional hospitality and kindness-they truly made my stay memorable. Highly recommended!

author: Markus W
title: Worst customer service!!!
text: We recently stayed at this hotel and received the worst check in experience you could possibly imagine. Abdel the Front receptionist who greeted us was super rude and didn’t want to let us check in as there were 3 of us and he said it was not allowed. The attitude and tone was completely unacceptable for a hotel staff to address customers checking in. Eventually we checked in and were harassed by him continuously during our stay saying that we can’t stay here in the same room. Not something I ever ever experienced having stayed at many hundreds of Accor hotels worldwide. Hands down worst experience at a Accor hotel in over 12 years. Would not recommend staying here.

author: NATH31380
title: Excellent
text: Great Hotel, very welcoming, very helpful staff, very comfortable bed, breakfast on top

author: Alma N
title: Wonderful vacation in Paris
text:
My husband, our 15-year-old daughter, and I stayed in this beautiful hotel during the week of Ferragosto. 
The hotel is strategically located very close to the metro in a quiet and characteristic neighborhood of Paris full of life and charming venues.
Kind and helpful staff. 
Comfortable triple room. Adequate cleanliness.
Highly recommended!!

author: Lee B
title: Stay Very Far Away
text:
AStay very far away from this "hotel".  It has no hesitation to treat its potential guests as financial prey. It stole $691 from me without rendering any services whatsoever. I conducted myself in courteous, responsible, respectful manner and they returned this with an uncaring, thug-like, outrageous response. 
I made a reservation March 1 2026 for May 3. - 7 through Expedia for the Hotel Alahambra in Paris for my vacation. I paid with American Express. Almost immediately after I made the reservation I realized that that I would not be able to make in on May 3 which was a Sunday cause there was not a train I could take from Cannes to Paris after I arrived there at the end of my cruise. I tried to shorten my reservation by 1 day and was told by Expedia the hotel would not do that. I told them that I would arrive, then, one day later than my reservation but would keep the departure date the same. I was told by Expedia I needed to contact the hotel directly which I did by email through Expedia. The hotel responded with "dear Guest,
we will respect the booking conditions of arrival". I assumed that they understood from this cryptic response.  I was boarding the train that Monday, when I discovered that my reservation had been cancelled on Expedia. I immediately called Hotel Alhambra and was told that I was viewed as a no show and as a result my entire reservation was cancelled. I reminded that I sent them an email telling them I would be one day late. They told me this changed the original terms of the reservations and that as a result when I did not show on Sunday May 3, I was viewed as a no show and that Expedia cancelled my reservation. When I contacted Expedia they said that was the policy of the hotel and that that the hotel canceled the reservation. No where in Expedia's site not on the hotel'd site nor on the paperwork anywhere does it suggest that if I was a day late, and told them, that my reservation would canceled with no refund.  I have filed a dispute with American Express  and they have refunded the money.  Expedia's behavior was of no help. They told me they could not recover a canceled reservation. Expedia told me the hotel would get my $691.63. Note I received an email from Expedia telling me my reservation was cancelled on May 6 only after I officially complained to a supervisor. This was 3 days after the cancellation This was an outrageous theft of my money with no services rendered.

author: DL H
title: Absolutely recommendable hotel with an ideal location advantage
text:
We were at the Hotel Alhambra, Paris with two families and three teens.

The air-conditioned rooms with modern bathrooms were top.
The teens had an extra-large 3-bed room and a larger bathroom. 

The very good breakfast could. Be taken in the garden or in the dining area. 
There is the typical French breakfast croissants, pain au chocolat, baguette, with salmon, ham, salami, jam, cheese, yogurt, granola, fruit mix, orange and apple juice as well as coffee and tea selections.

The hotel is ideally located between Pl de la République and Bastille.
The Oberkampf metro station is around the corner and you are therefore within 25-30 minutes of all the sights in Paris - regardless of whether by metro or on foot.

Absolutely recommended.

author: Monica W
title: Strict policy, not customer-friendly
text:
Be aware of their strict policy!!
Due to a cancelled SAS flight, I was delayed and arrived early the next morning. I emailed them in advance to explain the situation. They told me they had cancelled my reservation, but they still charged me for the entire stay!

That is, they kept 100% of my payment, refused to let me use the room for the remaining nights, and I was forced to find and pay for another hotel. This policy is completely unacceptable and deeply consumer-unfriendly. The staff showed zero empathy or willingness to find a solution. I highly recommend avoiding this hotel due to their rigid and unfair practices. It’s a risk I wouldn’t take as there so many other nice customer oriented hotels in Paris. 

Check out Hotel Les Theatres instead. Not the same area, but very charming and friendly.

author: Rita P
title: Very good experience!
text: Clean rooms, good breakfast, very pleasant garden. Air conditioning working very well during the heatwave.

author: laujordyn
title: Very pleasant stay
text: The hotel had everything we neeeded for a 4 day stay, it was located very close to restaurants and the shopping center. The staff was very nice and informed was very well.

author: aeddar434674
title: Top hotel in the heart of Paris!
text:
I was fully satisfied with my stay. The hotel is impeccably clean, ideally located, and the rooms are spacious, comfortable, and decorated with great taste. The breakfast is varied, generous, and of high quality.

The value for money is simply excellent. Whether for my business trips or for family stays in Paris, I have finally found my go-to hotel. I will return with great pleasure and I recommend it without the slightest hesitation.

author: Errori G
title: Terrible experience: zero hospitality and zero humanity.
text:
We were left speechless by the total lack of professionalism and humanity. At 11:20 PM, the hotel canceled our room, despite our request and agreement for check-in at midnight. The reason? The card was temporarily blocked for the guarantee charge. No real attempt to help us, no alternative proposed, no understanding of the situation.

Result: two people left on the street at 1 AM. There was no overbooking; they simply "dropped" us without any regard. This is not service, it is not hospitality: it is a lack of respect towards customers.

Terrible service. Terrible hospitality. Terrible management. Terrible humanity. Absolutely not recommended.

author: sotedeschi
title: A good place to stay
text: Great location, great place. Very convenient. The room was spacious and clean. We were on the first floor, yes you can hear the metro but it didn't bother us.

author: hotelopraopal5bl2026
title: Bad experience
text: Aircon is broken and no one can help, just explained due to too many people may using cause couple of room without aircon.  Can’t open window due to too many fly.  It was a terrible experience and not worth for such room cost.

author: Rachel S
title: GREAT STAFF
text: Hard to find this level of customer service elsewhere. This is the type of place where the staff remembers your name and goes above and beyond to try to help with whatever you need. One of the staff, Nelson told me they treat their guests like family - and I've felt it over and over again. I stay here every time I travel in! Everyone is lovely. The location is central -  and bonus points for the tacos across the street.

author: sgrey7
title: Great hotel, great location
text:
This is a great hotel - suspect it would be very hard to beat in NYC.

The first thing is the location. We have been to NYC probably 40 plus times now and the location of the hotel is perfect. Opposite Union Square - which is a great central location in itself with its market and buzz - it is in walking distance of the  best of NYC in our view. On one side, you can walk to 5th avenue, pass the Empire State building, Times Square, the usual tourist hot-spots. Turn in the other direction and you have West (and East) Village with its fabulous restaurants and neighbourhood feel. There is no better located hotel in our view.

The staff are all warm and genuinely friendly. The room we had was great. Decent size, quiet for NYC, great view. Clean. Couldn't fault it.

There are just two things they could do to make it even better. First, the Lounge and the Rooftop bar are a bit of a faff. They don't open two days a week and are closed between 12-4 every day, which is right when you want to escape NY heat and grab a cool drink. A Lounge in particularly should also be 'loungy' - i.e. you can chill there, get whatever drink you want etc, but there are a few too many 'rules' - its a bar at night and a cafe by day for example. If I want a glass of wine at 2pm I think the hotel should provide this (the restaurant on the ground floor does have a small bar but its not comfortable for a drink and the drinks there are not the greatest). Likewise, if I want some tea at 10pm after a meal, there should be somewhere I can do this. Secondly, there is no water in the room. When it's 34 degrees outside, really need water in the room that we can take with us.

Overall though, these are quite minor and the hotel does the big stuff right. Good staff, great location, comfortable and clean. We're back again in 2 months!

author: frisee
title: Expected More
text:
Our corner room was small and the bathroom was particularly small. The way the shower door opened was very awkward. The lighting in the room was poor. There was no light over the coffee maker and about one-third of the room had no overhead light or lamp. The bed and pillows were softer than we like. 

Housekeeping was noisy in the mornings. There was a lot of slamming of doors, not just by housekeeping, but by guests. 

Most of the staff were very friendly and welcoming when we were coming and going through the lobby. 

We were appalled to find a big roach on the bathroom floor on our last night. We mentioned this when we checked out and the woman at the front desk shared our horror. She said she would report it to management and they would get in touch with us, but to date, no one has.

author: Distant B
title: Expensive, and with annoying nickel and diming
text:
It's not the worst, but poor value price.

• Poorly designed rooms. No outlets near the only available table. No light in the room's only closet, so you're packing and unpacking in the dark.
• Oddly placed light switches. The one in the bathroom is under the towel hanger so it's not visible when you have a towel hanging. The switches are tiny buttons that are finnicky to use and hard to operate in dim light.
• I bought an upgraded room for over $500+/night. Upon check in (well past 4 PM), they tell they only have one room in that category available right now, but it has a "minor" view obstruction, and whether that's okay. Minor view obstruction turned out to be a 6' brick wall. Lesson: don't trust hotel staff.
• Upon check in they'll tell you that they've generously given you an allowance of $35/day to spend on hotel amenities. It turns out they're charging you a "destination fee" of $40/day which lets you buy $35/day of amenities. How magnanimous.
• Internet is $14.95/day if you didn't book direct. $20/night hostels give it to you free.
• I called them before I arrived to ask if they could precharge the destination fees they'd charge when I arrived because it would've saved me time in our expensing software. Quite oddly, a basic favor like this for someone paying $500+/night was anathema to the W, and they point back refused to help.
• Elevators slow, small, and with frequent stops as everyone is waiting for one.

The rooftop bar is nice if you can get in (we were initially refused a reservation despite it being completely empty for the next 90 minutes). The 2nd floor lounge and cafe are great.

author: KMC
title: Stylish Revival and Prime Location Shine at W Union Square
text: W Union Square has made a remarkable comeback with a meticulous renovation that preserves its historic charm while infusing the public spaces and hotel rooms with a fresh and inviting atmosphere. The rooms and suites exude a vibrant and airy ambiance, creating a welcoming environment that allows guests to fully appreciate the spacious accommodations. The rooms are exceptionally clean, and the city views are simply breathtaking. Additionally, the hotel’s prime location offers easy access to a plethora of delightful restaurants and cafes. I eagerly anticipate my next visit to W Union Square!

author: Rona N
title: A perfect stay
text: A wonderful hotel with comfortable, clean, well-designed rooms, thoughtful amenities - like in-room Nespresso machines and complimentary water & snacks - and an excellent staff.  We especially enjoyed the concierge, Anthony, whose warmth and friendliness made us feel welcome. He shared ideas for  our stay and gifted us with a free bottle of wine - above and beyond service!  The hotel is in a great location, close to the subway and within walking distance of Chelsea, the High Line, many midtown sites and lots of good food.   Despite being in a popular area for nightlife, rooms were quiet for sleeping.  It was a great value by comparison to other hotels in the area.  We will definitely stay here again.

author: Amy P
title: Amazing hotel, just book it!
text: We had a fantastic stay here, the location is perfect for exploring and there are loads of great restaurants and bars right on the doorstep. Hotel itself is beautiful, room was spotless and we slept really well. Staff were also great, particular shout out to concierge Anthony who helped us with taxis and is super friendly and helpful. We will definitely be back!!

author: Harold F
title: A wonderful, awesome hotel experience.
text: Perfect. Outstanding   Large beautiful junior suite.  We were in awe of our magnificent view of the Empire State Building. The room was so quiet and clean. We received complimentary treats on check in. The neighborhood was vibrant; filled with pastry and ice cream shops. The staff was midwestern friendly, always available for our questions.  I cannot imagine a better hotel experience.

author: Blair S.
title: The Hotel That Made Us Feel Right at Home in NYC
text:
A true hidden gem in NYC! We only stayed one night, but this hotel left such a great impression on us. From the moment we arrived, the staff were incredibly gracious, welcoming, and genuinely helpful. They allowed us to check in early, helped us with directions around the city, and every interaction we had with them was warm and friendly.

Our room was immaculate, spacious, and so comfortable. The complimentary snacks and water were an unexpected little touch that we really appreciated.

We spent a long day exploring NYC, so coming back to a clean, quiet, comfortable room at the end of the night was exactly what we needed. After all the walking and craziness of the city, it felt so good to have a place that felt welcoming and relaxing.

For us, it was the combination of the wonderful staff, spotless room, and those thoughtful little extras that made this stay stand out. We honestly feel like we found a hidden gem, and we would absolutely stay here again!

author: Shane F
title: First family visit to NYC.
text: We had a great time and Anthony at the door was great and super helpful.

author: Mary G
title: Great staff and upscale lodgings
text: We had a great experience at the Bryant Park Hotel! The staff is outstanding - they were so attentive and genuinely friendly. Our room was very attractive and comfortable. We enjoyed the spa-like bathroom. The midtown location is convenient. And what a refreshing bonus - just across the street - strolling in Bryant Park before breakfast and after dinner.

author: Travelready2
title: Our best Manhattan experience ever!
text: Our best Manhattan experience ever - mostly because of the professional, welcoming and helpful staff. Our beautiful room overlooked Bryant Park, which is close to the Theatre District, great restaurants, jazz clubs and shopping. Their cozy Celon Lounge and Bar is very near Koi, an excellent Asian Fusion restaurant. This hotel is an excellent value for all that it offers. Can't wait to go back!

author: Tim S
title: Bryant Park Hotel is a must stay experience
text: Fantastic experience here. Service was next level. Siobhan, the general manager, and her whole staff, particularly Josephine and Scott at the front desk were above and beyond helpful, professional and competent. Every request we made was dealt with immediately, and professionally. Our room, and everywhere we went in the hotel, was extremely clean and well thought out. Our room had a beautiful view of Bryant park and the NYC skyline. We highly recommend. We are looking forward to staying here again!

author: Cathy W
title: We had a wonderful stay, will definitely be back!
text:
We flew in for our wedding anniversary and enjoyed a wonderful 3 night stay! We were warmly greeted by Scott and Shannon and upgraded to a junior suite, which was just lovely! The views of the park across the street were beautiful and since we were on the 16th floor, the noise wasn’t bad at all. The room itself has plenty of space to stretch out and the bed was very comfortable. 

The location is perfect, we walked to a Broadway show, shopping, restaurants and of course Bryant Park. It gets very crowded in this area but our room was a delightful respite from the crowds.

The hotel is currently renovating their lobby but despite the construction, the hotel staff were extremely professional, warm and hospitable. Special mention to Shannon and Jo, just wonderful ladies who helped make our stay extra special!

We highly recommend this hotel, we are already forward to our next stay!

author: rmerje02
title: Love the Bryant Park Hotel
text:
Recently my s.o. and I spent a lovely three nights at the Bryant Park Hotel; our third stay in less than a year.  Our Bryant Park one bedroom suite on the 21st floor was spacious, beautifully decorated and offered stunning views of Bryant park and looking east.  The room's sophisticated design includes ambient lighting and contemporary furnishing that fit our needs perfectly.  It was a pleasure to return to our oasis for a quiet rejuvenation after a long day in the city.
The staff at the Bryant Park hotel are genuinely friendly and helpful with every need.  They are committed to making sure  your stay at the Bryant Park is everything you want from your experience. 
And... they are wrapping up on an amazing update on the lobby.  They have a large screen video to see what is coming and it will be stunning.
Thank you to everyone at the Bryant Park for making our stay so special.  See you in the future!

author: Manisha
title: Part of my well planned NY trip!
text: It is so close to Penn Station an Times Square, that makes commute  easier for elders and kids on a family vacation trip to NY

author: Thomas L
title: CHECK YELP BEFORE BOOKING
text: CHECK YELP BEFORE BOOKING. Every negative comment on yelp is true. BEWARE OF THIS HOTEL. Hotel staff very rude and not helpful. Place is disgustingly dirty.

author: Flyer18680698796
title: Overcharging bogus fees
text: This was the worst experience ever!!! To start they charged my card 2 times prior to my arrival and didn’t have the courtesy to call and explain what happened and this over drafted my account leaving me with no funds for my trip as it too 4 days for refund to hit my account then we put a different card on file for the 150 incidentals and they charged both cards again causing another overdraft fee they also charged us 4 other charges totaling over 400 for room charge and facility fees and I’m told it was just an error by the new guy inputting this incorrect these charges where manual entry so they took the photo copy of our cards to enter these charges I reached out to Wyndham and it’s out their hands as it’s a franchise and I have tried 4 times to be connected to the manager and no luck this hotel seems to be scamming travelers of money and I’m sure many haven’t noticed they would not even comp our parking to help us out for the issue they caused I have never had an experience as unfortunate as this causing so much issue that now I have to deal with my bank to fix all the wrong charges and overdraft fees this has caused and my other bills that got declined as this locked my accounts up the customer service was the worst over this and every body blamed every one else please do yourself a favor don’t book this hotel and be careful of all Wyndham as they will not support or help you for their errors!!! Double check your bills and ask for a copy of all charges

author: N S
title: Unacceptable issues
text:
I would not recommend this hotel. There were problems from the moment we arrived, and the overall condition and management of the property were extremely disappointing.

We arrived early and left our luggage with the hotel, and the security for stored luggage was basically nonexistent. I did not feel that there was any adequate system in place to make sure bags were secure or returned only to the proper guests. For a NYC hotel handling travelers’ belongings, that is unacceptable.

When we checked in, we were put into a room that was NOT the type of room I had reserved. I had to address the issue myself and insist that they change it back to what I had actually booked.

The lobby was in disarray and looked poorly maintained. To make matters worse, there were dead flies clearly visible inside the light fixture directly above the reception desk. That should tell you something about the attention being paid to cleanliness and maintenance.

The bathroom was another disaster. The shower water was dangerously hot and very difficult to regulate, and using the shower resulted in water flooding the bathroom floor.

These were not small cosmetic complaints. They involved security, cleanliness, maintenance, and basic functionality of the room. I expected considerably better from a hotel carrying the Wyndham name, especially at NYC hotel prices.

One star. I would not stay here again.

author: Pat L
title: Good close to places we wanted to visit
text:
Hotel staff was very friendly 
Water very hot 
Complaints 
Shower curtain very dirty and shower rod very rusty. Both need to be replaced

author: Rossella C
title: Terrible hotel.
text: I booked a triple room and found myself in a room with only one double bed, making me believe that the bed was larger than a normal double bed... after much insistence, especially considering the heat and the lack of air conditioning and a fan, I was moved to a room with two beds... the room was very dirty, several components were broken, it was not cleaned the following day... dust everywhere, very dirty carpet... bottles thrown on the floor in the hallways... I do not recommend it...

author: Achebe
title: Horrible, to be avoided at all costs.
text: Catastrophic and unprofessional welcome, incompetent customer service (very peculiar handling of complaints, especially when it is related to a billing error by the hotel). Very relative cleanliness of the rooms, dilapidated and poorly maintained building. Very frugal breakfast and with basic industrial products. This hotel is a real shame for the Accor Group and for the 4-star Mercure hotels.

author: Safari39027690173
title: Hotel next to La Villette.
text: The hotel is well-located, just a one-minute walk from the metro station. The rooms and bathroom are spacious. Breakfast is acceptable. Unfortunately, the building's air conditioning was not working. Nevertheless, it offers good value for money.

author: travelheur
title: AVOID AT ALL COSTS!
text:
Avoid at all costs!
We stayed at this hotel at the beginning of July.
Upon arrival, we were asked if we had received an email regarding the air conditioning not working; however, we had received nothing, nor were we even warned when booking.
It was very hot and we were explained that to compensate for the air conditioning breakdown, we would find a fan in our room. It was so noisy, to the point that we could not run it during the night. To get a little coolness, we then opened the window. It only opens to 30 degrees, and it overlooked the boulevard. Noisy because people were partying there, not to mention the vehicle traffic.
As a result, we were very hot and slept little. Not even a bottle of water in the room...
It should be noted that the bathtub is slippery; it really presents significant risks of falling! So much for safety.
Dirty windows, questionable carpet.
The next day we went down to have breakfast.
Frankly, we were surprised by its more than basic level. In bulk, no small jars of jam but large jars where everyone helped themselves; not very appetizing. No yogurts, we were told that there never were any and that we could fall back on the fromage blanc! No hard-boiled eggs either, only 2 cheeses, few fruits, etc. etc., I'll spare you the rest.
Having stayed in Mercure hotels, I think it is clearly not up to standard. The overall services are those of a 2-star hotel (and even then, Ibis hotels are clean), certainly not a 4-star (except for the price).
This establishment has no place in the Accor group. It even gives it a bad name.
I requested feedback from hotel management by email.
To date no response ... Online obviously with everything else.

author: Hervé B
title: Failed stay
text: First of all, no air conditioning with 35 degrees outside, I let you imagine, the room is cheap and high up, it is good for the price, of course no air conditioning, the breakfast is horrible, have it outside.

author: Josee B
title: Perfect little oasis
text:
Hotel Malte was the perfect little gem for this solo one week trip. 
The staff were amazing, especially since I messed up my reservation and they immediately made it all more than ok for me. 
The location was perfect. Easy access to shopping, restaurants and public transportation, while being very quiet. 
The hotel was clean and chic and I felt comfortable throughout my stay.

I would absolutely recommend and I'll be choosing this as my go to spot when I come back.

author: Ayana D
title: Amazing!
text: Beautiful and convenient location with very helpful, friendly receptions. My room was randomly upgraded to a suite which made my stay in Paris even more special.

author: Sebastian C
title: An excellent hotel to explore Paris
text: We arrived earlier than check-in time, just with the intention to leave our bags and start exploring Paris. I was a great surprise that we got the opportunity to take breakfast for free before we took of, which was a warm welcome after the long journey to get to the hotel. The personnel of the hotel is very kind and helpful, the location of the hotel allowed us the explore Paris bay foot but we could find nearby metro stations when needed. The hotel is comfortable and clean, you get extra perks like drinks in the minibar which are replenished every day, not to mention the open bar and sweets in the lobby from 2pm until 2am, and you can use that in all Astotel hotels from Paris.

author: Chase P
title: August solo stay
text: The location is perfect, it’s central enough where you can walk anywhere, but it is also quiet and calm in the hotel. It is very much worth the money, the amenities are great and the staff is extremely accommodating. Would totally stay again!

author: Rolando O
title: Malte Hotel
text: Amazing experience. The hotel was more than perfect for my stay in Paris. Highly recommend.

author: Curious30138685486
title: NH hotel Opera Paris
text: The hotel reservation personnel was polite. Breakfast room too small considering a four stars hotel and the variety of food selection not adequate again for a four stars hotel. The suite room was nice and renewed but with very bad positioning since located at First floor facing an internal light well. Moreover, pigeon feathers in the gutter was present without any cleaning. Lastly, the air conditioning positioning just on top of the sofà bed caused cold problems on the body during sleeping so we have been obliged to switch off it sensing hot temperature

author: Tina Montinola
title: Great Location, Lovely Service, But  Book a Bigger Room
text:
enjoyed our stay at NH Paris Opéra Faubourg, especially because of the location. It’s very convenient for exploring Paris, with the Le Peletier and Cadet Metro stations just a couple of minutes away. Galeries Lafayette, Opéra and Boulevard Haussmann are also within easy walking distance, so shopping, restaurants and getting around the city were all very easy.

One of my favorite things about the hotel was the little complimentary refreshment station in the lobby. They had water, juice and these delicious blue and white meringues that I kept going back for! It was such a simple touch, but after being out walking around Paris all day, I really appreciated being able to grab a drink or something sweet whenever we came back to the hotel.

The staff were another highlight. The reception team was warm, friendly and very helpful. They assisted us with restaurant reservations, including getting us a table at Paul Bert, which we really appreciated.

The hotel itself has a nice, modern vibe and has recently been renovated. My main issue was the size of our room. We booked the Standard Room, which is 14 m², and for two people with suitcases, it felt very tight. There was barely enough space for our luggage, and even the hallways felt quite narrow. I know smaller rooms are common in Paris, but personally I found it a little too cramped.

If I stayed here again, I absolutely would, mainly because of the excellent location and helpful staff, but I would definitely pay extra for a larger room. The Superior rooms start at 18 m², and I think those extra few square meters would make a big difference.

Overall, a very pleasant Paris hotel with a great location, thoughtful little touches and genuinely helpful service. Just don’t underestimate how small 14 m² feels when you have two people and two suitcases

author: SQ18
title: Great stay
text:
Great hotel! We stayed in a junior suite which was spacious for Paris standards and had a very nice balcony and view. Very clean and modern. 

Staff were friendly and the location is good, easy walk to the Opera area, plenty of restaurants, shops, etc nearby. Only complaint is that there is one elevator and sometimes the wait time is a bit too long.

Found it to be great value compared to other places i've stayed at in Paris. Would definitely return.

author: Ricardo D
title: Great experience in the city of lights.
text: The bed and pillows were the standout features of this experience. The breakfast was incredible, and the staff was incredibly attentive. Overall, it was a great value for the price. The location was also very convenient, near metro stations.

author: Baukus
title: best hotel in the neighborhood - we will be back!
text:
"Upon entering the hotel, we were welcomed very warmly by Mounir at the reception, and after the professional check-in process, he upgraded us to a suite as the 'lucky guest for the day.' ;-)"
But the breakfast was also..."

author: rosetintedjourneys
title: Fantastic Location, Decent Stay with Room for Improvement
text:
We stayed at the Renaissance Paris and overall had a good experience. The location is truly phenomenal — close to major sights, great restaurants, and easy transportation. It’s the kind of spot that makes exploring Paris effortless, and for that alone, the hotel has a lot of value.

The staff was friendly and helpful, and we appreciated the warm service throughout our stay.

The hotel itself, however, is very old and a bit run down in areas. You can feel the history of the building (which is charming in some ways), but there are definitely spots that could use refreshing. From what we’ve heard, the property is currently under renovation, which is promising and hopefully means a much-improved guest experience in the near future.

That said, the comfort, the service, and especially the unbeatable location made it a solid stay — and once the renovations are complete, this hotel has the potential to be truly exceptional.

Overall: a very good base for exploring Paris, with upgrades on the horizon.

author: tallulahsoq
title: NOT a 5 star hotel and dont be deceived by photos on website!
text:
How this hotel is even a "5 star" hotel is simply deceptive and a joke. I stayed here for a work conference and even though the location is great (right next to the tuileries garden and the place vendome), there is nothing left to be desired. It seemed that the owners just cannot be bothered to maintain this hotel and it really showed. 

1. main revolving doors not working and never once been fixed during our stay
2. shower stalls are perpetually clogged, needed to be unclogged and pumped daily
3. tap in handwash basin misaligned so water keeps spraying everywhere everytime you wash your hands
4. WC is also clogged, we complained and the plumbers came to fix
5. panel above WC falls off everytime you flush, never mind i just pushed it back in.
6. the lifts didnt work 2 out of 3 days. On the morning of departure i had to carry my suitcases down the emergency stairwell!!
7. the doors and walls are thin and you can hear every noise and footstep outside.

TOTALLY APPALLING. AND FOR 500 EUROS A NIGHT A COMPLETE RIPOFF.

author: Nancy W
title: Great location, staff and food - I loved it all!
text: What a great hotel! Location is excellent. Quick walk to the Louvre, Notre Dame, Ste. Chappelle and Arche de Triumphe. And the staff is excellent. If you meet Eric the concierege, say hi to him for me. He gave us great tips like going early to the train station Le Gare De Leon for our nonstop train to Avignon. He said we could enjoy a beverage or snack in Le Train Bleu, a restaurant featured in Murder on the Orient Express movie. What a great tip! The restaurant is quite a surprise in the middle of the train station! You have to see the ceilings to believe it! Eric got a big kick out of our car for a Paris tour, a tiny Citroen. He went out to talk to our driver and was really smiling! As Marriott Platinum Elite guests, we enjoyed 2 free $35 breakfast buffets every morning which was good news/bad news - delicious and I hope the calories didn't count! And the bartender was a delight to watch - a true professional. All in all, an excellent stay!
