author: Manny1950
title: Renaissance Hotel Vendôme Paris, what a disappointment
text:
At the end of a trip to Italy, my wife and I stayed at the Renaissance hotel for two nights. The room was supposed to be a deluxe king room. The price was just over $1000 per night. The first room they asked us to stay in Was probably about 150 ft.² overlooking the mechanical units of the hotel. We refused to stay there. We were brought to a different room which we also did not care for however they said it was the only other room available. We reluctantly accepted.
This room at best was similar to any motel hotel room you would find off a freeway in the United States. Probably would’ve paid $150 per night in the US. I understand that rooms in Paris are way more expensive than that but to pay over $1000 for this pathetic room was ridiculous. The weather was warm and the air-conditioning didn’t work. I asked several times to have the air-conditioning evaluated. Front desk said that it was however air-conditioning never functioned  during our stay. The amenities at the hotel were worthy of only a three star rating rather than the five star rating.  

My wife and I have stayed in Paris many times and this was by far and away the worst experience we ever had from a hotel standpoint. I am a Marriott Bonvoy member and I’ve always enjoyed staying at their hotels. For the money that we paid for this Marriott property, over $1000 per night, disappointment was the ruling feeling.

author: MarthaE1818
title: Not 5 stars by any stretch
text:
I was shocked that this is considered 5 stars. I almost never book on points but was doing a solo weekend w/o my family and decided it was a good time to take a risk. Upon check in, I received surely one of the worst rooms in the hotel - on the first floor, above a noisy restaurant/bar and with a broken air con during an extremely hot period. Fortunately, when I was unable to fall asleep at 11pm because of the thumping bass (and inability to open my window to try and cool down), they changed my room. However, the hotel had no mini bar nor room service. The sheets were scratchy and then room was otherwise tired and beat up. However, the worst part of the experience was when I was blow drying my hair after a pre-dinner shower, and housekeeping had walked in on me (and scared the heck out of me as a women traveling alone). I did not report this to the hotel as I did not want to get the housekeeper in trouble, but a basic part of training should be that if you see someone in a towel, you immediately leave the room.

While the location of the hotel might be 5 stars, the lobby, rooms, etc. very much felt like a 4, realistically 3 star experience.

author: Jo B
title: Great hotel
text:
We had a great time at this hotel in a triple room.  The staff were all very good and couldn't do enough to help.Very good location.  Clean rooms.  
Breakfast was great and much better than I was expecting.  I liked the drinks and snacks given in the rooms.
Bathroom was adequate but on the small side.
All in all a great 3 days in Paris.

author: Lynn B
title: Beautiful boutique hotel
text: Beautiful boutique hotel, we loved the location and the very warm welcome at check in. The staff are attentive and very pleasant, the decor is of a high standard  and beautiful. The bedroom was spacious and very comfortable with everything we needed and loved the little touches, champagne and great toiletries, We would highly recommend.

author: Marie-Luce Bozom
title: A beautiful, well-kept house
text:
A very beautiful hotel ideally located between the Luxembourg Gardens and Notre-Dame de Paris. Refined and welcoming decor. Quick and courteous check-in with the possibility of early check-in. A room facing the courtyard, charming and impeccable, very quiet. A glass elevator allowing you to enjoy this beautiful staircase with 19th-century stained glass. 
Nice welcome in the room with a self-service minibar, a half-bottle of wine, and small cookies. Always a nice gesture. 
Kudos to you

author: Michaela W
title: A lovely time in Paris in a very good hotel
text: We felt very comfortable, the staff are very friendly and accommodating. The atmosphere is really very good and relaxed. The breakfast is delicious and very extensive. We can recommend the hotel without any reservations. We will very gladly book a room again.

author: stephane p
title: Excellent stay
text: Excellent stay in this charming hotel, right in Saint-Germain-des-Prés. The staff is adorable and very helpful.

author: Vanesa G
title: We'd always come back
text: Excellent location, facilities, super friendly and predisposed staff, we would return without hesitation

author: ZvilleMomof4
title: Just a “meh”
text: Returned late to Paris off the train and needed a close room just for the night. Proximity to St Lazare station is great. Otherwise the hotel feels very downmarket. Small, cramped, needing renovation. Room was just ok. Was fine for the few hours we needed it but would not recommend it for anyone wanting a longer stay or with any comfort or amenities. Bathroom was cramped, shower was poor with no pressure. Beds were hard and not overly comfortable.

author: Pantelis Z
title: Holidays with kids in Paris
text: The services provided were very poor considering the price we paid. The hotel is in desperate need of a full renovation; its only saving grace is the excellent location. Being in the heart of the city, close to major monuments and the metro, is very convenient. However, there are definitely better options nearby for less money. I wouldn’t recommend it, which is a shame because the location is perfect.

author: Itidel C
title: An excellent hotel
text: They are excellent. They welcomed us very well and, as my sister is ill, we asked for a change of room. They did so without hesitation. The staff is very professional. I highly recommend this hotel.

author: Olaf D
title: Nice place, perfectly located.
text: Travelling to some meetings in the center of Paris, this hotel has it all: Easy to reach and find, nice stay, all the things you need in 5 minutes around: Perfect.

author: Pam D
title: Highly recommended
text:
We had a great stay at the Hotel. Location well connected to public transport. 
The lobby is just out of this world. The rooms fantastic. Breakfast was delicious. Staff friendly and helpful. Will definitely come back.

author: DRM1221
title: Construction Aug 2026
text:
Hotel is fine…as expected. 

Renovations and noise never mentioned at booking or checkin. Expect construction noise on adjacent floors throughout the day.

author: Elle S
title: Far from places of interest
text: We did not choose this hotel to stay. It was one night stay before our river cruise and was provided by Avalon Waterways. It is not easy to get to the tub to take a shower. First, it is a quite deep tub, second, the bottom is slippery. To get out of it more difficult than to get in. The hotel needs to convert this tub/shower combo in the shower cabin for people to avoid injuries. The hotel shows age. The room is below average size, the bed is OK. The bathroom was clean. The breakfast buffet was with a lot of choices for hot, cold food and breads. We did not go to their restaurant, but the cafe in the lobby is fine for snacks and drinks. The location is OK, but it is a long walk to Arc De Triomphe, Musee D'Orsay, Louvre, Notre Dame. It is necessary to ride a taxi or metro. The hotel staff is friendly and responsive and helps with taxi rides. We would not recommend this hotel for longer stays.

author: Hillary H
title: Sufficient
text: This hotel is just ok. Nothing spectacular but was sufficient. Staff were friendly.

author: K Aust
title: A great location in Paris
text:
I had a great experience at Le Meridien. The location was close to the Metro/RER and a perfect base for work and play. 
The room was a generous size, very quiet and clean. Fluffy towels and a very comfortable bed. 
The staff were very helpful, and friendly. A burger in the Luna Bar while watching the FIFA World Cup was fun. Breakfast is chaos, but lots on offer including delicious cheese. 
I would stay here again.

author: monica459io
title: Fantastic hotel to return to for sure
text: Excellent location, spacious room with a panoramic view, very comfortable bed, and special attention paid to the guest.

author: Laarabd
title: Excellent, nothing to complain about
text:
Everything is good
An on-site massage service is also great 
Amenities are nearby, the RER and the subway as well, the taxi service on time for the airport.
The staff is smiling and helpful.

author: jpgorczewski
title: never disappointed
text: I have noted a certain consistency in all the services over the five years that I have known this hotel

author: gabialmer
title: Very good location
text: Very good location near the opera and several metro stations, good for exploring the most important sights!

author: Zasygia
title: Simply perfect!
text:
A truly excellent experience. The hotel was perfect, clean, and well-organized. The food was excellent and high-quality, and the staff proved to be truly kind, helpful, and efficient. The price-quality ratio was also excellent.

The only small flaws were the toiletries, which were rather meager, and the provided glasses, which were still full of detergent residue. For the rest, nothing to say: a pleasant stay and a highly recommended property.

author: Qiyun X
title: Worth the hype!
text:
The location for the hotel is very convenient if you want to do shopping close to golden triangle. Hotel team is extremely helpful and friendly with quick response to my asks/requests. My room has been upgraded to the suite level with the best view of the street and a touch of Eiffel tower, which is the highlight of my trip.
Will definitely comeback

author: stephen
title: Lovely hotel in a great neighborhood
text: Everything you could want in a Parisian hotel.  Location was a perfect base for exploration.  Fantastic service, tasty cocktails, curated design, comfy bed.

author: Globalepicurian1478
title: 8th arrondissement hidden gem
text: The Grand Powers is a bourique hotel located in the heart of Paris. The staff treats you like family and makes you feel at home. It is litterally steps away from the Champs-Elysees. Thank you all of you for an exceprional stay. I hope to be back soon.

author: Breanna H
title: Fave Hotel in Paris!!!
text: My husband and I have traveled to Paris the past four years and three have been spent at Grand Powers! (The second year, we thought to try a new place for something “different” and were so disappointed!). The staff are all SO kind and we adore the location. We can shop and visit museums and do all the tourist things while walking for the most part! The bar/restaurant is great!! It’s very cozy, but you’ll love the cocktails and food!! We cannot say enough good things about this hotel!

author: Danny C
title: Amazing Hotel
text: Sofia was absolutely wonderful and made our stay unforgettable from the moment we arrived. He checked us in, made us feel genuinely welcomed, and went above and beyond to make sure we were comfortable and had everything we needed. Her kindness, professionalism, and attention to detail really stood out. Sofia is a huge asset to the hotel and was a big part of what made our experience so special. Thank you, Sofia, for the amazing hospitality!

author: Roger G
title: Great hotel with a good location
text:
My wife and I wanted a hotel that was close to Gare du Nord with easy access to the main Paris attractions. We spent four nights at Hotel Lorette Astotel. 

The hotels had just reopened after renovation and everything was spotless. The staff very friendly, the room clean and a good range of options for the breakfast. 

There is a free complimentary mini bar - restocked every day and free complimentary coffee/tea/drinks and pastries/cake available every day from 2pm to 2am. As a guest you can visit any of the other hotels in the chain in Paris and take advantage of their complementary drinks and pasties!

Our room (the cheapest available) was perhaps a bit on the small side but that didn't matter to us and we spend our days exploring Paris and only needed the room to sleep.

author: Chinenye O
title: Even with the mistake in my booking, receptionist still considered without stressing, I will come back again 💯
text:
Everything 100% 
I recommend, from staffing, cleanliness, breakfast, midday snacking, the complimentary bar in the room, location, value for money is everything

author: Sophie B
title: Charming hotel in the heart of the 9th arrondissement
text: Human-sized hotel, ideally located in the 9th, Place St Georges. Very well served (bus and metro line 12 in the immediate vicinity). The Opera, the department stores, and Montmartre are accessible in 10 minutes on foot. Nicely decorated room and very friendly staff. The breakfast satisfies all tastes. A multitude of restaurants in the neighboring streets. Very good stay. Address to keep.

author: LPF1010
title: Wonderful and central
text: A wonderful hotel for a vacation in Paris. Very well located, just a few minutes from the Opera and Montmartre. A very quiet area, with a very good atmosphere.    Subway next door, direct line to Montparnasse station and Place de la Concorde. Friendly and familiar service, very pleasant. Good breakfast and a common area with pastries and drinks, courtesy of the house. Excellent value for money. Essential. We will always return.

author: Judy C
title: Lovely Parisian style hotel
text: Hotel Lorette is a cute and charming Parisian style hotel.  It is an older building but has been renovated and while I was there, renovation was on going in the other floors but it did not bother me.   I booked a family room for 4 people and the room I stayed in was recently renovated and is  air conditioned. I absolutely loved that the family room had two separate rooms with each one having its own bathroom. One of the rooms face the front and had a nice view. Every morning I would open the window and enjoy the view.  The neighborhood is quiet even though the restaurants are open late with people sitting outside. I sat outside one of these restaurants for late night drinks and loved the convenience back to the the hotel.  At the hotel, all day, you can get coffee, tea, and juice in the lobby for free.  For breakfast everyday, I went to a nearby bakery, I highly recommend Cyprien Boulangerie, to buy freshly baked delicious french baguette and other baked goods to bring back to the hotel to have it with coffee.  That worked out well and I did not need to buy the hotel breakfast. The hotel also offer free snacks from 2pm-2am. I love coming back to the hotel after sightseeing and have the snacks and drinks. You can go to the other hotels in the group for the free snacks as well. Almost forgot to mention, everyday they fill your hotel room fridge with water, soda and juice, all included. The lobby was nice and cozy, also got to enjoy the patio.  The location of the hotel is great and it is only one block away from the metro and it is in a nice, safe neighborhood.  There are good restaurants close by.  I really enjoyed my stay at this hotel and would not hesitate to stay there again for my next visit.

author: Fabia A
title: Small hotel near Piazza Fiume.
text:
Chosen for the competitive price considering the number of stars and the location. 
On Via Piave, just steps from Piazza Fiume (Rinascente) and about a 10-minute walk from Piazza Barberini (nearest Metro). Quiet area with bars, restaurants, and supermarkets. 
The hotel is small and appears clean. The room is small but functional (despite the 40 degrees, I found it cool). A single elevator for the entire hotel, quite slow and always occupied. The breakfast room on the lower floor is small, with various sweet and savory choices, and fruit. The coffee is good! 
For the price paid, it was fine; perhaps if it had cost more, I would have considered other options as well.

author: Marzia G
title: Very small but comfortable single room
text:
Great location just steps from Rinascente. I booked a single room that honestly was really small but quite comfortable. I would say it was more similar to a nun's cell or the cabin of a ship. Single bed with a comfortable mattress. Cleaning was okay. Bathroom
nice but in the shower, there was no hot water (only slightly warm) and the drain did not work. In short, if it's just for one night, it's okay given the rates, but I would say that 3 stars would be more appropriate at least for this type of room.

author: Jill C
title: Three night stay.
text:
Double room overlooking the Main Street. Room very small and bathroom even smaller. No hot water in handbasin and plug did not work resulting In Water constantly draining out. The shower head kept dropping down.
Reported it at reception the next morning but nothing done about it. Air conditioning was set at 23 degrees! Far too hot in the room. When I asked if it could be altered we were informed that every room was the same.
On the last night, no hot water in shower. Reported it again only to be told no one else had reported it. Not helpful! Saw the person at the front desk constantly vaping!
Breakfast was good.
Great local restaurants all around the hotel.

author: Lottepuss
title: Adequate hotel near Villa Borghese
text:
Single rooms are very small. Location is good if you are visiting Villa Borghese and it took me around 15 mins walk from Termini. Not a 4-star in my opinion, but a 2-3 star.
Pros: All staff I encountered were very helpful and friendly.
Breakfast was OK, but there was no freshly squeezed orange juice (surprising for a 4-star hotel?).
Nearby to some great eateries e.g. Ristorante Pizzeria Andrea (Via Castelfidardo), Le Virtù Molisane (Via Collina), YEZI (Asian restaurant).
You can walk to the main sights in around 20 - 30 mins. (Piazza Barberini, Trevi Fountain etc.)
Cons: Rome was 29 degs when I was there and the aircon in the room was very poor. I barely slept due to the heat and the mattress was too firm for me. 
Far away from Vatican city, but I got a 492 bus direct (took 30 mins) from Via XX Settembre - just tap your credit card (1.50 Euro single ticket).
I liked the area of this hotel, but I would not stay in this hotel again. I would find one with better air con and more comfortable beds.

author: Leena B
title: This Property cannot be classified as a four star
text: This hotel was sold to us by Exotica  as a four star property. Rooms are very tiny, bathroom had a damp smell, property is very dated and really does not qualify as a four star property by international standards. Elevator is old and very slow.

author: M D
title: Good hotel, but service could be improved.
text:
Well-located hotel. 
Very beautiful view from the corner room on the 7th floor. 
Clean room, small but functional.
Sluggish air conditioning. 
Bathroom lacks ventilation and a towel warmer. 
No air conditioning in the hallway on the 7th floor, stifling while waiting for the elevator.
Breakfast is decent, nothing more. 
All the front desk staff are friendly and efficient. 
However, the staff at the 8th-floor bar is not up to par; after 15 minutes of waiting to have a drink, we gave up.
Lunch, the waitresses are a bit inefficient.

author: Bev N
title: Lovely hotel
text: Lovely hotel in a great central location rooms are on the small side but very comfortable pool on the roof which is great to cool down in and bar on roof also staff very friendly and knowledgeable of local area

author: Cristina M
title: Clean and spacious.
text: Hotel near the Colosseum, clean and spacious with a very good and varied buffet-style breakfast.

author: Zineb J
title: Not the Experience We Expected
text:
Great location. However, we were disappointed with our room. The tiny window looked directly onto the hotel’s trash bins and back area. When we asked the staff, they said the room was assigned randomly, even though we had booked four months in advance.

The bathroom was not very clean, with hair on the floor and around the toilet. The room was very small and felt cramped. It was also very noisy—we could hear even small footsteps and noises from outside the room.

The prices were very expensive for what was offered. Overall, the location was great, but the room, cleanliness, noise, and value for money did not meet our expectations.

author: Bridget S
title: Good stay near colosseum.
text: Nice hotel, good location. 1st floor room has some city noise but not too bad. Decent size and clean. Breakfast was decent. Friendly staff. Rooftop bar and pool.

author: Lesley S
title: Hotel Ripa in Trastavere
text: Avoid room 213. Old carpet and decor. Mould in the bathroom.  Bath with curtain around it for a shower. Shower pressure excellent though. Bottled water only provided for the first day for some reason, not refreshed at all during our 3 nights.  Sockets on the bedside and around the room don’t work with usual adapters, we shorted the electric trying to use one. The socket used for the TV and fridge were the only ones which could be used with adapter.  Staff friendly. Location handy, Breakast good, amazing fresh melon every day. Restaurants of Trastavere within 10-15 mins walk and easy 45 mins walk to the Colosseum / historic centre. Bus to Vatican & train station from the main road, a 5 mins walk walk from the hotel

author: george s
title: Trastevere gem
text: Location is superb very close to buses are regular taking you into centre of Rome , 20 minutes walk to train station, ideal for train to Fumicino airport direct route, also close to centre of Trastevere and its sights and many restaurants and bars. Staff at hotel couldn't be more helpful, and always very pleasant and helpful. Hotel is a bit quirky with the random statues about hotel. Our room was fine very spacious, and a good shower, breakfast was good a good start to the day and the air conditioning was a blessing. On whole a excellent experience.

author: Mar r
title: Good hotel in need of improvements
text:
The hotel in general is fine, but the beds are a disaster, full of lumps, they need to be changed...the rooms are spacious but old, the breakfast is good, they have variety, the staff is good too.
It is a 4-star hotel in Rome, here it would be a 3-star, the decor is innovative and striking and it catches your eye from the outside, it has a mini gym but the beds are a disaster.

author: BJBM
title: Ugly, bad, noisy hotel!
text:
- Crazy hotel (grim decor, strange kitschy statues and nasty sofas)
- Very noisy (read; poorly isolated).
- Old worn rooms (dirty and worn carpets, old air conditioning luminaries, small indifferent cabinets with no space, poor lighting and the difference on all lamps - everything is SO ugly!
- No matter little balcony with ugly views.
- the cleaning of the rooms is mediocre.
- ELENDIG breakfast buffet - there's SO much noise from high pop music and kids riding around. The light reminds more of entering a crazy bar. The food is dull, cold, the eggs are wet and clam.
- Service at the disc is poor and arrogant. Their key system is a really bad idea and when you finally place your key they are completely indifferent and let it lie on the disk (anyone could easily grab it).

This can be done better!

author: Gemma C
title: Top location
text: Lovely quirky looking hotel. Room was nicely decorated with air conditioning. The Safe in the room was free.  Free wifi throughout. Restaurant was amazing, we were half board and had fantastic 3 course meal every night. Breakfast was quite basic but sonething for everyone. Location is perfect, withing walking distance to all the main attractions.

author: Scott T
title: Good Quality Hotel
text:
We arrived in the early hours so the hotel was locked, but we were met in no time by the night staff.

On letting us in, he went through the details, rooms, breakfast, check out times and taxes for the stay.

Our room was huge, single beds but oversized so perfect for us both.

A good location, 5 minutes from the train station, bus terminal, trams and open. Us tours. A 25 minute walk from all the main historical attractions.

The breakfast is continental, but everything was good quality and tasty.

I would definitely stop here again

author: SERGIO C
title: When I return to Rome, this will be my hotel.
text:
Very positive experience.
Kind staff, willing to resolve any problems.

author: mychelle_gurgacz
title: Excellent location
text: Excellent location close to the station

author: Dante A.
title: A positive two-night experience! Friendly and Helpful Personnel! Reasonable price.
text: A positive two-night experience! From Fabrizio the porter, who deftly handled our eight bags to the front desk clerks (Maddalena, who spoke perfect English, and Maurizio, who ordered us a private car when we learned of a taxi strike and needed to get to the airport) to Carmine, the friendly and efficient waiter in the adjacent restaurant, we were very pleased with the personnel. Our room was more than adequate for the price (clean, comfortable, air conditioned, with a small refrigerator and safe for our valuables). We enjoyed the location near Stazione Termini and a short (half-hour) walk to the Centro Storico (Fori Romani). I have stayed here before, but this was the first time for my wife. She was as pleased as I was.

author: Dr. Ziauddin Ahmed
title: Located in a convenient place
text: Located in a very convenient place close to the Roma Termini station. Colosseum, Roman theater and many other attractions are located very close to this hotel. My room was small one with a double bed. Breakfast was good though limited menu. Staffs were friendly. Many restaurants are located nearby. Parking is difficult to find.

author: Amelia M
title: Vile doesn’t even cover it
text: Absolutely disgusting. Rooms don’t look anything like the photos, we sat down on the bed after checking in and the sheets were damp. The room smelt like musty fly killer and the carpets were grim. The bathroom was full of mold. Immediately left and found a new hotel

author: Lilit
title: Disappointing
text:
The room was far too small for four people and definitely not suitable for a group of that size. Considering the price, we expected much better value.
The breakfast was exactly the same every day, with very limited choices.
The only positive thing about this hotel was its location. It was close to the city center, and we could easily walk to most attractions.

author: C7677
title: Seen better days
text:
Decent location fifteen minute walk from Piazza Barberinin where the nearest metro station is located. One of the bus tours stops is about five minutes down the road. The rooms are ok until you get to the bathroom, the fixtures are grotty a deep clean required at minimum the toiletries are in little paper packs very odd. There is also warning signs not to drink the water. The room is quiet. At check in make sure you have Euros as the city tax must be paid in cash the only place in Italy that insisted on that! Breakfast is next door at the restaurant of the same name it is standard fare. The restaurant appears only to open for breakfast.
The left luggage turned out to be the public television room.
Of the six hotels we stayed in Italy this sneaks fifth.

author: Anthony P
title: Americans Pay Attn
text:
If you are American, this place is one step below a Motel 6, it is not 3 stars. Before arrival I sent a request to be housed in the remodeled section which went unanswered. When we arrived, they attempted to place us a in a dinghy, dirty room. The carpet was covered in dust and mold and the bathroom looked like it fell out of the 1800's. After complaining, they gave us a remodeled room after upcharging us 110 euro. The remodeled room was only slightly better but it looked cleaner w tile floors and upgraded bathroom. There are NO AMENITIES in this hotel, it is as barebones as it gets. No safe in room, the wifi sucks, no satellite tv so you only get Italian stations, the AC is horrible, the staff was rude and seemed to be annoyed if any questions were asked. For early siteseers, gonacross the street for coffee. They tried to make us leave our key at the front desk everytime we left the hotel.

As for cleanliness, this place was gross, for one week, they never swept or mopped the floors, we wore flip flops the entire time on our feet when in the room, not even socks because they would turn black.

I thought 3 stars would be middle of the road for a middle class family, but this place is NOT 3 STARS. I would not advise any American to stay here, it was as BELOW BUDGET as BELOW BUDGET gets. It would be worth extra money to find a better place. Whatever you do, LISTEN to the poor star ratings, the ones with good ratings are either planted or those people come from third world countries.

author: Andrea F
title: School trip
text: The parquet in the room was in very bad condition, very dirty so much so that it had changed color in some places. The bathroom handle was unhinged towards the inside of the room. The narrow room seemed to be for two people at most instead of three.

author: marcoPoggibonsi
title: Good stay in Rome
text: Three-night stay in August. Hotel in a quiet area, excellent cleanliness, thanks to Rome in August no noise at night. Large beds, perhaps a bit firm but it is a matter of habit. I did not try the breakfast because for three of us it cost as much as the room. Kindness of the staff. Excellent stay. Our triple room was practically a mini-apartment! Area that seems quiet, you can reach the subway in 7 minutes on foot. Fair price. Satisfied.

author: Laura L
title: Good hotel with sufficient facilities and services
text: The hotel was very nice and modern feel with sufficient facilities throughout. The staff were lovely and breakfast was good.

author: Kayleigh Edwards
title: Lovely stay
text: Lovely hotel out of the main centre and a short metro to all the main attractions. We booked a family room and it was big and well appointed. Really helpful staff and the roof top restaurant/bar is lovely for the evenings. Highly recommend!

author: loloswa
title: Very good stay and nice neighborhood.
text: We enjoyed our stay (3 nights in July 2026). There is a subway station not too far away and we got an 18-euro subway pass for 3 days, so the hotel is very accessible and makes it easy to reach all the tourist spots. We were well welcomed and informed by the front desk. We were able to leave our suitcases in the luggage room to go for a walk while the room was being prepared. We really liked the breakfast: clean room, lots of variety, and excellent cakes as well. We found the room clean but a bit old with a shower that leaked a little. Foreign TV channels, especially in French, did not work very well in the afternoon and early evening. It was also not easy to get the room cleaned during our stay (it still wasn't done one day at 4:00 PM even though we had properly put up the sign requesting that the room be cleaned). We really liked the neighborhood, quiet, with a good bakery right across the street and restaurants and ice cream shops nearby. We tried the rooftop restaurant: not bad but a lot of wasps, which detracted from the experience. We would gladly return but will ask in advance that the shower leak and TV issues be checked beforehand.

author: Hicham K
title: BAD EXPERIENCE
text: A very disappointing experience. The welcome at the front office was not warm and lacked professionalism. Furthermore, the room was extremely noisy throughout the night due to a lack of proper insulation and partitioning, which greatly hindered the quality of my stay and my rest.  Very bad experience. The front office staff was neither welcoming nor attentive and lacks experience. Furthermore, the room suffered from poor insulation, leading to numerous noise disturbances throughout the night. A stay far from expectations for an establishment of this category.

author: Rose C
title: We had a wonderful time in Hotel Pace Helvezia
text: I absolutely loved this hotel, the location is perfect, we walked everywhere it was so convenient to the centre of Rome, the room was wonderfully cool with air conditioning, spotlessly clean with a bath and shower! Wi fi and breakfast were perfect ! Our favourite were the staff who were exceptionally friendly and helpful, charging cables, extra towels it was never any issue, they gave us the best restaurant advise also, I would 100% return to this beautiful hotel, it might be a little dated for some but I think it added to its charm, the roof garden was devine also to watch the sunset !!

author: Karla G
title: 4 stars has nothing?
text: The location is amazing. Okay, that's what I got to say about the good of this hotel. Everything else, very bad. Bad internet. Super aged structure without maintenance. Bad service!! We lost the Brazil game pq the TV was spoiled and did not resolve. Frigobar tb was not working, we stayed 3 nights and until the exit did not resolve. When my husband complained for the second time of figobqr (40 degrees- taking hot water), the receptionist ironized and asked if he wanted to go there himself to solve, super rough

author: Fabienne P
title: Correct but needs refreshing
text:
We stayed at this hotel with a group of 18 people during the Pentecost weekend.

The welcome was good and the staff was helpful throughout the stay. The location is a real asset, allowing easy access to the main sites to visit.

On the other hand, the hotel would deserve a serious refresh. The carpets are worn, the armchairs are old-fashioned, and the rooms, although clean and tidied every day, are dated. This is the first time I prefer to leave my clothes in my suitcase rather than put them in the wardrobe. The curtains also do not give a fresh impression.

Soundproofing is practically nonexistent, and the noise from traffic is constant, which can be bothersome. The bathroom is very simple, but clean. The minibar is well-stocked and replenished daily, which is appreciated.

The panoramic terrace is a positive point, offering a beautiful view. However, the complete lack of shaded areas makes it difficult to use on hot days, although it remains pleasant in the evening.

The breakfast is decent, without being exceptional.

In summary, it is a suitable hotel for travelers seeking well-located and reasonably priced accommodation, but who should not be too demanding regarding comfort and modernity of the facilities.

author: Ladylee33456
title: Spotlessly clean, comfortable hotel. Close to all central tourist spots
text: Just come home from an incredible week long stay in this lovely hotel. The staff are super friendly and incredibly helpful. One couple in our party needed to move rooms, as their original room was at the front and incredibly noisy due to traffic and the never-ending sirens of Rome! The Receptionist had them moved immediately to a much quieter room. There are two lifts ( one is wheelchair friendly from reception) and although they look small, they can carry 4 people easily. The bedrooms were spotless and well decorated in a lovely gold wallpaper. Bathroom was spotless and bed very comfortable. Coffee and tea making facilities in rooms. The restaurant is up four steps from reception and wheelchair users would have to go up one floor in the lift, get in the other lift and go back down again! A bit of a faff, but doable! Breakfast in the restaurant was very good indeed- much better than other Roman hotels I’ve stayed in! Scrambled eggs, cold meats, cheeses, toast, croissants and pastries, cereals, yogurts and fruits as well as coffees, teas and juices. The downstairs reception rooms were very spacious and comfortable and we were allowed to take bottles of wine/spirits that we had bought and drink and socialise in there. The same with the rooftop terrace that is accessed from floor 6. We took our bottles and glasses up there too which was very nice in the sunshine after a tiring day sightseeing! The road outside is incredibly busy and the non stop sirens drive you insane! We were lucky enough to have room 21 which was at the back and very quiet and if it hadn’t been for the inconsiderate room neighbours, I would have slept like a log, but some people have no manners or courtesy and think only of themselves! ( which is not the hotel’s fault). All in all a very enjoyable stay and I would thoroughly recommend this hotel to everyone I know who is travelling to Rome! We will definitely stay here again as it is also very close to the central tourist spots and close to some very good restaurants- one of which is Le Lanterne- a 1-2 minute walk away! This hotel offers free WiFi too.

author: Sandra R
title: Dirty and broken
text:
Dirty and had to change rooms when there were traces of bed bugs in the mattress.
Broken floor and mouldings. Very worn out.

author: Relapsis
title: A place we always return to
text:
We have stayed at this hotel several times and from the last time to the present, many improvements have been made and from the entrance you can notice the changes in floors and furniture, the rooms are totally new and super comfortable.
Breakfast is still in the same place and it is fine, it would just be missing more variety of fruits and waffles.
It has been a pleasant surprise the changes for the better that were made.

author: enaclements
title: Highly Recommended
text: Just returned from a week at Colonna Palace Hotel. Can't fault it. Staff were so helpful and location is perfect for seeing all the sights. Rooms cleaned every day. Good breakfast and nice little bar to finish off the evening.  Hand rail in shower would have been helpful.

author: Priscilla M
title: Ok option
text: It’s in a nice location, you can walk pretty much anywhere but the beds are not the comfortable. Also, our safety didn’t work, we told the front desk but the guy never showed up. Really safe place, a lot of police around

author: Brianna M
title: Great location!
text: This was our first stop on our honeymoon. The  room was clean! The hotel is in a great location, we walked everywhere! I was able to email the hotel a few weeks before our stay for a private transfer from airport upon arrival.  Very basic amenities and everything was always clean. Our only complaint was the AC(of course we are Americans visiting during a heat wave) it never seemed to catch up but cold showers helped! The staff was always kind and the breakfast being included helped our day start off right!

author: Jonathan H
title: Location, location, location
text: Location was spectacular, it was literally the center of it all, our longest walk was 20 minutes to the colosseum. Everything else was literally just mins. Restaurants, stores and monuments were relatively close the only thing we got a taxi for was for the Vatican otherwise it was beyond great. Breakfast was good, staff was amazing.

author: Kim B
title: Short Roma visit
text: We stayed in Roma for a few days after our cruise.   The staff was amazing, kind, and very attentive.   Definitely worth another visit!!!  Our flight was early and they packed us a breakfast box to go!!!!

author: Trek52525275451
title: WE WILL RETURN
text: Everything was great, 5 STAR SERVICE

author: 54gloriar
title: Love Hotel Delle Nazioni
text: The location was perfect. We walked to everything. The room was perfect (for how long you're actually in it.) Hotel was quiet and clean. They cleaned our room everyday and always gave us fresh towels. The service at the desk was amazing. Whatever we needed they were very accomadating. But outside was amazing!! Not far from the Trevi, gelato shops, restaurants, bakery (that has the best pizza in Rome), a grocery store and more. We will be going back to this hotel and told friends about it for their stay in November.

author: lulubelle0
title: Busy location but a good stay
text: The hotel is older  but well kept. It would be a historic place to stay.  It is located in a very busy area, so beware. However we had no issues. Lots of restaurants around and one of the best breakfast buffets I've ever seen which was included in our nights stay. The bed was super comfy and the staff were pleasant. Overall location is very central to all the attractions.

author: AngieLovestoTravel23
title: Great hotel in Rome
text: Location is perfect - walkable to most sights, supermarket, restaurants and stores. Friendly and helpful staff. Great breakfast. Hotel restaurant has variety of great food. Would stay here again!

author: christian m
title: Dinner on the Seine.
text:
We had a very good time, very pleasant, a beautiful boat ride on the Seine, another way to see Paris.
The singer was brilliant, bravo.
The staff was attentive.
The dinner was very good.

author: Zoh B
title: Superb experience.

author: Cfkhamis

Wonderful experience 
Best tour to do in Paris

author: Mathilde M
title: Perfect

author: mary s
title: Terrible Customer Service
text: I redeemed a voucher for a dinner cruise and overnight stay on the yacht on Nov 26 and got my email confirmation on May 16. I then went ahead and booked the rest of my Paris plans and tickets on to the Netherlands for November 27. Then on July 10 I get an email from VIP yacht saying they don't do dinner cruises on Thursday in the Winter which is strange because they knew it was a Thursday when they confirmed. They say they'll move my reservation to Friday night and not charge me the weekend surcharge but I'm from Canada, I can't easily change plans without costs and I immediately emailed back saying this and have been ignored for 10 days. Buyer beware, they don't care once they get your money.

author: Susan K
title: 3 night stay in Rome

Great pool, fitness center, spa

Would have like a continental breakfast included.
Not a great location.for walking anywhere but bus picks up right at end of driveway and connects to metro.

author: jmaxeden
title: Easy Stay

Hotel was a bit of a hike from all the tourist attractions but it was comfortable and affordable.  The gym was under impressive.

Staff was friendly

author: Ciara D
title: Great experience
text: Beautiful hotel with pool area. Very clean. Staff were very accommodating with recommendations and help needed. Only ate in the hotel for breakfast which offered a high quality food with plenty of choice. Hotel gift shop organised a shuttle bus into centre and collected after for a fee which we found very convenient due to a large number in our party. Would definitely stay in this hotel again.

author: Mallerlyn Z
title: Family Vacation
text: Beautiful hotel. Rooms are very well kept with beautiful view of the pool and courtyards. Service is amazing. Their reception, kitchen, restaurants, bars staffs are all so nice and friendly! Loved our stay there

author: rose01924
title: Great for families
text: Great family hotel with brilliant pool. Perfect for a morning sightseeing (it is a 15 min taxi, approx 20 euros) and then a chilled afternoon. Lovely breakfast. Friendly staff

author: Steve
title: Hôtel Elysées Union – 2 Night Stay
text:
Location

The hotel is in a fantastic central spot. It’s around a 20‑minute downhill walk to the Eiffel Tower and close to cafés, restaurants, shops and major attractions. There are metro stations at both ends of the road, making it really easy to get around Paris. The locality is simply beautiful.

Staff and Service

The staff are incredibly friendly and helpful. The lady on the front desk when we arrived gave outstanding customer service and genuinely made our trip. She went above and beyond to upgrade us for our second night and gave us what must be one of the best rooms in the hotel, with a beautiful balcony and an unforgettable view of the Eiffel Tower. We were celebrating our daughter’s graduation, and she made it feel extra special.

Hotel and Facilities

The building itself is beautiful, with a bar, lounge and a lovely atrium garden. There’s a lift, a gorgeous staircase and a free bag‑holding service. They offer breakfast you can simply turn up for without booking.

Rooms

The rooms have everything you need. The bathrooms are modern, while the rooms keep a traditional Parisian charm. The beds are comfy, everything is spotless, and you get a safe, mini‑bar and a TV in each room. Rooms were peaceful with no noise from neighbours.

Overall

We had a wonderful stay and would 100% recommend Hôtel Elysées Union. Good value for money. We’ll happily return every time we visit Paris.

author: mandmoya
title: Two nights in Paris
text: Had a great time at this hotel with my daughter for our two nights in Paris. We had a courtyard view for the first night then an Eiffel Tower view for our second night. Both rooms were spacious and clean. The location is perfect,a ten minute walk(we walk fast) to the Eiffel Tower in one direction,ten mins to the arc de triomphe in the other direction. Close to the champs elysees shopping street too which is amazing. We ate at a nice restaurant just up the street from the hotel called le Copernic,good price too. The people on reception were really friendly and helpful. Loved our stay and definitely want to come back to Paris and this hotel.

author: tafuri2015
title: Good option
text: Hotel well located, helpful staff, good breakfast, small room but with a balcony with side view to the tower, I did not understand very well because they make many warnings in the sense that if you stain the towels will be charged 99 euros, it happens that the towels are well wrapped, so you will understand né? also charge a bail of 200 euros in my case was stained at the end of the stay.

author: Paul Z
title: Loved it
text: We LOVED the Hotel Elysees Union. It was our first time in Paris and there were four of us with plenty of luggage. Shaheen was an incredible help with everything. We were able to walk to most of the sites.  The staff and our room were excellent.  Everyone's English was excellent, so there were never any language barriers.  Don't know when we'll make it to Paris again, but we would love to stay here!

author: Elle76_11
title: A good quality, well located hotel option for visits on a budget
text: We stayed here as a group of friends for a weekend in Paris. It is a decent hotel, really well located with plenty of cafes and restaurants within minutes walk and a lovely view of the Tour Eiffel from the street-facing rooms. It isn’t the lap of luxury and the rooms aren’t huge but it’s clean and with lovely service from the maids and reception (who are dealing with a stream of holiday-makers like us!) it was perfect accommodation for us. One of our rooms faced a lovely quiet courtyard and the other had the amazing view. Both had a massive French window and juliette balconies, which was also really Parisien and so charming. Breakfast was included in our very reasonable rate and was perfectly good. No complaints whatsoever!

author: NOELIA M
title: Hotel Opera Melia
text: Very nice and centrally located hotel. The receptionist Ivan is a true professional and always very pleasant.

author: Nani E
title: Excellent location and quality
text: We will surely repeat. The breakfast is small but very complete and delicious.  Excellent room with a terrace on the top floor and exceptional staff… Ishara is a delight who helped us with everything. Nothing bad to say…. The location is unbeatable. A place not to be forgotten….

author: Kristy H
title: Our week at Hotel Paris Opera - Exceeded our expectations!
text:
My husband and I spent a week at Hotel Paris Opera Affiliated by Meliá and had an excellent stay. From the moment we arrived, the staff welcomed us warmly. Our room included a lovely welcome gift of chilled Cava, cookies, a tote bag, and a handwritten note.
Ishara at the front desk was outstanding—he recommended restaurants and attractions, booked tickets and reservations, and at the end of our stay walked my husband through Uber and gave clear instructions for navigating Heathrow. His calm help gave us real peace of mind.
We had some noise the first two nights, but the front desk quickly upgraded us to a quiet corner room. The location is ideal, with many sights, restaurants, cafés, and Galeries Lafayette within a short walk. The lobby and breakfast area were always clean and bright, the queen size bed was very comfortable, and housekeeping kept our room fresh daily.
The room was small (as expected in central Paris), and we missed having better TV/streaming options, but overall the value exceeded our expectations. A big shoutout to Ishara—his attentiveness made our stay exceptional. We’d happily stay here again and highly recommend it.

author: JULIA H
title: Family trip
text:
The best part was the location, a very good area with all services nearby.
As for the rooms, we took 2, we were traveling as a family, worse impossible. Small, they faced an interior patio, terrible ventilation, very unpleasant smell of humidity. Located on the top floor, not comfortable at all.

author: Kathie V
title: Great Hotel/Staff!
text: Hotel Paris Opera by Melia was an excellent hotel to stay in! It was so close to many tourist sites in Paris and was a great place to feel like a local. There were so many good restaurants near by and the hotel was very clean. The staff was extremely helpful, especially Ishara who went out of his way to help us on numerous occasions. We highly recommend this hotel and cannot thank Ishara enough for his help with directing us on how to get to each of our tourist locations. Thank you again!

author: Simone
title: A Montmartre Gem – Wonderful Hotel & Exceptional Staff
text:
I write this review with genuine sincerity.

The wonderful staff at Timhotel Montmartre have this week accommodated the smallest of requests for a dear friend who is staying there on my recommendation. They have been so patient with the time difference, so obliging with my requests, and wonderfully accommodating in arranging a small gift and note for her.

My uncle has stayed at Timhotel for many, many years, and I too have had the pleasure of staying there.

If you choose to stay in Montmartre — always my favourite part of Paris — Timhotel is a wonderful choice. The views are magnificent, whether of the beautiful street life below or across the rooftops of Paris.

My sincere thanks to the wonderful staff, particularly Eliza and Yazid, who have moved mountains to make my dear friend happy upon her arrival today. Sometimes the smallest gestures mean the most.

Thank you once again 

Simone

author: Andrea H
title: Worth Booking a Room with a View!
text: We loved our stay here and had an amazing view of the Eiffel Tower! The staff were friendly and helpful. Hotel is in a part of Paris with lots of character! Air conditioning works well and can be adjusted to your liking. Friendly staff. Our room was cleaned daily which you don’t always get in the United States.

author: Heike S
title: Small and nice

author: Jean-Louis V
title: Big disappointment.
text:
We are regular customers and we hesitated for a long time before sharing our disappointment with you. Not because of the service, but because of the lack of commercial spirit during the mishap that happened to us following the cancellation of our train (for which we were in no way responsible and which we learned about on the 23rd) and the lack of listening on your part to postpone our stay from 06/28 to 06/29 by one day or to obtain a refund, even though we had booked and paid on 3/8 (210.06€, a supposedly more advantageous price but non-refundable, according to your receptionist, even though she offered us to pay about 189€ again..., quite contradictory remarks). Mr. & Mrs. Vanantwerpen-Somers

title: Excellent service, Mr. Rocco Modesti is great.

title: Rome experience

author: Giuseppe A

author: Antonio T
title: The visit was for work, but I would return every time.
text: I spent 4 nights at this hotel and had a great time. Excellent welcome, excellent hotel, very kind and helpful staff, excellent location near the station.  I will definitely return and I recommend it to you.

author: nenette75011
title: Very decent
text:
Very decent hotel, we were worried after all the negative reviews we read at the last moment. But once again, that was unfounded. We then stayed at a hotel in Pisa and a hotel in Florence, and neither matched the Corot. So, indeed, you have to ask at the reception to turn on the air conditioning, or at least to adjust it, but once you know the technique, it’s very quick. The staff is very nice, except for one young woman; the gentlemen speak French, and the blonde lady is simply adorable. The brunette lady at breakfast is the same ☺️. Breakfast is classic: bread, croissant, toast; for fruits, it’s either canned or fresh apples, but then there’s a hot drink dispenser. We are indeed facing the Termini station (personally, I live in Paris, so I found it relatively calm 😂). There is a wide choice of restaurants nearby; we actually ate several evenings at Julie’s, a little further away where the owner has some nice anecdotes to share about the flame in Beijing,
Regarding the hotel, the bathroom is perfect, I liked the vintage side, the room is basic; personally, we just ask for a decent bed to sleep. The curtains are very blackout, and there are shutters behind; no power outage between June 25 and June 29. Honestly, we recommend it without fuss (ps: wifi is fine in the rooms and the elevator is fine for 2 adults, 2 large suitcases, 2 backpacks, and 1 banana 😅 honestly, $100 a night for 2 on a trip, that’s not asking too much)

author: judi&vic
title: A Charming Boutique Hotel
text: We love Hotel Bolivar with its comfortable rooms, traditional Roman decor, a beautiful breakfast room and best of all, the hidden location between two main streets. Because of this it is very quiet in the rooms, which we really appreciate after a busy day of sightseeing in Rome. There’s also a fabulous restaurant right across from the front entrance, Ristorante Santa Cristina al Quirinale (reservation highly recommended).

author: atjtetmt
title: I’d stay again.
text:
Pros:

Such a beautiful place. Hand painted murals all over. 
Lobby has seating and a bar.

Balcony was big enough for table and chairs.

Cons

Some of the breakfast items were dry and guessing from the day before.  There were plenty of choices so everyone ate enough.

author: B H
title: clean, good location, great staff
text:
we stayed here as a family of 6 , 3 rooms and we had a lovely experience. The man on reception on check in was friendly and helpful as were all the staff on reception. 
It is an extremely clean hotel, quiet in a back street in a very busy location. 
I had an amazing single room on the third floor with a balcony with wonderful views of Rome.
The breakfast while adequate could improve slightly, ie cold scrambled eggs and cold boiled eggs but apart from that no complaints.

author: אלעד ז

author: johnandelaine12
title: Attractive hotel in a perfect city centre location.
text:
Eight of us stayed here for two nights over the weekend. An attractive and comfortable hotel in the heart of the city. Friendly and efficient service from reception. 
The bedrooms were spacious, well furnished and tastefully decorated.
Breakfast choices were many and varied. The breakfast room on the top floor was bright and offered some lovely views across the city towards the countryside.
Our accommodation was priced very reasonably, given  there must have been high demand for hotels over the weekend because of the Italy v Scotland rugby match.
Highly recommended. We’ll book this hotel next time we’re in Rome.

author: Foteini S
title: Nice and tasty dinner
text: Very nice food and service. Very beautiful ambience

author: Gurl P
title: Ok in August I guess
text:
I had a mostly pleasant stay here, and the room was definitely one of the highlights. It was cute, stylish, and had a great overall vibe. The AC worked really well, which in Rome in August is not a small thing. The shower was also excellent and honestly one of my favorite parts of the room.

The minibar was fine—nothing particularly exciting, but it did the job. The gym was also perfectly adequate for getting in a quick workout, although nothing particularly memorable.

Unfortunately, the breakfast was where things took a serious turn.

For the price, I expected much better. The bacon was hard and tasted suspiciously like pepperoni, while the scrambled eggs were watery and essentially flavorless. The espresso tasted burnt, and somehow the cappuccino managed to be disappointing too—which, in Italy, feels almost personal.

Then there were the pancakes. Calling them pancakes is generous. They tasted like actual cake and seemed to contain enough sugar to launch a small child into orbit.

The pastries weren’t much better. The cream croissant was the best of the bunch, but there was approximately three molecules of cream inside. At that point, just call it a croissant.

The fruit was fine. Nothing to write home about, but perfectly acceptable.

Overall, I liked the hotel and enjoyed the room, AC, and shower. However, the breakfast was expensive, underwhelming, and easily the weakest part of the stay. I’ve had some incredible food in Rome, so unfortunately this was not the final Italian breakfast experience I was hoping for.

author: Marika B
title: Perfect hotel

author: Gloria

author: Susie P

author: Pierluigi D
