author: Morgane R
title: Parisian stay
text:
Pleasant, quiet, and functional hotel.
Elevator, decent breakfast, pleasant staff.

author: Linda B
title: A nice hotel in Paris
text: We stayed there for one night as a family. Everything was really good, from the welcome to the breakfast service to the check-out.

author: Lava
title: Convenient to public transportation
text: Great location in between Rome and Clichy. We were able to walk to the train stations and convenient bus stops. The staff was very friendly and had complimentary soft drinks in the room. We had a room with twin beds and it was very clean. My only issue was that the walls were so thin and the floor creaked in several places as you walked around. There isn't much they can probably do about that but we could hear conversations and the alarm of the room next to us. The air conditioning was good and there was a window that could be opened. This place was great for our trip.

author: Naillic
title: Gold Standard
text:
We have stayed in the Conrad Saint James regularly over the past number of years. It's central location, ease of access to all types of transport,  the serenity of the locality but especially the incredible customer service levels, keeps bringing us back for a truly five star experience. 
From the moment we arrived and were checked in by the smiling and ultra efficient Jane, we were met at every corner with just a fantastic level of genuine friendship and a willingness to help by all staff members we encountered. 
Karim at concierge went out of the way to sort out a small issue with our airport transfer with the minimum of fuss. Ably assisted by concierge team member Chris, our minor requests were dealt with admirably. However the star of the show on this occasion was Ruslan from house keeping.  Ever so polite, his eagerness to help and his professionalism in keeping our room organised was simply superb. A real star on the house keeping team.
All too quickly our stay came to an end but as a gold hilton member this was truly a golden stay again in this superb Conrad. I am planning our next visit already.

author: SteveKCarlisle
title: New fave stay in London
text: Extremely well located for sightseeing, fantastic breakfast, good executive lounge and amazing/friendly staff

author: Mary G
title: Best Pimm’s Cup at Hedferow bar
text: I requested a Pimm’s Cup in the Hedgerow bar. Anna made the best one I’ve ever had. She made a very delicious ornate drink for me.

author: Lachlan C
title: Pure Delight
text: Beautiful atmosphere with fantastic, friendly staff! Our man Ibrahim was a pleasure with amazing tea suggestions and a couple of fun guessing games to try and expand our palette. We even got the function room to ourselves as we came a little bit earlier. Highly recommend this experience!

author: Anna C
title: Conrad London Blue Boar Pub
text: The staff is very professional, knowledgable and friendly. I was greated by Harry and was served by Gavorney who made amazing cocktails. Thank you very much.

author: Marie-evelyne L
title: Average
text:
Bathroom full of mold. 
Very small room, has nothing to do with the photos.

author: celia m
title: very bad experience
text:
Very bad experience.

Upon our arrival, the hotel could not even find our reservation. After several minutes, it reappeared as if by magic. We were given a room number and asked to leave our luggage in the luggage room.

As a precaution, we called in the afternoon to let them know that we would arrive around 9 p.m. We were confirmed that everything was in order and that we had until midnight. Upon arriving, the receptionist finally announced that our reservation had been canceled and that there were no rooms left. After insisting, a room was finally "found"... Go figure.

Each staff member gave a different version. As a bonus, we had paid for a room with air conditioning, but there was none, and the cleanliness was less than average.

A blatant lack of organization and professionalism. I absolutely do not recommend this hotel.

author: Jean luc
title: A complete renovation would be welcome! Because it is time
text:
Very old setting, it smells stale  
Very small room. Carpet and wallpaper very dirty, no power outlets, archaic TV that only works half the time.
NO. NO AIR CONDITIONING, suffocating!
Everything needs to be redone from the entrance to the 4th floor, dilapidated stairs. Archaic bathroom, no tissues, for a 3-star hotel, details and maintenance are a bit cheap. No power outlet. The cleaning leaves much to be desired; if the corners want to be swept, they need to be caught... dust in the corners. No shutters, shabby curtains full of dust that do not cover the entire window.
No fridge in the room, no water.
Being disabled, there is barely enough room to turn around in the room (about 8 m2), plus a bathtub, no shower?..
Breakfast was good but basic, the furniture was very outdated!
Everything needs to be reviewed; it is very old-fashioned and dusty.
The only good point is the location! But everything is going downhill and is askew.
Really just for a quick stay of one or two nights if nothing else is found, especially at €600 for two nights!

author: Gabriel E
title: Worst experience in France
text: Worst hotel I've ever stayed in my life, still good that it was just one day. Bad service, uncomfortable room, made me lose a lot of money on account of misinformation, acted in bad faith

author: Vincent M
title: Steer clear!
text:
When I checked in, I was given the key to a room which was occupied… No problem getting in, except there was someone sleeping in the bed. Back to the reception, the employee was very concerned that I might have disturbed the guest. Not so much about giving me the key to the wrong room. 
In my new room the closest electric outlet was over 3 meters from the head of the bed. In 2026?
Only redeeming feature, a decent breakfast. Inept and unapologetic staff. No response from manager to a letter of complaint. They don’t care!

author: Advisor_Mio
title: Good although a bit dated hotel
text:
A small a bit dated hotel located at the doorstep of Santa Maria Maggiore, near Cavour metro station and in a walkable distance from Termini station. Clean although a bit small rooms with air condition, free wifi, kettle and fridge. Friendly and helpful staff. 
A restaurant in the neighbouring building. Breakfasts in the hotel available, but we didn’t try them, there are many local cafes nearby.

author: Maisie E
title: Great Location and Friendly Service, but a Little Dated
text: The location is definitely the main selling point of this hotel, making it a really convenient base for exploring. The atmosphere was pleasant and relaxed, and the service was very good, with friendly staff who were happy to recommend places to eat. The reception is staffed 24/7, and you have to hand your key in whenever you leave, which is a nice security feature. The rooms were clean and did the job, but the hotel is quite dated and could definitely do with a refresh, with things like broken lampshades. The cleanliness was good overall, although the **amenities** could be improved, particularly the air conditioning, which didn't work very well and wasn't ideal during the August heatwave. The noise level wasn't an issue for us during our stay. Overall, the hotel offered decent value for what we needed, mainly thanks to its excellent location and friendly service, but it would benefit from some modernisation.

author: madison o
title: Most uncomfortable bed I’ve been forced to sleep on.
text: Absolutely nothing like the photos, plus the most uncomfortable bed I’ve ever had to sleep on. There are zero amenities so it’s basically a cot and a bathroom. Photos show an outdoor dining/seating area, balconies on the rooms and plush beds — not the case at all. Way over priced, old, dated and gross. Only upside is how lovely the staff was, otherwise I was completely scammed.

author: Silvana D
title: Awesome experience with the staff at this hotel.
text: 1000/10 Highly recommended! Throughout my entire stay, the staff at this hotel took wonderful care of me and answered every question I had. I can't recall their names at the moment, but a special thank you goes to the lady and gentleman who recommended where to buy whole-bean coffee, and another special thank you to Mohamed for his attentiveness. Everyone there was incredibly friendly. I thought the location was phenomenal—just a 10, 20, or 30-minute walk to all the beautiful sights in the historic center. Plus, you have everything right nearby: a supermarket, a pharmacy, bars, and restaurants. Thank you, Hotel Verona!

author: Din D
title: Lovely central location
text: Amazing location. We would stay here again. The 24 hour staff / concierge are delightful. It feels safe and there is next to no noise when the window is shut. However, the room temperature is then hard to control. The other major down side included a very firm mattress and thin flat pillows. Towels aren't changed mid-week: only the beds are turned down. There is just one key, which they require to be left at reception whenever going out.  Guests with mobility problems or large luggage would not manage easily as the lifts are strangely located on the landings between two floors.

author: Luciane C
title: Praise
text: This hotel is wonderful! The staff at this hotel helped me a lot even without being a guest. Excellent service! Excellent hotel!

author: sarahando13126
title: Would stay here again without hesitation
text:
We stayed here 28th may-1st June prior to arriving i emailed the hotel to ask about ensuring our room had 4 beds (2 adults one teenager one child) as some reviews said it was a sofa bed. They emailed me back within 20 minutes! Which alone is unheard of.
I was  reassured all rooms have been renovated and it will be fine. And it was! 
Biggest room ive ever had on a city trip. Long corridor which consisted of full sized wardrobe bathroom with shower and bidet,a double bed and 2 single beds perfect!!

Air con in the room hot water for everyone's showers.Room serviced every day!

Staff were all very friendly.

Hotel is literally 15 mins from most big attractions in Rome (apart from vatican, but even that is only a 30 mins walk)

The underground were on strike whilst we were there so couldn't utilise that as much as we'd like.

Monti Is a trendy area of Rome to stay, lots of boutique shops restaurants etc 

As a family we all felt totally safe too!

Would stay here again without hesitation

author: Aleksandra G
title: Highly recommended!
text:
We gave the stay at Hotel Virgilio in Rome to my mom for her birthday – and it was just a great choice! We were very satisfied all around.

The room was large and very nice, as was the spacious bathroom with a large shower. Everything was freshly renovated and really spotless. Our wishes for two beds and a shower instead of bathtub were fulfilled without any problems, which we greatly appreciated.

Although it was a bit noisy from the street, but at night we could still sleep well – after all, you are in the middle of Rome and very centrally located. The proximity to many attractions, such as the Trevi Fountain and the Colosseum, is a big plus.

Special praise goes to the team at reception: The boys were incredibly friendly – thank you for the warm welcome!

Breakfast also convinced us: delicious, varied and something for everyone. We were particularly happy about tomatoes and cucumbers, which is not always a given in Italy.

Thank you very much for the wonderful time in Rome – we would love to come back!

author: fillin402
title: Perfect for a visit to Rome
text:
Staff attentive and available 
Breakfast quite correct 
Cozy room and practical bathroom 
1 single flat the street noise

author: Omar A
title: Great location, close to everything
text: A very good hotel even though I was in the pieces that are accessed from the outside. I even think it was even better because we didn't feel the hustle and bustle of a hotel. Comfortable and spacious bed, large bathroom. Perhaps it would improve the isolation between pieces because the conversations of the neighbors are felt when everything is silent. The location is great and the neighborhood is very nice and quiet. Good breakfast buffet. The receptionist spoke Spanish and very friendly and helpful. I would definitely come back

author: valentina c
title: Non-existent parking: forced to garage away and paid 25€ despite being said free. Little transparency.
text: Non-existent parking: forced to garage away and paid 25€ despite being said free. Little transparency. It takes more professionalism, tiny and uncomfortable room

author: Travel
title: Hotels area Termini
text:
Hotel located in Termini area, less than five minutes walk from the station. The structure externally is very nice with a well-kept garden. 
The room where in the living room on the ground floor was really bad, I start by saying that the wallpaper was very dirty, the floor in very bad condition old and dirty, the sheets and bath towels dirty with mold and the terrace dirty 
Unfortunately, room conditions and mildew seriously affect the quality of sleep 
I strongly recommend taking action for these issues  
The staff of the structure all very friendly

author: giovannicamp80
title: Good experience
text:
Convenient place, both for the location and for what it takes a few days to stay there.
Friendly and helpful staff.
Bravo

author: prof. GLP
title: Nice and good experience but ... with some "weakness"
text:
The hotel is situated in a GREAT location. The staff was KIND, WELCOMING AND PREPARED. Despite being very close to the station the rooms were well soundproofed and the cleanliness of the rooms and change of towels was IMPECCABLE and good.
But on two aspects there was a bit of disappointment: breakfast is essential, one morning there were no fresh croissants as some eeprsone had finished them and we were offered the prepackaged ones and we did not take them. We went out to the bar for breakfast. Then the fruit salad is packaged and the salty aprte is very minimal.
The rooms, unfortunately despite being CLEAN AND WITH AIR CONDITIONING, are very old and the bathrooms, although spotless, are very small.
It should be restructured and modernized so that it can make the most of the positional, relational and Welcoming qualities it has.
It's work in progress.
I hope they invest in modernization...they would gain a lot.
Price, location andpersonal: EXCELLENT

author: fiffy74
title: Good.
text:
Good.
Good location. Rooms small, old-fashioned, but very clean. If booking through Booking is breakfast included, but it is not. Of the two consierges, one is not very polite, the other too much. Cost too high for room type

author: eider701
title: Nice hotel
text:
We stayed at this property for three nights in January 2026. The location is very good: close to Montparnasse station and close to the Luxembourg garden.
The welcome and service are very good. The property is clean, the room is spacious and very quiet.
The breakfast buffet is good.
Only problem: the elevator is smaller than our old phone booths.

author: Deborah S
title: A very good 3 stars. With lovely staff.
text: Charming staff!!!! Nice location. However the hotel is for me a 3 star. The room has equipment in medium condition.( broken bedside lamp, split bathroom sink...) bcp small details despite a great team.

author: Johanna S
title: Excellent
text:
I had a great stay at the Nude Paris hotel.
Welcoming was excellent, friendly staff and care. 
The place is very nice and it is ideally located. 
I recommend++++

author: felipe p
title: Total disaster. Lack of commercial loyalty. Total absence of air conditioning.
text:
We arrived on June 29, 2025 and stayed until July 5 to celebrate our 50th anniversary of marriage. We pay for everything in advance. They lied to us that they had air conditioning. THERE WAS NO SUCH AIR OR VENTILATION. 
PARIS WITH RECORD TEMPERATURES BETWEEN 35 AND 40 DEGREES. They wouldn't give us another room or return the money paid. The deal was practically terrible abandonment of elderly people in a country foreign to us. We spent only one night without air could not breathe and the window that overlooked the street got warmer. EXCRUCIATING. An embarrassment for French hoteliers. No one took responsibility. It seemed more like they were funny situation. They wouldn't let us settle any complaints. They were shielding at the counter from what looked like a reception. They were just saying that there were difficulties with the air that on some floors were not walking but that they had no idea when it would be fixed, amid laughter.
In my country never could this hotel have obtained the 4 STAR rating.

author: Richard S
title: Unsatisfactory. Non-existent conditioning.
text:
Everything was good, except the complete lack of air-conditioning in our 5th floor room at the onset of our 5 night stay. We spent the check in night in blazing heat, wrote a message via Booking.com message, requesting another room or we would seek a relocation / refund. The next morning we were offered another room, if we could check out and leave our bags. We were on our way to catch a train to our tour, and could not do so. That night we were given a portable fan. The next morning we checked out and when we returned we moved into a room on the 4th floor. No air-conditioning again. I asked the desk clerk to come check the room to verify that everything was turned on and working. He came up and said he was sorry, but the owner was in the process of correcting the old building's air-conditioning. We were given a fan for the remaining days, and as the temperature had dropped, we slept with the windows open and the fan on all night. Once you are in Paris, it's too late to change. Check my other ratings, I have nearly always given 10 out of 10 ratings in our prior trips to Europe.

I didn't see many negative reviews, and marked it up to outliers. If the ambient temperature is satisfactory for you to sleep in, then risk it if you choose. At least you can open a window, although without air-conditioning the humidity may be uncomfortable regardless of the temperature.

author: Emma B
title: The best hotel in Paris !
text:
A wonderful wedding anniversary!
We had the most amazing time 
Hotel and staff are so incredible and can’t do enough for you. 
The pool was a bonus and lovely although a bit cool !

author: Staci B
title: Lovely, quiet location near the Opera and Galleries Lafayette.
text: We booked two rooms for our family of four for our recent stay in Paris.  The hotel is in a very quiet location, and it is an easy walk to a metro station.  The hotel staff was lovely and accommodating, the rooms are clean, and the decor is fun.  Our rooms were a deluxe and a classic.  The deluxe room was quite small, but we were out and about seeing the city, so that wasn’t a problem.  If you wanted to spend much time in that room, it would be a bit snug.  Bathroom shower is great, if small!  Classic room was a much more comfortable size.

author: marylyn r
title: Great experience!
text: I was very pleased with my room. The location was fantastic. I was able to walk wherever I’m able to be. The staff were friendly and accommodating, even though I didn’t speak French. I was able to get a great night sleep. The staff was very helpful in getting me anything I needed.

author: syndi z
title: Thank you for everything and then some.
text: Our wonderful experience with this hotel began months before our arrival. Every question I had was answered and every request I made was fulfilled. Explanations were given, reservations were made and even a special pick up was done for us. All with smiles by a very attentive staff. Kudos and a special thank you to Freddy.

author: Adelaida S
title: Content
text:
Our stay was perfection. The rooms
Were beautiful and each was designed for comfort and a luxurious feeling. Everyone at the front desk was always so happy and willing to help. Especially kudos to Marwan who kindly booked trains for us and always advised us well. Will always recommend this place to friends and family.

author: Marcaret
title: In general terms, very good
text: The price-to-comfort ratio is very good, and it is very well located. Additionally, it is very central for the tourist

author: cibarbosa
title: Rest time
text: Thank you for making our stay something very special. The staff is very attentive and helpful. Impeccable rooms.

author: yaelr771
title: Great stay
text: Great location and service, every request fullfilled, we loved the room the location and will come back again

author: Mhprins72
title: Pleasant stay
text: We had a great experience here. We felt very welcome and the staff was extremely helpful. Highly recommended!

author: elenaK4522CP
title: Disappointing stay
text: Very disappointed with our stay . It’s up a very steep hill so not advisable for older people. And not for families as the rooms are very small

author: Irene Z
title: Top
text:
We stayed at the Hotel Trevi for 5 nights, in two rooms, a quintuple and a double.
At the time of booking we asked for the possibility of having the two rooms close together, we were pleasantly accommodated and the double room was of a higher standard than the one booked.
Clean, spacious, finely renovated rooms. Spacious bathrooms with shower and tub in both rooms; in the quintuple room, the tub was a whirlpool.
Excellent daily cleaning; we even found a small bottle of water each as a welcome.
The reception staff was very kind, available for our every request, and even helped us manage the emergency that forced two of our guests to depart early.
We also appreciated the excellent quality breakfast.
A positive note for us was the location of the rooms outside the main building; it guaranteed us greater privacy and also easier management of the children.
The hotel's location a stone's throw from the Trevi Fountain is priceless.
This is the third time we have stayed at the Hotel Trevi and it has never disappointed us.
Highly recommended

author: Carolina B
title: Excellent
text: Excellent location, excellent work by Roberto the receptionist. A very good and comfortable atmosphere. I traveled alone and they were super helpful

author: mundial862026
title: Unbeatable location
text: Very good treatment from the staff in general. In a privileged area, a few meters from the Trevi Fountain, and despite that, no noises were heard inside the rooms they gave us. It is a place to keep in mind in case of arriving in Rome.

author: Fiona
title: A great central base
text: Hotel Trevi was lovely and did the perfect job of being a central base as we ran around Rome.  Our room was in a building near to the main reception, which was unexpected as we weren't informed about this prospect at all prior to booking.  But it wasn't too much of a problem; we were still very close by.  There was a very narrow lift to our floor, which wasn't always working.  The air conditioning in the room was much needed in the heat wave.  I had booked for 3 adults and 3 separate beds, but we got a double and a single.  We made do. The room was very clean and had everything we needed.

author: Ellen Y
title: Great hotel!
text: Fantastic hotel and value.  Clean and modern rooms.  Great air conditioning.  The staff is friendly and helpful.  I would definitely return.

author: Caterina L
title: Disappointing hotel. I would not return.
text: Hotel Julia, although located in the heart of Rome, has absolutely embarrassing rooms. I stayed for two nights in July.  The bathroom was old with a broken shower stall, and there was only a shutter in the room, with no screens. There was no desk and not even a surface to put things on. Not very clean; in fact, the first night there was an insect on the pillow. Quality/price ratio... paid too much!

author: Francesco M
title: Worst hotel ever
text:
Location ok close to Trevi fountain but is
An hotel without a soul. Terrible rooms terrible reception terrible lights terrible bathrooms terrible showers terrible beds. Noise of water during the night. Don’t chose this hotel do yourself a favor
For the same price you can get much more.

author: Emanuele P
title: Convenient.
text: A convenient hotel for exploring Rome, close to the Barberini metro stop and the Trevi Fountain. Friendly staff.

author: Mgc
title: Best price if you want to be in the center of Rome
text:
A very central hotel of everything, less than 5 minutes from the plumbing. It has no frills but is clean and the rooms are not dwarfs. We had a very nice week, and the price is very good to be in the same center., and in the evenings it was not noisy either. They change your towels every day and your sheets one day a week. 
You can even have a simple and very cheap breakfast. 
The staff is also very nice and helpful.

author: Peter P
title: Not enough of a budget hotel to return
text: I am afraid that a third time will not be the charm. After a six year absence, I decided to visit Hotel Julia once again in an effort to save some money because of bloated Jubilee year rates. The savings was not enough. I knew breakfast was eliminated but you would think the hotel would offer a pot of regular perculated Maxwell House coffee (never mind those espresso machines) and the Rome equilavent of Tim Bits gratis, just to get you going in the morning. The on again/off again Wifi in the rooms in this day and age is inexcusable. But there are pluses...excellent location, walking distance to major sites and bus line is close by and a subway station is just around the corner and only two stops to Termini rail station.

author: Melissa Lezcano
title: DO NOT BOOK THIS HOTEL
text:
A very disappointing experience and unacceptable conditions.

I am writing this review as a travel agent, on behalf of some passengers who recently stayed at this hotel.

The experience was extremely negative. The establishment is very old and the facilities are in urgent need of renovation. During their stay, the air conditioning in the rooms was not working correctly, despite the high temperatures in Rome. The hotel only provided them with fans, a totally insufficient solution, and my passengers could not rest or sleep properly due to the unbearable heat.

The problem did not only affect one room: other families staying there also expressed the same complaints. The passengers recorded the situation at the front desk, but they did not receive an effective solution or an alternative room.

The conditions were so difficult that they considered leaving the establishment before finishing their reservation and looking for other accommodation on their own. It is unacceptable to offer rooms in these conditions, especially during the summer, without informing guests beforehand that the air conditioning system is not working correctly.

I would not recommend this hotel until they carry out a serious renovation of their facilities and improve the way they respond to their guests' complaints.

author: Jonathan F
title: Very disappointing stay – avoid this hotel
text:
The welcome was barely satisfactory.

The parking, advertised as included, is not even located at the hotel. Even worse, the reception staff advised us not to use it, explaining that they had recently experienced a problem with it.

In the bathroom, there was only one tiny packet of soap provided for two people (see photo).

The breakfast buffet was extremely limited, with very little choice (see photo). In addition, the dishes and cutlery were simply dirty (see photo).

Although it was around 34°C (93°F) outside, the air conditioning did not work. We reported the problem to the reception. When we returned later that day, the issue had still not been resolved. We were then offered another room, but the electricity was not working there. We were eventually moved to a third room, which was larger and had a fan. Unfortunately, the air conditioning still did not work there either, and the room was dirty.

During this whole situation, I also witnessed a particularly shocking scene: the reception staff reprimanded the technician in front of guests in a manner that I found humiliating and completely inappropriate.

The only positive aspect of our stay was that the Wi-Fi worked well.

We will not return and cannot recommend this hotel under any circumstances. In our opinion, it does not deserve its four-star rating in any way.

author: Francesca C
title: Terrible
text: Terrible, fortunately, I only stayed one night. Air conditioning not working in the middle of July (the issue was reported immediately without receiving assistance or intervention). Dilapidated bathroom and inefficient plumbing (the flow of hot water was just a trickle in both the shower and sink). Breakfast with very little choice, especially in savory items, as there were neither eggs nor cheese and nothing in terms of fruit. Highly discouraged

author: Kerry S
title: Basic, good value
text: This hotel fit our needs well. The room was small, but that is typical of hotels in the area, and this provides a good place to sleep. Maybe a 10-minute walk to the train station, with one subway stop even closer and many busses nearby. In this historic building, rooms are old but clean, and ours had windows opening onto a quiet back street. There is even a church on the third floor! This was our second stay at this property, and we would return again.

author: Magnus R
title: Older charm with great location for a weekend in the Eternal City
text:
A perfect location for a long weekend in the Eternal City. 5-10 minutes walk from Termini and many nice restaurants in the immediate area. 
The palace, that is, the hotel, which was the residence of an early pope, has its own chapel, beautiful halls and charm. But like most older houses a tad tempered with a certain need for care.
Very quiet in the room, a little hard beds, spacious bathroom, and nice view of the beautiful courtyard.
Breakfast was a bit limited, with ok anyway.

author: canadatraveller72
title: Go Elsewhere
text: Good location as it’s a 20 minute walk to the sites and 3 minutes to the main train station, but this place feels like a dump. We were in the secondary building which we didn’t even know existed. Room is small and the air conditioning is t wonderful. The room needs to be painted as there’s scuff marks everywhere. It made the room look dumpy and unclean.

author: Jodie
title: Lovely hotel
text: Situated a 30 minute walk away from the centre of Rome, this hotel was very quiet and small which was nice. Breakfast is continental with plenty to choose from. There isn't a bar. I think some of the room images are out of date. Our room was modern, very light with the most powerful shower. The hotel was very clean and the staff helpful. Good value.

author: Thi
text:
Unfortunately, my experience at the Hotel Piemonte was extremely disappointing.

The hotel seems to lack maintenance and organization. The air conditioning in the room does not work, nor does the bathroom fan. The overall feeling is that of a neglected and poorly maintained facility. Additionally, the elevator is old, unreliable, and uncomfortable to use.

Besides the structural issues, the service also left much to be desired. We informed the staff that we would be leaving very early for an excursion and would therefore miss the breakfast included in our stay. We simply asked for an alternative solution, such as a piece of fruit or something light to take away, but we were not offered any assistance or attention to our needs.

It is difficult to understand how a hotel that hosts so many tourists can provide an experience so far below expectations. The facility is poorly maintained, the upkeep is insufficient, and the attention to guests is practically nonexistent.

The only positive aspect is the location near the Roma Termini station. For the rest, the stay was very disappointing and not up to what one expects from a hotel in Rome.

I do not recommend it and would not return to stay at this hotel.

author: Carrie H
title: Poorly maintained
text: Perhaps once grand,  but now poorly maintained.  Hair on the walls and in the shower.  Not well cleaned.  Rusty.  Marks all over the walls.  Slimy sticky stuff on edge of tub.

author: Claire R
title: Excellent Location
text:
Just returned from a 3 night stay. After reading some of the reviews I was a little concerned however once we arrived everything was fine. The staff were polite and helpful. The room was clean . Breakfast was basic but did the trick. The location for us was ideal as it was minutes away from the bus/ metro terminal so we used the transport links the whole time we were there. 
Fantastic restaurant just around the corner from the hotel . Would definitely return.

author: Fatiha C
title: Very negative experience
text:
I travel very often for work and usually stay in hotels. During my stay from May 19 to 22 at the Celicia Hotel in Rome, I had a very disappointing experience.

Upon my arrival, I presented my driver's license, unfortunately recently expired, having forgotten my ID card and passport at home. Despite explaining that my daughter could immediately send me a copy of my identification document, the manager, Mr. Antonello Greco, reacted aggressively and in very loud tones in front of other employees, leaving me deeply disappointed and uncomfortable.

The first room assigned to me, located on the ground floor, was very damp, with a strong smell of mold, and even the mattress was damp, causing me to spend a sleepless night. Fortunately, the next day Mr. Gaetano at the reception proved to be helpful and professional, managing to get me a room change.

The hotel is dated and needs more attention to cleanliness and maintenance. Regarding management, an improvement in communication and respect for customers would be truly desirable.

author: Stephanie C
title: Awful - do not book!
text:
DO NOT STAY HERE. This hotel is awful. 

We wanted to stay near the Appian Way, and booked one of the “best” rooms in the hotel.

We arrived in our room to find peeling wallpaper, cigarette butts on the balcony, holes that had been patched but not painted. The electricity did not work.

The walls behind the front desk are covered in stains, it’s in a sketchy part of town on a very busy street, and just outside the driveway there are big overflowing trash cans being sifted through by the homeless.

We left and went to a nicer hotel - we did not come to Rome to stay in this miserable dump. When we asked for a refund the front desk clerk said no, we should have given them time to fix the problems (clearly impossible) and that he didn’t care if we left a bad review.

The only good things I can say about this hotel are that it was reasonably close to the Appian Way and that the young woman who originally checked us in was pleasant.

This place sucks. Trust me and book somewhere else!

author: Luciano
title: For one night is fine!
text: Hotel neglected but "acceptable" value for money, also considered the area and the presence of parking (for a fee)

author: Nico F
title: 550€ and 200U$D stolen
text:
A stay that started more or less acceptable, turned into chaos.

We arrived on October 6 at night and were given a room that had the defective Safe.

I went to warn them of this problem and they told me that there was no other room or safe, that I could use the lobby if I wanted. I refused to use the lobby, as I didn’t find the idea too safe.

On our last day at the hotel, October 9, we entered the room and while I was assembling the luggage, I thought to count the money I was bringing (which I had kept in the suitcase, hidden among the clothes). To my little pleasant surprise I was missing 550€ and my friend 200U$D. 

The hotel director, Antonio Greco, wouldn’t give us any answers, treating us as liars and saying that if we wanted to walk to the police station. We insisted on calling the police to come, he refused to say the police were not going to come for such a small thing.

Eventually we called the police and the police came, took our complaint and told us that it was a good thing we did that since the police station was closed.

Anyway, they gave us no answer, and we were left with less money.

I attach photos of the police and the hotel.

A beautiful stay in Rome, ruined by the ineptitude and insecurity of this hotel.

author: Sarah H
title: Perfect for short stay great location
text: Warm friendly greeting on arrival gentleman was polite helpful. Room was clean and tidy unfortunately the shower well that was a experience for my husband as it was very small cubicle .shower curtain was tatty and there was mould around the cubicle that I’m sure with a good scrub would come off. ! There is meant to be a bar service but it’s not really maned waited a long time to get a drink which seem to annoy the female on reception. The hotel is perfect for short stay great location metro was easy to use lots of shops nearby too. Breakfast was pleasant and has a nice out side space too. Hotel is just a bit dated needs a bit of tlc but overall a lovely stay. It’s 3 star 🌟 good value and would recommend for short stay great location.

author: Sheryl P
title: Ok
text: Ok hotel. No real welcome. Couldn't find our booking no communication about that by the boss Daniel.  Finally found it. Did not explain that if we took wrong lift we would end up in hotel next door. Otherwise clean but dated. Breakfast fantastic & rest of staff good! Restaurant next door excellent - the boss - fabulous & food too!

author: Toby La Rone
title: Good location no frills
text:
Good location for exploring all the sites everywhere is walking distance except the Vatican.  
We had a basic room that was clean and a comfortable bed.
The roof garden is nice for breakfast especially the very top terrace.
Only downside was lots of wasps and pigeons in August.
Staff were good and efficient.
Would recommend

author: TheDales
title: Lovely hotel!
text: This hotel was stunning. Staff friendly and hotel was spotless. The views from the Roof Terrace were stunning! Only criticism I have is that there is 1 small lift on which is slow, especially in the mornings around breakfast and check out time

author: Tamara L
title: Nice hotel
text:
The room was a comfortable size for three people and very clean. My only real complaint was that the refrigerator never got cold, even after maintenance came to check it, and the air conditioning struggled to keep up with the outside heat. The hotel’s breakfast was adequate—nothing special—and after two days it did start to feel a bit repetitive.

The staff were consistently friendly and attentive, and the location was excellent. Being so close to Termini Station made getting around incredibly convenient. Pro tip: if you’re waiting on the main elevator while guests with luggage load in and out, there’s a smaller elevator around the back. It only fits two people and no luggage, but it’s almost always free.

Overall, despite a couple of minor issues, I would stay here again.

author: Sean M
title: Wife got food poisoning.
text: Hotel staff and room was lovely. Food was absolutely poor, set menu and we only liked 2 things from it and then after the beef fillet my wife has been throwing up and diarrhea since Tuesday night. We got home friday night and its now sunday and shes still poorly.

author: Apo Geo
title: THE BEST !
text:
A big thank to the staff. They make you feel like you have known them for years. The lady who welcomed us on Monday 10th of August I don't remember her name . And then Mario and Francesco. Also the housekeeping did an amazing job . Thank you . 
The location is our favorite. Via Nazionale feels like it's the center of Rome . Buss stations and metro station so close. Coffee shops, pubs and tigre supermarket is 2 minutes way . 
The view from our room was AMAZING.  Can't wait to go back for our 3rd time.

author: Peixoto I
title: Excellent hotel!!!
text: Excellent!!! The staff Francesco was very helpful, we loved your tips. An excellent professional. I highly recommend this hotel!

author: schtroumfette89
title: Ideally located in the city center close to the train station.
text: Very good one-night stay at this hotel perfectly located in the city center and 10-15 minutes on foot from the train station. Room for 3 or 4 is quite large, but the extra single beds are not comfortable at all. Beautiful modern bathroom. Well-equipped and air-conditioned room. Very good breakfast with a variety of options. Very good welcome (in French) with recommendations about Rome, thank you!

author: Bernhard Wannemacher
title: A good hotel in a central location.
text:
A nice hotel, very centrally located near Termini, the metro, and the bus. Many attractions are easily reachable on foot. Rooms are adequately sized and clean, as is the bathroom. The staff is very friendly. The only downside: the breakfast could be significantly improved. Aside from the fact that there is almost nothing for vegans (which we are used to), unfortunately, there is not even vegan milk for cereal here. Only toast bread and small, soft rolls are available. 
It was bearable for 6 days, but not great.
Aside from that, there is nothing to complain about.

author: FabrizioCantoni
title: Great location
text:
Small but very comfortable hotel, clean and conditioned rooms. Very good reception, they waited for us with the rooms early which made it easy for us to arrive. 
It has a very good location, ideal for walking to most important sites.

author: Explore09742193213
title: Excellent experience
text: Excellent hotel in Roma termini. I was impressed by the politeness of the staff particularly Erika. She was effective, polite always hvaing a smile on. I had an enjoyable stay.

author: Gillian O
title: Disappointing ecperience
text:
Nice hotel, staff professional and somewhat friendly. Clean and modestly decorated.
Did not have breakfast at the hotel so cannot comment on it but there are lovely cafes nearby that are good value for money. Good transport links and based in the centre of the historical attractions.

CAVEAT ... Be careful of your possessions. Left a beautiful dress in the wardrobe when i checked out and within 24 hours of contacting them, they claimed it wasn"t there and the housekeeping team had no knowledge of it which is quite dishonest of them as i actually saw it but git distracted and didn't take it. Makes me wonder what else. Not impressed at all and on that basis alone will not be returning to the hotel or recommend it to anyone else.

author: Ani G
title: Very Disappointing Stay
text:
0 out of 5

The only positive thing about this hotel was the staff—they were polite and friendly. Unfortunately, everything else was extremely disappointing.

This hotel is advertised as a 4-star property, but it felt more like a no star hostel. It certainly does not deserve its 4-star rating. The rooms were outdated, poorly maintained, and nothing like the photos. The overall condition of the hotel did not justify the price.

The biggest issue was the neighborhood. It felt unsafe, especially in the evenings. Even several locals warned us to be extra careful because of the high number of pickpockets in the area and advised us to avoid certain nearby streets. That made us feel uncomfortable throughout our stay.

I would not stay here again or recommend it to anyone. The staff deserve credit for being kind and helpful, but they cannot make up for the poor quality of the hotel and the disappointing location.

author: Anet52
title: Great location and friendly staff
text:
The hotel is less than 5 minutes from Rome Termini station. My room was very clean, comfortable and quiet.
Good coffee at breakfast (you can request cappuccino or expresso )
Great food choice for me as a vegetarian..
All staff were friendly and very helpful.

author: Natssha B
title: Crack avenue
text: I want to be as honest as I can be writing this review. I am writing this whilst waiting to board my plane. This hotel is not a 4 star more like 2/3 The hotel its self is okay if you are using it only for somewhere to sleep (like a base). We picked this hotel based off location and being in walking distance to the major sites like the Trevi Fountain ect. This location is vile. You have drug addicts sat outside of the hotel. During the day and night. First day we arrived we witnessed 2 people smoking crack right outside. We also witnessed a women smash a glass bottle and hold it up to someone else’s throat. We The whole area is full of drug users. I am glad that we done a coupes trip and didn’t bring our children along this isn’t a location for children! This area doesn’t feel safe at all. The hotel room could be better horrible bathrooms and room could be cleaner. Some staff friendly. Other not so much. Breakfast wasn’t great. Overall I wouldn’t recommend staying this side of Rome definitely not near the train station anyway.

author: H B
title: Lovely junior suite view - however, screaming during Tuilleries summer festival is unpleasant.
text:
Hotel Brighton is clearly a popular hotel, and there was much that I enjoyed about my stay, particularly the beautiful view from my junior suite and the convenient location.

Upon arrival, the lobby and front desk seemed quite hectic, and I waited for some time before being informed that my room was ready. I was, however, very grateful that the hotel was able to accommodate me with an early check-in.

Service was somewhat uneven. Several members of the front desk staff were warm and friendly. The night manager on Saturday and Sunday was less helpful. When I asked what might still be open after 10 p.m., I was simply told, “Nothing—it is after 10 p.m.” Fortunately, I found a nearby café open on both evenings. A little more assistance or local knowledge from the front desk would have been appreciated.

The housekeeper was lovely—hardworking, pleasant, and gracious—and I was very happy to tip her. The room was very clean.

Regan was also pleasant and helpful at checkout.

Unfortunately, the taxi arranged for me at departure was a disappointing final experience. The driver initially attempted to charge more than the agreed-upon fare, relenting when I told him I knew the correct fare. He also refused to accept a credit card despite having card capability and dropped me some distance from the curb at the Air France/Delta First Class departure area. I hope the Brighton will reconsider using this particular driver.

Breakfasts were enjoyable, the staff overall was pleasant, and the view from my junior suite was truly lovely.

My principal caution concerns the summer festival in the Tuileries. The screaming from the amusement rides carries across to the hotel and is decidedly not relaxing. Travelers who value peace and quiet may wish to avoid staying during the festival.

Overall, there was much to like about the Hotel Brighton, and I would consider staying again at another time of year.

author: Dorian K
title: The Brighton Hotel problems
text:
We arrived while it rained, however, no bellhop to help with our 5 bags of luggage, not a good start.... once in the room the room was warm and the mini-frig was warm, went to tell them and the response was simply its hot outside (temp was 82 that day) and air-conditioning doesn't work like in the US, for the mini-frig we got some response of its not a refrigerator its a minibar that is only suppose to make things a little cooler (see photo). Then off to the shower where you play the game of scald you with boiling water or cool you off with cold water (temperature fluctuates as others in the hotel use their water so no modern temperature regulator, a child could get very hurt/burned in here), then you have to cross the 2 foot wet, slippery ledge outside the shower (no grip strips at all) and step down without breaking your neck.  Ceiling had old water stains, table would almost fall over if you leaned on it.  But we had a view of the courtyard, yes a view of other windows, industrial units, and roofs (not a courtyard at all!).
Great location to everything, but would never stay there again.

author: Valeriy K
title: Ceiling leak, a midnight room move, a threat to call the police, and a family with a child evicted on 25 minutes' notice
text:
We have visited 37 countries, but we had never been treated like this — at a 4-star hotel on rue de Rivoli, across from the Tuileries Garden.
Booking: a Junior Suite for 5 nights, 30 July – 4 August 2026, 2 adults and a child, €2,448.75 in total with breakfast included. We had requested the extra bed (sofa bed) for our child in advance — room 202 was confirmed to us.
On the night of 2–3 August, around 1 a.m., water started leaking from the ceiling. The receptionist watched our video, acknowledged the problem and said he would not stay in that room himself. Alone on duty, he could not help us move. He gave us the keys to room 402, “the same category” according to him — in reality smaller and with no sofa bed — and then, after seeing our photos, also the keys to room 403. In the middle of the night, with a child, we carried our belongings ourselves.
On the morning of 3 August, technicians were already working in room 202: the leak had come from the floor above. We were asked to see the manager, Marina. Not a single word of regret. Instead, an ultimatum: by 12:00, either return to 202 after repairs or accept 402 — 5 m² smaller (her own words) and without the sofa bed we had paid for. Our request to simply keep the rooms we had already been given for the one remaining night received a flat “no”. The offer to have staff pack our belongings while filming themselves was unacceptable: nobody would bear responsibility for our valuables. It was 35 °C outside, we had morning plans with our child, and we asked only for a little time so the hotel could consider what it might offer.
Instead of an answer, a hotel employee came to the room to pressure my husband. When he began filming to document that pressure, the employee declared he was calling the police. A few minutes later Marina informed us by phone that we had to leave the hotel by 12:00 — 25 minutes' notice of eviction. With a frightened child who kept asking what was happening, in 35-degree heat, we urgently called a taxi, packed our bags and searched for a new hotel.
The result: the hotel kept €1,940.60 for 4 nights — including the full Junior Suite rate for the night of the leak and the move — and refunded only €415.90 for the unused last night (invoice no. 194242 of 03/08/2026). No price adjustment, no reimbursement of expenses, not even an apology. As we left, the manager told us we were “the worst guests of her life” and that she had “written about us everywhere” (we still do not know what that means).
A reminder to the hotel of the French law that, in our view, was ignored here:
—	Articles 1103 and 1217 of the French Civil Code: a contract is binding on the parties; in case of non-performance the client may demand performance, a proportional price reduction and damages;
—	Article 1223 of the Civil Code: a proportional price reduction for imperfect performance — instead of the Junior Suite with a sofa bed that we paid for, we were given smaller rooms without one, with zero adjustment;
—	Article 1231-1 of the Civil Code: compensation for losses caused by non-performance (emergency taxi, finding new accommodation, ruined plans);
—	Article L.612-1 of the French Consumer Code: the right to free mediation — the hotel's designated mediator, SAS Médiation Solution (reg. no. 11007/OC/2111) — as well as a report to the DGCCRF via the SignalConso platform (signal.conso.gouv.fr). We reserve the right to use all of these avenues, including court.
The leak happened in the hotel — yet the guests were cast as the guilty party. In 4–5-star hotels, situations like this end with an apology, a solution and a small gesture — and the conflict is over. Here: psychological pressure, a threat to call the police, and a family with a child put out on the street in a heatwave with 25 minutes' notice. We had even paid for cancellation/interruption insurance (€50) when booking — but no insurance protects you from treatment like this. Families with children: avoid at all costs.

author: Two Grey nomads
title: Would not recommend Hotel Brighton Paris
text: In Australia, this hotel is advertised as 5 star, and after staying there I would rate it as 3 star at best.   I would not recommend this hotel to anyone.   On arrival I was informed one of our rooms had been cancelled, even though it had already been paid in full, so I had to purchase another room, which was far inferior to the one already paid for.   The room had never been cancelled and I am still awaiting my refund for the different in price.   We sat in the lounge until this problem had been sorted out, and noticed nail clippings surrounding my chair, I informed a staff member but no-one cleaned them up.   The next day my room wasn’t serviced, I informed the front desk but the room was never cleaned.   The hotel advertised afternoon tea,  this does not exist anymore.    The air conditioning was almost non existent.   The staff were quite polite but absolutely rubbish.   They have 2 elevators, one was literally large enough to carry two people (as long as you were breathing in) the most ridiculous elevator I’ve ever been in.   Myself, my sister and nephew did not enjoy one moment of our stay in this hotel.

author: Yasmine okbani
title: Anarchic organization and management
text:
Very disappointed with our experience at the Hôtel Brighton.
We had booked a room for two nights at nearly €600 per night. For a 4-star hotel of this category, imposing a 4:00 PM check-in is hardly acceptable. In most comparable establishments, rooms are available by 2:00 PM at the latest.
We are regular visitors to Paris and know the city very well. Instead of looking for a solution or offering a commercial gesture to compensate for this wait, we were simply handed a tourist guide to visit Paris. We specified that this was of no use to us.
At this price point, we expected a real sense of service, consideration, and better management of the reception. This experience reflects, in our opinion, a real management and organizational problem.
We did not expect this level of service from an establishment that claims to be high-end.

author: Jorge E
title: Sufficient for a good stay
text: Well positioned in relation to the city, near the metro, enough breakfast, helpful reception staff, rooms with no great amenities but good to rest. The main problem is that we felt in the rooms the subway passing underneath. The breakfast service by some employees is not expeditious, they let the food run out and were late to resume.

author: Lindynine
title: Love Paris, enjoyable stay.
text: This is the second time we stayed at Hotel Opera Lafayette through JET2 City Breaks.  We stayed in a room on the fourth floor we had emailed in advance asking for a room on a higher floor as we knew the road noise could wake us. We slept very well in room 47 at the end of the corridor no road noise and hardly felt the metro this high up. Lovely french windows to open   for fresh air and take in the view.  The room was cleaned, beds made and new towels every day.  One day we had put on a do not disturb sign on the door for a sleep in and left the used towels outside. Later housekeeping came back and knocked, in my basic french I managed to ask for new towels and a bath mat, the ladies were very friendly and helpful.  Shower powerful and just needed a few minutes to warm up.  Used the hairdryer provided in the bathroom and I had to remove the end cap or it would cut out but worked fine after that.  Shower body wash, hand wash, shower caps, cotton buds provided in the bathroom. Safe to use in the room. Kettle,paper cups, bottle of water and a few coffee sachets included. We didn't have breakfast at the hotel as there are many boulangeries nearby.  Cadet Metro a few minutes walk away.

author: Alina
title: Good location
text:
The hotel is well located, right next to Cadet metro station.Many restaurants and supermarkets nearby.
The carpet in the room is very dirty and should be changed. The subway passes under the hotel, I knew it, but apart from the noise of the subway, the walls are very thin; you can even hear someone blowing his nose in another room. One day, someone entered my room around 3:30 p.m. while I was trying to rest after a long walk (no one apologized). The bathroom door is sliding and does not close properly.If you use the shower, the entire bathroom is flooded because the pipe is defective.Breakfast without fruits or vegetables.

author: steve w
title: A great find!
text: I had never been to Paris before and I stayed 3 nights at this hotel including breakfast. The hotel is very clean and comfortable. The day and night concierges were excellent, very friendly and helpful! Easy to travel to from Orly airport, via metro . This hotel is in an excellent central location for visiting the main attractions in Paris, either by metro,bus or walking. I walked all over Paris, le Louvre, le Marais, Eiffel Tower, Montmartre etc. The breakfast at this hotel had an excellent, good selection of options. My single room (double bed ) was very comfortable with a lovely bathroom.  Close to Metro, Restaurants, bars etc, this hotel is a great choice. I can't recommend enough! Thankyou

author: Marica F
title: WEEKEND IN PARIS
text: We received this hotel as an alternative to another for a mishap and I must say it was a nice surprise as it is practically on the road leading to the Lafayette Gallery. Serviceable rooms with the necessary, good lighting, excellent soundproofing as the street noises are heard very little (unfortunately I can not deny that you hear a slight roar of the metro passing under, but it has not affected the living room at all). Breakfast easy from sweet to savory, good cleaning of the tables. Cleaning of the rooms every day and very neat. Perhaps I would recommend a mirror before the exit of the room as it is only present in the bathroom and small. Friendly, kind and especially understanding staff as I did not speak French.

author: Sabina R
title: Not recommended
text:
I stayed at this hotel and the experience was not pleasant. The property is quite far from the center of Paris. To reach it you have to use the subway, but the walk to get to the station is not safe at all.
The hotel is located in a highly degraded and dangerous area, adjacent to a car park full of homeless people and surrounded by real mountains of trash. The feeling of insecurity is constant.
To make matters worse, there is the staff: politeness and courtesy are not found here. The staff proved to be cold and unwelcoming.
The only positive note of the entire stay was the Uber app. Thanks to this service we were able to get around everywhere, at any time and at absolutely affordable prices, avoiding walking in the area around the hotel. I strongly advise against this property.

author: Patrizia R
title: Never again
text:
Hotel to avoid, it is located in a dirty and disreputable area. You
are even afraid to take the subway
Far from the center and often an Uber or Bolt driver will refuse the call
Poor breakfast, acceptable cleanliness

author: Sara R
title: Friendly staff and large rooms
text: The staff is very friendly and the rooms are very clean and of a good size for what is standard in the city. The only not-so-favorable point is that it is located in a somewhat dirty neighborhood, although it does not feel dangerous

author: Sohail M
title: Pathetic, Dirty Location
text:
We have stayed at Novotel Suites Paris Montreuil Vincennes for 3 nights on 15June-18June 2026 with my family of total 3 person in a family room The room was average with a double bed and a sofa bed. The washroom is small with a closet type shower where within a minute waters flows up in the floor, very slow water drainage system, a tiniest separate toilet at the entry door. 
Atmosphere just pathetic, the area just in front of the hotel's main & only door is the most dirtiest place in Paris, numerous poly bags are floating in wind everywhere, dirtiest footpaths, the whole roads actually like a disaster, This is the Paris !!!!, no it should not be...please take care of your belongings and locked.
Cleanness inside average, Value for money Overpriced property like this.
Service at the Reception, Super, which is the only good thing of this hotel I must admit that, everyone is very helpful, easy to communicate. Thank you for that

author: ys791
title: Jacob S

Wonderful Hotel , Clean peaceful , nicely renovated with very friendly Staff.
15 mins walking distance from Arc De Triomphe and Eifel Tower.
Recommend to all.

Well located close to 2 metro stations
Friendly staff
Great breakfast
Comfy bed
Well equipped bedroom

author: Kypu_0107

text:
Very friendly and supportive staff, renovated rooms very good.
Not far from the metro station and the park.

author: Happiness28658195679
title: The Pendry West in Harbor Yards
text: We love the Pendry Hotel West in Manhattan, one of our favorites. the professionalism of the staff to the cleanliness of the rooms. everyone is very helpful. Having Harbor Yards in your backyard is also helpful, so many things to do!

author: Rebecca S
title: Beautiful Stay in Hudson Yards
text:
Beautiful hotel in Hudson Yards with an elegant, modern design and warm natural finishes. The rooms are exceptionally clean, quiet, comfortable, and surprisingly spacious for New York City. The air conditioning is also fantastic — if you like to sleep in a very cold room, this hotel delivers.

The staff was wonderful and very responsive. When I asked for a room fan, it was brought up almost immediately. Everything about the stay felt polished and comfortable without being stuffy. The location is excellent for Hudson Yards, the High Line, restaurants, and walking around the area.

I would absolutely stay at the Pendry Manhattan West again.

author: John P
title: Exceptional 5-star experience in Midtown
text:
We stayed at the Pendry Manhattan West for a single night for an event my wife and I attended. The experience is a true 5-star hotel experience and the hotel is exceptionally designed and very well kept. The staff were very kind, courteous, and professional, which made our stay even better. They are laser focused on the guest experience and it shows. 

We enjoyed the in room dining which was very timely and well made! Food was hot and had fantastic flavor, and service was very prompt. Special shout out to Josh at Bar Pendry who made some incredible cocktails and also managed to almost effortlessly serve a full bar and lounge by himself. 

If you’re looking for a midtown hotel that prioritizes you as a guest, look no further

author: IwantToSeeTheWorld
title: 5 star service and amenities
text:
Absolutely amazing! When we found out it was a Montage owned property we were not surprised at all. The service level was elite, which can be hard to come by in Manhattan even at 5 star hotels. The staff was super friendly and helpful. We were there for a wedding and I didn’t have time to take pictures before the event, the girls at the Front Desk were so sweet to take photos of me, really good pictures at that! 

we also had an issue with AC in our room and they were very quick to fix it as we were experiencing 80° in the room. our the boy was so awesome. His name is Dean, very hospitable and friendly. 

breakfast was amazing and delicious and super quick. the Fitness area was perfect. I highly recommend this hotel we will definitely come back and stay again.

author: alitarogers
title: Stay at the Pendry
text: The Pendry Staff rocks! The front desk and bellmen teams understand customer service and deliver it year in and year out. There is limited turnover so we are greeted with recognition every time we arrive and throughout our visit. The interior design is very appealing and the rooms are exceptionally clean.

author: Sara C
title: Recommended!
text:
Excellent hotel, clean, very kind and helpful staff, good breakfast.
In a strategic position to visit Paris, well served by public transport.
Many places to dine in the surrounding area.

author: JonesieLinthicum
title: Comfortable, Reasonable, and Well-managed
text:
We stayed here ten years ago when we needed to be near  the Montparnasse train station. I have been recommending it ever since as a good-value, well-managed hotel. If anything, it's even better than before. 

We were able to check in right away when we arrived midday, which was a delightful surprise. The process was quick and easy. 

Our room was comfortable and well-equipped, with some really thoughtful touches. The light switches made complete sense, with one to light up the entryway as soon as you enter the room. That is not always the case!

We actually had two stays here, a few weeks apart. For the longer, second stay, we upgraded to a top-floor junior suite. The huge room had a sitting area and a large marble bathroom with double sinks, a tub/shower combo, and a separate WC. It was the largest room I have ever had in Paris, and I have been coming here for over fifty years.

We used the honor bar one night, and had a great conversation with some wonderful folks who, like us, love travel, live music, and combining the two.  The breakfast room/ lounge is very comfortable and a great place to meet up with family or friends. 

The location is convenient, even if you are not arriving or leaving from the Montparnasse train station. There are several historical markers on rue Delambre alone, and dozens more in the surrounding area. There are metro stops at either end of the street. You are surrounded by great cafes and restaurants. 

The staff here is very kind and helpful. When you stay here, you know that you are in good hands. I could not recommend it more highly!

author: Amanda Floyd
title: Amazing hotel, would stay again 🥰
text: What an absolutely beautiful hotel, the hospitality is amazing, the staff are lovely and so friendly.  Breakfast is delicious there is lots of different options, fantastic area for restaurants as

author: amelie v
title: Absolutely UNREAL
text:
How has this hotel ONLY got 3 stars?!

Me and my boyfriend stayed here for 3 nights and it was AMAZING!

It was super close to 3 metros and a train station and there was nowhere in Paris we could not get to from these stations.

The staff are absolutely lovely and cannot do enough for you. They go above and beyond and even upgraded us to a junior suite which was so spacious and just absolutely unreal!!

It is super clean and a lovely classy atmosphere. Amenities are spot on, had robes, slippers, 24/7 bar and room service.

Excellent value for money, could not recommend anymore and will definitely return!!

author: Yann g
title: Clean and well placed, nice welcome
text: Nice little hotel close to Montparnasse, rate in the neighborhood average.It has been redone recently,everything is clean and in condition.Little flat, during our visit the elevator was broken down...Room reserved on the 6th floor! No gesture of compensation that would have been commercially the least of things...

author: Mary L
title: Charming hotel in a less touristy area
text: This was a cozy and charming hotel close to boulangeries, shops, metros and pharmacies, and we loved that it was not very touristy.  We ate at restaurants where we heard mostly the chatter of locals.  We loved that you can open the balcony doors for fresh air and despite being hot during the day, the night breezes were lovely.  The metro is close by  for when we were too tired to walk.

author: Marya M
title: Extremely disappointing experience — especially because of the management’s unacceptable and aggressive behavior.
text:
I stayed for four nights, and on the fourth night I was moved to an attic room that was completely unacceptable. When I complained about the room and asked to cancel, the manager refused to cooperate and instead became aggressive, shouted at me, and insulted me. Even when I decided to leave, he followed me and continued arguing.

The room itself had serious issues: the bathroom was built inside the room, with an extremely narrow entrance that required you to turn sideways to get in. There were also two doors inside the room, in addition to the main entrance, with no clear explanation of where they led. I felt genuinely unsafe and spent the night worried about my security. The bed sheets were also visibly dirty.

For a hotel charging over €200 per night, this level of
 room quality, cleanliness, security, and especially customer service is completely unacceptable.

I strongly recommend reconsidering this hotel before booking.

author: dbwillows
title: Father Daughter Trip Base in Paris
text:
Here’s a more complete TripAdvisor review that incorporates your experience:

We thoroughly enjoyed our stay at Hotel Minerve. This was a father-and-15-year-old daughter trip, and the hotel was able to provide comfortable twin beds, which worked perfectly for us.

The location is outstanding in the Latin Quarter—an easy walk to Notre-Dame, the Panthéon, Luxembourg Gardens, and countless cafés, bakeries, and restaurants. Metro and bus connections are excellent, and getting to and from CDG Airport by RER and Metro was straightforward.

Our room was air-conditioned, clean, and surprisingly quiet despite being in the heart of Paris. The double-glazed windows blocked out the street noise when closed, but it was also nice to be able to open them for fresh air. The elevator was appreciated after long days of sightseeing, and every staff member we encountered was friendly and helpful.

For anyone looking for a comfortable, well-located hotel with excellent transport links and plenty of dining options nearby, Hotel Minerve is an excellent choice. We would happily stay here again.

author: NDaya2026
title: Gateway to Paris
text: We were thrilled with the location of the hotel - easy access to transportation and walking distance to many interesting places! The room was spotless, cool, and quiet. It was small, which one expects in Europe, and we had packed accordingly. Great view from 6th floor balcony. Very satisfying breakfast. The staff are all very helpful and kind.

author: Carol S
title: Lovely Paris Hotel
text: Minerve Hotel has helpful, friendly staff, rooms are charming and clean, and the location is convenient for sightseeing.

author: Andrea F
title: Excellent
text: Spotless hotel, very kind and polite staff! Beautiful sea... but above all discreet and fantastic entertainment! Cristian, Seba, Anna!! And all the guys at the restaurant, really nothing to say. I will return!

author: I R
title: Hotel Smeraldo – The Hidden Gem I Almost Don't Want to Share!
text:
I absolutely loved every second of my stay here, and part of me wants to keep this place a secret but it's too good not to rave about. This hotel completely made our Rome trip incredible.

The staff were incredibly nice from start to finish. A special shoutout to Geneva for being so welcoming, and also to the overnight gentleman (sorry I didn't catch his name!) who helped my husband and me with an AC issue late at nigh the was a lifesaver.

Location is a huge win walkable to everything, and you're surrounded by the best of Rome. The hotel itself is spotless and smells wonderfully fresh. They offer complimentary guest water, which is such a thoughtful touch, and the breakfast was outstanding featuring Roscioli bread that alone is worth waking up for.

Clean, comfortable, friendly, and perfectly situated I would absolutely stay here again if I return to Rome. Do yourself a favor and book this gem before everyone finds out about it!

author: Crystal @EatDrinkCLE
title: Great location in Rome
text: The location was absolutely fantastic! The room was clean and comfortable but we were disappointed that we were in the secondary building. This wasn't obvious when we booked.  Otherwise, everything was good.

author: Modehesa
title: Smeraldo
text: Excellent location, the staff super attentive. The breakfast very complete and the coffee very delicious. I felt safe at all times and the room also super good and with air conditioning working to perfection with the terrible heat that it was making

author: PettsWVU01
title: First visit to Roma
text: Stayed here for a three day visit prior to our cruise. We had nothing negative to say about our stay. The hotel was pristine and the staff was great. We stayed in one of the two bedroom, two bath apartments. Our family of five had plenty of room and the staff did a great job having it ready early for us. The complimentary breakfast was very good and the hot drink bar was a nice add on. The hotel arranged for a shuttle from the airport, and to the cruise port. I liked the location because it was central to all major landmarks. If you absolutely had to walk to some of them, you could. A/C was great, WiFi was good, and the bakery across the street was a nice one pace to grab something quick. Basically, if I come back to Rome, we will stay here again.

author: Ollie M
title: Owed €300
text: I booked this hotel in February. They then cancelled the booking due to the hotel not being available due to refurbishment. But three weeks later they have not refunded my booking money. I have now emailed three times and today went into a TimHotel to ask what's going on. I am still unsure when the refund will come through. I am owed 300 euros.

author: Emma9732b
title: Hotel very good
text: The hotel is very good, clean, quiet, well placed 5 minutes from the train station on foot. The staff is friendly and very good advice. Breakfast is full, even for children.

author: philippemontagna

author: Cris
title: Poor service
text:
The rooms were not ready for check-in at 14:00. When I mentioned that to the blonde receptionist woman and told her it's not normal, she started to argue with me.

Small room.

Only one towel per person.

Noisy A/C.
