author: GRMY64
title: Hotel with original decor.
text: Very good location right next to the Pigalle metro station, with many attractions and restaurants nearby. The staff is pleasant, available, and ensures that the stay goes as smoothly as possible. The room was clean and quiet (street side) with a small balcony that included a table and two chairs. The decor (just like the rest of the hotel) is unusual. A fridge was present in the room, and two bottles of water were provided as a courtesy. Excellent water pressure in the bathroom. Complete breakfast in the hotel's basement with very cheerful staff in the morning. A few downsides: not many electrical outlets in the room, a larger partition in the bathtub would be helpful to avoid flooding the bathroom when showering, the air conditioning, which works well, is apparently turned off at night (not great given the current temperatures), the elevator is a bit slow, and the breakfast room is rather small and narrow (maximum of about twelve seats). Despite these few points, a very good establishment in Paris that I recommend.

author: June P
title: Great experience
text: My Granddaughter and I have just returned from this hotel and we loved everything about it. The Moulin Rouge theme is tastefully done. Room was an ok size and everything worked and was spotless. Bathroom was good size and good hot shower. Staff were exceptionally helpful. Breakfast was good value and tasty. We will certainly return when it's not so hot!

author: Laurence D
title: A pleasant Parisian interlude.
text: A very nice hotel, just like its staff. The rooms are pretty and clean. I recommend it 100%.

author: ccartaciano
title: Nice hotel and great location
text:
Hotel was nice and great location.
Staff was very helpful and friendly. A lot of good places to eat around the area and walking distance to the Eiffel tower and other great places to visit.

author: maurodellaspoletina
title: Perfect hotel
text: Excellent location, kind staff, clean and quiet hotel, very good and abundant breakfast, I would gladly return.

author: melindaheurtebise
title: Excellent.
text: Hotel very well located - The breakfast was very good and all-you-can-eat - Staff very friendly and welcoming.

author: nir972
title: very nice hotel
text: good location, nice neighborhood and near the Eiffel tower which  is also good for the night time especially with kids. the rooms in the hotel are also nice and clean.

author: kkneissl
title: Very satisfied!
text: A simple but very clean 3-star hotel with very friendly staff in an absolutely top location!

author: Nynon N
title: BED BUGS AND DISHONEST MANAGEMENT
text:
Avoid at all costs!!

We left this hotel the same evening without spending a single night there. As soon as we arrived, we found a bed bug as well as a room in a deplorable state of cleanliness. A second room was offered to us, but it was just as dirty. We therefore had to find another hotel in an emergency at 10:30 PM.

The worst part remains the handling of the situation. Despite photos, a video, and several emails, the hotel refused to acknowledge the problem, downplayed the facts by calling it "normal wear and tear," and then offered us... a free night in the same hotel. Since then, no more responses to our follow-ups.

Only the receptionist present that evening was professional and understanding. On the other hand, management shows bad faith and total contempt for its customers.

I strongly advise against this establishment. If a problem arises, do not count on them to take responsibility for it.

author: Robert T
title: You get what you pay for.
text: Didn’t expect much after reading other reviews but were pleasantly surprised by this small but very clean hotel. The rooms are small but so was the price. The bathroom was very small but the shower was excellent and all very clean. It was a twin room and the beds were fine plus with hot nights the window actually opened to let some air in.  No food or bar but Bayswater is full of eateries. The room was quiet and comfortable. Staff very friendly and helpful.

author: JESUS SOLERO
title: Good value for money
text: I stayed here a couple of years ago and then gave it a rating of three; in this case, I will raise it one point, as the room they offered me was better than that time. It is located in a very quiet area, just five minutes walk from busy Queensway, full of cafes, restaurants, shops and supermarkets. Very close to the Queensway and Bayswater subway stops. I occupied a single room with private bathroom for two nights, at a total price of £100 (€115). I was assigned a fourth floor, but fortunately, this hotel has a lift, which is not very common in the area. The room was small but more than enough, with a large and comfortable bed, flat screen TV, hairdryer, enough plugs, kettle and complimentary coffee and tea. The wifi was excellent. It doesn't have air conditioning, but I didn't need it either. The bathroom, very small, with jars of gel and bars of soap; the sink, exaggeratedly small, and the shower, very difficult to adjust so that the water came out at the correct temperature. The receptionist, lovely. Despite these drawbacks, for value for money, I think it is practically impossible to find something better around the area.

author: bojana v
title: We loved staying here
text: Fantastic location, pleasant stay and very nice and professional people.

author: Diane B
title: Walls are paper thin. I asked for a quiet room....
text: Staff are friendly, room is good for the price.  But it's 1am and I can hear everything everyone is saying in the rooms near me so I cannot sleep.  Absolutely no point staying in London for work if I then go to work exhausted!

author: AnnaRani97
title: Fairy-tale hotel
text:
This is the fifth time I have returned here and every time it feels like being at home, I want to thank THIN in particular for her kindness, helpfulness, and cheerfulness. Thanks also to KRISTINA. 
The location for me is excellent, in one of the most beautiful areas of London. The private garden is a great little spot to have breakfast or to rest and relax for a moment. We will return here as always for our future trips to London. THANK YOU

author: Calpurnia0016
title: Simple and functional, well located
text: Simple and very functional room with all the necessary comfort for a stay of a few days. Comfortable bedding. Clean. Very quiet. Perfect location 10 minutes from Liverpool Street Station, for those arriving by plane from Stansted Airport. And good value for money.

author: Vic
title: Lovely Hotel
text:
Great little find. Super clean. Great value for money. 
Great service and will definitely stay in this hotel chain again.

author: Maverick598
title: Nah, not worth it.
text:
Pros:
Great location right next to Liverpool Street. Easy check in and check out. 
Staff nice and polite. 

Cons:
Rooms are small. I was on my own but we would have struggled if there had been two of us. Maybe about foot on the right and at the end of the bed. Shower room small.  
Lights - I’m pretty good with technology but I struggled to get the main light off. Without turning the whole room off.  It’s a touch pad where nothing seems clear and you’re there asking yourself why won’t it turn off? Am I pressing too hard, too soft, or in the wrong way?!
Not ideal at the end of a day or night, and I was sober. 
Air con - room had air con and I appeared to have got it working despite the touch pad, but it wouldn’t cool the room, only the fan came on. Not great. 

Overall maybe you’ll have a good experience here but I’m not sure I’ll go back even if I need a crash pad for the night. The price would have to be ridiculously cheap to make me book again.

author: MarkyP264
title: Compact It Is!
text:
The compact rooms are really, really compact! These rooms would be ok for one person but it is tricky to move around if you have 2 people in them.

Away from that, nice hotel in a good location, clean and modern. I should have picked a larger room.

author: Siran Yang
title: No One at the Front Desk Key System Down Locked Out of My Room
text: The entire key swiping system is down so no one can get into their rooms. The front desk staff has to manually open the door for every guest but by the time I got back, I had to wait 30 minutes to get in cause the front desk was empty. Unless you really wanna save money, DO NOT COME HERE.

author: Corbin U
title: Justin is an amazing worker, give him a raise!
text: Justin, the man at the front desk, is my brother from another mother. He made our experience here 20x better and i’m very thankful to have met him. Anything we needed or asked him for, he was on it. That man deserves to be getting paid $100 an hour. The hotel is also very nice. I think Justin’s aura brings the whole place into a perfect harmony and keeps everything running smoothly.

author: Reynald H
title: Very good stay
text:
Pleasant stay with an amazing host Justin,
Cheers from France 😉

author: shumaila a
title: very comfortable and relaxing experience staying here in the severe weather
text: amazing and super comfortable experience staying here especially considering the winter storm and all. friendly staff, quick service and really good hotel rooms.

author: Navigator54694617384
title: Basic af - you pay for 0 frills then pay some more
text:
The only reason this hotel gets any stars at all is because I have to rate at least a “1”. I have to say that it is clean and somewhat modern. That’s about the only thing going for it other than location. 
If you’re trying to do anything other than sleep here though, well f%#

author: 299sjh
title: Fabulous relaxing visit
text: Another fabulous stay at the St Ermin Hotel. Visited on a theatre trip with my daughter. The hotel is perfectly located to walk to/ from Covent Garden and the theatre district as well as Piccadilly, St James Park, Buckingham Palace and a wee bit of shipping on Regent Street. Lovely comfortable room, fabulous bed and shower and a coffee machine. Great breakfast and cocktails on the terrace. Lovely relaxed visit thanks everyone.

author: Shmees
title: Great hotel. Unbelievable staff !!
text:
What an amazing hotel !

Staff: 
The way the staff of St Ermins treats guests should be in an instructional manual for hotel hospitality! At all times, the hotel staff made us feel like we were a pleasure and a joy to have on site. No request is unreasonable, every request is a pleasure for them to fulfill. They don’t just get you what you are asking for — they offer more in response than what you even thought to ask for. And this started before we even left home, with long and thoughtful emails from no less than three different members of the staff, offering us a choice of rooms and so on. They left us delicious treats upon check in, and a bottle of bubbly with cake for our anniversary a few days later, and London-theme coloring books for the kids, and a lovely box of little shampoos to bring home. We had requested an early check in, but upon arrival our room wasn’t available. I was expecting to be told to wait in the lobby…. but no, they handed us the keys to a different room and told us to please go rest and relax in that room until ours was ready!!! It never would have even occurred to us to ask for this! 

Rooms:
 We saw and used two rooms, both spotlessly clean, full of useful amenities. Well lit. Very comfortable. The room we were offered to rest in temporarily was quite tiny but very suitable for a single traveller (or couple looking to see the sights, not sit in a hotel room). The actual room we were given was an unusual but larger version of their “family room”. It was huge, with two full bathrooms, including one with a huge shower and huge double sink. Also had doors to close between the main bedroom and the rest of the room - really felt like a large suite. We loved this room. Housekeeping was excellent and turndown service wonderful. (Note: the bathrooms had rain showers only, no detachable or adjustable shower heads or different settings.) 

Location:
It is a 60 second walk from the front door of the hotel to the entrance of St James Park Tube station. And St James Park itself. Maybe 5-7 minutes walk to Westminster Abbey & Big Ben & Westminster tube station etc. Walked easily and quickly to Buckingham Palace. Lots of cafes and restaurants and even a small Whole Foods within 90 seconds walk of the hotel. You can walk to Westminster pier to catch the Uber boat. You really can’t beat this location!

Food: 
Breakfast buffet was very plentiful with lots of stations, hot and cold options, etc. The à la carte breakfast menu is quite reasonable and plentiful. We ate dinner at the bar a few times, we were always too late for dinner in the restaurant. There is a small kids menu. You’re also just a few minutes walk from so many restaurants, cafes, etc. and we ordered UberEats one night and ate in the room. 

Kids:
We saw a lot of families with kids, but we never heard any noise. The kids had a good time doing the scavenger hunt that the hotel provides. The room was great for travelling with kids/teens as we had space and two bathrooms. It felt very quiet and safe. 

Why are you still sitting there reading this review, go book this hotel fast before it sells out!

author: GundamWing101
title: Excellent hotel at a good price
text: Very centrally located hotel, just a few steps from the St. James Park tube station. Even though the hotel has a lot of rooms, the service was very good, I never had to wait more than a few seconds for somebody to take care of my requests. Everything was very clean, the room was quiet and had a good size and enough space to put my things away. For all that it offered, the price was very reasonable. I would definitely stay here again.

author: Htoufeily
title: Lebanese traveler
text:
We stayed one night from Saturday till Sunday ( 15 till 16 ) 
Historic hotel , room very comfortable and service beyond our expectation
Very friendly staff at concierge ! Gentleman from Cyprus  supported us and give us all advices needed how to move around 
We enjoyed our stay and for sure we will come back 
Love location and people 
Well done guys

author: Geno A
title: Great Place to Dtay in London
text: Beautiful hotel!  Room, staff, and service were all top notch. Location is close to key London sites.  Also right near St. James underground line which made getting around a breeze.  Would absolutely stay here again during my next bust to London.

author: Cathrine T
title: beautiful!
text: beautiful room with air con and a balcony, breakfast was delicious with plenty of options and the staff were so lovely and helpful. Definitely book an hour in the spa

author: Sabina M
title: Top
text: Beautiful hotel and exceptional spa

author: Ruby
title: 5 Nights
text: Stayed at Hotel Delgj Aranci for 5 nights while visiting Rome. Can't complain staff are 24hours at the desk, cleaners come every morning. Hotel room was lovely and clean, bed comfy. From the hotel you are able to grab the bus into 'city center' could walk it but decided against due to the heat. Breakfast was lovely, have a good options of bacon,sausage and scrambled eggs, pastry's.

author: Mads S
title: Notification
text:
The hotel is super nice to stay in. It offers many experiences: delicious and selective breakfast buffet, delicious restaurant, if you are tired of city tour, a large and cozy lounge to relax in mm. 
The hotel has an authentic and cozy atmosphere in which you feel safe and comfortable. 
Very pleasant stay. Not my last visit!

author: Jen S
title: Hotel Degli Aranci
text: This hotel is beautiful and the staff are amazing!  The front desk was so helpful with suggestions that we asked for.  I really can’t say enough about this hotel!

author: alafratt
title: Nice hotel, great location
text: This is a nice hotel in a great location.  The room was clean and we loved having a small balcony.  The breakfast buffet was very nice - everything from baguettes and croissants to eggs and bacon.  Several juice and coffee options, and the hostess, Chafia, was LOVELY, and she even made homemade chocolate chip and vanilla cake/bread for the buffet.

author: Nancy N
title: I come to this hotel often but this time I would like to commend the kindness of Chafia and her cakes!
text: I come to this hotel often but this time I would like to commend the staff who are adorable and a big bravo to Chafia for her welcome and her "delicious" homemade cake.

author: Marcpc
title: Recommended.
text: Location is excellent. Unbeatable in fact, just 15 mins from Gare du Nord trip to St. Michel station beside hotel & smack bang in front of Notre Dame. Rooms are "compact" but nicely decorated (as always thr photos on the website are a bit flattering. Service friendly and efficient. We didnt have breakfast here but the price seems reasonable compared to cafés outside. Our family room had a small terrace facing in to the courtyard. It was just right for having our august siesta and hanging out at night watching TV before bed. We will definitley return

author: Aaron N
title: Perfect location!
text: Outstanding location, 5 minute walk from Notre Dame. Great breakfast with cheerful service, Chafia was a delight each morning. Highly recommend.

author: MHTruett
title: Great location
text: This hotel is in a great location

author: Allison K
title: Not recommend Park Hyatt Paris Vendôme
text:
I would not recommend Park Hyatt Paris Vendôme.

Compared with other hotels in a similar price range and location, I found the condition of the room and the quality of the staff service to be disappointing.

The €60 breakfast was extremely basic, and if you stay for more than two nights, there is very little variety and hardly anything new to eat.

On top of that, the sink in my bathroom was draining very slowly. I reported the issue and requested that it be fixed, but it was never resolved. This is the kind of problem I would expect at a one-star hotel.

I would recommend the Hyatt Louvre Hotel instead.

author: Basem S
title: Great stay
text: great service, great location, great staff, exceptional concierge, excellent ambiance....highly recommend this park hyatt!

author: traveldad2018
title: Great hotel and staff; would return but review your bill upon checkout
text:
I really enjoyed the Park Hyatt.  The rooms are refined and comfortable.  Location is good.  The hallways are classy.  The bed was comfortable and the shower was great.  Breakfast was not great, but was very good. 
Two negatives, one very troubling.  I had a nice breakfast and did not leave a tip (as I would in the US), but when checking out ~2 hours after breakfast, there was a 10 Euro charge (for the breakfast that was included with the room).  Someone at the hotel apparently "doctored" the bill to add a tip.  First time this has happened to me.  The other negative is that I gave Cafe' Jeanne a try for dinner (PUR' was on holiday), and the food was disappointing though service was very pleasant.  Notwithstanding the apparent fraud, I would return to Park Hyatt Paris.

author: Simon
title: A hotel that takes enormous pride in its people, and it shows
text:
Our stay at the Park Hyatt Paris-Vendôme was memorable from the first minute. On arrival, our taxi driver's card terminal failed and I had no cash on me. Without any fuss, the hotel staff came out and paid the driver in cash on the spot. A small crisis resolved with total grace, and it set the tone for everything that followed.

The location could not be better. The hotel sits on Rue de la Paix, a minute's walk from Place Vendôme, with the Opéra Garnier at one end of the street and the Tuileries and the Louvre a short stroll away. Everything we wanted from Paris was on foot, and returning to the hotel each evening felt like coming home to the calmest address in the city.

And it really is calm. Despite being in the very heart of Paris, the suite was remarkably quiet. We never heard traffic, corridors, or neighboring rooms, and we slept beautifully every night. The atmosphere throughout the hotel matches that serenity: understated, elegant, and discreet rather than showy, with beautiful materials, soft lighting, and staff who seem to glide rather than rush. It is luxury with the volume turned down, which is exactly what we wanted.

Our suite was gorgeous, generously sized, and thoughtfully laid out, with a marble bathroom that was a pleasure to use. Housekeeping was superb. The suite was kept immaculate throughout, serviced constantly and always to the highest standard. In a week we never once found so much as a smudge; cleanliness here is close to obsessive, in the best way.

The in-room breakfast service was the highlight. The lady who served us on our last three mornings was exceptional. She remembered exactly how we liked everything laid out, brought the exotic fruits she knew we enjoyed, and made sure there were fresh flowers on the tray each morning. That level of attentiveness is rare anywhere, and it turned each breakfast into a genuine pleasure.

That breakfast story sums up the service as a whole. Every department, from the front desk to housekeeping to the engineering team, was responsive, warm, and genuinely proactive. The amenities matched the standard: excellent in-room dining, fast complimentary Wi-Fi, fresh water replenished daily, and every request handled promptly and without fuss.

author: John L
title: PH Vendome...true gem in the Hyatt Collection
text:
WOH Lifetime Globalist...just got back from a long weekend stay at this hotel (Thurs-Mon) after a 2 week vacation in Greece.  PH Vendome is an amazing hotel and will return on my next trip to Paris.  I would've given 5 stars (as they deserve it) but the hotel is under construction right now and there's a bit of loud work on-going.

Under normal circumstances, this hotel would be 5 stars.  It's centrally located, staff are incredibly helpful and professional, the hotel itself is a gem, spa is great, gym is very good, and Pur (Michelin restaurant onsite) is excellent.

author: dellie50
title: 24 hour stopover in London
text:
1. Great location; very close to Paddington Station which is the terminal for the Heathrow Express and has a number of Underground lines. It is walking distance to the West End and other areas of interest.
2. The staff were so helpful. I arrived at 7am from Heathrow after a long flight. They managed to check me in which meant I could shower and then go exploring.  The hotel also has baggage storage facilities which I used after I had checked out.
3. Spring Street has good eating places. 
4. The hotel was clean and tidy.
5. The hotel offered compact rooms for a very reasonable rates, which was ideal for me as I was staying 1 night.

author: Jay
title: Room paranoia. Useless manager.
text:
An incident occurred during our stay which significantly affected our experience. I am awarding 2 stars, primarily because the air conditioning was functioning well.

Our first impressions were positive. The gentleman at reception was polite and kindly stored our luggage before check-in.

Unfortunately, the lift was out of service, which was inconvenient when carrying suitcases. As we made our way up the stairs, the age and condition of the hotel became increasingly apparent. There were cracked walls and worn carpets with visible damage. While some wear and tear is understandable in a budget hotel, there are reasonable standards that should still be maintained.

After checking into our room, we had been there for less than ten minutes when a member of housekeeping entered without knocking. At the time, I was lying on the bed without clothing, trying to cool down during the heatwave.

I found the incident both embarrassing and upsetting. I immediately contacted reception to raise a complaint and was informed that the manager would contact me.

After waiting for approximately an hour without receiving any response, I went downstairs to speak with the manager directly. Unfortunately, I found her attitude unhelpful and dismissive.

I explained that the situation was unacceptable and appeared to demonstrate a lack of communication between staff members. As paying guests, we are entitled to privacy within our room, and this should never have occurred.

Although the manager apologised, my request for a partial refund was declined. No alternative form of compensation or goodwill gesture was offered despite the distress and embarrassment caused.

As a result of this incident, we felt both uncomfortable and unsafe for the remainder of our stay. Knowing that someone had entered our room without warning left us concerned that it could happen again.

We found ourselves constantly watching the door and anticipating further interruptions. The situation caused significant anxiety, to the extent that my partner placed our luggage in front of the door for added peace of mind.

Given the impact this had on our sense of privacy and security, we ultimately decided that we could not continue our stay and requested a full refund. A refund still not received. 

I made it clear that I would be leaving a review of my experience. Based on this incident and the way it was handled, I would not choose to stay at this hotel again.

author: MARIA ANGELICA L
title: Very good value for money
text:
We had a very pleasant stay at this hotel. Its biggest advantage is definitely the location, which is excellent and makes it very easy to explore the area and access nearby attractions, restaurants, and transportation.

Another highlight was the friendliness and helpfulness of the staff. Everyone was welcoming, attentive, and always willing to assist with any questions or requests.

The hotel itself is rather simple and could benefit from some refurbishment and general maintenance in certain areas. However, considering the price paid, we felt that the overall value for money was very good. The excellent location and the quality of service more than compensated for these minor shortcomings.

We would gladly stay here again and would recommend it to travelers looking for a well-located hotel with a friendly atmosphere and reasonable rates.

author: marydurhone
title: Excellent customer service
text: I walked into the Edward Hotel in May 2026 after getting stuck at Paddington late in the evening when all trains to my destination were cancelled.  Helga, the receptionist, saved the day by being welcoming, giving me her full attention and finding me a room. I've met few hotel receptionists with her customer service skills. Thanks again!

author: Fozia K
title: Worst hotel ever! Unsafe conditions and appalling service.
text:
This was hands down the worst hotel experience I've ever had. From the moment we arrived, it was clear that basic standards of cleanliness and hospitality were optional here.

The room smelled strongly of damp and stale cigarettes, and within 10 minutes my daughter, who has a lung disease, began breathing very heavily. The stench was so overwhelming that my husband, who is immuno-compromised, began vomiting.The carpets were stained beyond redemption and so dusty it felt as though they hadn’t been cleaned since the hotel first opened. Although the downstairs areas look presentable, do not be fooled — this place is a complete waste of money. 

The staff were equally disappointing. When we addressed our concerns with the manager, we were met with blank stares and excuses. Management were unwilling to help in any way. They repeatedly directed the receptionist to deal with complaints, who confirmed she had no authority to do anything. They refused to provide any certificate or proof that the hotel is damp-proof. We spent over two hours trying to negotiate a refund, which was also refused. 

Other guests were complaining that there was no hot water in their rooms. We didn’t even get a chance to use any facilities as we left immediately. We were forced to find another hotel in the middle of the night. 

Avoid at all costs, especially if you have children — the service and conditions were disgusting and clearly pose a risk to health. If I could give zero stars, I would.

author: Robin H
title: Wonderful Roman Hotel
text: I have stayed at this hotel on each trip to Rome for over 20 years. We have always been treated lovely, the breakfast is amazing and the beautiful marble throughout the bathrooms is just gorgeous. It is centrally located to everything and has the best pizza place in Rome right down the street on the right. I recommend the Pear and Gorgonzola pizza.

author: Brian N
title: Outstanding service
text:
What a lovely hotel, the staff are outstanding ( went to the colloseum but forgot my wife's passport, phoned the hotel and they emailed a copy to us so we could get in OUSTANDING SERVICE)
The hotel is clean with a nice old school feeling with a lovely bar to relax in at the end of the day, it has central locations minutes walk to the shops and restaurants, (go down  the side streets and it's a lot cheaper, 2 mains ,water, two drinks and bread 50 to 70 E ) you are 25 minutes walk from the Vatican and 15 minutes in a taxi  20 E from the colloseum.
Fle markets on Sundays 20 euro by taxi.
I will definitely book this hotel in the future and recommend it.

author: Nia J
title: Brilliant hotel, central location near to the main attractions
text: The hotel is in a fantastic, central location which means all of the must see sights are within easy reach. There is a metro station just steps away so if you want/need to use public transport then this is easily accessible. The staff were all pleasant and friendly. The rooms felt authentically Italian with their decor & the beds were some of the comfiest I’ve come across at a hotel in recent times. Breakfast was great, with a variety of choice & always plenty of space available in the breakfast room. We’d all leave full up after breakfast ready for a full day ahead. Later of an evening after a busy day of sightseeing, this hotel was close to lots of restaurants within a few minutes walk, which meant we didn’t have to go too far from our hotel of an evening to find food. We often found ourselves going later on for a sit by the Spanish steps as these are within a short 10 minute walk. I would certainly recommend this hotel to someone who wants a hotel in a central spot to all of the main sightseeing attractions.

author: Pia75
title: Great choice in Rome
text:
Overall: well located hotel and clean, nice and very good service.

Location: as many others say, the hotel is very central and nice. 

Service: Very friendly, even when I needed to change room. Effective, kind and very professional employees. You feel like a guest, not a customer. Everyone is welcoming and friendly. 

ROM: 
All rooms are beautiful and clean. It is tastefully decorated and well equipped rooms. But the standard and DeLux rooms are very small and there are narrow and slow elevators in the building. Therefore, it is advisable to make sure that you book a room that suits your needs. We upgraded to one of the rooms at the atrium. That was lovely. Nice bathroom with luxurious products, delicious towels and bathrobes. The room is very clean and nice. 

Common areas: everything is clean and neat and neat. The breakfast room is cosy and we always had good space. The bar is cosy, especially sitting out.

Food: breakfast is very good, especially to Italy to be. Good selection of fresh fruit and proper eggshells. Delicious coffee and good selection of both sweet and salt.

author: Adventure51910016451
title: An oasis of calm, coolness & welcome.
text:
I traveled with my partner and young adult sons.  We’d booked the deluxe rooms and they overlooked the courtyard; it was always calm and peaceful.  The hotel is a little bit quirky (one lift to the first floor and a smaller lift to higher floors) and the rooms are individual, beautifully decorated and the air conditioning was quiet and effective.  It was lovely to lie in the bed after a busy day in Rome and relax before going out to enjoy the evening.  The room sizes were not an issue for us, I unpacked and my partner lived out of his suitcase and there was plenty of room.

Breakfast was great, lots of choice and always plentiful, even towards the end of service.  
The bar area is beautiful and we had THE best Aperol spritz of any we had in Rome…we tested extensively.

All the staff without exception were friendly, welcoming and helpful.  

The location is fantastic…close to the metro, tram and bus stop.  Across the road from Piazza del Popolo and the city awaits…  You can see the Flaminio obelisk from quite a distance, so it was always easy to navigate home.  We bought a weekly travel pass and zipped about.  The buses and metro are good.  

We would return to River Palace in a heartbeat…Thank you so much for having us.

author: Sam D
title: Perfect location
text: The location of this hotel is perfect. All tourist attractions walkable distance.

author: Sophie C
title: Avoid at all costs!
text: Aside from the staff, who are friendly, and the central location just behind the Galeries Lafayette, this hotel should be avoided. I stayed there during a week of heatwave, and the establishment has no air conditioning. The fan provided only circulated hot air. The temperature in the room, tiny with a low ceiling and carpet, reached 95 °F: impossible to sleep there. As for the breakfast, it was very disappointing, served in a cramped and stuffy room. All of this for €250 a night. A completely unjustified rate considering the services provided. An experience I do not recommend.

author: Delphine L
title: Terrible hotel
text:
My room smelled very bad, I would say it was truly awful. 
I immediately informed the front desk.
I said it is lamentable to give a room like this, and he told me not to complain because there is another room, especially at that price, and then he told me that I am not pleasant; I told him, excuse me, the one suffering is me, I am changing floors with all my luggage and there is no normal help.
At breakfast, no one says hello.
The orange juice is disgusting, and the pastries are not good and frozen.
Breakfast where there are too few options.
Avoid at all costs.

author: bibimapi
title: Disappointing.
text:
I spent three days in this hotel located in a very convenient and central position in the city. The presentation photos on various sites, including the official one, are beautiful and indeed convincing for a 3-star rating. In reality, the structure is quite different, with small rooms, uneven flooring even though covered with carpet, no wardrobe or drawer in the room, no air conditioning, and at night it was impossible to sleep due to the heat, no safe, and a minimal breakfast served in a tiny room.
In short, a two-star rating would have been more appropriate because the only thing three-star was the price: 900 euros for three nights.

author: François L
title: AVOID!!!!!!
text:
Do not trust the photos on online booking sites or the positive reviews.
It's a rat hole. 830 euros for 3 nights in a room less well-equipped than at Ikea... an old rack, a handmade desk made from 3 plywood boards... 830 euros for 3 nights!!! We are much more comfortably welcomed in budget hotels around the ring road for four times less. Avoid it, respect yourself.

author: Michele D
title: Good stay!
text: Stayed here two nights. The room was good sized, beds were comfortable and bathroom was clean. The AC wasn't working very well..we went back to the room a few times during the day it was very warm in the room. We couldn't set the AC below 68. It was cool enough at night though while sleeping. Breakfast was good, not crowded at all like other reviews say. No issues waiting for elevators either. Pretty quiet for NYC also. The rooftop bar was great..amazing views! Great location too, near Times Square and Rockefeller Center. Probably wouldn't stay here again as we really didn't need a suite with stove and dishwasher, etc but it was free since I had won my stay in a sweepstakes.

author: Vanessa R
title: Excellent!!
text:
Our experience at the hotel was incredible, all the staff were super attentive and willing to help with any request, the breakfast is 10 out of 10, varied and super abundant, we loved the help that Jose santa fe offered us, he was super kind, cordial and very attentive to making us feel comfortable with the breakfast and with our questions, he made us feel at home.
Congratulations to this hotel for its very kind staff.
The hotel is super clean and the rooms, although they are not very big, are very comfortable.
The hotel's location is another plus that should not go unmentioned.

author: maayan s
title: Great
text: We stayed here twice during the World Cup and had an amazing time! Huge thanks to Ynocencia for being so wonderfully helpful with our baby during breakfast. Excellent hotel and incredible service – highly recommended!

author: Gunjan V
title: Friendly service and perfect location.
text:
I had an excellent experience at the Home2 Suites in Times Square. The hotel was very clean, the location is perfect for exploring the city, and the atmosphere was very pleasant.

I want to especially highlight Ynocencia, who was incredibly kind, attentive, and helpful throughout my entire stay. She always greeted us with a smile and was willing to help with any question or need, making us feel very welcome.

I would definitely stay here again and recommend it to anyone visiting New York. 
Thank you, Ynocencia, for making our stay even more special!

author: Alfonso L
title: Good experience
text: Excellent and very good service from Ynocencia.

author: TravelManGB
title: Budget hotel, poor location for sightseeing
text: The hotel is modern but designed to be as cheap as possible with absolutely zero frills. Absolutely everything comes at an additional cost including room cleaning. The bedding is comfortable but the mattress is rock solid. The breakfast is very poor and expensive for the selection on offer. There are no restaurants nearby so be prepared to travel for meals. The hotel is conveniently located next to the metro although note that this is closed after 10pm on weekdays and some days during the week during February and March. I would not recommend this hotel for sightseeing holidays as it is a good 30 minute metro journey to the main landmarks. It is the perfect hotel for stopping over for one night but any longer, I’d suggest looking for alternatives.

author: Camille D
title: Good and practical
text:
The hotel is clean with sober decoration, the agents are professional and the room is functional with comfortable bedding.
Sanitary facilities are clean and functional. 
For pedestrians, the hotel is very close to the metro line 12, suitable dining establishments and studio 107.

author: Nat G
title: A Bit Far From the City
text: It is a very good hotel however, it will take you 45 mins to get into Paris (2 trains). Good thing, an M-12 train station (Front Populaire, wheel-chair accessible) is just literally in front of the hotel. Hotel is located in the north, secluded area outside of Paris. There is a nearby convenience store, couple of restaurants and boulangerie. The buffet breakfast is decent and there are vending machines in the hotel lobby. About the room, there is an air conditioner in the room. Only bath gel is provided, no other toiletries. There is no kettle, teacups and glass provided. Hairdryer and iron can be borrowed from reception. No in-room phone. No laundry facility but there is one a bit far away. Receptionists are very accommodating (I am so sorry, I forgot the name of the 3 receptionists I got to talked to). I will certainly stay again to this property when I am back to Paris.

author: Ugo_saporito
title: Very minimal
text:
HOTEL all designed to minimize costs. Modern

ROOM small, well equipped

BREAKFAST varied but of poor quality 

PRICE 80 eu in Paris!

author: RS
title: To flee
text:
I spent a very bad night in this hotel. 
The very noisy ventilation, which cannot be cut off, prevented me from sleeping well. 
It stopped as if by miracle at 6am.... Total silence at the end of the night... weird, right?
Uninteresting and uninteresting welcome. 
Hotel environment not great. 
Only positive aspect: Proximity to the metro

author: Jacky2701
title: Great Boutique Hotel
text: Found the hotel by chance as I was already staying in the area . All the staff I met were very friendly & welcoming . Really good breakfast included in the price

author: cl760
title: confrotable and quiet
text: a very nice and welcoming staff. A nice and confortable room in a quiet street but close to the Victoria station which is convenient.

author: Amber L
title: Unacceptable Bathroom
text: We stayed in a Double Room, which was situated oddly. It was 2 rooms and a bathroom no common area. The bathroom shower was disgusting. It had black mold around the caulking. The caulking was separated from the shower walls allowing water to go in and underneath the shower pan. The walls of the shower had built up soap scum. There was a rodent trap behind the toilet. The carpets were stained. There was no place to put a suitcase or dresser to store clothing. The location of the place is outstanding. But the cleanliness was unacceptable.

author: wontontraveller99
title: Beautiful b&b in the heart of Belgravia
text:
Excellent b&b in a beautiful neighborhood 
Checkin was easy 
Late checkout was provided free of charge 
Very short walk to Victoria station, and many shops and restaraunts 
Would 100% return

author: Mette
title: Mice in hotel room
text:
STAY AWAY!! 
While location is excellent, we had a terrible stay. Mice in the room. In the bed, in our suitcases, on the table. Needless to say we did not get a lot of sleep. 
On top of this, no reaction at all from management on this issue. 
Doors do not close tightly, so while you may believe we just had a bad room (#7) we saw them several times running out of our room below the door, and either into the kitchen or other rooms. 
Just stay away!

author: Yvonne N
title: Net positive
text:
Our experience was largely positive with with a huge shout out to Kalim. 
The rooms were beautifully appointed with unique features celebrating the Harlem location.
Operationally, the hotel seemed to struggle with their full capacity. Our room assignment occurred 2 to 3 hours after 4 PM and our room was not cleaned on a daily basis.
That said, the front desk team was calm and professional.

author: Barry S
title: Great Days in Harlem
text: Great stay. Third time at the Renaissance. Can't beat the location. Very convenient to transportation options as well as walkabity. Check in can get busy at times but the staff is very accommodating. Thumbs up to Jaziah at the reception desk. Discount vouchers are a welcome touch. The lobby bar and restaurant can be crowded but hang in there. It's a fun spot. And you can't beat the views if you can get a high floor room. Looking forward to my next visit.

author: Catone001
title: A nice stay at nyc
text: This hotel is brand new, the service are so nice, breakfast are delicious, salad Nichole and aamier are amazing , will be back!

author: Vacation11308380911
title: Outstanding Hospitality and Unbeatable Location!
text:
I absolutely loved my time here! The staff are incredible—so attentive and welcoming that they actually remembered me from my previous visit. A special shout-out to Kenday the bellhop, who was consistently patient, helpful, and kind throughout my stay. They also stored my luggage for free while waiting for my check-in time! 
Having stayed here twice, I can say the accommodations are great. My first room was perfectly comfortable with plenty of space to move around, while my second room was impressively spacious.
Don't miss the Victoria Restaurant! While it is on the pricier side, it is well worth it—the food tasted fantastic and the portion sizes were excellent. To top it all off, the location is unbeatable. You are steps away from everything: shops, street vendors, banks, subways, bus stops, and the iconic Apollo Theater. I will definitely be back!

author: Isaiah B
title: Good stay
text: The staff was helpful with ordering food and when my key stopped working. Rooms were nice!

author: eliane
title: WELL LOCATED, but....
text:
I have been to this hotel several times, which is very well located, near the subway, theaters, restaurants, and shops; 
The rooms are small, but comfortable and clean. Several times, the elevator was out of order....... I did not return because the prices had increased terribly after covid.

author: flavia
title: Very good
text:
Qualified and friendly staff, clean, tidy and comfortable rooms. Very quick check in and check out. Great location.
Recommended!!

author: lrpvinci
title: Excellent
text: Small b&b in Montmartre, small but comfortable and very central. The staff was friendly and helpful.

author: Jutta S
title: 3 days City
text: The hotel is super central.the staff are very friendly and very helpful.we were nicely received and the room on the 6 floor was also ok.great view,the breakfast as well as the coffee was fully adequate and it was delicious ,you can recommend very well

author: Ross
title: Excellent experience
text:
We just stayed at this small hotel in the 9 arr of Paris. The location is strategic, close to two metro stops, a short walk from rue de la fayette and Opera. A 15 min walk from the quaint Montmatre district. If you want you can walk to any site of interest.
Our room on the top floor was bright and spacious, maybe a little dated, but we were not there to spend the days in the room... anyway, despite being in the center, very quiet. Very comfortable beds.
Good breakfast.
The staff was very kind and helpful. A special mention to the nice Mr. Oliver who was able to give us valuable guidance.
I highly recommend this property

author: Cris S
title: Absolute ripoff
text:
I spent £250 staying at the dump. It was a very hot night in London and my hotel had no air conditioning. So I checked out and traveled across London to stay in the ‘fully air conditioned rooms’. I spent my £250 checked in, only to be told that ‘oh yea, sorry the air conditioning doesn’t work in that room. We can give you a fan!’. So I am sat here with a tiny window that opens into a well that contains all the working AC units, so any air that does make it in is baking hot.
So my advice is don’t believe anything anyone says about this hotel. The place is an absolute dump and they will scam you for every penny they can get.

author: Derek C
title: Won't stop there again
text:
Location brilliant for Buckingham Palace
Nice and friendly
Rooms are expensive 
Value 5 out 10
No restaurant for evening meal. You could order in and eat in the room where they serve breakfast
Breakfast is continental only, despite someone posting their omelettes were cooked to order.

author: Amy L
title: Good hotel if you're watching Wicked
text: A great little hotel l, just 5 minutes walk from Apollo Victoria (Wicked). Room was clean and perfectly usable for an overnight stay. Super shower! Breakfast was ok, continental with a few choices but perfectly adequate.  Friendly staff, would recommend for a cheap break in Theatre Land.

author: mminuscoli
title: Good hotel, privileged location
text: Good hotel, room is small but very comfortable. Breakfast good but simple, has the potential to improve guest experience. The best thing was the location that allowed us to make various travel with quite ease. My reservation was regarding the hygiene of the room because when I picked up a Lego from my son on the floor I was quite surprised by the amount of dust that was under the beds. I suggest you do a more thorough cleaning!

author: Johanna S
title: A good hotel
text: After we'd booked we read some reviews and as a result almost cancelled our booking. So glad we didnt. We asked for a top floor room - it was really quiet and a good room for the price. No complaints at all. It was a continental breakfast but quite a good variety. Would stay there again.

author: Abigail k
title: Very poor experience
text: First night we got there the shower had broken it took 50 minutes for someone to come up and check on it the whole thing had broken and fallen onto the ground after that we received not a single sorry or any sort of compensation we had to completely re pack and then in pack into a new room, staff are very unwelcoming to English speakers and generally will not want to serve you. The breakfast options are wide but when we had made our hot chocolate we had found maggots in the cup absolutely disgusting. Not sure how it’s 4 stars realistically Its a 2.5-3 star hotel.

author: Sanjay V
title: Great reception
text:
We stayed at this hotel for 3 nights from July 22 to July 25 2026.
Martina at the reception was very polite helping and nice
She explained everything 
Please appreciate and reward her 
Hard to find good people like her

author: MOeROB
title: Good value for money
text: The hotel is located in a very quiet area. We chose it because we were looking for a hotel with parking. Our room was comfortable and clean. The staff is kind. We recommend it.

author: Francesca11974
title: very kind staff and nice rooms
text: hotel with a lot of service staff, all very kind, we stayed in a deluxe room with a balcony, clean, spacious and with a nice, well-stocked bathroom, breakfast was a wonderful surprise, excellent coffee and cappuccino and a lot of choice, both sweet and savory (not always available in this category of hotels), also recommended for the location for those going to Luiss on Via Pola

author: Massimo F
title: Weekend in Rome
text: Very kind and qualified staff. Convenient location. Comfortable environment and excellent cleanliness. A special mention to the restaurant, which offered us exceptional raw materials and top-level cuisine.

author: Samantha A
title: Shocking - not the good kind.
text:
​Prospective guests should be extremely cautious before booking here.
​Our family stay was ruined by severe health and safety violations:
​Biological Hazard: Our room flooded with raw sewage (feces and urine) from the toilet, soaking into the carpet where my young children had to walk. No sanitization or footwear assistance was provided.
​Unauthorised Entry: Staff entered our locked room unannounced under the excuse of "refilling the minibar"— we stayed in two rooms and neither room had a mini bar so I am unsure how that is an excuse.
​Safety Risks: The replacement room offered to us contained chipped, broken glassware.
​Management will likely respond below by claiming they "addressed the situation" or offered loyalty points. 
Do not be misled: offering loyalty points for raw sewage and broken glass does not erase a severe public health hazard. Furthermore, the booking platform has already acknowledged the severity of these issues in writing and issued a cash refund directly from their own pocket due to the hotel’s refusal to take responsibility.
​The health, safety, and security of your family are not worth risking at this property.

author: Minel P
title: parking is terrible
text: we booked for 1 night at this hotel, the rooms weren’t that bad but they were tiny, the staff are terrible we were in the parking garage because we had a boat trip to get to and we were late because the garage door wouldn’t open, we told them we were late to our boat trip because the door wasn’t opening and they said we had to pay at the reception so we ran to the reception and they gave us 3 tickets the tickets did not work and we kept complaining after all that time of waiting they opened the door and we missed our boat trip because they apparently couldn’t open it earlier.

author: Teni A
title: Valuable belongings disappeared from our room and the hotel’s response was appalling
text:
My three friends and I checked into Novotel Paris 17 on 19 June. Our initial check-in was pleasant, but the rest of our experience was extremely concerning and disappointing.

One of my friends had brought a very expensive pair of shoes with her. She did not wear them on the evening we arrived, the following day or on the Sunday. On the second day of our stay, we left the hotel at around 2pm. When we later returned, we were told that our room could not be cleaned because the housekeeping staff had already finished for the day.

The following morning, when my friend went to wear the shoes, we realised they were no longer in the room. We searched everywhere, turned the room upside down and checked every bag, cupboard and possible location, but they had disappeared.

We immediately reported this to reception and asked the hotel to investigate who had entered our room. The electronic door records showed that the housekeeping manager had accessed our room after we left at around 2pm.

The hotel later claimed that CCTV showed the housekeeping manager briefly opening the door and looking inside to check whether the room had been cleaned. This explanation made no sense to us because the room was not cleaned afterwards. We could not understand why an occupied guest room needed to be accessed simply to look inside, especially when we had been told that housekeeping had already finished.

When we explained the situation to the front-desk staff, they were rude, blunt, discouraging and completely unsympathetic. Instead of showing concern or reassuring us that the matter would be properly investigated, they blamed us for not putting the shoes in the safe. A pair of shoes would not reasonably fit inside a hotel safe, and guests should not be made to feel responsible when belongings disappear from a room that hotel staff have accessed.

The disappearance of our belongings was serious enough, but the rude and dismissive attitude of the front-desk staff made the situation even worse. We were treated as though we were at fault rather than guests reporting missing property from a room that hotel staff had accessed.

Despite the hotel confirming that a member of housekeeping management had entered our room, there appeared to be no serious or transparent investigation. There was no meaningful search for the shoes, no clear explanation and no practical support. We were simply told to report the matter to the police.

Unfortunately, the police were not very helpful, partly because of the language barrier, and appeared only to file the report.

After returning to our home country, I also discovered that my leather card holder was missing. It contained all of my bank cards, loyalty cards and membership cards. My ID was the only item not inside because I had removed it before going out.

We have since contacted customer service and escalated the matter to senior management, but we have received no satisfactory resolution or meaningful support.

I cannot personally prove who removed the missing belongings. However, the facts are that valuable items disappeared from our room, the hotel’s own records confirmed that a member of housekeeping management entered while we were away, and the hotel failed to conduct what we considered to be a proper investigation.

author: 719herfm
title: Just go to another hotel
text:
Value - Too expensive for what is offered. It is not a 4 stars at all (most likely 2 stars). No fridge in the room.
Room - not clean enough / strange smell
Service - It was OK during the check in. At night my key was not working and the person in the reception was rude. Missing towels.
Noise Level - the sound from the rooms can be listened outside (dog barking, kids playing). For me it is not a problem, but it might be for less tolerant people.

author: meganeh91
title: Once again very good!
text:
We stayed for the second time in this hotel, accustomed to the Accor chain, it is one of the best located to access the center of Paris by car with a parking lot large enough to accommodate our Espace. Room on the 3rd floor, well soundproofed and well air-conditioned. 
Decent breakfast but not transcendent for the price! 
Big plus, the fresh water fountains on each floor available for free. 
We will certainly return for our next Parisian stay.

author: Safari15784148395
title: They tend to overcharge you with "deposit"
text:
Well I have booked from Hotels.com seeing their 4.1 rating there, but I should have checked google reviews honestly.
Beware, they will charge you an upfront 100 pounds as a "deposit", and they may afterwards charge you for ludicrous staff.
I have been to many hotels and this is the first time I was charged 20 for a hand towel that had some stains on it and "rendered unusuable" (which was some residue from hair dye). This is at the very least bad practice, and at worst malicious intent. And I would say management was quite rude in subsequent correspondence.
You can see many past reviews that they are quite problematic in this "deposit" part, so travelers beware.

author: GoPlaces65703425672
title: Bad hotel
text: The price at the hotel was tempting. We arrived at the hotel and the lobby was very small. They let us wait until the evening without a room. When we entered the room, we realized that we were wrong. There was no place to put the suitcase. There was no place to move. The employees there entered the rooms and stole things, took pictures and said that we had caused damage, and then charged money from the credit card after weeks of vacation. A hotel of thieves.

author: RAEMIRO
title: Very small room, smaller q cheap cabin
text: Minimum room really minimum bathroom infamous had to enter one to exit another. Skylight ceiling impossible to sleep from the light. Too bad.

author: Tome M
title: Decent Hotel in a Good Location
text:
The hotel is in a nice location, and our room was clean and tidy. However, it was located in the semi-basement, which made the surroundings less pleasant and not quite what we expected.

Overall, it's a regular hotel — okay for a short stay, but we would have preferred a room on a higher floor.

author: Pedro A
title: OXFORD HOTEL - Accidental reservation.
text:
In an accidental manner, a reservation has been made through Revolut which intends to verify how the point system functions. Immediately, cancel the system without permission. Contacted with Revolut to request the cancellation and indicate that I am not concerned because the error will be understandable and that contacting the company to inform you of the cancellation and the response will be negative. Before this situation was contacted with the company directly explaining the reasons for disclaiming and practically refusing the cancellation of the reservation, it was not difficult to contest it. If you wish to receive a new email informing you that you will create a negative result from the hotel, if you respond, you will be notified of the creation of false results.

Disconnect the service simply by asking me with my dinner for a trip that we do not intend to organize, so that we cannot travel and leave.

All this is certain and demonstrable, therefore, I have a negative valuation of the hotel and I recommend that we do not stay in the hotel, but we can have an idea of ​​inflexibility in a situation as I imagine that it will actuate in other ways.

author: Sylvain M
title: ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ An Excellent Stay – We Would Definitely Return!
text:
We had a wonderful stay at the André Latin Hotel. From the moment we arrived, we were welcomed with warmth and professionalism. The front desk staff are exceptionally kind and always willing to help. A special thank you to Joël and his daytime colleague, whose outstanding hospitality made our stay even more enjoyable.

As Canadians visiting Paris during the heatwave, we especially appreciated the air conditioning. Unlike many European hotels, it was powerful enough to keep the room very cool, and we loved being able to adjust the temperature ourselves. After a long day of walking in the Paris heat, it was a real luxury!

Our room was a comfortable size, very clean, and we never had any issues with hot water. Everything worked perfectly throughout our stay.

The only minor suggestion would be to add a little more variety to the breakfast. The food was fresh, tasty, and of good quality, but a wider selection would be appreciated, especially for guests staying several days.

The location is also excellent, just a short walk from the Luxembourg Gardens and in a wonderful neighborhood that's easy to explore on foot.

Thank you to the entire team for making our stay so enjoyable. We highly recommend the André Latin Hotel and will gladly stay here again on our next visit to Paris.

author: Lorenzo
title: Hotel Andre Latin
text: Hotel in a very convenient area of Paris, well connected especially to the RER and buses, and lively, full of restaurants and young people. The staff was very kind, especially all the guys at the reception. The room is very well-kept, with all the essentials. The breakfast is complete and satisfies everyone. An experience to repeat.

author: UrbanTeacher
title: Nice hotel, small rooms, in a great location in the 5th
text: I really liked this hotel. It was in a great location in the 5th, about a five minute walk from both the Luxembourg Gardens and the RER B (convenient for both airports), 10 minutes from the Pantheon, and about a 15-20 minute walk from Boulevard St-Germaine, and the fabulous Cluny Museum. The front desk staff were very friendly and helpful. The air conditioning in the room was good, which was important since I had a room on the 6th (top) floor. I'm only giving this hotel a 4 out of 5 (I'd give 4.5 if I could) because the rooms are very small, which isn't generally a problem for me, since I'm not a big person, but might be if you are tall. The bathroom was nice but very narrow, which means it might be a challenge for someone with long legs to use the toilet. I don't know if other rooms have larger bathrooms. Other than that, the room was comfortable. There were also a lot of restaurants/cafes nearby, so it was easy to find a local place to eat. I don't have an opinion about the breakfast since I didn't purchase it, as there were many cafes nearby.

author: Nutnut1976
title: Great hotel
text: 3 Night stay in July 26 for my 50th, daughters 21st and 18th birthdays. Great hotel, location zone 1. Our room had 3 single beds very comfortable. Ballon’s with champagne and macarons welcome. Lovely touch. Air conditioning in the room.  Very nice area. The staff are fantastic dry helpful and friendly. Would return again. Our room 559 x

author: scarboroughgirl123
title: Good for a city break
text:
We stayed in March as a couple. The hotel is about 10 mins from the metro so good to access the landmarks of Paris.
Breakfast was nice but in a small basement. The rooms overall were small and we found them to be very hot. Also I think we were unlucky that building work across the road was incredibly loud so meant we couldn’t open the doors.

author: SheisS65
title: Please do not book this hotel during hot weather (summer months), as no adequate aircon
text: This is a really nice small hotel well located very near Kings Cross. I stayed in a small double room, with the following facilities: hairdryer, two shelves - one with tea/coffee facilities, safe, large under bed space for luggage, wall mounted bed lights, extra blankets, openable window, nice clean shower room with lovely soap and shower gel, and a great shower, with removable shower head, and space for shampoo etc, shaver sockets, heated towel rail. However, the shelves didn't really provide much room, the sink also had little space for anything but toothpaste and a toothbrush, there was a traditional key that you had to hand in each time you left the building (!), you had to knock on the door to be kept in in the evening (!), and my room was up some narrow winding stairs. But the worst part was (and this is the reason for my rating): I understand that this is unusual, but I arrived in the middle of a heatwave in London - temp around 30 degrees every day. Even with heavy curtains blocking the window, and a rotating wall fan, the room was just too hot, and my level of comfort during my stay was virtually zero. I maybe slept for a couple of hours in a row interrupted by wakening due to the heat each night. It was pretty exhausting. A rotating fan is totally inadequate for this temperature. I ended up having to dampen a couple of towels to lie on during the night, couldn't even wear my short jammies! What's worse is that I was there to attend two concerts at Tottenham Hotspur stadium that required a lengthy walk to the underground station after a very long day queuing in the heat, both nights, and the thing I really needed was some good sleep. I would not book a room here during summer months again, given climate predictions. If you're used to that level of heat, then go ahead, but I imagine that most people who live in hot countries who can afford a trip to London are probably used to nice cold Aircon! My advice is that if you are staying in London during June, July, or August, only book a hotel with proper Aircon. Even if you have to pay a lot more. If not, you'll just be exhausted, having had no proper sleep for the length of your stay. I'm sorry to have to give this review, because the price was reasonable for the location, staff were friendly and helpful, and the room would have been fine in any other weather conditions.

author: Giovanni
title: I will be back
text:
The ideal solution for short stays in London.
Cleanliness and order in the rooms, reception always available to guests.
Various solutions regarding means of transport: trains, buses, and the subway.
Highly recommended.

author: Veronique M
title: Hotel very well located
text: Hotel near the Eurostar station. Subway and bus stations. Quiet friendly staff. Very clean room. The downside is the bathroom is very small no small shelf to put toiletries that is what is missing in the bathroom. Very comfortable bedding. I will return to this establishment if I come back to London

author: Jill B
title: Convénient for Kings X and St Pancras
text:
Small room, small 4 ft 6 bed up against 1 wall . Slightly below Street level, no lift 
,down steep stairs but young reception staff were very helpful . Fortunately it was cool in the basement and a window with a fan light that opened. Clean and fine for 1 night. No breakfast but plenty of choice nearby and at the stations. Reasonable price for London.

author: Stephen Matthews
title: Great stop for travellers
text: Picked this hotel for its proximity to Kings Cross/St Pancras - just a few minutes’ walk. Perfectly good for a two-night stay. Room was up 30-plus stairs - no lift and a task with a suitcase, but desk staff offered to help. Staff were great generally. The room was small and had a single bed, which was all I needed. There are spaces where you can slide bags etc to keep floor clear. The ensuite was modern and did the job. The free daily cookie was welcome, and the complimentary bottles of still and fizzy water were a godsend as the temperature passed 34C. The cooling was by fan, which helped but struggled with the heat. It’s a very busy part of town so expect noise from outside if you’re facing the road, or if Arsenal have just won the league. Was very grateful to be able to leave my luggage in storage after checking out. Recommended as a stopover for travellers.

author: Cheltenham Camper
title: Brilliant Hotel
text:
Spent three nights here with my daughter. The hotel was really easy to get to from the Gare du Nord, just a 10 minute walk. The staff were so friendly and welcoming when we arrived and throughout our stay. The room was spotlessly clean, the en suite was modern and the beds comfortable. 
We loved the courtyard garden and the fact it was so close a metro. It made getting to the Louvre, Pont Neuf and Montmatre really easy. 
The area the hotel is in, is a little run down and the view from the window wasn't the most picturesque but we would definitely stay there again.

author: Denis C
title: very good stay
text: Excellent breakfast, located right next to the subway station that goes to the center of Paris and close to the Gare de l'Est

author: Dermot B
title: Good enough tourist hotel near Gare du Nord.
text: Fairly decent, if basic, tourist hotel with decent transport links a short walk from Gare du Nord. Think Premier inn or Travelodge. Aircon in rooms actually works, and although not cold enough safety a hot day out it meant sleep was OK. Breakfast not worth the money, and rooms are small with minimal furnishings. Good as an inexpensive tourist hotel though. Bonus: authentically surly Parisienne desk staff!

author: andre m
title: Clean hotel, great service, and very well located.
text:
Quiet hotel, very well-insulated rooms, excellent bedding, and friendly staff.
Close to the Gare du Nord and Gare de l'Est, and 30 meters from the Louis Blanc metro station.

author: askin e
title: Great for short break
text: This is a lovely clean comfortable hotel. Excellent a/c Paris was hot, nice breakfast room with outside terrace. Convient for eurostar 10 min walk. Excellent value. Used metro nearby and  bus to city centre, as walking in area was not pleasant.

author: Charlotte W
title: Wouldnt stay here again
text:
We were extremely dissapointed woth the hotel, the pictures make it look beautiful, but when you actually see the rooms they are very old, tired and dated.

The first room we were given we went down to reception to complain and was given another room but again, very dated.

Bathroom is tiny, you can barely get in the bathroom and close the door to use the toilet.
The double bed was hard

Location okish

Breakfast, don't waste your money. We paid for breakfast but ended up eating out on the second day.

I requested a refund for the boat cruise tickets and was told to email and i will receive a refund. I have emailed 3 times and been ignored each time. 

So so disappointed

author: 911bethb
title: Good trip, stayed 10 days
text: Hotel met our expectations! A/C worked great, no problems with internet. Family of 3 adults. Transportation from Nord du Gare was easy. Staff was friendly. Shower head was not tight, but could hold it just fine. We did not do the breakfast, plenty of boulangeries to choose from. We used #4 metro the most to get around Paris and occasionally #7 a 10 minute walk.

author: Gabriela G
title: Unsanitary bathroom conditions
text:
We stayed at Avalon Hotel Paris Gare du Nord for one night after having a great experience at Avalon Cosy Hotel earlier in our trip. Unfortunately, this stay was a huge disappointment.

After my husband showered, we discovered the shower drain was severely clogged. Water pooled in the shower and eventually drained, bringing up black debris, hair, and other unsanitary material. Every time we used the bathroom sink, dirty water backed up into the shower again. It was clearly a maintenance issue that should have been caught before the room was rented.

The front desk staff were polite and genuinely tried to help. A staff member attempted to fix the drain, but the problem remained. We were told no comparable rooms were available, and the only alternative was for me to use the shower in a different room.

What disappointed us most was the lack of response afterward. I emailed management with photos and videos documenting the issue and even followed up weeks later, but never received any acknowledgment.

It's unfortunate because we had such a positive experience at Avalon Cosy Hotel. The front desk staff deserve credit, but the condition of the room and the complete lack of follow-up from management left a very poor impression.

author: Catherine T
title: It was okay.
text:
It was okay!
What was really good was that the room, although it was in the attic, had a functioning air conditioning unit.
This was very helpful given the outside temperature of 113°F.
10 € for breakfast was not worth it.... Getting such hard baguette in the middle of Paris is quite an achievement!
The location is perfect for train travelers.

author: cocolatte76
title: HORRENDOUS
text:
Absolutely horrible hotel. SO BAD I LEFT and found somewhere else to stay.  Lobby and front desk were filthy. Lobby floor had several broken tiles and vending was empty. The front desk person did not know how to make an additional key. 
Not a great first impression. The room was no better, extremely small. The shower had mold in it and dripped water. I could not get hot water. I wish I took more pictures. This place needs to be condemned not taking peoples money and calling it a hotel. STAY AWAY!!!

author: Sisuke
title: Located in the charming Marais...
text: We spent three nights at the "Aida" hotel, located on a quiet street. The room is a bit small and angular, but equipped with air conditioning and clean. Very pleasing for a three-star hotel: there is body lotion!  The breakfast is okay. The ladies and gentlemen at the front desk were very friendly and helpful (tips for dinner).

author: allybeeLancaster
title: Avoid the poky rooms at the back. Good hotel otherwise
text: Mixed experience here, booked a superior double via Booking.com. Arrived to find we were in room 11 which is more like a cupboard, the roof was sloping and the bathroom so small I had to sit on the loo sideways! I complained to reception and the guy told me “ all the rooms are superior “. He did however try to move us but the rooms were all fully booked. He arranged to move us the next day but we had to pack all our things and put them in left luggage. author: Lloyd R

Wonderful staff. Spacious rooms, nice and cool. Beautiful courtyard for breakfast.

author: Lene A

author: carla1974

Very clean.

Correct price / quality.

author: judi&vic
title: Glad we stayed here!

Outstanding breakfast! The most extensive hot and cold choices of any hotel we’ve stayed in and not just in Italy. It was delicious. We also really appreciated breakfast being available until 11:00. author: DrFrank1996
title: Great hotel with great location

author: FSE
title: Excellent Location, Spacious Room and a Very Comfortable Family Stay
text:
We especially loved the location of the hotel. It is excellent for exploring London, with very good connections by Tube and bus and easy access to many of the main attractions.
Coming from Dubai, we already know and appreciate the Taj brand. The hospitality was as expected — perhaps not extraordinary, but certainly professional and with nothing negative to point out.
Our room was probably the strongest part of the stay. We were travelling as a family of three with our 14-year-old son, and the room was more than spacious enough, with a generous entrance area, a good-sized and well-equipped bathroom, and all the amenities we needed. Even the water pressure was surprisingly good considering the age of the building. The extra bed provided for our son was also very comfortable, which is not always the case in hotels.
Our room faced the courtyard, which we really enjoyed. It provided a peaceful escape from the noise and bustle of the city and made the room feel particularly calm.
Overall, we were very happy with our stay and would comfortably recommend the hotel to both families and couples. One small observation for international travelers is that a large proportion of the guests during our stay appeared to be from India, which also reflects the strong recognition of the Taj brand among Indian travelers.

author: Rachel M
title: Disappointing experience and poor follow-up from management
text:
We were really looking forward to our stay at St. James’ Court, particularly given the reputation of the Taj brand and the price we paid, but unfortunately our experience fell well below expectations.

I booked and paid for an Executive Family Room for two adults and two children. Upon arrival, we were instead given a Superior Master Suite with only one king bed. We were told that two cots — not actual beds — would be brought to the room for our children. Despite repeated calls and speaking with management, it took more than four hours just to have the two cots delivered. After an overnight flight, our children were exhausted, yet they were unable to properly settle into the room until late that evening.

The hotel offered complimentary breakfast following the issue, but only after I prompted them and asked what could be done to make up for the situation. However, we never actually used the breakfast because our children were so exhausted from being up late the night before that they slept in and missed breakfast.

The hotel also comped £68 from our restaurant bill that evening. To be clear, this was not a complimentary dinner for our family — the £68 covered two drinks and two desserts. While we appreciated the gesture, this did not feel like adequate compensation for receiving a different room than the one we booked and then waiting more than four hours for two cots, rather than actual beds, for our children.

At checkout, I again asked what could be done and was told by the manager on duty that he would get back to me. I later received an email pointing to the breakfast offer and the £68 restaurant credit as the compensation provided. I responded explaining that we had never actually used the breakfast and asked that a portion of our room charge be refunded instead.

I also specifically asked for the matter to be escalated to management. No one responded.

That lack of follow-up was ultimately one of the most disappointing parts of the experience. Mistakes happen, even at luxury hotels. But when a guest pays for a particular family room category, does not receive it, is instead given a room with one king bed and two cots for the children, waits more than four hours for those cots to arrive, and then repeatedly gives the hotel an opportunity to resolve the situation, I would expect management at a Taj property to take the concern seriously and at the very least respond.

The hotel itself is beautiful and the location is excellent, but the service recovery and lack of response from management were not what I would expect from a luxury hotel at this price point.

author: Jots14

text:
I don’t even know where to begin with this hotel. It was my second time at this hotel and it didn’t disappoint. The Taj in London is just spectacular, our stay from start to finish was such a beautiful experience. It is a piece of luxury, hidden in central London - we could have been anywhere in the world but we wouldn’t know as the hotel was just a dream! The room standard was just impeccable and a great view of the courtyard.
Every member of staff we encountered were attentive and helpful nothing was too big or small for them. This stay has created wonderful memories for my family and I. Apologies I didn’t get everyone’s names, but thank you to everyone and a shout out to the gentleman in the concierge who was super helpful. We can’t wait to visit again.

author: adam
title: Excellent hotel with hidden gem of a courtyard

author: ruthroddam
title: Vet good indeed , great value , far better than an Overpriced Travelodge .
text:
Excellent location for Visiting Buckingham palace etc.
All the Team were very good.
Rooms very well appointed.
