author: dieseldope
title: Great hotel for cyclists in center of London
text: We came for a one night stay without reservation, after cycling a whole day.  We received a warm welcome and the manager told us that if we made the booking on line, we could benefit from a cheaper rate (instead of having the hotel complete the booking).  So that was really appreciated, it saved us money for a lots of beers!  We could store our bicycles at our room or at the luggage room.  Service was excellent, room was clean, shower refreshing, bed was nice so had a good sleep and breakfast was great. We were ready for another day of cycling!

author: Anna M
title: Lovely stay
text:
Good morning,

This was our second time staying at this hotel, and just like the first time, it was great. Everyone was very welcoming and friendly, and always happy to help.

I was celebrating my 40th birthday with my girlfriends, and we were offered complimentary breakfast, which was a lovely touch.

We will definitely be coming back again!

author: Dawn A
title: Our favourite premier inn
text: We had a really enjoyable stay at the Premier Inn. The room was clean and comfortable, with a lovely comfy bed and a really good shower. The staff were friendly and welcoming, and the food was also very nice. Overall, a great stay and we would happily return.

author: DevonMan
title: Perfect stay near Fleet Street
text: I received the warmest of welcomes at Reception, and when I explained that I had a change of circumstances, he and a lady who joined him were most helpful, and I felt they genuinely cared. The room was spotlessly clean, very quiet and very comfortable. The hotel is located just off Fleet Street, close to bus stops and Blackfriars Underground. I was very lucky with a scratchcard I was given, as it was for 50% off main courses at dinner, so I made use of it. I had chicken makhani curry, with rice, poppadom and mango chutney, and it was delicious. There was a small technical issue which meant there was a lull during dinner when there was noone available to order dessert, but sometimes these things happen - it wasn't a huge problem for me. Full breakfast was included in my deal, and there was a choice of full English, cereals, croissants, yoghurts, fruit, various hot and cold drinks/juices... It was all fresh and delicious. I would definitely stay in this hotel again.

author: Connector15364954433
title: Broken mirror not by us!
text: We stayed in this rundown hotel, as it calls itself. The room was small and the air conditioning was noisy. But what really upset us was that they kept our $100 deposit, blaming us for breaking the mirror, which was absolutely not our fault. The staff was not at all courteous; no matter what we asked, they didn't respond politely. The breakfast wasn't plentiful; the tables were few and dirty, and often occupied. The morning we left, we asked if they could pack us a bag of breakfast, since we have a young child, but they refused. I wouldn't recommend it to anyone, even though the location is good.

author: Nicolo
title: Strategic hotel
text: Quiet hotel conveniently located close to walk to Time Square and surrounded by quiet places to eat, basic clean hotel, clean rooms, normal breakfast nothing exaggerated but normal nutritious and good , friendly and courteous staff

author: Boy_Scout
title: You Get What You Pay For
text: The hotel is priced below most hotels in NYC.  There are reasons for this.  It’s about 3/4 mile to the theater district; the rooms are very small and it’s definitely “no frills”.  That being said, if you’re just sleeping there and don’t mind the walk (or taxi ride) to get to where you’re going it’s an OK choice. The staff was friendly and helpful; the breakfast was just what you would expect from Comfort Inn, and we felt safe, even walking back from the theater at night.

author: Michael P
title: Unacceptable Experience at Comfort Inn Midtown
text:
I rarely write reviews, but my recent stay at your Midtown location compels me to be brutally honest: this was one of the worst hotel experiences I’ve ever had.

The Wi-Fi was a complete nightmare—slower than DSL, intermittent, and completely unreliable. Two public networks were available, neither functional: one (“Comfort_Inn”) promised connectivity but failed to reliably log in, and the other (“Wireless”) barely registered at all. For a hotel in the heart of New York City, this is absurd and unacceptable.

The staff’s behavior, however, was the most egregious part of my stay. I was subjected to a litany of unprofessional, petty, and legally questionable behavior, including:

Unjustified demands to enter my room: Staff repeatedly tried to gain access without valid reason and refused to provide details in writing, turning a simple stay into a stressful ordeal.

Harassment over my service dog: Staff insisted on seeing physical certification or a vest, despite ADA laws clearly stating this is not required. They attempted to intimidate me, citing a “no pets” policy that has no legal standing for service animals.

Dismissiveness and outright rudeness: Every attempt to address the situation calmly was met with condescension, ignorance, and petty power plays. Staff seemed more interested in asserting authority than actually serving guests.

General incompetence: Between the Wi-Fi issues and the staff’s unprofessionalism, it felt like the hotel actively worked against providing a basic level of service.

This experience was not only frustrating but also made me feel unsafe and disrespected. A hotel’s responsibility is to provide a secure, welcoming environment for paying guests—not to create unnecessary drama, violate guest rights, or showcase ignorance of fundamental accessibility laws.

I strongly urge management to seriously address these failures. Training, accountability, and a thorough review of policies regarding guest rights, accessibility, and professional conduct are essential. Guests should never leave a hotel feeling belittled, harassed, or disregarded, as I did during my stay.

author: Roam08015208904
title: This hotel was disgusting! Booking photos were lies!
text: This hotel was disgusting, unclean and dilapidated. I was moved once and neither room matched the booking photos. My first room had no working lights and a dead phone. I had to call the front desk from my cell and ask to be moved. The second room had visibly dirty carpet and sticky bathroom floors. The booking photos showed a stall shower and these rooms had tubs. Stall showers are important for a mobility impaired person like me and the tub wasn't even clean. When I moved,  I left a bag in the first room. Your front desk staffer wouldn't go with me to look for it so I had to wait for the shift change to get one of your employees to care. I have never seen such terrible service and unfit facilities. Your company should be ashamed of itself. This dump shouldn't share a brand name and no customer should be treated like I was. This was FRAUD!

author: Go30681748921
title: Too hot
text: Too hot, too hot, too hot. Gets way too hot, only 19C outside but outside it is boiling.

author: Denise S
title: Great location!
text: We stayed here for two nights and although the room was hot we had a great stay! The room was clean, the bed was comfy and it was a good location. Breakfast was tasty especially the hash browns and eggs!  A great location if you’re off to Wembley to watch a concert.

author: Tony T
title: Great service

author: MRnickee J

author: Harry W

I completed a survey and asked that you call me. I did provide some specific information in my survey but not every item was addressed because of character limits. I called today and you were not available, so I am emailing you information about my stay on June 17, 2026.
I had 2 rooms. The confirmation #'s were: ******* and  *****
1. I waited in line for 42 minutes to check in. This was unacceptable. There was no customer service skills. There was not a Hello, welcome, sorry for the wait-nothing!
2. I had requested 2 rooms next to or near each other since we were with my 89 yo mother who requires assistance. We did not even get rooms on the same floor.
3. I went to the room that I was given the keys for. I opened the first room only to find it occupied. THIS IS NOT ACCEPTABLE.

9. I wanted to take a shower. I could not figure out how to use the shower. There were not any directions in our bathroom. I called the front desk several times so they could tell me how to use the shower. No one answered.  One of the calls I was on hold for 45 minutes. When a staff person walks into an elevator with you, they should at least say "Hello", "Good evening", "Good morning". This did not happen There were not any smiles or nods. There were housekeepers, maintenance workers, housekeeping supervisor who came into elevators who did not say "good morning" after we said it to them.

Unfortunately, this was probably one of the worst hotel experiences I have had.

RZH

author: Asem G
title: STAR – BE VERY CAREFUL WITH YOUR CREDIT CARD
text:
⭐️ 1 STAR – BE VERY CAREFUL WITH YOUR CREDIT CARD

I strongly recommend that travelers think twice before staying at this hotel.

I had already paid for my reservation through Expedia. At check-in, the hotel asked for my credit card for a security deposit/incidental authorization, which I understood would be released after check-out.

Instead, my credit card was actually charged.

After I contacted Expedia and the hotel, I was told that the refund would be processed. Expedia even confirmed in writing that the hotel’s front office supervisor would process the refund and that I should receive the money within 3–7 business days.

More than 15 days later, I still have not received my money.

I provided the requested bank/credit card documentation to Expedia, and I have continued to cooperate with every request. I was even asked for a separate hotel receipt that was never provided to me.

The most frustrating part is that I have documentation showing the charge, documentation showing that the reservation was already paid through Expedia, and written communication confirming that a refund was supposed to be processed.

This is not about a small inconvenience. This is about taking money from a customer’s credit card and then making the customer spend weeks trying to get it back.

If you are staying here, PLEASE check your credit card statement carefully after checkout and make sure that any security deposit or incidental charge is actually released.

I hope the hotel finally does the right thing and returns my money. Until then, based on my personal experience, I cannot recommend this hotel.

Travelers deserve transparency, honesty, and their money back when they are owed a refu

Another major issue was the cleanliness. There were a noticeable amount of flies in the front desk and dining area, which was very off-putting. The breakfast was also underwhelming—mostly reheated items like sausage, biscuits, bagels, yogurt, and oatmeal, with nothing particularly fresh or appealing.

The room itself was very small. While it looked clean at first glance, the carpeted floors throughout the property were dirty. Noise was also a big problem; you could clearly hear doors slamming in the mornings from guests and housekeeping, and there is a club across the street that plays loud music all night.

Even the window shades did very little to block out light, making it difficult to get a good night’s sleep. Overall, this stay did not meet expectations, and I would not recommend it for anyone looking for rest or comfort.

author: Traveler C
title: Warm and Professional Hospitality
text:
First time staying at Le Méridien New York, Central Park while in the city to collaborate with my colleagues for work. What really stood out to me at this property was the A++ customer service.

From the moment I arrived, Ricardo greeted me right away and assisted with my bags. This was followed by a very warm and genuine welcome from Melissa at the front desk, who gave me an intro to the property and promptly checked me in. The entire process was smooth and pleasant.

Having traveled to New York frequently for work since 2022, I especially appreciate some peace and quiet in the evenings, something I’m used to back home in California. The hotel was very accommodating with this request, which I really appreciated especially after a long workday.

Brian at the front desk and Asimina from the concierge team were also very warm and courteous, and always happy to offer their assistance to guests whenever needed - they are true professionals. I also want to recognize the GM, Mr. Scarpa, who took time out of his busy schedule to personally reach out and make sure everything was alright. The GM’s gesture was sincere and attentive, and it was clear that he and his team cares about the guests staying at the property.

I stayed in a one-bedroom suite overlooking part of Central Park. The room has an interesting mix of traditional and modern European design elements, with separate living and bedroom areas divided by a sliding door. For me, this worked m well — I could take virtual calls in the living area and still have a separate space to rest and unwind.

Overall, a very pleasant first stay. I would highly recommend this property for both work as well as leisure travel, and most importantly, thank you to Ricardo, Melissa, Brian, Asimina, Mr. Scarpa, as well as Director Jeremy, Carlos and Eduardo and the rest of the team for the warm and professional hospitality.

author: J C
title: Not a luxury experience!
text:
Long story short, this hotel is not luxury. 

Prior to arriving they reach out and ask how they can make your stay special, if you're celebrating anything, or need anything to make your stay better. I told them my reason for visiting and upon arrival, there was nothing done or special to acknowledge my visit. For reference, when I stayed at The Ritz and they asked the same thing, they gave me the most thoughtful welcome gift related to my reason for visiting. 

The Classic King Guest Room is okay. There was no luggage rack or additional space to elevate your luggage beside the desk. So if you're more than 1 person in this room, space can be challenging. 

I asked someone at the front desk if they had a hair tie. At other Marriott properties, I could have sworn you could request a hair kit similar to a dental kit. The front desk lady smirked and said no we don't have hair ties. 

For an establishment that made it a point to ask prior to visiting what they could do to make my stay better, there was NO sense of hospitality. She couldn't even make a recommendation to visit the Duane Reade on the same street to help problem solve. Again, no above and beyond service, not luxury! For the price paid, the least I could expect is solution orientated front desk assistance. 

The food at the property is okay. The views are minimal. 

The location is the only reason I gave it three stars, otherwise it'd be 2.5. The hotel is walking distance to Central Park, a Pure Barre class I took, the train, and an accessible bus. However, the location is not enough to have be stay at the property again.

author: explore_10021
title: Zero benefit for Titanium members
text:
It was OK.  I stayed here for 10 nights as I was visiting family and friends (used points). PROS: Excellent location, friendly cleaning staff and the French restaurant is nice.  CONS: There is zero benefit as a Titanium member (they got excited telling me I’d earn 1K points for my whole stay); There is a 45 usd  per day destination fee which wasn’t useful to me (some days I’d just buy a 6 dollar coffee and tipped 15 just to use the daily 25 food spend portion); I had to ask several times to change my room from back facing no view (finally got a front facing with broken A/C - even the maintenance guy told me to change rooms again). 

In a nutshell, I struggled to see the “luxury”.  My friends stayed at another hotel around the corner (AKA hotel) and it was cheaper, bigger room, and they just randomly found it online.

author: Downdown_D
title: Booked a Terrace. Received a Safety Hazard and Two Towels.
text:
Ah Marriott......Where the Promise Ends at the Reservation Confirmation.

I did not receive the room type that I booked. It was beyond obvious there was something happening when the agent left the desk to go talk to someone at check in. My "terrace" was above the terrace room that I booked. It was a fraction of the size with two beat up dirty chairs and weeds growing everywhere.

To access the "terrace" requires an awkward step in and out of a door that doesn't stay open. So if you aren't careful, the door could push you and cause you to lose balance traversing the doorway.

The room itself needs so many repairs. The desk looks like it was glued back together. There are scuff marks on the ceiling as a guest clearly attempted to store their luggage on top of the closet/wardrobe. The wood in the room is badly beaten. The safe won't stay open and slams shut. It makes putting items in and taking items out a risk of losing a finger. The difficult-to-turn shower head? The leaky shower that flooded the floor.....

A Masterclass in How Not to Design a Hotel Room....

Design wise this place is atrocious. Yes, Manhattan hotel rooms are small, but they can be well thought out to maximize space in a shoebox. Whoever designed this place clearly has never travelled before or simply hates hotels and the people that use them. They must think every guest is over 6 feet tall as you have to be a giant to use the vanity mirror in the bathroom. And everyone enjoys taking a shower in order to turn on the shower. I feel very bad for the housekeepers who have to deal with the shower set up every day.

Bonvoy Status: Thanks for Your Loyalty, Here's Two Towels...........

2 TOWELS! 2 TOWELS?

When we arrived, 2 bath towels, 2 hand towels and a floor mat. Laundry doesn't cost that much. Is that really where management thinks the cost savings are located or your nod to being environmentally conscious? Your hotel already has an environmental grade of C, less towels aren't going to raise that grade. Have you done the math on how much staff time and energy it costs to bring towels throughout the hotel when all the guests order more towels?

How much time is it worth to your guests? That time spent waiting is intangible and how arrogant of you as a hotel operator to not think how much this detail matters.

Where Marriott Loyalty Goes to Die......

Bonvoy status or the fact that I reside in a Marriott managed property means absolutely nothing and went unrecognized. There was too much emphasis on if they could pull off the bait and switch on the room type.

So I ask you this.....if you aren't going to recognize my loyalty, why should I continue to be loyal to a brand who does not care about its guests or their experience?

The restaurant outlets do make great cocktails.

author: Abbie
title: Great budget option if happy to travel into Rome.
text:

The rooms were newly renovated and clean. Lacking in a USB port. One room had a massive walk in shower but my room was a small bath with a hand shower and no way of attaching to the wall so I used the other room. Disappointed that the coffee facility in the rooms were paper cups but I’m sure they would not have minded if I’d raked proper cups from breakfast. 
The hotel is a 20 min train from Romes main Termini and then a 10 min walk. 1.50 euro. 
The hotel has a small restaurant where we had daily buffet breakfast. Lovely and fresh food options, home made cakes and biscuits and the staff were happy to make me a fresh coffee rather than from the available machine. We visited the water park one day and this was only 15 minutes away via Uber.

author: Jennifer W
title: Would not recommend. Left early.
text:
I booked my hotel through the Chase travel portal. The price was great esp during high season and a lot of other hotels much more expensive. 

The good:
- Able to put three people in a room for a reasonable price. This seems uncommon in Italy. 
- breakfast nice, continental style. Coffee machine the bomb
- free street parking around the block. Surprisingly safe. 
- nice family style neighborhood pizza/restaurant called 6zero9 down the street
- reasonable walking distance and access to Cornelia station with access to metro 
- did not charge us for city tax for last day when we decided to check out early.
- cleaning lady came daily to clean room. 

The bad
- breakfast is not free if room booked through Chase (which is seen as Expedia on hotel side)  -8 euro pp
- a/c not working pretty miserable as room seemed to generate heat. Mosquitos come if you leave door open to ventilate. No ETA on A/C fix. 
- shower made entire bathroom floor wet.
- toilet super high off the ground. A really weird set up. 
- poor lighting - bring a headlamp! Lights also generated a lot of heat. 
- mini fridge does not generate cold. It is more of a cooler that generates more heat. 
- no luggage rack 

Would not recommend. Poor experience.

author: Jasmine J
title: It should be removed from the IHG portfolio
text:
Terrible Experience – Completely Unacceptable for an IHG Property

We genuinely do not understand how this hotel qualifies as an IHG property. It fails to meet even the most basic standards of comfort and customer service.

First, the location is directly on one of the busiest streets imaginable. Motorcycles, trucks, and cars are constantly racing by—it honestly sounds like a war zone, with what feels like a nonstop Harley-Davidson parade. 

At check-in, the front desk associate (Steven) was friendly, but gave us no warning about the major issue awaiting us. When we entered our room, it was extremely small and very basic. Worse yet, the temperature inside was 30°C (87°F). We opened the balcony door hoping for relief, only to be hit with overwhelming street noise and mosquitoes—there is no screen.

We called the front desk about how to operate the air conditioning, only to be told that the system had been broken all day, no technician was coming, and there was nothing that could be done. Because of the noise, we could barely hear the conversation and had to go downstairs in person.

There, we found multiple other frustrated guests in the same situation—rooms were unbearably hot with no solution. One couple had just arrived from a long flight from Korea with a ticket at 7am the next morning to visit the Coliseum, and two women was from the U.S.—all IHG members, all completely dissatisfied.

We requested a refund so we could move to another hotel, but were told that only the manager and the booking department (who would not be present until the next morning) could approve it. We then spent two hours of our vacation contacting IHG customer care, only to be told the same thing—nothing could be done until the next day.

Ironically, the lobby and bar had working air conditioning (standalone units), which made the situation even more frustrating.

So to summarize:

-The hotel had a known, property-wide air conditioning failure on a hot, humid day.
-There was no management onsite to handle the situation
-Guests were left in unsafe, unlivable conditions with no immediate solution

Ultimately, we had no choice but to find another hotel late at night. Fortunately, just behind this property we found the Ergife Palace Hotel, located in a quiet oasis with a huge pool, palm trees, spacious rooms, and a luxury breakfast buffet—all for €50 less than what we paid here. We didn't get to rest until midnight.

Even with functioning air conditioning, this hotel does not meet IHG standards due to its location, room quality, and overall guest experience. The complete lack of accountability and support only reinforces this. The next morning, we did go back to speak to a manager for our refund, he apologized and asked us to send him an email regarding the situation in order to process our request. We did as he instructed, but we have not heard from him as of now, nor have seen a refund on our credit statement. 

This property should not represent the IHG brand. Members deserve far better than being misled into staying at a substandard hotel like this.

author: Eli G
title: Avoid

author: Samuel E
title: Cockroaches in my room
text: I found cockroaches in my room. When I told the hotel staff about it, they not only refused to remedy the problem or allow me to change rooms, they also unreasonably tried to blame it on me. I eventually had to switch hotels and did not get my money back nor a reduced price.

author: Maria Elena T
title: Rome🌸
text: Very nice hotel in Trastevere. I stayed in Rome for work, and the hotel accommodation was excellent. Friendly staff, beautiful room, and excellent breakfast.

author: Serena S
title: Good
text: For a budget hotel I thought I would find problems instead, in my case, the only thing that 'seemed strange and' that belonged to a condominium, on the top floors but then the friendly welcome, the nice and clean room, bathroom with shower, TV, wifi, breakfast in a nice room dedicated, elevator and very convenient bus stops. Supermarket just below and shops. Luckily I didn't have noisy neighbors otherwise I guess it would have been difficult to sleep because the walls are thin. I was also able to microwave a dish for consumption in the room. The fixtures are a bit old and in the balcony there were some machines that made a bit of noise but for me it wasn't a problem.

author: Buho
title: If we doubt we will repeat if we return to Rome
text:
Well I don't understand how they put a terrible or bad valuation, because my son and I have been delighted, the hotel workers very friendly and attentive, if you need anything are to help you, we have dined in the room some night food from outside and have been so kind to heat it in their microwaves, which they do not have to. 
The room and sink very clean, every day they do the cleaning.
The unbeatable location, the trastevere station is a few meters from the hotel with bus and train connection to the whole city, a luxury.
We will definitely come to this hotel for quality price if I return to Rome.

author: David C
title: Sightseeing trip.
text:
Overall well, better than the expectations we had when reading the previous opinions.
Very clean rooms, you are replaced by daily towels, friendly staff.
We took double room with Single bathroom, (it seems that there are rooms with shared bathroom), and only accommodation, we bought breakfast in the super downstairs.
We were offered for €10 more a day a “comfort” room, which was only for having air conditioning, and in March, we nailed it, but it is the only catch.
There is just below a bus stop, which made public transport very comfortable.
Next to the train station trastevere.
Underneath the hotel is a pretty big super.
The biggest catch is that the windows are not insulated, and from 7:00 in the morning you hear all the cars and beeps, because otherwise not, but in Rome there are only horn beeps and sirens at all hours.

author: Uktourist77256
title: A litte smelly
text:
A good hotel. Close to the stations with good service. 

Unfortunately the only downside was the sewage smell that lingered. We were on the 6th floor,  and it was worst outside in the corridor but our room smelled musty.

Can't fault the cleanliness as the room was spotless and the view was amazing.

As others have noted there was a sporadic rumble caused by the nearby metro. 

Good value just a shame about the smell!

author: Lucas J
title: Lovely Hotel Near Stations, Minor Smell Issue
text: A really lovely hotel that we enjoyed a lot. It's super close to the stations and the service was genuinely helpful throughout our stay. The only downside was a sewage smell that lingered around the place. We stayed on the 6th floor and it was worst out in the corridor, though our room did smell a bit musty too. That said, I can't fault the cleanliness at all because the room was absolutely spotless and the view was amazing. Like other guests have mentioned, there was a sporadic rumble from the nearby metro that you could hear now and then. Honestly it's very good value for money and the location can't be beaten, just a real shame about that smell because otherwise it would have been a completly perfect trip. We'd still happily come back and would recommend it to anyone visiting Paris on a budget.

author: Suse M
title: Always happy to return
text: I have been coming to this establishment for many years. Especially in the summer, I appreciate the air conditioning and mini-fridge. The location is unbeatable and the staff (from reception to cleaning staff) are super nice and always helpful. The small balcony made drying my swimwear easy. Facing the front, you even have a view of Sacré-Cœur. (But I prefer the quieter rooms in the back)

author: Road44410994137
title: It was not a privilege to stay in a privilege double room.
text:
Upon arrival(having been travelling since 3am) we had to wait a further hour and a half for our rooms to be ready even though check in is 2pm. 
The privilege double room was a lot smaller than expected. The room was quite dark and some lights were not working. The hair dryer was not working and the shower head left a lot to be desired(standing in a shower of rain would have had better results) 
The area for the hotel is VERY noisy so bring earplugs if you want to actually sleep. The pillows are uncomfortable and lumpy.
The breakfast was minimal to say the least, we ventured down for a look one morning with the hopes of having a nice buffet. We were told the pancakes/crepes were finished and the rest of the buffet could fit easily on a kitchen sideboard( for €14pp there were very few options,we went elsewhere) 
Simple things like toilet paper is also an issue as we were expected to use less than half a roll between two adults from one room refresh to the other(they didn’t leave any if there was half a roll left in the room) and we had to keep asking for it when we arrived back from sight seeing each day.
Also the room manager walked in on my daughter while she was in the room, he was doing room checks but rather than wait for a reply he simply opened the door and stuck his head in to see was the room cleaned! 
My daughter was very distraught as she could have been changing or showering when he opened the door! 
Having the train station across the road is good for sight seeing.

author: serzou
title: Perfect!
text: We come here often, next to the Gare de l'Est, beautiful hotel, beautiful room and bathroom, everything very clean! Beautiful common areas and a very good breakfast. Efficient and friendly staff.....that is why we keep coming back!!

author: Flyer45031192583
title: Very good

author: MKelly2080
title: Family stay for a few days in a great location
text: We stayed at Hotel Elixir for four nights as a family of four. The hotel room exceeded our expectations! We had a queen bed and also bunk beds which were in their own separate section. This was great for the kids! We had plenty of space for our clothes and suitcases to go. The shower in the bathroom was a bit odd but once you figured it out it was good! Also the bathroom was separated from the rest of the area with frosted glass and the bathroom door didn’t lock. As we were with our kids this wasn’t a big issue but I could see if you were traveling with people you weren’t super comfortable with this could be awkward. The hotel was in a great area! We didn’t have breakfast at the hotel but opted to grab pastries and coffee at a coffee shop around the corner from the hotel. Super close to walk Notre Dame and you could also walk to the Louvre from there as well. I would definitely recommend Hotel Elixir. Also, the person at the front desk was always pleasant. We appreciated that we were able to check into our room an hour before expected. We were super jet lagged and couldn’t wait to get into our room.

author: zizou135
title: Excellent
text: Top-notch welcome from Raphaël. Very nice location right in the center of Paris, everything is accessible on foot. Clean hotel with very nice decor. Hearty breakfast. I would return without hesitation.

author: Raph1289
title: I RECOMMEND!!!
text:
Awesome. Very kind and welcoming staff. 
The manager is always helpful and very kind, always attentive to the customer. Really 
Very good establishment, the rooms are super clean and have a pleasant smell.

author: Rabih A
title: Misleading Photos and Very Disappointing Stay
text:
I was very disappointed with my stay at this hotel. The rooms shown in the photos appeared renovated, modern, and well-maintained, but the actual room was old, outdated, and did not match the pictures at all.

The bathroom was extremely small and uncomfortable to use, even for an average-sized person. In addition, the internet was not working properly during my stay, which was very inconvenient. To make matters worse, there were plumbing issues, with blocked drains that caused further inconvenience.

The only positive aspect of this hotel is its location, which is excellent and very convenient for exploring the area.

Overall, this hotel is advertised as a 3-star property, but based on the condition of the rooms and the issues encountered, I would not even rate the room 1 star. The photos are misleading and do not accurately represent the actual condition of the accommodations. I would not stay here again and would not recommend it to others.

author: NikoLatre
title: The best thing is the location
text: A fairly basic hotel, but it delivers for the price-quality ratio. I booked it for one night to be close to the station to take the train early in the morning. The staff is friendly.

author: Tessy M
title: Memorable stay
text: Very convenient and central location.  Quite environment. Nice and cozy. Affordable with value for money. Absolutely very clean. The staffs, specially Mr Marco, Ms Ida and Mr Jovani were very nice and helpful. Thank you for making our days memorable in Roma.

author: Mrs C
title: Awful customer service
text: Don’t do it! I reserved a room for 5 days. After reading many reviews about people arriving and having non-working A/C, I needed to confirm that our room would have a working A/C unit as we would be traveling with people (with medical issues) & medications that could not withstand certain temps. I sent 2 emails with no response and then tried to call the hotel. A woman answered & said “this is not for confirmations, lady”, I explained what I was trying to verify & was hung up on. Tried to call back more than 15 times throughout the day & was hung up on every time.

author: satu j
title: Great experience
text: Location really good, easy to explore the city. Atmosphere cozy and the staff is so friendly. Room was small but just enough for sleeping. Value for the money is excellent. I am sure to come back also next time. Thank you🩷

author: Donaldo84
title: A train brought me to safety.
text: Rome is definitely among the most beautiful cities in the world, and I love spending weekends there. This time, however, I was just passing through, and I needed a place to spend Sunday night while waiting to catch the train the next morning. I will start with the positive aspects: the proximity to Termini Station. The facility is really just 50 meters from the entrance of the train terminal. There were no issues with check-in, despite the late hour; after all, I had made sure to inform the hotel several times by phone about my arrival around midnight. Unfortunately, the list of pros ends miserably here. The rest was a nightmare. I had booked a single room for about €100, so I did not expect much. But certainly, I did not deserve to stay in the staff room. Of course, those who work in hospitality will always have my esteem and respect, but the dignity of the customer must still be respected. The small room assigned to me faced DIRECTLY onto the small breakfast room: something between absurd and embarrassing. The small thin wooden door, of course, could never have shielded the room, and so I had the honor of having breakfast with all the hotel guests. But, unfortunately, much worse had happened during the night: I simply found myself in the water. The bidet's drain was not working, and the water simply flooded the bathroom and part of the room. Some of my clothes got wet. At 2 in the morning, I contacted the night porter, who, upon arriving in the room, could do nothing but assess the situation, and nothing more. And so I fell asleep in a semi-flooded room. After the hotel guests "unintentionally invited" me to breakfast, I crossed the threshold and joined them. Just enough time to enjoy a rather unappetizing brioche and a piece of tart, then I decided to finish breakfast with a coffee and a cappuccino. Unfortunately, when I returned from the machine to my little table, I found it cleared of the saucer and cutlery, and already occupied by two other guests. I tried to ask the waiter for an explanation, who simply invited me to take another table. The disbelief was great, but fortunately I had a train waiting for me not far away. I managed to wash my teeth and face (fortunately the sink's drain was different from that of the bidet), I put the pajamas back in the suitcase and fled. I have never been so happy to check out. At the time of paying the tourist tax, I took advantage of the presence of what I believe was the owner of the establishment to inform her of the "small" inconvenience with the bathroom (I limited myself, out of pity, to just that). She had already been informed by the night porter. Unfortunately, a sudden phone call did not allow her to apologize properly. Fortunately, I had a train waiting for me. I have elaborated on this story, but the experience was truly traumatic, even though it was very brief. I sincerely hope that the other rooms are normal (I saw that the keys, unlike mine, were magnetic), but in case you need a single room, only accept it following a good offer: personally, I would not agree to relive this stay even if they offered me 50 euros. I find it hard to believe that I had to pay for that "room."

author: Manuela B
title: Little Caterina
text:
Our room was located on the first floor far from the reception (so I did not see the rest of the property), I can say that the location was excellent for moving towards the main attractions of Rome.
The room was very small for three people, but clean.

author: Mona H
title: Nearby hotel in the centre of Rome! Obs no elevator!
text: Nearby hotel in the centre of Rome! We were placed elsewhere than the hotel that we booked! The hotel communicated well with us so it went well and found out to the other hotel! The hotel was nice but no elevator and had to walk many stairs! Rooms were nice and big! Nice staff!

author: Spipard
title: Bad experience
text:
Maybe I was particularly unlucky, but my experience was this: 

1) On January 9th I book a room for 2 nights in February. The reservation, guaranteed by Mastercard circuit card, was successful.
2) Five days before departure I receive notification that the card was not charged and I am required to change my Card.
3) I immediately change my card but a few hours later I receive another notification similar to the first: the property can not charge me the cost of the reservation.
4) Since both cards are fully functional, covered by liquidity and with adequate ceilings (I used them both for other purchases on the same days), I try to contact the structure and here the problems arise: on the phone they do not answer (I called at different times and on different days), on the Booking chat they do not respond to my many messages in which I request to be contacted to understand if maybe I can provide a transfer.
5) Four days before departure I receive a notification that my reservation has been cancelled, all without ever having received a shred of response from the structure. So I found myself having to look for another one in a hurry and it was particularly stressful. Obviously I successfully booked the new structure with the Card that did not work for them.

And that's it. All documentable, so I challenge these Gentlemen to contest this review.

author: Emmanouil
title: Very bad experience
text: Dont book with them. They double charge and they dont reply through booking.com or through calls. Very bad experience.

author: Silvia
title: DISAPPOINTING
text:
Professionalism is not at home.
We made a reservation on Booking in July for an apartment for 9 people, 2 days after the date of alleged charge of the stay (15 days before departure) we are reported that there was a problem with the charge with the credit card, after several attempts to call the structure for more information obviously without any answer and have entered another credit card, the email with CANCELLED BOOKING arrived.
The property could not be contacted for more information and Booking assistance could not do anything.
Subsequently I saw that the structure has done it several times symptom of very little seriousness.

author: Family M
title: Avoid: Bedbugs and No Response to Refund Request
text: Good location, but bedbugs in the room ruined our stay. My child developed multiple bites and a severe allergic reaction, and we were forced to leave early. The hotel has completely ignored my refund request for the unused nights and does not respond to emails or phone calls. Extremely disappointing and irresponsible.

author: AJ
title: Lovely stay
text: I'm  not sure why people put bad reviews on here from what they pay..its not the ritz but it was very clean with clean bed linen and towels..staff very friendly and a stones throw from the tube station. We had a lovely time and booking again for January ...if you want absolutele luxury then pay for it but it was perfect for the actual time we spent in the room...clean and comfy !

author: Sophie R
title: Below standard felt like a hostel
text: The location of this hotel was fantastic for the event we was attending, and I was really excited to stay, however upon entering the property I was very disappointed. It appeared quite run down and not properly looked after, we were told upon arrival we were in the basement room. Not offered directions so just left to guess where we had to go, the view from our room was of a stair case and bin area and all the passers by could see into our room. Unless we kept the curtains closed. There was no water offered in the rooms, despite the weather being 35° that weekend and was told the water from the bathroom taps was not suitable for drinking. The radiator cover was broken in several places and kept falling off onto the bed which was positioned right next to the radiator. The floor had gaps in it where it had been haphazardly laid therefor kept moving, TV had no signal so what time we did spend in the room meant we couldn't watch the TV as it kept glitching. The icing on the cake though was the extremely lumpy old mattress, and the bites all over my partner and I that we came home with, so we suspect bed bugs or fleas. It really was a shame as this was meant to be a lovely surprise get away for my partner!

author: Gthunberg
title: BLOOD ON THE WALL, SIMPLY DISGUSTING
text:
We were two girlfriends looking for a hotel near Wimbledon, so this hotel suited us well because we also wanted separate beds.
When we were assigned our room we were very disappointed that we were directed to the basement floor. The floor in the bedroom was extremely worn, the window was not onto any garden but to a small patio.
I was about to take a shower and to my horror there was BLOOD on the walls (3 places). Thick and dried blood!!
We contacted reception immediately. The receptionist (a young guy) came and said he would try to arrange it, that it was UNACCEPTABLE.
He came back after a few minutes and offered us to switch to a double room with a double bed. We declined, we had chosen this particular hotel because we wanted SEPARATE beds.
He tried several times.
When he saw that we did not want to, he picked a card from his back pocket and said that he SURE had the same room (2 separate beds) on floor 1 but that he WANTED TO TRY DOUBLE BED FIRST.
What is this place....?
The second room was exactly as we had expected and as we had seen at hotels.com. Fresh, bright and against ... a courtyard with trash but little greenery anyway.
We never come back to this hotel and we advise everyone not to book a room there.

author: Getaway66250836874
title: Awesome employee
text: Eion was so helpful and friendly!

author: Jenna B
title: Great place

author: eweleng

author: Ty S

author: Stephen L

text: Excellent Hotel  ! Especially the breakfast. Felix the cat was the best. He worked in the breakfast area and was  very  attentive .

author: Jannah H
title: Perfect central london stay
text: Perfect hotel for Hyde Park. Quiet street,  air conditioning and comfy beds. The staff are so lovely and were even kind enough to provide complementary breakfast!

author: TSH90
title: All right.
text:
We first got room 51, which is definitely not recommended. It needs a solid upgrade. The room was not properly cleaned etc. in addition. 
However, after a little while and we got to switch to another room in a slightly newer part. Totally curant room for short stay. Small rooms, cleaned fine (but could be even more thorough) and newer aircon here.
Most of the people we talked to who work there were very nice and therefore land at 3. 
Location attracts very much.

author: Gemma Y
title: Will definitely stay again
text:
I was a little apprehensive before arriving because I’d read some mixed reviews, but our experience couldn’t have been better. We originally booked a room with two single beds, but the hotel kindly upgraded us to a much larger room with two double beds and a single bed, which was perfect for our family and gave us plenty of space for our pushchair.

The room and bathroom were both spotless, the air conditioning worked brilliantly, and the beds were very comfortable. The staff were so friendly, welcoming and helpful from the moment we arrived.

For a 3-star hotel, we thought it was excellent value for money. We had a really enjoyable stay and would happily book here again.

We stayed here because my husband had an appointment on the other side of Hyde Park and it was a really good location close to everything we walked up to Oxford Street

author: James F
title: Great
text: Very central to everything. Staff were extremely friendly and helpful.

author: Naveen K
title: It’s a cheap deal for a reason , and it still won’t be cheap enough - avoid
text:
Whilst the room was cheap - sub £100 for the night (single room), it isn’t cheap enough to make that worthwhile. 

Tiniest room and shower cubical I’ve ever seen and everything felt cheap and nasty. Wires visible leading to the air con unit , paint work touched up by Stevie Wonder, as paint was all over the spot lights and sockets. Just bad. Curtains are as thin as tracing paper. No matter how cheap it might be, stay elsewhere - avoid

author: Semra T
title: Very clean
text: Very clean, high quality products in the room, very good location.

author: Annemarie
title: Cheerful, artistic, and very friendly
text:
Very friendly, clean, cozy, trendy, cheerful, and artistic hotel
This will be our favorite hotel in the coziest neighborhood of Paris. We are not staying anymore. On a little jump from the Moulin Rouge and 300 meters from Boris Boulangerie from Miraculous Ladybug

author: Stephanie K
title: Fantastic hotel
text: 5+ stars! Impeccable customer service, incredible location in the heart of Montmarte, friendly, helpful staff and beautiful rooms. So many little touches that made this a unique experience and a hotel to come back to. Merci!

author: Alin D
title: Great value for money. Staff makes
text: There are plenty of good things about the hotel. Staff is the most important one, great smiles and great service. The hotel is nice, simple, efficient. Rooms are small same with bathrooms. It did work for us but bigger people will not fit in the shower, at least not in our room. This is a typical refurbished old building, so the feeling is different from a typical chain hotel. We loved it and many people will find it an exceptional value for money. But know what to expect

author: Claudia
title: Cozy, small, clean hotel
text:
Perfect hotel for exploring the Montmartre area. The room was small, but well-equipped. View into a small courtyard, but very quiet at night.
Staff was very friendly and accommodating. When checking in, I also received a map to explore the neighborhood. I did that, and it was very interesting and worth seeing.
The hotel is located in a quiet area; walking home at night (alone as a woman) was no problem at all.
I enjoyed it thoroughly and will likely come back again.

author: CARLOS S
title: NASTY HOTEL!!!!!
text:
Horrible hotel! Look at the pictures and read the reviews carefully before booking. The actual room was NOTHING like what was shown in the pictures.
The hotel was dirty, and the bathroom was unbelievably small. The toilet was only about 6 inches from the wall, making it nearly impossible to sit. The shower was so small that a normal-sized person could barely use it.
Our bathroom didn’t even have water, and there was a towel on the floor with what appeared to be human feces on it. 🤢
As soon as we saw the room, we asked for our money back, but they refused. We ended up leaving and paying for another hotel that was much nicer, clean, and had air conditioning.
Don’t waste your money! Before making a reservation, ask them to send you REAL pictures of the exact room you’ll be staying in. The pictures online are extremely misleading.

author: Marcela C
title: The worst hotel I have ever booked in my life.
text:
The worst hotel I have ever booked in my life. The photos are completely misleading and look nothing like the actual property. The location is okay, but everything else was absolutely unacceptable.

The reception area is old, cluttered, and full of construction materials and debris. The elevator is unbelievably tiny — barely large enough for one person at a time.

But the worst part was the room and bathroom. The room is extremely small, dark, and absolutely impossible for two people to stay comfortably. There is NO AIR CONDITIONING, which is unacceptable during the European summer.

The bathroom is even worse. It is so ridiculously small that you can barely fit inside. It is practically impossible to sit on the toilet properly because there is simply no space. The shower area is absurdly cramped, making the entire bathroom almost unusable.

To make matters worse, we found a dirty towel lying on the floor when we entered the room.

We walked in and walked right back out within five minutes. I have traveled and stayed in many hotels, and I have honestly never seen anything this bad. The property is completely misrepresented by the photos, and the reality is shocking. I would absolutely NOT recommend this hotel.

author: Aka Y
title: Unsafe living conditions in central Paris - stay away from!
text: Unsafe living conditions in Central Paris. Building has sewer issues that owner knows about it but decides to do nothing about it hence their response was - wait 5 minute your toilet will clear itself ( it didn’t , got worse) . No replacement rooms available either when requested one. Sneaky people don’t leave hotel before you’ve got your refund in your hands otherwise you’ll have to go through your bank . Careful this hotel will ruin your holiday .

author: Ygor M
title: The booking was charged twice on our card!
text: Don't fall in the blow. They charged the reservation on our card twice and do not return the amount. They report that two reservations were made, but we did not. We warned that the charge was wrong before even the card released the amount and still continued the charge!

author: Haydon d Bayliss
title: Poor quality, hazardous and quite frankly, false advertising.
text:
I checked in to the hotel Eiffel Kensington the 6th of may with my partner to celebrate my birthday in Paris. On check in we were greeted by a friendly gentleman who gave us our keys and directed us towards our room. on the desk was a sign saying the wifi wasn't working, unfortunately no compensation was given for this. when we left the elevator we emerged into a pitch black corridor where I almost tripped on a mop bucket haphazardly left by the stairs. once we got into room 14  the bedroom was clean but poorly decorated and the bed was small with 2 thin pillows, we asked for more pillows but were informed that the hotel was full so they didn't have any spare. they did have a spare adapter for us which was very friendly. once we went into the bathroom we discovered the toilet seat did not fully open which means we had to have it touching us to stay open. the shower was poorly positioned with the holder causing the water to soak the ceiling which was clearly rotting and coming away. the skirting board in the bedroom had painters tape where they had clearly forgotten to take it off, we found painters tape in the hallway as well. we were given no information about breakfast or the hotel facilities. 
Your website paints a very unrealistic portrait of your hotel, advertising luxury rooms and a high quality establishment "we are not settling for less when balancing maximum quality". you also advertise wifi multiple times as benefit of staying at your hotel "Surf with ease and stay connected to the digital world with our free, high-speed Wi-Fi. Emerse yourself in an ocean of information, communicate effortlessly, or post those picture-perfect moments without a hitch—an entire digital spectrum is at your disposal with our cutting-edge connectivity solutions." "and, of course, gratis WiFi, satisfying your strive for modern warmth while staying true to authentic Parisian charm." "Offering the luxury of affordability combined with indispensable intricacies including an ensuite bathroom, television, and WiFi access, Eiffel Kensington Hotel sets the stage for an indulgent sojourn in the heart of Paris." which should be a standard in todays world. 
I have attempted to contact the hotel directly about these issues and unfortunately not heard anything back, as someone who works in a hotel myself I am reluctant to pot reviews on trip advisor but felt that people needed to know that this hotel is definitely not worth the money and it certainly not the luxury budget friendly accommodation they advertise themselves as. 
I will definitely not be staying here again.

title: Terriblllllllllle.........

please please do not visit...

title: 30 minutes later we left

Shoved in a room on the 5th floor ( not a classic room like we had paid for) no working lift up to the 5th floor. Doors to room didn’t lock and being asked to leave keys for the hotel at the hotel? Cleaning staff seen laying on the bed charging phones in one room we were told to go look at. 

We lasted 30 minutes and left.

author: DavJess
title: Charming!
text:
Ideally located hotel for those wishing to visit Rome; the main sites are a 30-minute walk away, otherwise the area is very well served by buses.
The staff is truly lovely both at breakfast and at the reception, and is always available.
The rooms take you back in time, which helps with the change of scenery and adds charm to the trip.
Thank you for this beautiful stay.

author: Riccardo M
title: Pleasant discovery
text:
I stayed at the Hotel Des Epoques in Rome on the advice of a friend, and I must say that it was really a great discovery.

The location is very favorable, well connected and surrounded by numerous restaurants and services, which makes the stay practical and pleasant.

The hotel retains a charming old-fashioned style, with elegant and characterful settings. The room was comfortable, with a newly renovated bathroom, modern and attention to detail. The bed, equipped with topper and memory pillows, made the rest particularly relaxing. The furniture, in antique style, adds charm even if it shows some signs of ageing.

A strong point is certainly the staff: always friendly, helpful and professional, both at reception and during breakfast service, attentive to the needs of guests and able to make you feel at ease.
The breakfast is varied and of excellent quality, with a wide choice of both sweet and savory. The only small note concerns the tables in the breakfast room, which were not set.
The lunch service is also very interesting: for a supplement of 12 euros you can have lunch at the hotel, a convenient and convenient solution.

There is some detail to review, but the property offers all the services in line with its category.
Overall, a very pleasant stay: I will definitely return to stay here and recommend it.

author: magicmagic1
title: Great hotel in Monti area
text: First visit to Rome and the location was perfect; Monti is a short walk from pretty much everything you would wish to see in Rome. The area was quiet and felt safe. Room was spacious and had everything you would need. Great that the mini bar is initially complimentary; the room was clean and as expected. Breakfast was good and set you up for the day. Would return if in Rome

author: Patricia A
title: Great experience
text: Great location, the staff is very friendly, the room is excellent

author: Juan Carlos R
title: There is no better hotel. 100% recommended
text:
This hotel could not be better in practically anything.
The location is excellent, less than a 20-minute walk from any important monument (Colosseum, Trevi Fountain...) and also very close to Termini station.
This is not the most remarkable thing about the hotel. The room is excellent, spacious, the air conditioning works perfectly, the bed is impressively comfortable, and the cleaning service does an excellent job of leaving everything spotless.
Without a doubt, what is worth highlighting is the kindness of the receptionists and waiters. They understand Spanish practically to perfection with excellent, very friendly service, and with a smile always on their faces, they have resolved any question for us instantly.
I recommend booking the breakfast service to be served by good old Giacomo and his waiters. And you have to order their delicious themed cappuccinos, no matter what!
Thank you very much!

author: thomas f
title: Rome stay
text:
Really enjoyed my stay here close to everything staff very friendly every morning the manager at breakfast would make a coffee with a different picture displayed which is a great touch really felt welcomed to be in rome thank you
 Tom and emily

author: Fearless271986
title: Beautiful Hotel 💥
text:
Fantastic hotel with a perfect location! The breakfast was amazing, and the service was absolutely divine  A1! ✨❤️

Thank you, Rome, for making me feel right at home. 🇮🇹❤️ Special thanks to Cuacomo, Maria Angela & Paulo for the wonderful breakfast service. You were amazing! 🥰

Grazie, Roma! 🇮🇹✨

author: Xisco R
title: SERVICE AND FACILITIES OF BARELY 2 STARS (IF THAT) AT A PRICE OF ALMOST 5 STARS
text: The price of this hotel is practically double that of any other hotel in Rome of the same category, features, and location, but it should actually be less than half that of those hotels; in other words, it is not worth even a quarter of the price they charge. It is a supposedly 4-star hotel, but its service and facilities do not even reach those of a 3-star hotel. They charged us no less than 250 euros per night (1,000 euros for the 4 nights we stayed), and the service and room they assigned us are not worth more than 50 euros per night. We booked it assuming that cost with the intention of having a wonderful stay as a couple in supposedly exceptional facilities, and they were indeed exceptional, but in a totally negative sense, as I will proceed to explain in detail so that no other person has to endure their extremely low quality of service at a luxury price: Small room with small "views" of a road through a window (obviously without a balcony, much less a terrace). Very scarce breakfast, very little variety (two or three plates of cold cuts and cheeses, bread, scrambled eggs, boiled eggs, and little else), only one type of milk (cow's milk and whole, of course), three small bowls of fruit (almost always empty), and on top of that, the products would run out and they wouldn't replenish them if you didn't ask. Each of the 4 days when we arrived for breakfast, all the product trays were practically empty (the dining room was full of people), and if you didn't ask, they wouldn't replenish (at 250 euros a day, I repeat). We even felt embarrassed for them because of that restriction of products. Paper napkins, and cheap ones at that, and no tablecloths on the tables; directly on the table. Restaurant without any type of air conditioning (we didn't dine there even once because the temperature was 37 degrees), without any special atmosphere—well, neither special nor not special, just no atmosphere at all. Zero delicacy in the treatment by the staff, robotic-style attention, 2-star hotel service or less. Upon arrival, we asked the receptionist if he could give us a room with a view, just as we had requested by email days before; his response was that the room was already assigned and that he did not assign them. They gave us a room with a "view" of a road through a window. In addition to the above, we were also unable to have shared views from the supposed rooftop terrace because it was closed (they told us it was due to construction). As a final touch, on the last day we left our luggage in their storage room for a few hours, and when I went to pick it up, the receptionist, instead of handing me the luggage, gave me the key to the storage room where it was located and told me to go get it myself and lock it back up—"wonderful" 4-star service at 250 euros a night!!! We booked this trip through "Viajes El Corte Inglés," an agency we have been customers of for years, but we are considering not booking with them again if they do not better filter their choice of hotels, as they should not market establishments like this one. Finally, I beg everyone who reads this to share it so that it gets maximum exposure and no other person has to suffer these terrible facilities and service at 250 euros a night.

author: Aimee P
title: First time in Rome
text: Our first time in Rome and this was the perfect place for us. Staff are friendly and helpful. We spent mornings sightseeing and the hot afternoons by their beautiful pool.

author: Ilovecake0
title: Elegant city stay
text:
Beautiful hotel in a lovely area up the hill from Trastavere. Ten minute walk down (uber back up if you can’t face the steps)
In the heat the pool was a life saver as was the air con. Slept well, great breakfast buffet and friendly staff.

Ileana

author: Ann C
title: Very disappointed
text: We visited the hotel pool today. It was 97 in Rome. My son booked us in to get into the pool. We were charged €35 each to use the pool facilities he knows my son my husband did not want to go in the pool nor did his 12 year-old daughter. We went back up to the person in charge and asked if he could refund us the €35 as they were not going to use the pool he said no even though I told him that we did not know at the time they would not be swimming. We had lunch there bought drinks and had coffee and spent over €120 plus the €35 each 210 euro to get in and they couldn’t see it to give us back the €70 we probably could have booked in and stayed the night and got in bed and breakfast included very disappointed with the customer service of this beautiful Hotel

author: D3bs2013
title: Exceptional customer service.
text: I have stayed here numerous times. Never had any complaints. But my stay last week (checked in 18/8) was superb mainly due to the staff. Check in lady, man on bar, man who brought our food provided the best customer service I’ve ever experienced. And it did not feel put on. They were genuinely helpful, personable and caring. Room was spotless too. We paid to park so we could spend the following day in London after checking out. Returned to collect car late that day. We had a bit of a drive back and wanted to use the facilities before leaving. Went to reception to ask if that was ok as we were no longer guests. Yet again, another incredible member of staff on the desk. Couldn’t have been more helpful and genuine. Having stayed in so many hotels all over the world and across the full range of star ratings, I can honestly say I have never experienced such exceptional customer service. Thank you so much to the team at Greenwich.

author: Sara H
title: Perfect O2 Stay – Friendly Staff
text:
We stayed here for one night last week while attending a concert at the O2. We had originally booked another hotel in the area, but after reading some worrying reviews, we decided to change our reservation and stay here instead. We are so glad that we did!
From the moment we arrived, the reception staff were incredibly friendly and welcoming. Check-in was quick and easy, and we immediately felt looked after. Our room was clean and comfortable, with air conditioning (which was very much appreciated).

The hotel was exactly what we needed for an overnight stay before and after an event.
Breakfast was also good.

 A special mention also goes to the receptionist who kindly refilled my reusable water bottle with ice and water as we checked out and headed into central London on what turned out to be the hottest day of the year. It was a small gesture, but one that was greatly appreciated.

This hotel has definitely earned our loyalty and will now be our first choice whenever we attend events at the O2.

author: Marlyn
title: Good visit
text:
Good location (20mins walk to O2).  Rooms were ok, getting slightly sold now. Good air con 

I expect all rooms to have safes on. To be a basic thing 

Breakfast was ok, selection of complimentary cold and hot. 
 Would recommend.

author: alexandra
title: Pleasant break! Anita 10/10
text:
We chose this hotel as I am disabled and use mobility aids and it was one of the closest to the O² arena after a gig there on the 12th august. 
When we arrived lovely Anita checked us in and was very accommodating when I asked if the had shower caps in the room. I didn't want to ruin the hotels stuff with my freshly died hair. 
She was welcoming friendly but professional. Directed us perfectly as it was our first time using this holiday inn. Anita even remembered us from check in when we saw her again later that night post gig. She was exceptionally well mannered. Holiday inn definitely need to keep her. A credit to the company. 
The air con throughout  was a welcome reprieve and the offer of refreshments was very well ranged considering the bar itself wasn't the biggest. 
Everywhere in the communal areas the bar restaurant and check in was very clean. 
When we checked into our room the air con was on and black out curtains pulled closed. Whoever was our housekeeper in room 423 bravo 10/10 that room was so perfectly chilled. Perfect to escape London's extreme heat at the moment. 
I was pleasantly surprised to see the in house shower products were dove. As I had forgotten shower gel. The bathroom was spotlessly clean, the shower was roomy which is rare for me as someone who is 6ft tall. 
The room was spacious with all necessary amenities and we even had a couch/pullout which was a nice surprise. 
The view of Greenwich from the hotel helped make a couples getaway that much more special. 
Every staff member we encountered at this holiday inn was professional yet smiley, well presented. I was very impressed as a well seasoned traveller we will definitely be adding this holiday inn to our yes pile. Hope to see you again.

author: Chris B
title: ok for a night
text: Was ok for a night as we were visiting the o2.  Room was clean enough albeit a bit tired.  Bathroom a bit tight but did the job for a night and seemed clean enough again though a bit tired.  Breakfast the usual fayre although can't really comment as I only had toast!  Reasonable walk to the o2 from the hotel although my word the litter on the route, no excuse for people to do that.  Nothing to do with the hotel of course.  My one real gripe is the £33 (with discount) parking on site.  You pay for a room and yet £35 for 24 hours parking?!  Daylight robbery really.  London prices we were told, well it may be better to catch the show on tour at your local seaside resort.  Similar hotels we stayed at in Bournemouth and Portsmouth parking was around £7.50.  So a bit of a liberty really.  So in a nutshell ok for a nights stay but it would certainly be cheaper by train!

author: Salvatore
title: Excellent
text:
Excellent 3-star hotel a stone's throw from the station.
During breakfast the staff proved to be very kind, in particular Giulia..
Excellent service, we had a good time and we will return..

author: Aldo F
title: Disappointing
text:
Little cooperation in handling the problem
The stay on 08/12 was regularly completed and paid €86 directly to the hotel.
The problem concerns a second Trivago booking for 08/23, worth €65, which was never used due to an error in the booking procedure.
I asked the hotel for simple cooperation to allow Trivago to evaluate the refund, but the property stated that it could not intervene, referring me back to Trivago/Orbe Travel.
I understand that the booking was managed through an intermediary, but I would have expected more willingness to seek a solution for the customer, especially considering that the room for 08/23 was never used.
Regular stay, but management of the problem decidedly unsatisfactory

author: Mike R
title: Clean, Safe room exactly next to the train station
text:
This place is exactly across the street from Rome Termini Station. Booked it because we had an 8am train and didn't want to deal with any commute. 
Found this. The older reviews were lackluster but newer ones much more positive. Figured, at worst it's just 1 night. 

What we got was a quirky,  old fashioned hotel but everything was spotless and modern. The decor in the room was like my grandmother's place from the 1940s... but new. Very unique and nice. 
Loads of dining nearby. We left early in the morning so didn't take the breakfast option. Obviously, no opinion on that regard
The price point was a little high compared to some other areas in the city but you have ultimate convenience to the rail system, a clean, safe hotel and helpful staff... perfect for late train arrival or early departure. I could see using it as a base for a couple days but for longer stays, I think I'd choose something away from the train station

author: Anna B
title: Extremely kind and efficient staff
text:
I forgot a blouse in the closet, the hotel staff found it and helped me send it to my home. A big thank you! 
 The hotel has an excellent location, the room was a bit dated but comfortable, and the air conditioning was working perfectly.  Receptionists were really kind and efficient.

author: CriticoCostruttivo
title: Not really...
text:
Leave it alone unless you want to spend "little" (very relatively) and have an absolute need to be close to Termini.
Friendly staff, excellent location... sufficient breakfast.
EVERYTHING else is negative; the rooms are not old, they are completely in need of renovation: rust in the bathroom, destroyed floors, phone in the room not connected, bidet with a blocked stopper, balcony blocked (overlooking a busy street with noise all night), shower in the tub without even a $10 curtain, shower gel bottle completely empty upon arrival... etc. etc...
A maze of rooms, I imagine all like mine; I understand that it is difficult to renovate them all and it is more convenient for them to "get by" since they still earn from tours, etc... but they must do at least a MINIMUM of maintenance; otherwise, it is hard to understand how they can remain open. Also because it costs less than other hotels in the area, but it is still too expensive for the conditions in which they leave it.

author: GrandTour47149898999
title: Everything
text:
Our Stay at the Hotel 

We had a wonderful experience at the hotel from the moment we arrived. The hotel completely met all of our expectations and provided everything we needed for a comfortable, enjoyable, and relaxing stay. The atmosphere, service, and overall experience were excellent, and we would absolutely recommend this hotel to anyone visiting Rome.

Matteo’s Outstanding Service 

However, Matteo truly took our experience to another level. He is an incredibly kind, warm, attentive, and service-oriented person. He took care of us exceptionally well and always made us feel welcomed and valued.

No matter what we asked, Matteo was always happy to help. He gave us detailed and thoughtful answers, went above and beyond to assist us, and made sure we had everything we needed.

What stood out to us the most was his genuine warmth, friendliness, and care for the guests. His positive attitude and kindness made our stay so much more enjoyable.

Even though the hotel already exceeded our expectations, Matteo made the experience twice as special. His service truly made a difference, and we are very grateful for everything he did for us.

We would absolutely recommend this hotel to everyone we know, and Matteo is definitely one of the main reasons why. He is a wonderful representative of the hotel and deserves all the appreciation and recognition for his outstanding service. ❤️

author: javier n
title: A spectacular experience at the Trilussa Palace Hotel
text:
Our stay at the Trilussa Palace Hotel in Rome has been simply spectacular. From the first day we felt at home thanks to the very warm, friendly, and professional treatment from all the staff. The service received was a ten, always with a smile and willing to help us at all times.
I am Davinia, the Spanish woman who was using a crutch, and Javier from 613.

I want to especially highlight my dear Faviola, for her friendliness, affection, and attention during our entire stay. People like her make a trip become an unforgettable memory. I also want to thank the front desk manager, who, after we explained what had happened to us with Logitravel, gifted us a spa day; everyone at the front desk is unique and so good, whose professionalism, kindness, and dedication have been exceptional.

The rooms are comfortable and clean, the location is excellent for visiting Rome, and the hotel's atmosphere is quiet and welcoming. It is no coincidence that the hotel has thousands of positive reviews and a very high rating among travelers.

Without a doubt, we will return to this hotel when we go back to Rome. Thank you for making our vacation so special. I recommend the Trilussa Palace Hotel to anyone who wants to enjoy an unforgettable stay in the Eternal City.

Thank you, Faviola, thank you to the front desk manager, and thank you to the entire Trilussa Palace Hotel team for your extraordinary attention!
