author: Trini
title: Friendly, attentive, clean and cool!
text:
Lovely stay and would recommend. What really stood out for us was the customer service. Responses to emails ahead of the trip were very prompt and professional, and the warm welcome we received when we arrived really set the tone for a positive and comfortable stay - management should be proud of their staff as you cannot underestimate the importance of making guests feel at ease and welcome as soon as they arrive. 

We arrived a few hours before check in and appreciated being allowed to leave our bags in a storage room - being offered bottled water before we headed off for a little explore was a kind touch. It’s v hot in Rome atm and we were grateful to receive a message to let us know our room was ready (earlier than expected) and our bags were waiting for us in our room. We also appreciated the ice bucket delivery to our room, and a complementary bottle of fizz. 

In terms of the hotel itself - its very clean, great location (there’s a super market and mini market close by, and restaurants a short walk), quiet (we had a room with a balcony and couldn’t hear traffic when windows were closed) and great air con. 

Overall a lovely stay - the highlight being the staff and their approach. Keep doing what you’re doing - it works and is appreciated! Thank you!

author: Isabel F
title: JUST AMAZING
text:
We stayed at Trulissa Palace Hotel in Rome from the 8th–10th and honestly, it was amazing. We were a little sceptical after seeing some of the negative reviews, but it completely exceeded our expectations and we genuinely couldn’t fault our stay.

From the second we arrived, the staff were so lovely, welcoming and helpful. Every time we had a question, they were more than happy to help and were always so informative. The hotel itself was absolutely spotless — genuinely, there wasn’t a single bit of dirt anywhere. Everything was so clean and well looked after.

We stayed in what I believe was one of the more basic rooms, but even that was exceptional. We had a balcony, a mini bar and everything we could have needed was provided. One night, our TV stopped working at around 12–1am, and they immediately sent someone up to help us. He had a little look around and managed to get it working again, which we really appreciated considering how late it was.

We also booked the spa, which you get at a discounted price as a hotel guest (up to 30%, I believe). Unfortunately, we completely overslept and missed the time we had booked, but they were so understanding and more than happy to let us go in a different slot instead. Everyone was just genuinely so kind and accommodating.

Breakfast was included with our stay and there was such a huge variety, so there was loads to choose from. The rooftop bar was also amazing. We unfortunately didn’t get the chance to eat up there, but we went up for a quick drink and it was lovely.

The location was also perfect. It was so close to the centre and there were loads of transport options nearby — buses, trains, bikes, electric scooters, pretty much everything you could need. It made getting around Rome so easy.

Overall, we genuinely loved our stay here. The hotel was beautiful and spotless, the location was great and the staff were honestly some of the nicest and most helpful we’ve come across. We were so impressed, especially considering we had been a little put off by some of the reviews beforehand. I would 100% recommend staying here and would definitely come back! ♡

author: Giada P
title: A magical place
text:
Returning to the Trilussa Palace is always a sure thing. I already know this property very well and, precisely for this reason, I can say that every time it manages to confirm my expectations and make me feel at home. The spas remain one of my favorite corners: a well-kept, elegant environment, perfect for indulging in a moment of true relaxation. It is precisely that type of place where you know you can completely disconnect and enjoy a few hours of tranquility. A special thanks goes to Lorena, who once again proved to be exceptional. Her kindness, professionalism, and attention to the customer truly make the difference. It is nice to find people who, with their way of working and welcoming you, contribute to making every return even more pleasant. If I keep choosing the Trilussa Palace and returning there, there is a reason: quality, atmosphere, and above all, an attention to the guest that is not at all taken for granted.

A guarantee, as always.

author: Clarissa G.
title: Quiet but small rooms, great food
text:
I initially planned to stay at Archer for just one night and ended up staying three.  I owe a great experience to Jason at the front desk.  I ran into a couple of hiccups upon check-in and had already worked with 2 of the 3 agents at the desk.  After getting to the point where I was ready to request to cancel my reservation, Jason, the third agent, greeted me with a huge smile and was so happy to assist me.  In a matter of minutes, he was able to get to the bottom on my issue and ensure I was satisfied.  Not only was he a extremely patient and professional, he was also very warm and empathetic and he seemed invested in wanted to insure I had the best experience possible.  He is an asset to the hotel and I hope he is recognized for his customer service.  The company got an additional 2 nights out of me because of him!

Scott the manager was also very helpful and accommodating.  He went and above and beyond to assist me, and I'm really grateful for his support.  I'd also like to mention Chole, also at the front desk.  Each time she assisted me, she was hospitable, friendly and happy to assist.   I was very pleased with the level of service she provided. 

The rooms are nice but very small and carpeted, with curtains; and that can be an issue for someone with allergies like me.  They also use a certain cleaner, the smell of which I didn't care for.   However the windows open partially to allow fresh in fresh air, which I love.  They also provide several Nespresso capsules, which is a plus!  The rooms are very quiet, and I didn't hear any noise from the people across or above from me and I've very sensitive to noise!  The person who cleaned my room after my first night did a heck of a job!  I typically don't request for my room to be cleaned, but I'm so glad I did because coming back to a room that looked almost better than it did when I checked in was an incredible feeling.

I used the $25 credit on breakfast, and I'm so glad I did.  I'd return to the hotel for the breakfast alone it was so delicious.  I cannot have dairy or gluten so they gave me gluten free toast and fruit to substitute the potatoes I could not have.  So I had bacon, eggs, toast and fruit, and I can't remember the last time I've had a breakfast that delicious.  It's pricey at around $22, but it's worth it.

So thanks to Jason, Scott, Chole, the room attendant and the restaurant chef and staff, I had a very nice stay at Archer!

author: Michael W
title: Two Days in NYC, One Great Hotel
text:
A fantastic first NYC experience

Visiting New York City for the first time with my wife and our 11-year-old son, the Archer Hotel turned out to be a fantastic home base for our trip.

We arrived around 10 AM and were able to drop our bags right away, which was incredibly convenient. We grabbed brunch at the Spyglass rooftop restaurant at the hotel, enjoyed the food and the views, and then headed out to see as much of the city as we could.

Our first day was packed. We walked around Bryant Park and the New York Public Library, visited Grand Central Station, and then made our way up to the Empire State Building Observatory. The views of Manhattan were amazing. After a break back at the hotel to rest our feet, we headed out again and took in Times Square at night. It was busy, loud, and completely overwhelming in the best possible way — exactly what I imagined NYC would be.

We stayed in an Empire State Building View room, and the view really was incredible. Waking up and looking straight out at the Empire State Building was pretty special, and our son thought it was awesome.

The hotel was clean, comfortable, and the staff were friendly and helpful. But for me, the location was the biggest advantage. We could walk to so many of the places we wanted to see, and when we needed to go farther, the subway made getting around surprisingly easy.

The next morning we checked out but were able to leave our bags at the hotel, which gave us most of the day to keep exploring. We headed downtown and spent some time at the 9/11 Memorial reflecting pools and museum before going up to the One World Trade Center observation deck. Again, the views are insane!

Before leaving the city, we got our first real NYC subway experience and rode from One World Trade Center up to Central Park. We walked around the park for a bit, then jumped back on the subway and rode back to Bryant Park to grab our bags before heading out of the city.

Coming from Seattle and visiting NYC for the first time, I was honestly surprised by how much we were able to experience in such a short time. Having the Archer as our home base made it easy to get around, come back and recharge, and head back out without wasting a lot of time traveling.

The location, staff, cleanliness, and Empire State Building view were all excellent, but the convenience is what really made the stay for us. Traveling with an 11-year-old and trying to see NYC in a couple of days can be a lot, and the Archer made it much easier.

We had a great experience and would absolutely stay here again on our next trip to New York.

author: Tinus J
title: Very disappointing experience
text:
I had a very frustrating experience with Eiffel Seine Hotel.

I originally booked a room for 2 nights (28th–30th) for 2 adults and 1 child. On the 3rd of the month, our plans changed because a friend was joining us, meaning we would become 3 adults and 1 child. I contacted the hotel to ask whether they could accommodate the additional adult or, if not, move us to a suitable room. They told me there was no availability.

I therefore requested cancellation in the same email and understood the booking to be cancelled. I subsequently made a new booking through Booking.com at another hotel that could accommodate our group.

Then, around the 22nd/23rd, I received an email about hotel services. Unfortunately, I did not properly notice the hotel name and assumed it was related to my new hotel. I ended up ordering flowers costing around €80.

On the 26th, I was surprised to see that Eiffel Seine Hotel had charged my card €315 for the deposit. I immediately contacted them and explained that I had requested cancellation. I also followed their cancellation link to make sure the reservation was cancelled and contacted my bank regarding the charge.

To their credit, the hotel eventually agreed to refund the €315 deposit. However, they refused to refund the approximately €80 charged for the flowers, stating that the order had already been made and could not be cancelled. Initially, I disputed this, but eventually my wife suggested we simply accept the flowers and collect them.

What makes this experience particularly disappointing is the lack of clear communication and the confusion surrounding the cancellation and hotel-service emails. From a customer's perspective, after requesting cancellation and believing the reservation was no longer active, receiving a €315 charge days later is extremely frustrating. The subsequent situation with the flowers only added to an already unpleasant experience.

Overall, this has been a very poor customer-service experience. While I appreciate that the hotel agreed to refund the deposit, the whole process was unnecessarily stressful and confusing. I would strongly recommend that the hotel make its cancellation process and service-related communications much clearer to avoid putting guests in this situation.

Very disappointing experience and, unfortunately, not a hotel I would choose again.

author: Discover52357756623
title: The room cleaning hours are not appropriate
text:
Complaint Regarding Noise and Cleaning Hours

We stayed at the hotel for six nights, and unfortunately, on three of those nights we were disturbed by noise from the room cleaning staff, which prevented us from sleeping properly.

The room cleaning hours are not appropriate. The cleaning staff start as early as 7:00 a.m. and continue until 10:30 p.m. In addition, they make a considerable amount of noise, including banging, moving things around and using vacuum cleaners, without taking into consideration the guests in the adjacent rooms who may be trying to rest.

On one occasion, when we went to reception to ask them to stop the cleaning because our child was trying to sleep at 10:30 p.m., we were actually told that we should wear earplugs. We found this response completely inappropriate and unacceptable. Guests should not be expected to wear earplugs in order to be able to sleep in a hotel room. The hotel should ensure that cleaning activities are carried out at reasonable hours and that guests' right to rest is respected.

It is particularly disappointing because we stayed for six nights, and three of those nights were seriously affected by the noise, to the point that we were unable to sleep properly. This had a significant impact on our stay and on our overall experience at the hotel.

That said, we would also like to highlight that the service provided by Abu in the dining room was excellent. His friendliness, kindness and positive attitude helped to make our experience less negative than it otherwise would have been. We would like to thank him for his professionalism and for always making us feel welcome.

Overall, however, we believe that the issue of cleaning hours and noise should be addressed urgently, as it significantly affects the comfort and wellbeing of hotel guests.

author: Explorer35668432941
title: Fights at the pool, rude staff and disgusting accomodation! WORST HOLIDAY EVER
text: We stayed here recently and I wish we had saved our money, so please don't waste yours. This is by far the worst place we've stayed in 6 years of travelling with children. The "cabins" are basically tiny static caravans and I wouldn't bed my dog down in one of them. The toilet and shower smelled of sewage - like a gagging smell you couldn't get rid of. The toilet also wouldn't flush properly and broke half way through our stay. There was filth everywhere and air conditioning in one room only. The mattresses are concrete and the pillows feel like they're made of rubber. The shower has 2 settings: Cold & Freezing Cold. Upon arriving we immediately visited reception to ask to be moved to another cabin and were rudely told they had no other accomodation for us and if we had a problem to speak with a rep at Eurocamps. Guess what? There is no rep. I think I'm most angry at how deceiving Eurocamps have been with their advertising. For example: they advertise a BBQ area - well, if you want food poisoning then by all means use this dirty little grill dumped out the front of the accomodation, you might just fit 3 sausages on it but it's also filthy. The pool is disgusting and wasn't cleaned once in 6 days - it's also absolutely chaotic and over crowded every minute of the day and the security / lifeguards cannot control this many people. The deep pool is so crowded you have to squeeze past people just to get in it, and you can't see the bottom of the pool because it's literally opaque. It is utterly disgusting! The camp is in the middle of nowhere and if you need to visit the local shop then you must walk along a main road with no pavements facing oncoming traffic travelling at speed. The staff are UNBELIEVABLY RUDE which is laughable considering they work at a khazi like this, yet they still look down their nose at you for some odd reason. We went for food at the one single restaurant on site only to be told they don't have actual menus and everything is via a QR code and in Italian. The food was also below average and the staff just stand there and stare at you until you leave. I ordered a hot dog from the pool bar one day which took 25 minutes to be cooked and cost me €12 for that and a Coke. They then tried to charge me for ketchup and mustard. Sorry? There was a massive fight by the pool causing security to run all over the place and knock into my 6 year old knocking him over. The staff behind the bar saw this and started laughing - my wife had to physically drag me away at that point. Overall, please PLEASE DO NOT book this place. There's so many other wonderful places you could stay for much less. We ended up paying close to £2k for 6 nights at this hovel. To clarify - we stayed with Eurocamps not Hu so I can't comment on their packages but if Eurocamps are anything to go by then I would seriously do your research before booking. Eurocamps please do not offend me by replying to this post telling me you're "sorry we didn't have a great time" and making excuses for this hell hole you call a holiday camp, because I don't want to hear it and nothing you can say or do will give us a week of our lives back. Fabulous Holiday Village is diabolical in every sense of the word.

author: Jeppy
title: A beautiful experience but the cleanliness must improve
text:
I stayed with my family at the Fabulous Village at the beginning of August and it was a truly fantastic experience from every point of view. We had booked directly from the official Hu Openair website and we had such a good time that, just two weeks after the first vacation, we decided to return.

Not finding availability on the official website, we therefore made a second booking through an external tour operator, using the Campings.com website and through the tour operator homeair vacances 

On the day of arrival we arrived before the scheduled check-in time and I went to the Info Point to ask, in case our accommodation was already ready, if it would have been possible to check in early. Having a small child and an elderly person with us, it would have been really important for us.

I must give special praise to the girl with the Calabrian accent whose name I do not remember, at the home air eurocamp Info Point: she was extremely professional, helpful, and friendly. She personally committed herself to verifying the possibility of moving up our check-in and showed great attention to our needs. I truly thank her for the professionalism and kindness shown.

Unfortunately, however, the second experience was very disappointing regarding the cleanliness of the small house.

Upon our arrival, we found greasy pots with food residue inside, dirty cutlery, and, more generally, dishes that were truly very dirty. Even the cleaning tools for the small house were in unacceptable condition: the broom was so dirty that it could not be used, and the floor mop was in the same condition. The indoor table was in barely acceptable condition: it was so dirty that it felt sticky and greasy to the touch. A situation that left us particularly surprised and a bit disappointed, especially considering the excellent experience we had during our first stay. I am attaching only a few demonstrative photos.

It is a real shame, because the facility, the other services, and the organization were (and continued to be) so pleasing to us that they pushed us to return after just two weeks. Precisely for this reason, we expected the same level of care and attention this time as well.

I hope that this review, made with constructive and not polemical intent, can be useful to the facility to improve the inspection and cleaning of the accommodations before the arrival of guests, because the Fabulous Village really has all the characteristics to offer an excellent stay. Despite these details, I will always remain in love with this place.

author: Daniela
title: Positive experience, but with luck.
text:
Ferragosto week at hu fabulous, I wanted to take a risk despite the various negative reviews. Family trip with my husband, my celiac daughter, and my eighty-year-old father. 
Minimarket 
I'll start with a plus for the minimarket for the presence of basic gluten-free products (it's not always a given to find them, actually it's very difficult), with prices I would say fair for being in a resort (very kind staff).
Reception 
We booked an hu smart mobile home directly on the hu openair website. We did online check-in, as soon as we arrived (10:30 am) we got the keys to the house. (Very kind staff)
Assistance and cleaning 
Clean and comfortable mobile home with all the comforts, it had a broken hair dryer. 
I made a report via QR code and in five minutes flat the technician came, he was very kind, replaced the device, and adjusted the air conditioner to keep the house cool at all times.
Swimming pools 
The swimming pools are very beautiful, one umbrella for every four chairs. Despite the number of people and a very long initial line, we always found availability at any time. However, it opens at 10, I would say a bit too late (at other hu locations it's at 9). 
Staff and entertainment 
Kudos to the lifeguards and security; despite the crowd and guests who were not always polite, they always kept the pools clean and enforced the rules. Entertainment full of events and very talented guys. My daughter had a great time with dance lessons, games, and free workshops. (Even with outside artisans)
Holiday village 
Unfortunately, I have to confirm some reviews; I recommend paving the entire village. In our lane, there was dirt, and cars were speeding, kicking up a cloud of dust, even while we were eating. Furthermore, better signage for house numbers is needed; cars were driving around aimlessly, and many people were speeding (even some of the staff), which is very dangerous for children; more checks are needed. 
In other lanes, there were gatherings in the small houses with music and karaoke, and tables set up outside the mobile homes without any respect for the guests in the nearby houses. I have never seen all this in other villages, whether hu or not.
I confirm the absence of trees.
We had a good time looking for our corner of relaxation (on the lawn) at the pool, and our house was in a lane with polite guests, participating in almost all the entertainment activities. With evenings at the very nice free playground and a few jumps on the paid inflatable jumper. However, I would return in June or September to avoid taking any risks.

author: kezza345
title: Never again
text:
We stayed at the Hilton Garden Inn Central New York and, unfortunately, wish we had chosen somewhere else.

We are a family of four — two adults and two children — and the room was unbelievably small and cramped. When we first walked in, I genuinely wondered where the rest of the room had gone! There was barely enough space to move around, and we were constantly knocking our feet and legs against the side of the bed and chair because there simply wasn’t enough room.

I have travelled and stayed in plenty of hotels, but I have never stayed in such a small hotel room. Thankfully, we were out most of the day and evening, because spending much time in the room as a family would have been extremely uncomfortable. I asked reception whether there were any larger rooms available, but was simply told, “This is New York.” That really wasn’t a helpful response.

The elevators were another major issue. We only used them once during our four-day stay, to get our luggage up to the room, and after that we used the stairs because the wait was so bad. We were only on the 6th floor, so it was manageable.

However, on checkout morning, we had three large suitcases and three hand-luggage bags. We waited around 25 minutes trying to get an elevator, but couldn’t get on once. The elevators would bypass our floor, and when they did stop, they were already completely full. There are three elevators in the hotel, yet only two appeared to be working at a time, which is ridiculous for such a large hotel.

Eventually, after waiting around 25 minutes, we had no choice but to drag three large suitcases and all our hand luggage down six flights of stairs. It certainly wasn’t the end to our stay that we had hoped for.

Overall, we were extremely disappointed and definitely would not recommend this hotel for families. Perhaps it would be more suitable for a solo traveller who doesn’t need much space, but for a family of four, the room was simply not adequate.

Unfortunately, the hotel did not live up to our expectations or how it was advertised, and we would choose somewhere else if visiting New York again.

author: Mark S
title: Excellent hospitality
text:
Business travel can be stressful, but this Hilton made the entire experience feel effortless. From arrival through the rest of my stay, everything was handled in a way that allowed me to focus on the purpose of my trip rather than the logistics around it.

Herbie deserves special recognition. His professionalism, attentiveness, and genuine willingness to help made a noticeable difference. He anticipated needs, handled things smoothly, and created the kind of experience that makes a guest feel valued rather than simply accommodated.

That level of service is what people remember. Because of Herbie and the overall experience, this Hilton will be an easy choice for future business trips.

author: Evan A
title: My Stay in Hilton Central Park
text: I was greeted by a very warm and welcoming host with free points! Herbie was his name. He actually helped us get a deal to travel to other Hilton locations as well. From then on, I knew my stay would be amazing. Would recommend!

author: K P
title: Had a blast!
text: Herbie was absolutely fantastic! He was friendly, professional, and made us feel genuinely welcome. He went above and beyond to make our experience great. Hilton is lucky to have him!

author: TwoStorks
title: Great choice in Paris
text: The hotel is quite dated, however the location close to Place Vendome is unique. The hotel then has an interesting structure, with an enclosed courtyard with a conservatory where events and cocktails are often organized. The rooms are spacious enough. Overall a hotel that if booked with some offer (it is a 4 star but can easily get to cost like a 5 star depending on the period) is absolutely worth it.

author: Natali F
title: Elegant location, classic paris charm.
text:
You simply cannot beat the location. Nestled between the Louvre and Place Vendôme, it’s walking distance to many of Paris’s major landmarks, metro stations, and high-end shopping. Perfect for first-time visitors or anyone wanting to explore central Paris on foot.
”Normal” shopping isn’t around the corner, about 20 min walk you can reach Zara, HM, galerie laffayette etc. 

The decor of the hotel was classic. While the room was charming, some of the furnishings felt a bit dated, and the bathroom could use a refresh. We stayed in a two room suite but the rooms didn’t have proper closets. 
Room service was fast and food was better than expected.

author: christopher
title: Past its prime
text:
Second stay at Westin Vendome in a couple of years. My wife also stayed there during a state visit when it was the Intercontinental, which was in better shape.

The staff is nice and accommodating, general ‘public’ areas are relatively well maintained, but that’s about it. This hotel definitely went downhill since our last visit a couple of years ago, and especially since my wife stayed there during her work trip a while back. 

What’s unfortunate is that most issues with that hotel are easy fixes (e.g. broken toilet seat, really cheap curtains and curtain rods that have no place in a hotel like this, dust and crumbs from previous guests). Not to say that it doesn’t need a bit of an overhaul, but it’s amazing how a clean room without crumbs on the couch and coffee table, dental floss on the carpet, or broken toilet seat with rotten wood in the bathroom will leave you with a lasting and positive impression.

The good.
Excellent location, across the street from the Louvre Museum and Place Vendôme. 
Depending on your room, the outside view is amazing (both times we were in a suite, so I can’t speak for other rooms).

The bad.
Room felt (and was) dirty. I really hate to say this because staff was nice and tried hard, but our room was consistently dirty. 
Hotel is run down, compounded by a lack of maintenance and cleaning service. 
Both full baths in our room were severely worn and degraded.

This hotel has great potential. It has good bones and a strong foundation, but needs a facelift and a lot of care/maintenance. We will likely stay at Le Meurice next door during our next visit because the Westin isn't cheap, and I'm not sure it's worth the price anymore.

author: duckworthnw
title: Best Breakfast Buffet in Paris?
text: Loved the room. Very comfortable.  The breakfast was AMAZING! Eggs to order, great buffet---no complaints.  Breakfast seating and service was quick and attentive. Would definitely stay here again due to its location close to the metro lines and you can walk to the other side of the river on a foot bridge in just minutes.  Our taxi driver said it is closing for a 3-year renovation next week.

author: Shamit D
title: Poor stay
text:
Poorly lit lobby very old and poorly done up place. Dark and dingy feel as you enter the reception. When you zig zag and enter your room from the lift, the appearance of the room is of like a hostel bed. The only good thing is the balcony. But everything else is at just a stretch of a hand. There Aircon is from BC and takes the whole night to cool. The bar Tolliries (hopefully I have spelt the name correctly) is the good place. 
Overall experience was poor and unlike a Westin and a hotel with some stars.

author: vincent b
title: Comfortable Clean Convenient
text: Perfect hotel if you just need a simple clean comfortable hotel for a few days.Location great for metro,dining,supermarkets takeaways etc.Just off a very busy junction,and can be a bit 'lively' but for us that was part of the Paris experience.We had a room overlooking the main road with a magnificent view of Sacre Coeur as the sun went down ( a couple of chairs on the balcony would be great ! ) Overall,helpful staff, spotlessly clean with modern fittings ,and the luggage storage room is a godsend.Would stay again.

author: ge12345561
title: Good experience.
text:
The location was excellent with close transport links along with a McDonalds and pharmacy that is less than ten seconds from the hotel. The atmosphere was good with no noisy neighbours. The room had a broken plug socket on the right side of the bed and the shower was faulty which needs resolving. The value of the hotel in terms of price was reasonable. The cleanliness of the hotel was perfect with no issues identified. The service was also excellent. The amenities included two biscoff biscuits and french instant coffee which was delicious.

Overall, a good hotel which was in the perfect area close to a restaurant/hospital/police station/pharmacy and the service was very good. There was faulty plug sockets and shower head was faulty too.

author: Nelly D
title: An excellent stay
text:
Courteous and very professional reception.
Friendly, available, and attentive staff.
I was fortunate to be upgraded for free, which is always appreciated.
Calm, comfortable, functional, and very clean room
The air conditioning works perfectly
The room has a small fridge, which is very convenient during a heatwave, as well as a capsule coffee machine.
The breakfast is very decent.
Very convenient location surrounded by shops and right next to the subway in a very lively and friendly neighborhood.

author: fenp
title: Nice!
text: Nice hotel and the area is especially in summer a nice place to walk along the water

author: Lupuslooney
title: Decent price and area
text: Overall, good place and area to stay.  Lots of restaurants, bakeries and shops in close walking distance.  The only issue is the noise of the road, we were on the 8th floor at the front and emergency sirens were constantly gping past together with general people/car noise.  Be aware there is a nightclub and large bars just around the corner.  It's very clean, comfortable and most of the staff were helpful except the night porter.  Nice walk by the canal and Metro around the corner.

author: Akanksha C
title: Exceptional Stay with Outstanding VIP Service
text:
Our stay at Hyatt Regency Paris Étoile was fantastic from start to finish. The service throughout the property was top-notch, but the standout highlight was Jeanne from the VIP team. Her professionalism, warmth, and attention to detail elevated our entire experience. She went above and beyond to make sure every aspect of our visit was seamless and memorable, exemplifying true world-class hospitality.
The hotel’s location is unbeatable for navigating Paris. Being directly connected to the transit hub with seamless access to the Metro and RER train lines made exploring the city and getting to major sights completely effortless.
The lounge is another major highlight—exceptionally well-run, offering a relaxing atmosphere, great food and drink selections throughout the day, and breathtaking views over the city. It served as the perfect retreat after a long day of sightseeing.
Between the prime connectivity, fantastic lounge, and exceptional care from Jeanne and the team, this hotel exceeded all expectations. We will definitely return on our next trip to Paris!

author: Peter K
title: Excellent service at clean Paris hotel
text: Excelllent service - nice professional hotel. Clean room and bathrooms. Biggest negatives are that the rooms are a little small and the hotel has a very business/conference feel

author: Christine K
title: Paris trip 8/16/26 to  8/22/26
text:
Disappointed by How Our Family Emergency Was Handled

We arrived on August 16, 2026, as a group of four. We booked our reservation through Amex and reserved connecting family rooms. Breakfast was included for all four of us.

Unfortunately, we had a family emergency during our stay—my mother-in-law passed away unexpectedly. As a result, my husband and daughter had to leave immediately. We canceled one of our rooms, while my son and I stayed for the remainder of the trip.

After canceling the second room, we were told that our reservation had to be recreated and that breakfast was no longer included. This was very disappointing because our original reservation clearly included breakfast. I was never informed that canceling one room would result in losing our breakfast package.

I do not feel this was handled fairly or with much compassion, especially considering the circumstances our family was going through. I am also a World of Hyatt member, but unfortunately, I did not feel that this was taken into consideration. The manager was not friendly or understanding during a very difficult time for our family.

I understand that reservation changes may sometimes be necessary, but I believe the hotel could have handled this situation with much more care, flexibility, and compassion.

author: Simon
title: Definitely worth upgrading to the Eiffel Tower view and Club Access.
text: Stayed in the Hyatt Regency Paris Étoile for 3 nights with my wife and youngest daughter,  and had an outstanding experience.  We shared a room and while cosy, it was spotlessly clean and housekeeping were fabulous.  Some lovely little touches that make it an elevated experience.  The view was outstanding - we had opted for an Eiffel Tower view which from our room on Floor 31 was simply amazing!  The girls loved looking at it day and night out of the window, and was such a wonderful backdrop.  We also had gone for a Club room,  and this included access to the Regency Club which we couldn't recommend more highly.  A great breakfast service that set us up well,  and a wonderful place to stop by and spend some time in with drinks and snacks for a break from the sightseeing.  The staff there particularly were fabulous and always so efficient, helpful but not overbearing.  Thank you!

author: traveldad2018
title: At this reasonable price point, HRP deserves 5 stars
text: Small rooms and clean, you may be competing with tour groups and flight crews to get to your elevator.  Breakfast was quite nice, with eggs made to order.  Staff are generally very good.  I appreciated the option for vegetables/broccoli at breakfast (though for some reason the broccoli was not tasty).  Great views of the Eiffel Tower.  The 17th Arrondissement is nice but a bit away from the main drag (other than Arc de Triomphe) so there may be increased cost for Ubers or one may take the metro.  Would return to this hotel.

author: bru2026
title: Does not deserve its 3 stars
text:
The business rooms are adjacent to the elevator, so avoid them; you get the impression that other travelers are walking through your room (that said, I had been warned about this situation upon booking...). Soundproofing is almost nonexistent.
The shower and toilet are in the room, without any separating door, except for a curtain.
The room is tiny (ship cabin) and overlooks the back, which is dilapidated.
Average breakfast (no fruit salad, few different breads, butter and yogurts are not kept cold), the room is very cramped.
Staff friendliness varies depending on the person. The "breakfast manager" on her smartphone next to the customers.

What remains is the excellent location and the air conditioning, which is essential in summer.
Not worth the price, and certainly not its 3 stars.

author: hugoyvinec1
title: Decent stay, nothing more.
text: Decent stay overall. The hotel is well located and the staff is rather welcoming, but some points need improvement: room a bit aging (TV among others) and soundproofing could be better. The value for money remains decent without being exceptional. A suitable stay for a short stopover.

author: yboclet
title: Very good
text: Very good for everything. Just a slight, somewhat unpleasant smell of stagnant water upon waking, but otherwise everything was great!

author: zoulaitty68520
title: Very disappointing
text: I am not in the habit of leaving negative reviews, but the services here were too disappointing: a king-size bed was advertised when it was actually 2 beds pushed together; very, very low water pressure in the shower; a dusty coffee maker; the lady at the front desk was not friendly, and the gentleman in the evening did not deign to respond to our greeting... the only advantage of this hotel is the location, which is in the center of several beautiful places in Paris.

author: Naomi M
title: simply great
text: very clean. comfortable in everyway. location perfect for a stay in paris. functioning lift. a return stay will occur in the future.

author: Amy E
title: Great hotel
text:
From the moment we arrived early the staff were very friendly and helpful! They kept our luggage safe until we could check in later in the day. They have a spot for you to change after your flights and prepare for the day. 
The room was clean, well equipped and in good shape. We had a triple which worked out great with teenagers. I would 100% recommend this hotel to others. Lots of food and easy stops to walk to in the area. And an easy walk from the train and bus stop too.

author: Gianna B
title: 5 stars all around
text:
Perfect location for a trip to Rome. It was a 5 minute walk from the train station and had amazing restaurants at the corner of the street with amazing food and good prices. Trevi fountain, Spanish steps, the colosseum and many more historical sites were a 20-30 minute walk. The hotel itself was VERY clean and the bed was very comfortable which I appreciated after a long travel day. The staff was so friendly and nice, allowed a early check in since my room was ready when I got there at noon and securely held my bags for me so I could explore the city after check out and before my flight. I will for sure be back 

Small cons: very poor water pressure but that’s everywhere in Italy (didn’t bother me for a quick shower) and the rooms can get a little noisy with outside traffic but nothing crazy that altered my stay.

author: Vicki Lynn B
title: Great location, wonderful staff!
text: I booked this place based on its proximity to Roma Termini, and it was perfect from that perspective.  But it is also a sweet little hotel with staff who really want to be helpful (and are!).  The hotel even provides for some local experiences without additional fees, and we took the night tour around the Colosseum - it was fantastic!  Also, the breakfast was amazing.  I would book again if going to Rome, and highly recommend.

author: Lisa D
title: 5 star staff
text:
We stayed here for one night and found it to be an excellent choice. The location is ideal, just a short walk from the train station and within easy reach of many of Rome’s attractions.

From the moment we arrived, we received a warm and friendly welcome from the young lady on reception, who kindly upgraded us to a spacious room overlooking the Baths of Diocletian. The room was spotless, comfortable, and well equipped with everything we needed for our stay.

Breakfast was very good, with plenty of choice, and the member of staff looking after the breakfast service was welcoming and attentive.

This would have been a five-star review. Unfortunately, on our return to the hotel in the evening, we had an unpleasant encounter with two men in the street outside, We fully appreciate that this had nothing to do with the hotel and was completely beyond its control, so it does not reflect the quality of the accommodation or the excellent service we received throughout our stay.

Overall, we would happily recommend this hotel for its location, comfortable rooms, and outstanding staff.

author: Andresito77
title: Great experience and excellent assistance with the luggage
text:
We stayed at the Hotel Diocleziano and the experience was fantastic. The rooms are extremely comfortable, spotless in terms of cleanliness, and a noteworthy detail, they are very well soundproofed, which guarantees excellent rest after walking all day around the city.
The attention from the staff was very good and attentive at all times. One gesture that we greatly appreciated was that, on the day of our departure, they allowed us to securely store our luggage in a restroom so we could take one last leisurely stroll before leaving the city for good.
Without a doubt, a hotel highly recommended for its comfort, service, and attentiveness to the guest. A place to return!

author: Beth M
title: Great location
text: The location is so good! It is right by Notre Dame and there are so many restaurants around. The room was small but that is expected. The staff was nice.

author: ignaciomW6447BD
title: Impossible to sleep
text: Impossible to sleep due to the unbearable noise from the street. The receptionist was rude and unfriendly to the customers. Not worth returning

author: millie812
title: Noisy hotel
text: Very clean hotel but on a very noisy street.Bars,clubs noisy till 4am.My mistake.Spoiled weekend as everyone tired, o sleep.

author: zlegouteur
title: I slept in a dormitory with 3 single beds. The shower was 50 cm wide. No electrical outlet available.
text: Small and very mediocre comfort.

author: Jens B
title: Perfect location, great value for money
text:
Cozy, small hotel in the heart of the 5th.
Everything is nearby, the Metro/RER is almost at the door, Notre Dame, the Seine 😍
One can reach everything conveniently on foot.
The staff is very friendly and the rooms are clean.
When I am in Paris, I stay here; I can recommend it.

author: Maria Q
title: Excellent hotel
text: Excellent location, everything can be reached on foot and close to boarding points for everything, including the airport, friendly and helpful staff, both at the reception and in the breakfast room, clean rooms, soundproof window, no noise could be heard even though the street is always crowded, the breakfast room perhaps a little small to accommodate everyone, it may happen that you have to wait for a table but the very fast staff does everything to reduce waiting times, three ladies truly impeccable and very nice, everything perfect and I would return without thinking about it, much better than many 4-star hotels, I would only suggest maybe putting something in the shower because the marble on the floor with soap tends to make you slip and be dangerous

author: anthony b
title: Exceeded our expectations and more
text:
Absolutely superb location 
Wonderful room and fabulous warm and friendly staff

author: Beth M
title: Nice hotel convenient to the sights and water bus.
text: This is a nice hotel very centrally located in Venice with great access to San Marco Square and the water bus. The hotel staff were very friendly and helpful. Bed was comfortable and the water pressure was great - good supply of hot water. Despite being on a major walking area, the room was quiet. air conditioning worked very well which was essential in July. Breakfast was fine but I will say that you really don't need to pay the price for the breakfast - there are plenty of restaurants or bakeries around where you can eat for less money. The only drawback was that the room was quite small - no room to really put the suitcases other than on the floor and no desk. Although the hotel is on a canal you really can't see it from your room.

author: handalirma
title: Great
text: Room was nice, good Air conditioning, staff great. No Netflix in Italy except Rome

author: Alec Ward
title: Experience of Rome.
text:
The hotel was in a great location, close to the main Termini Train Station and in walking distance.

The room was cleaned every day and was comfortable. The downside was all the TV channels were in Italion, but that is part of the experience. The lift was abit clostrophobic, mamimum of 2 people with cases were allowed in it.

The breakfast menu gave you a cooked menu, cold meat and cheese section and a variety of cereals to choose from. Nearby street cafes provided evening meals and drinks.

The Termini train station has a good selection of restaurants to choose from.

I would recommend the San Marco hotel. Staff were helpful and spoke good english.

Rome has a lot to offer. Do your home work, find out where you want to see and what tours you wish to participate in and hopefully you will have as good a time as I did.

Enjoy a great city.

author: lavern s
title: DO NOT BOOK THIS HOTEL
text:
Do not book this hotel.  I booked through Booking.com and the full amount has been taken from my credit card and my booking confirmed with a receipt received.

I received this message from them and confirmation that they have cancelled my booking:
Our account has been compromised as a result of a cyberattack. Your reservation will therefore be cancelled, as it was made using a rate that was not authorized by our property and was generated following fraudulent access to our account.
Please do not click on any links you may receive.
We apologize for the inconvenience.
Kind regards.
Hotel Milton Roma

I am now left in a situation with flights paid for and no accommodation.  Terrible customer service and makes me wonder if they have had more demand and decided to put the room rates up.

author: Inês G
title: SCAM
text:
I was notified that the cancellation was due to an alleged cyberattack and the generation of an 'unauthorized rate due to fraudulent access'. As a consumer, I am completely unrelated to any security breaches, IT problems, or operational vulnerabilities in your system.
Under European consumer law, a confirmed booking constitutes a binding contract, and economic activity risks must be assumed by the provider, never by the customer.

With less than a month to go before the trip, in the peak of high season, the cancellation of this booking leaves me in an extremely vulnerable situation, without accommodation in an overcrowded city and with almost no viable options on the market for the price originally contracted.

The property has rooms available, so the refusal to honor the contract constitutes a clear breach of consumer rights. 

Furthermore, I would like to inform you that I have previously attempted to contact you via message, but have received no response to date.

author: Carlos P
title: Excellent hotel to know Rome!
text: Hotel with an excellent location, almost in the centre of Rome, with a metro exit to the door as well as bus and tram stops. A 15-minute walk from the Coliseum! Very varied breakfast and friendly employees. There is a bar on a very nice small terrace. Very spacious room.

author: Rhayza R
title: Included breakfast was quite good!
text: I stayed with my family at this hotel in two rooms because there were five of us; the hotel is quite central and very conveniently located near the subway station, the rooms were clean and the other areas as well. The included breakfast was the best and quite varied; the aspect they should improve is the quality of the shampoo and adding hair conditioner.

author: Eloise S
title: Would definitely come back!
text: Great location. Great service in the hotel restaurant from Ehsan!

author: alex v
title: Wonderful staff
text: I visited NY with my dad and this Hilton was in a really convenient spot in the heart of the city, not also was the hotel in perfect conditions but also the staff turned out to be really nice people that make sure you have the best stay possible. Special thanks to Luis M :)

author: Lauren W
title: Our Trip
text: Beds could be slightly bigger. Breakfast was excellent and Mahbub was excellent serving and checking in on us. The butter was to hard as it was on ice, you had to leave it for a while till it was useable. The cleanliness was pretty good nothing was unclean. Noise level could be better as you can hear through rooms of conversations and hoovers. Location is brilliant easy access to subway and shops. Atmosphere was very good. Value isn’t expensive it’s affordable.

author: Karen L
title: Had a blast in NYC!
text:
The Hilton Midtown Manhattan was my family’s choice on a recent trip to New York City.
The location was great near Time Square and Radio Music  Hall. The staff was friendly and accommodating, they also notified me when my Amazon package arrived at the front desk, all at a great price. We plan to return in the Fall!

author: YuriNgn
title: Great location. Walking distance to central park
text: 5 stars for Virdell exceptional service and the hotel location only.

author: りょうま 西
title: Good service
text:
MAHBUB is good service!

彼は愛想良くコーヒーを注いでくれました。
とても気分がいい朝を過ごせました。

He poured the coffee with a friendly manner.
I had a wonderful start to the morning.

author: Andy B
title: Great stay.
text: A great stay at the Tower Bridge Hotel. Staff were great, in particular Helena and Maria. Looking forward to returning sometime.

author: Passenger39656946547
title: Great Hotel and Location
text: Great hotel, team are very responsive and personable.

author: LG
title: Our go to London Hotel
text: We stayed for two nights at our usual London hotel and the experience was excellent as always. The only gripe was that when checking in at 15:00 there were many rooms which had not been cleaned and were not available, including ours. We got into our room at about 15:45 after being offered a free drink in the bar. Breakfast is excellent as is the offering in the executive lounge

author: Thomas E
title: Just Hati Great
text: Hati in the exec lounge was a star! Competent, friendly. Wonderful smile and great service! I often stay in Hiltons but this was so much better than  e.g. Zurich

author: Oliver H
title: Best London Hotel!
text: The Hilton London Tower Bridge is one of our favourite Hotels ever! Especially Hati has made our stay extremely comfortable. She has welcomed us into the Executive Lounge every time we have stayed here, and has never made us miss anything. Thank you to the whole team!

author: JJ F
title: Checkin
text: Shuma was very kind to facilitate our early check in

author: Ginger P
title: Exceptional service, staff, and location
text: Everything was absolutely spectacular! We arrived early in the morning and everyone was exceptionally friendly and helpful from finding breakfast and storing our luggage so we could explore some - hotel location was in the heart of everything. Shuma was an angel and we were able to check us in a bit early and gave us a great room with a view. Top notch service and experience. 10/10 recommend!

author: Paul N
title: First stay - not disappointed!
text:
Having dined here many times, this was our first time staying overnight, and it exceeded expectations. 

Despite the hotel being fully booked and preparing for an upcoming restaurant renovation, the staff were exceptional from start to finish. Nothing was too much trouble, especially while catering to our group for my birthday. 

The location is perfect, ideal for exploring the South Bank and central London, but far enough off the main path to avoid the heavy hustle and bustle. We look forward to returning to see how the new restaurant and breakfast menu evolve in this unique hotel.

author: John G
title: A great place to stay in Central London.
text: Wonderful hotel so close to it all, with beautiful views of St Paul's Cathedral. Near Embankment and Waterloo stations. Friendly staff, great breakfast. Highly recommend.

author: Mark T
title: The Best.
text: Absolutely amazing staff that could not be kinder or more helpful special shout out to Miles we will miss the morning smile for sure, Sea Cintainers made our stay incredible could not be more appreciative.

author: dm90
title: Great location and a modern and clean hotel
text:
Stayed in a cosy room (queen room) on the 5th floor. 

Pros:
- location is excellent
- everything feels new and tastefully done
- bathroom is small, but really well done 
- staff attentive and visible
- very clean
- good desk and WiFi for working 

Negatives:
- room was small (but tbf standard enough size for London)
- mattress was ridiculously soft, just sitting on it had you nearly on the floor
- breakfast was (surprisingly) quite disappointing. The way it works if it’s included in your room rate is unnecessarily complicated (you can choose a combination of certain items) and if you want a full English you can only have it with coffee and juice, no fruit or a single pastry. Really?!

All in all I would stay again and recommend it.

author: Hollie S
title: Gorgeous hotel, great location,
text:
The hotel & rooms are gorgeous & clean. The rooms were lovely & cool during a London heatwave and very quiet. The beds were so comfortable and cosy. Great location. 

Didn’t get the see the rooftop as it was booked for a private event, we would have liked to be made aware of this prior to arrival as we planned to spend our first evening there. 

Unfortunately we didn’t qualify for the weekend pass that we saw advertised as we booked 4 days before arrival and it needed to be 5 days before. We didn’t feel this was fair but rules are rules I suppose! Had we qualified for the restaurant credit we would have dined there but we went somewhere else instead. We were offered an upgrade and an amenity but we didn’t get them and couldn’t be bothered to cause a fuss.

author: Revanth R
title: Perfect Stay
text:
Staff were incredibly friendly, and I had a wonderful stay. The room was cosy, and I was delighted to receive a complimentary upgrade. Mohammed was especially kind and helpful, arranging the late-night upgrade and recommending some great food options.

A big thank you to Mohammed for going above and beyond and making my stay so enjoyable. Kudos to the team!

The only suggestion would be to consider keeping the bar and restaurant open a little later, as they currently close quite early.

author: Charlie
title: Great Stay!
text: The location was amazing. The staff were lovely. We were celebrating our engagement and were upgraded and had a card in the room. The room was immaculately clean and well decorated. The bar and restaurant looked great but we did not have time to check it out. Would recommend to anyone staying in Shoreditch!

author: jasichel
title: wonderful stay!
text: highly recommend: wonderful lobby with a lively atmosphere; kind helpful staff; comfortable bed with luxurious sheets & pillows; spotlessly clean and smelled wonderful; lovely products.

author: M B
title: More like poor youth hostel quality
text: The website looks promising but in reality the hotel is very dated and dirty. The room we stayed in was actually very poor. Located directly on the street side. During our stay it was very hot and the air conditioning wasn't working properly. The only solution was to open the windows at night but there was so much noise from the street (restaurant across the street cleaning up in the middle of the night shuffeling tables around and a homeless guy residing in a tent directly outside the hotel who made a lot of noise) we couldn't sleep well. The room was really small too making it a challenge to move around. Very small bathroom. Broken soap dispensers. Toilet that didn't flush very well with a reservoir that took ages to fill back up. Door closers that shut the door with a loud bang. Breakfast is very simple and below average. This is more like youth hostel quality. Not recommended.

author: Mirco F
title: Lamentable
text:
Very disappointing experience, mainly because of the receptionist's attitude. Upon my arrival, I was not assigned the room category I had paid for. When I pointed it out, the receptionist had the nerve to tell me that, given the price paid, "I should be happy." Such a remark from an employee is simply unacceptable.

I immediately contacted the reservation center. With proof in hand (photos upon arrival), they refunded me 30% of the stay, thus confirming that the room did not correspond at all to my reservation.

On the second day, I had to change rooms because I had booked twin beds. The receptionist refused to make things easier for me, claiming that it was "not the same room type." In the end, they made me move to a twin room that was identical in every way to the previous one, with the exception of the two beds. A blatant lack of professionalism and goodwill.

author: Sylvie1403
title: Address to remember
text:
We stayed 4 nights in this hotel last week, in 2 different rooms, nothing to complain about.
recently renovated room and bathroom with taste, very clean, air-conditioned. The breakfast is quite good (savory, sweet, yogurts, compotes, fruits,...). The staff is helpful and smiling. The hotel is 500 m from the subway station. The most notable aspect during this heatwave is the availability of a refrigerated water fountain, an espresso machine, a slushie maker, and a small fresh juice fountain at the reception. The only small remark would be about the price when booking several nights; the price is not discounted or a bit cheaper.

author: Journey03988771654
title: A nightmare with entire hotel air condition broken down for five days
text:
Checked in on 24 May, found that air con not working.  Called reception and no one pick up the phone.  Went down and the receptionist said air con in some rooms broken down.  Another guest said it has been 3 nights since she checked in and it was still not fixed. The receptionist said someone will fixed it 8am tomorrow. 
Second day another receptionist said no one is coming to fix the air con.  I asked if we can change to a room with air con.  He said cannot because the rooms are occupied and full.  I said you are still selling room online.   Then he said the manager will come back at 8am.  Then later said 10am, then said today is bank holiday and not coming back. You can check out and get refund. 
In the afternoon, asked another receptionist, she said actually the entire hotel had no air con.  It’s hopeless and now 1:47am, still unable to sleep.  Totally lost of enjoyment.

author: Abc
title: Good - would stay again
text: I would stay again.  I slept really well - nice bed.  The rooms are typical Paris (basic and small).  Great location as well.  The only negative would be the guy who works reception - such a miserable, surly and awful human being.  He should do himself (and customers) a favour and find another job.

author: Annette H
title: First timer
text: From the first interaction to the last, the staff was extremely helpful, friendly , and professional. Our room was gorgeous and the included breakfast very tasty and filling. As an American on my first trip to Rome, I’m glad this was our hotel.

author: Thomas S
title: Always a quiet oasis in the middle of the Roman hustle and bustle
text: We have been to the hotel several times now and it is always wonderful there. We look forward to it every time and have never been disappointed.

author: Juliana L
title: Very central, safe and clean
text: Great central and safe location—easy to walk around, with plenty of restaurants and shops nearby. The property was very clean, the breakfast was lovely, and the staff were friendly and courteous. Overall, a wonderful stay!

author: Jossie R K
title: Awesome hotel
text: Nice, clean place. Staff are very curious, and helpful. Breakfast is awesome, lots of food choices.

author: Vicki N
title: Vacation trip
text: Beautiful hotel, amazing staff, delicious food and drinks.

author: James R
title: The best
text: Omg words cannot describe how wonderful this hotel is. From start to finish the team did an amazing job. The hotel is a museum literally and the rooms impeccable. I highly recommend it!

author: CuriousMeMelbourne
title: BEST boutique hotel suites - location and service 10/10
text: As a solo female traveller, this is the BEST place to stay in Rome. Enter through a secure door (with intercom) right on Piazza Di Spagna (safe street) and you are safe inside private courtyard of courtyard of hotel, take life to level 3 (no problem with bags) and your beautiful reception team will be there to greet you like family! Fresh, contemporary hotel with beautiful artwork, and the rooms superb. Location fantastic close to everything and so safe to walk day and night. Service 10/10 with helps on what’s app to reception team when you are out and about. Highly recommend, love to return if lucky to be in beautiful Rome again. Thankyou for looking after me so kindly.
