author: Nicola G
title: Something quite special
text:
Piazza di Spagna 9 is a wonderfully unique boutique hotel and an absolute gem in Rome. Stylish, comfortable, cool and beautifully appointed, it has a fantastic location that makes it the perfect base for exploring the city.

But the real star of the show is the exceptional customer service. From the moment we booked, everything was arranged seamlessly for us — restaurant reservations, airport transfers, private tour guides and more. Every recommendation was excellent, every driver and guide was of an incredibly high standard, and everything happened exactly when and as promised.

What particularly stood out was the attention to detail. Each morning we received a thoughtful email checking that we knew exactly where we needed to be and what we were doing that day. It made the whole trip feel completely effortless, while still being incredibly personal.

The entire team genuinely cared about making our stay special, and it showed in every interaction. All the other rave reviews are thoroughly deserved.

A very special thank you to the whole team at Piazza di Spagna 9 for looking after us so brilliantly and helping to make our trip to Rome so memorable. We wouldn't hesitate to stay again and recommend it wholeheartedly.

author: Jay M
title: Incredible Experience
text: The single best customer service experience I have ever had at a hotel.  Truly exceptional and a really unique and stylish hotel experience

author: alfonso
title: The greatest stay in Rome
text:
A chance last minute discovery i booked spagna9 and I will now never go anywhere else when staying in Rome.
Located on the Spanish steps.
Amazing.
The rooms are immaculately appointed the service first rate.
Atmosphere that offer a modern tranquil setting.

Franco and his team were nothing short of extraordinary.
No request was too difficult we had planned nothing and franco sat with us got a taste of what we liked and planned tours and restaurants that exceeded our expectation. The tours were so unexpected. I have been to Rome 12 times and never experienced Rome the way franco showed us. 
A must stay and experience the hidden gems of Rome like never before.

author: Paul Leenaerts
title: seeks a vibrant base in the heart of Manhattan.
text:
citizenM New York Times Square is a very trendy hotel in a prime location, just off Times Square. The room was very small, but smartly decorated and equipped with everything you need for a city trip. The hotel is quite pricey, but unfortunately that seems to be fairly normal in New York.
What really makes this hotel special is the amazing rooftop bar with stunning views of the city. The staff was very friendly and helpful. An ideal choice for those seeking a modern, vibrant base in the heart of Manhattan.

author: Accrosstheglobe
title: Go to!
text: Top-notch hotel despite the size of the rooms, but which is largely compensated for by its geographical location (150m from Times Square), the rooms are very well equipped and offer all the necessary comfort and modernity. Very welcoming staff, quick, simple, and efficient check-in!

author: ahjumaof2
title: Ok, but not our style
text: When you check in, a human asks you to please use a kiosk pad. The human standing there will offer help if you need it. We hung out in the area they call the “living room” a few times, and always saw people waiting to check in so I doubt many get early check in. As a gold Marriott member we did not but we did receive late check out.  The young woman we asked seemed to forget who she was helping and neglected to get back to us to confirm our request so we did have to follow up twice. Rooms were reminiscent of European size. There’s a drawer beneath the bed with extra pillows so if you take them out, you can fit a carryon inside to lay flat. If you have two people, there are two slim closets so it is possible to stand another luggage inside. We were not troubled by the lack of floor space for luggage, we made do but the funky smell of the shower curtain with a lack of ventilation in the small bathroom area was off putting.  If they hope to save energy, the button for the curtains on the wall and the iPad caused us to often mistakenly lower the blackout curtains and turn off all lights so unfortunately they didn’t save energy on us. The iPad controlled the lights, tv and shades. We opted to have one person sleep along the wall and one access to get out of the bed easily. You could sleep with both heads towards the window and then both have to scoot out of the bed. The breakfast was a 4/5 for us. Better than a Hampton level. Rooms are a little cramped and not much human interaction if you’re a regular traveler and  in your 40s or 50s.  I called the hotel a few times before our stay but never got through to a human. It was an anniversary stay but no special acknowledgement. Gym has some free weights, ellipticals, and treadmills. Overall, it was a fine stay but likely more comfortable for single travelers. Ok stay, great location if you want to be in the middle of Times Square. Personally, I like staying up towards 56th St even if going to see Broadway shows. Remember, every 10 city streets (not avenues) Is about 1/2 mile. Good luck with your research and stay!

author: Jerome D
title: Ok, but unlikely to stay here again.
text:
Major complaints:  They have a tiny ironing room on the second floor with one iron!  I understand not having them in the rooms - sets off the fire alarms.  But we intentionally did not pack a travel iron because we were led to believe it would not be an issue. Surprise! 
Secondly, the room barely got comfortably cool. Cut the unit down to 64. Doubt it got below 72, and the rooms in NYC are tiny! Day temps were high 80s, low temps 68-70. No excuse not to be able get comfortable on a room facing North!
Look at some of the recent three star reviews for elaboration and other room complaints. 
  I will say the proximity to mostly everything in Manhattan from the museums to the shows to shopping can't be beat. If you are a walker and have time, you can literal walk down south to the WTC and up north to top of Central Park, which has the major museums on either side of it.

author: torv213
title: Form over human function - Not good for couples
text:
I live a modern and minimalist lifestyle, so while I appreciate the concept, the execution and communication are poor in terms of what you expect and what you get. 

I expect a king-size bed with two sides accessible by each person, not a waist-high bed that you have to climb over and climb over your partner, especially when she has rheumatoid issues. I asked for a handicap room, but none were available until the next night, and it was too much bother to pack up and move.

I expect you to be able to drop garbage into the garbage can, not have to do a hand hook shot to get into the bin under the desk. Looks sleek there, but not functional.

I expect wall switches to have signs/symbols that indicate how they work. For future guests, you have to toggle the switches three times to get full lights.

I expect an actual bathroom wall and door, not a shower curtain separating me and my wife from the toilet and shower. Yes, we're a couple, but nobody wants to hear anyone else's business. Related, I expect a wall light for the bathroom, not an iPad control console to turn on the light at night. Seriously?

I expect drawerS. Not one giant drawer for two people, which also happens to be filled with extra pillows, and those have to be stored somewhere else.

I could go on, but the bottom line is that this room is form over function. Beautiful and modern, great location, friendly staff, but humans didn't design the rooms or sleep in it. More like a banker who wanted to pack in as many rooms into a floor and fit in a king bed. Maybe it's okay for one person younger than 40, but for couples and everyone who wants an intuitive room design, pass.

author: M Richards
title: Hilton Garden Inn Chelsea Stay
text: Jesus and Joseph were very nice, welcoming, and accommodating. They take a lot of pride in their jobs and it was very appreciated.

author: Brianna Z
title: BEWARE – Extremely disappointing customer service, a very suspicious experience, and a complete lack of follow-up!!!
text:
I have never left a negative review in my life, but this experience was the most frustrating thing I’ve ever dealt with at a hotel.

My friends and I stayed here for a weekend in May. After housekeeping serviced our rooms, several of us later realized we each had clothing items missing. At first, we assumed we had simply misplaced them because we’ve never had anything like this happen at a hotel before. However, after returning home and completely unpacking, the missing items were nowhere to be found. The items had all been left in bags that were left open in our rooms, and we are 100% sure we packed them.

I understand that mistakes can happen, so I called the twice front desk and left a voicemail for housekeeping. I also emailed the general manager two separate times over the course of several weeks. I never received a single response, aside from the front desk informing me that there was nothing in lost and found and that the person previously in charge of housekeeping was no longer with the hotel.

At this point, I don’t expect to recover my belongings. What was most disappointing wasn’t even the missing items — it was the complete lack of acknowledgment or effort to investigate or respond. Being ignored after multiple attempts to contact management is unacceptable.

The location is decent, but the rooms themselves were old. The customer service was by far the biggest issue. I would strongly encourage guests to keep their luggage zipped and valuables secured, and I personally would not stay here again.

author: Cynthia O
title: Do not include breakfast in the daily
text:
Positive points: there is microwave and fridge bar in the room, it is well located, the 28th subway station is in the same quarter of the hotel, facilitating the transportation. The bathroom has a good size, the large sink facilitates the storage of hygiene products. It has a board to pass clothes and iron, which also helps the guest. Comfortable bed. I stayed on the last floor (24th), room 2408, and had a pretty view of the city.
Negatives: I contemplated daily breakfast, but the items served were few and very basic, little variety, providing industrialized breads. There wasn't even cheese and colds.  Every day was served the same thing, which was unpleasant for a long stay as was mine (more than 20 days). In addition, although I already paid for the coffee, I was charged a slice every day, which weighs a lot on the budget. I checked several guests not understanding this procedure of forwarding the bill on the already paid breakfast.  Sure it would be more worth having had breakfast in the various places in the vicinity, which has more variety and lower cost. There was an incident in my room that made me very upset, which was the removal of a bag containing new clothes with label, which was on the opposite side of the trash basket. It is assumed that the maid thought it was garbage, as the garbage remained in the room. However, the management only regretted and did not offer any compensation for the loss. This never happened to me before, I was very upset, but I didn't want to fight and ruin my vacation.
Moreover, the shower was weak, the bathroom tap had little water flow, small bath towels. The bedding was also a little worn out.

author: Howard W
title: Good & Bad
text:
I apologized for my late review.  I was there on July 15-20, 2026 (5 days/nights for H. Wong in Rm. 2402).  There were some good and bad.  I will start with the good - great staff with excellent customer service skills including Reception (Fatima & Tamarin); Bags for Storage (Black & Asian males - sorry, I didn't get their name); AND Housekeeping Staff!  Now the bad - bathroom sink wasn't work properly; waited for 2+ hours for Engineer to show up after a couple of follow-up calls due a "no-show" for 30 minutes and another 30 minutes - their explanation "he is on lunch break; he is on his way back; etc.).  I finally went downstairs to Reception to ask for Engineer again for the 4th time (again, waited for 2+ hours already).  Reception contacted the Engineer again - Engineer miraculously show up immediately.  Then the Engineer was unable to fix the problem.  I didn't have the energy and patience to request for another room - most likely it was a full-house that weekend.  Also, I had to go down to 3 different floors (not all floors have an ice machine) for the ice machine located on the 9th floor (19th, 16th & 12th - all 3 were "out of order" with no signs posted)

After my stay, I filled out the survey HGI sent to my email address.  I filled out the survey with my above comments - complimenting the wonderful staff and my disappointments (bathroom sink, ice machines, etc.).  I suggest complimentary points due to the inconveniences - I am one of their faithful and loyal HH members.  After submitting the survey back to HGI, I have not heard back from them about complimentary points.  I am hoping the General Manager who reads some of these comments from TripAdivsor will respond back to me.  You can look up my personal info from the 1st paragraph on reaching out to me about the complimentary points.  Looking forward to hearing back from you - thank you in advance for your consideration.  Respectfully from a loyal and faithful HH members, HW.

author: Nan TMS
title: A place to be close to everything and comfortable.
text:
The good:
- The hotel has a privileged location
- Walking distance to the subway, Madison Square Garden, and other places
- Clean
- Good TV service and signal
- Acceptable WiFi
- Excellent front desk service
- Attentive staff
- A shout-out to the person who stores your luggage if your room is not yet available, a person who chats and always remembers your name!
- The room clean and the AC working
- Clean bathroom
- The cleaning staff is attentive and they do not take anything from the room
- Our room with a nice view of the city

The bad:
- The shower water temperature could not be regulated consistently; it went from cold to boiling, but it was not unbearable, just surprising, and we did not have the energy or desire to ask for a room change.

A bit expensive, but of the available hotels, it had the best price, considering the location

author: Monika Flexeder
title: Wonderful
text: A magical view to enjoy while visiting the bar. Fantastic bar area with great decor on the 35th floor, serving excellent drinks. Great advice on the drinks, very friendly staff and excellent service. See you soon.

author: Reyhan S
title: Absolutely beautiful
text:
Absolutely exceptional 5-star experience!

From the moment we arrived, the staff was incredibly friendly, welcoming, and attentive. The personal service truly stood out and made us feel special throughout our stay. The hotel was spotless, beautifully maintained, and exceptionally clean.  The smell was I incredible.  I would love to know if I could purchase the fragrance they use.  

The food was fantastic, with everything we tried being fresh, delicious, and beautifully presented. And the view was absolutely amazing—the perfect place to relax and take in the surroundings.

The location couldn’t have been better either. It was convenient to everything we wanted to see and made getting around so easy.

Overall, this hotel exceeded our expectations in every way. Amazing staff, delicious food, immaculate rooms, breathtaking views, and a perfect location. We would absolutely stay here again and highly recommend it to anyone looking for a true 5-star experience! 🌟I

author: Fay B
title: Amazing
text: We went for drinks here it was so lovely the bar staff and waiters are so frendly and inviting the cocktails that Johnathan makes are amazing to watch sit there with your drinks and nuts and watch the view was amazing thanks

author: Alice Zorzénone
title: Average at best — disappointing stay
text:
We had high expectations for Shangri-La London, but unfortunately our experience was average at best. The main positives were the room itself and the spectacular views, which were both lovely. Sadly, the rest of the experience fell well short of what we expected from a luxury hotel.

The furniture and décor in the communal areas, particularly the restaurant, bar and wellness area, felt tired and dated, with some pieces looking noticeably worn and heavily used. This detracted from the overall sense of luxury and made the hotel feel in need of a refresh.

We had booked the stay as a restful break, but the poor sound insulation made that difficult. We were woken around midnight by children yelling in the surrounding rooms, which was particularly frustrating when you are expecting a peaceful stay.

Interactions with some employees, particularly at breakfast and in the bar, also felt awkward and lacked the warmth and level of service we would expect from a hotel of this standard.

The biggest disappointment was the wellness area. It was poorly maintained and looked dirty, with visible dust and dirty towels. Combined with the tired surroundings, it felt more like a communal swimming pool than a luxury hotel wellness facility.

Having recently stayed at other luxury hotels, including Aman Tokyo and Hotel Okura Tokyo, the contrast was particularly striking. The attention to detail, upkeep, service and overall sense of luxury at both properties were on a completely different level. By comparison, Shangri-La London felt several steps behind.

We raised our concerns with the reception team, who acknowledged the issues and, as a gesture of goodwill, removed the £90 service charge. We appreciated this, but it did not change our overall impression of the stay.

Overall, the combination of poor sound insulation, inconsistent service and tired communal and wellness areas means we would not return.

author: Sabrina L
title: Breathtaking!
text:
Our stay at the Shangri-la was amazing! The staff were so incredibly helpful, especially the concierge team (Matt and Saji) and the managers. 

They truly made the birthday experience wonderful and accommodated my allergy very well.

author: Loucas M
title: Incredible and affordable
text:
I think it was a very good experience with incredible service. Our door wouldn't open anymore because of a technical problem, but they were there the whole time and found a solution quickly. View of the Eiffel Tower, very close to many monuments, I recommend you go there if you are on vacation. The price is very affordable and the room is large enough. 
Thank you very much for this service!

author: Amel
title: Very good address!
text:
The location of the hotel and the fact that the reception is open 24/7 were essential criteria for choosing this establishment. I was not disappointed.
Hotel located opposite the RER B Port Royal station, very good when traveling alone to the Stade de France...
Great welcome and service, a very attentive team that does its best to take requests into account and make the stay as pleasant as possible.
Continental breakfast with very good products.
Single room sufficient for staying a few nights for those who do not plan to spend their day at the hotel, otherwise it may seem a little small.
No air conditioning in the hotel but fans in the rooms.

A big thank you to the team for their welcome and for this stay!

author: Sylvie B
title: Great experience
text: From the reception, to the kitchens for breakfast, to the maintenance of the rooms, the staff was helpful, smiling, and competent.  The room was very clean.

author: Valentina R
title: Suffocating heat
text:
The hotel's location is certainly its strong point: convenient for reaching the main attractions and well-served.
Unfortunately, however, our experience was not positive. The room was really very small and the bathroom was extremely cramped, so much so that even the simplest movements were difficult.
The absence of air conditioning, especially during the hottest days, made the stay uncomfortable. Usually at night, so much so that we spent 2 sleepless nights, only a fan was present, which unfortunately simply moved hot air without offering any real relief. If they cannot install motors for air conditioning, they should organize themselves with other machines that allow one to be comfortable in the room.
Another aspect that we would have liked to know before booking is that, to reach some rooms, the elevator only goes up to the fifth floor: the last floor must be walked with suitcases. It is a detail that may seem secondary, but that would be useful to specify during the booking phase.
For the location it certainly deserves appreciation, but, considering the overall comfort of the room and the services offered, personally I would not choose to stay in this hotel again.

author: Roci G
title: Centrally located hotel and very cool views
text: Very well-connected hotel, the room was very clean and the staff was very friendly.

author: hum2008
title: Fab staff
text: It was very clean hotel, staff were so welcoming and polite. Very close to the metro literally just outside the hotel so convenient if u get the metro pass.

author: Explore35876029671
title: Good hotel
text: First-class rooms. Good cleanliness and service.

author: chayes2k
title: HOTEL STAY
text:
I had an excellent stay at First Hotel Paris Tour Eiffel, defined by both comfort and exceptional service. Prior to my arrival, the hotel was highly responsive and accommodating regarding my personal needs, which immediately set a reassuring tone for my visit.
From check-in through each day of my stay, the staff consistently delivered a level of professionalism and warmth that is truly uncommon. Every interaction—whether at reception or in the breakfast room—was marked by genuine courtesy and attentiveness.
The room was impeccably clean and well maintained, with efficient air conditioning and fresh, well-prepared breakfast offerings each morning. The hotel’s location is also a standout feature, with convenient metro access directly across the street, making it effortless to navigate the city.
While the rooms reflect the typical, more compact Parisian style, the overall experience is elevated by the hotel’s thoughtful service and prime location. I would gladly return and confidently recommend this hotel to anyone seeking a comfortable and well-managed stay in Paris.

author: Ciro N
title: Paris with family
text: We had an amazing experience at this hotel. WiFi could be a little better but nothing to ruin our trip. Perfect

author: robbieroc
title: Good overall
text:
Was a nice hotel beautiful decor in waiting rooms friendly helpful staff with a smile 
Positioned in a good area city centre not to far if hiring a uber
cafes & bakery close by for yr morning 🥐 & ☕️.
Room bed was very comfy & they have windows so u can open for sunny fresh air

author: anita p
title: Very nice abd cleab hotel, staff very kind, easy access to city center with bus
text: Hotel rooms was very big, comfy bed, very clean, free access to Spa center, available parking and very good assortiments for breakfast

author: Punarvasu
location: National Capital Territory of Delhi, India
title: Modern hotel with a great bar
text:
If you want bigger rooms with great service, stay here. We were offered complimentary drinks at the bar and the bartender made great drinks. We had issues with the room AC and the staff promptly upgrade a triple room with 2 rooms.
Location is good with local restaurants and supermarket nearby.

author: Chili
title: Perfect stay.
text:
The structure is definitely huge, but despite this, it is not overwhelming and is actually welcoming and hospitable.  Just 10 minutes by taxi from Piazza Navona, so the location is convenient. 

Spacious, clean, and comfortable rooms. We took one with a balcony, and the outdoor space is very large and pleasant, 
despite the view not being the best because it overlooks an abandoned area. 

Very good food (varied breakfast of decent quality), excellent bar with cold dishes and tasty snacks, well-maintained and quality restaurant. 

Brand new spa area, well-equipped and perfect for a relaxing break. 

Indoor parking, covered, included in the price, is spacious and easily accessible. 

The highlight: the staff is extremely courteous, available, professional, and well-prepared. Both at the reception and in the dining area. Truly everyone is impeccable. 

Pets are allowed and especially welcomed without any additional charge. 

Highly recommended.

author: Buongustaio
title: Great for business in the EUR area.
text: Unexpectedly elegant, spacious rooms, quiet large bathroom, and truly professional staff. Breakfast is also good. A little far from the metro.

author: gila2010
title: I felt important!
text:
The 5-star rating is thanks to the staff who, from check-in to check-out, were extremely kind and made me feel important. Large and spacious structure, fantastic room in terms of size and functionality. They granted me an upgrade and I found fresh fruit and wine in my room. Complete breakfast that can satisfy everyone; a gem that is rarely seen anymore: a coffee machine like in a café with a barista included!!! 
Strategic location for my tastes, parking included. I will definitely return next time. Congratulations to everyone.

author: RT R
title: Small, basic and clean
text:
Me and my daughter stayed in room 503 for 2 nights. Like all city rooms it’s small but this is pretty small. The balcony window is nicer the lift wasn’t working for 2-3 days so that was a mountain to go up and down a few times a day. Inc with luggage 
We didn’t have breakfast, but there is a Starbucks and Mac Ds just down the road. Really good location near the metro. 
They asked me before our stay if it was for a special occasion and it was my daughter’s 16th birthday: nothing extra was done so not sure why they asked. Other hotels have put something nice on previously.
Air con worked, hairdryer was good. Tv just bbc news or CNN news for English channels. 

There was drinks in the lobby area but no prices or information: 
I wanted some extra milk, they didn’t understand and I tried to ask them about the metro tickets - but not helpful again. 
Bonus was they looked after our luggage on the day of leaving. 
It’s clean, basic an near a metro

author: Nina K.
title: Would not recommend! Way better options in the neighborhood.
text:
The location of this hotel is great. Very central and close to everything (Gare du Nord, Pigalle, Mont Martre, le Marais, etc)
But thats about it. It’s just a bedroom in a boring street (with a club next door) The reception is ok, but the cleaning team is horrible. They started to make noise at 7:30. Loud phonecalls in the hallway, discussions amongst eachother, knocking on the door 2x times while the ‘do not disturb’ sign is up, vacuuming in the early morning in front of your door, not cleaning the towels while dirty, etc.
I would not recommend it. We won’t go back anyway.

author: RDragan
title: Fine, but not great!
text:
Strategically located hotel, 5 minutes walk from the M7 Cadet or Poissonnière line, 20 minutes, however, you are already immersed in Montmartre and 30 minutes you arrive at the Louvre museum. 
Different story instead for the rooms, really very small, it is also difficult to enter with the trolley and close the door behind. Cleanliness of the rooms excellent but attention to the courtesy line equal to zero. 
Breakfast with very little choice and always the same. 
Surely there is much better!

author: FURYO
title: DEPLORABLE, NOISEY, NOT STABLE AND WEAK INTERNET
text:
Deplorable is no match for a hotel for business.
Noise, your soundproofing, subway noise, dumpsters in the morning. 
Room very petie the bathroom let's not talk toilet stuck between the wall and the shower. Defective shower head , low ceiling, non-functional air conditioning and especially PAS. D INTERNET!!! Coneection problem not possible to make a video from your room. Systematic disconnection or too weak network.
Breakfast room small, without windows, poor pastries and bread (yet we are in the center and there are a significant number of excellent bakeries nearby.

author: starck
title: disappointed
text:
Overall I am disappointed by this hotel , the room is small, and the bathroom tiny, especially the space between the toilet and shower. if you are a little strong , forget, you will not be able to access it. 
TV offers only 4 or 5 channels and almost nothing of TNT , I watched TV on an iPad , yet I reported this inconvenience on my arrival, but no action. for the last night, the person in charge of cleaning the room, did not consider it useful to put towels in the bathroom, good surprise when coming out of the shower on Friday morning.

author: Keith R
title: Excellent service, good location, & budget friendly
text: The service provided by Haileny was excellent as she greeted us with a warm reception and informative knowledge for the area. The proximity of the hotel, value, and rooftop pool/bar makes this a great budget friendly fun place to stay.  It's not bougie, but it is beauty on a budget.

author: Kingsley A
title: Haileny is the best!
text: I was privileged to be helped by the beautiful Haileny! I came in super tired from my trip and she made the process seamless, quick and she even got me an upgrade!

author: Tom L
title: NYC visit
text: This is our second stay at The Empire Hotel. This time for 5 nights. The staff were very accommodating, professional and personable, especially Haileny and Adrik. The hotel could benefit from cosmetic updates but the rooms were clean and very large for NYC. Free bottled water upon each request was a much appreciated bonus!

author: Sebastian S
title: Relaxing
text: Such great employees , they were all nice and generous. i loved the soft voice all of them had

author: Jalen A
title: Amazing
text: Staff was very friendly and willing to help with any of my needs

author: Kevin Michael L
title: Great Stay at Holiday Inn New York City
text:
I had a wonderful stay at Holiday Inn New York City. The location was very convenient, making it easy to explore the city and visit many popular attractions. The room was clean, comfortable, and well-maintained, and the staff were friendly, helpful, and welcoming throughout my stay.

I especially appreciated the convenient location and the overall comfortable atmosphere. Everything was smooth from check-in to check-out. I would definitely consider staying here again on my next trip to New York City. Highly recommended!

author: MJ
title: Good value hotel in Manhattan
text: It is very suitable for business trips. The location is very convenient and the sound insulation is also good. It is even better than some Kimpton and crown plaza. Compared with the Manhattan Hotel, the room is very large, this price. The service attitude of the front desk is very kind and attentive. Robina, the front desk staff, is very friendly and remembers the name of every guest and takes everything to heart, which is very touching.

author: Laura B
title: nice location
text: Decent location in the middle of a lot of places. Walkable to other neighborhoods. We confirmed multiple times on the phone that we would have 2 beds and arrived to a double or full size bed for 2 people. One time a call center confirmed two beds, then the actual hotel said due to the holiday season (even though we booked months in advance) two beds or a king. The hotel did quickly change us to a king size bed which we appreciated. Very busy due to time of year but overall nice hotel and clean. Always returned back to our room clean and towels refreshed. Easy to get cabs from the door.

author: Nick K
title: Extremely rude staff
text:
What a terrible experience at this hotel. I have never encountered front desk staff who were so rude, especially the two women working during my stay. They became extremely difficult when I asked for a slightly later checkout because my train was delayed.

The check-in process was also ridiculous—I wasn’t able to check in until 4:00 PM. Once I finally got into the room, it was essentially a shoebox. To make matters worse, a random charge appeared on my card after I had already checked out.

Overall, the customer service was extremely poor, the room was far too small, and the unexpected charge after checkout was unacceptable. I would not stay here again.

author: Abby O
title: Great Location
text: We enjoyed our stay at Holiday Inn Manhattan 6th Ave for a girls trip! Friendly service, clean room, and wonderful location close to subway and many restaurants, vintage stores, and coffee shops. We will be back!

author: Chloe M
title: 1 of 1
text:
We booked two rooms for a bachelorette weekend staycation and from start to finish, it was an absolute dream! The location was perfect, the rooms were spacious, comfortable, and spotless and everyone was incredibly hospitable. Lei, G and Junior the rest of the team truly went above and beyond to make sure we had a wonderful stay.

We dined at Jams two of the three nights (sadly we missed out on brunch, but I’ve heard amazing things!) and we all got a chance to enjoy an early morning workout in the gym. It was the perfect place for a girls’ weekend and we genuinely couldn’t have asked for a better experience.

We’ll definitely be back! (even if it’s just for dinner and drinks at Jams)

author: Aaron A
title: Coming back for sure
text: Excellent location just steps from Central Park and the subway. The room was well appointed and staff was extremely friendly. Highly recommend tou eat at Jams. Breakfast menu is killer and dinner was fantastic. The in-bar live DJ  was vibing. Drink menu at the bar was solid. Definitely booking again.

author: francesco s
title: Unassuming hotel
text:
I stayed at this hotel on 11/15
Well advertised on the site, a real disappointment in person 
It is not worth more than a three-star hotel 
Very small rooms, cold, soulless.
I was supposed to stay 5 nights, but I fled on the second day.
Too much noise. 
Air conditioning was very annoying and noisy. 
I changed hotels. 
Never again - I strongly advise against it.

author: ktw26
title: No View from Park VIew Room and No Privacy
text: I booked a central park view corner room for $700+ a night after speaking with the reservations agent who told me that the room would be quiet so I could work from it and prepare for an important meeting. The agent failed to inform me that the hotel was under construction and repointing. The work was loud. There was only a sliver of a view of the park. It's more of a view into the apartment across the street. The bathroom is also glass so if you are staying with more than one person there is zero privacy. Very poor value.

author: Heidi K
title: Relaxed stay in NYC
text: Great overnight stay. As soon as you walk through  the doors you feel calm & zen. The smell of the hotel and greenery is so peaceful. We had an inside room that was so quiet in the middle of NYC.  I had the best sleep. Location is 1 block from Central Park and easy access to subways to get anywhere in city. Hotel Bar /restaurant perfect for drink before our broadway show and breakfast the next morning was delicious , would stay again.

author: Reggie S
title: Great...except for The Rooftop Waitresses
text: Had a great stay with you guys. Christian was awesome at The Charlie, the service was excellent with our waitress as well. The hotel staff was awesome as well. Every employee was awesome except for the waitresses on the Rooftop. They were not attentive at all and gave poor service overall. They were not good representatives of The Knickerbocker.

author: Sherpa51350947013
title: Excellent Hotel
text:
Excellent stay!!!  Best Hotel we have stayed at NYC.  Location was perfect as it was right by  Time Square. Subway  station is just stone  throw away. 1 block to CVS , 2 blocks to whole food and Target.
Hotel is the best place to stay for tourists like us as it was walking distance to mostly everything.
Staff are very friendly and welcoming .
Front Desk staff  Cynthia Allegra and Magina are  very  personable , friendly and accommodating .

Room 5/5  cleanliness 5/5  Ambiance 5/5  service 5/5
We will  come back and stay again for the New Year!

author: Jack J
title: Johir the the man !!
text: Johir was cordial, professional and very friendly. I would recommend going there with any party any day of the week

author: Katie A
title: Excellent service
text: Johnie and James were the best!

author: Svitlana G
title: Will be back
text: Beautiful place and service. Especially Johir.

author: Giacomo P
title: Amazing experience
text: Amazing service and a wonderful experience! Nikola was extremely helpful, kind, and attentive throughout our stay. The atmosphere was lovely, and the entire team was friendly, welcoming, and very professional. Highly recommended—we would definitely stay here again!

author: Denise S
title: Superb!
text: Great location for all amenities and a superb room! I had a good view of planes overhead and being a plane spotter this was great! No faults from us. Comfy mattress and pillows and although the room was warm we coped with the fan provided. Thanks for a great stay!

author: 3criticsBolton
title: Great stay
text:
Stayed at this hotel during our last visit to London. Great value, clean and in a good spot to explore London. Room was quiet and comfortable during our stay. When we arrived there was no problem storing our bags until our check in time this was a great bonus as we could make the most of our time. Only downside was that there was no AC in this hotel and as it is so hot during the summertime. ( As lots of hotels in London are.) But a fan was provided in the room. 
Nearest tube stations are Moorgate and old street. We found the bus stop right outside the easiest way to get to where we wanted to go. We would definitely use this hotel again.

author: Nehmeena M
title: NIKOLA
text: Good service thank you nikola

author: Joshua O
title: Amazing Travelodge
text:
Staff were amazing, especially Nikola who was so accommodating and understanding of any issues raised. She works round the clock to ensure good service!

Location was very ideal as you can cycle round most of London with hireable bikes nearby.

Room was standard as most Travelodge’s, kept clean and room of a good size.

Overall good value for money!

Only issue was the fire alarm going off a few times, with one at 4:30AM.

author: Explorer51497673385
title: Not the Dream you expect
text: have stayed at the Dream Meatpacking 4 different times, wouldn't stay at this location. It was cheap and we had a flight disruption but the rooms are in very rough shape, ours smelt like someone had been smoking in there for 20 years. We ended up checking out early, they offered us to switch rooms. Lobby is nice, all the amenities were closed which is probably why the room was relatively cheap but still don't think it justified the price we paid, i would have put this in a 2 star hotel category for our stay. Bellman are very nice and others working too, however the billing was all messed up took 2-3 calls to figure it out because we were overcharged.

author: DIOGENES L
title: Not too dreamy
text:
Best feature in the room was a nice working ac. The room itself was very small, and when I asked why there was no Globalist upgrade, I was politely told I should have asked for one. The room was very cute, although not sure if all lights worked. Bathroom and closet were tiny, no room to even place toiletry bag in the bathroom.
It was kind of noisy in the room all night, and not the street kind of noise...Bathroom has a loud fan that will not turn off at all. There was also similar type of noise coming from elsewhere, so sleeping wasnt so dreamy.
Lastly, breakfast was awful. Everything was bad, beverages, food, appearance. Mosquitos and flies circling your table in the restaraunt was an added nice touch.

author: kristina p
title: Dreams could use a revamp
text: Staff was very nice at check-in and check-out. Carpets are old and dirty. Room smelled musty. Bathroom was clean. This hotel could use a revamp.

author: julia w
title: Convenient location
text: Stayed at this hotel overnight for the united airlines half marathon in March 2026 and enjoyed our short stay. The later check out time made it so I could stop at the room and shower before checking out after completing my half marathon (I was in an early corral which made this possible). The attached bar was great and will define let stay here again next time I run the race as it was very short walk from the finish line and close to the subway to get to the start. Room was small and kinda of an odd layout but no issues for an overnight trip.
