author: PhilN
title: Good hotel. Give it a go!
text: It’s a great hotel. The reviews here are a tad off, and personally, I have to say I disagree with the consensus listed below. In my view, the hotel is fine. They take great care of their guests. The experience is top notch. Also, the location is great. The hotel rooms are fine. I genuinely have nothing to complain about. I’d suggest the hotel.

author: pin a
title: worse hotel
text: worse hotel l had ever been my entire life it’s outdated need major renovation from bathrooms to all rooms NO air condition unit works, spider on our bed and in the bathroom 2 more, the manager was careless, this was done through Super.com by cheating us as it’s 4 star hotel in fact it’s 1 star hotel.

author: Sarah D
title: Worst hotel
text: The absolute worst hotel! Do not stay here! They will charge you for a nightly excursion for every day you are there but not tell you and will not send you an invoice. I did not book the reservation, the person I was with did. They needed a card down for incidentals but told me I would be refunded (which I did) However a week after we checked out I was charged $175 with no information telling me about the charge. I contacted the hotel with no response. Two months I have been trying to get my money back and when I FINALLY got a response from Alfrie, and they don’t care, they will not help you and will not take accountability for their staff’s mistakes. This hotel will scam you for your money

author: User
title: No deposit refunds - don't stay!
text:
Very poor. They took a large deposit on arrival and never refunded it. I asked them for the receipt of the deposit, and they assured I would receive the money back. I emailed multiple times and have had no help. 
I do not recommend

author: David C
title: Very good stay
text: It is a 3-star hotel with an unbeatable location, the rooms are simple, but it is clean and we didn't have any problems during our stay. I would definitely stay at this hotel again. The hotels located in this area are exorbitantly priced and this hotel is great value for money. Do not pay attention to the reviews you read here.

author: Karl Z
title: Dishonest Service
text: Had room booked and paid for Saturday night. Was told upon arrival room was not available, and was not given a refund as it was a non refundable reservation . Very unethical and lousy customer service .

author: Kathleen P
title: Wonderful stay
text:
We booked The Fifteen Keys Hotel after reading so many great reviews, and it definitely did not disappoint — if anything, it was even better than we expected!

The hotel is beautiful, clean, comfortable, and perfectly located. From the moment we arrived, we were impressed by how friendly, welcoming, and helpful everyone was. 

The bar was one of our favorite spots. It has a lovely atmosphere, a great selection of drinks. It was the perfect place to relax after a busy day exploring the city.

Breakfast was also much better than we expected, with a great variety of delicious freshly baked and cooked options. The breakfast staff were also incredibly friendly and attentive.

It’s easy to see why this hotel has so many great reviews. We had a fantastic stay and would happily return!

author: Trevor B
title: Rome 2026
text:
Our 3rd stay at this delightful hotel and it didn’t disappoint.  The location is ideal for exploring Rome, especially if you’re happy to do it on foot.
The staff are exceptional and the breakfast is delicious, the rooms are stylish and spotless and nothing is too much trouble.
Can’t wait to return, thank you Fifteen Keys for a wonderful stay..

author: Rob Gough
title: Great hotel, even better Team
text: The team at The Fifteen Keys are exceptional. It is rare to find a combination of staff who are knowledgeable, professional, courteous, attentive and kind. Yes the hotel is in an excellent and quiet location BUT it’s the staff and their care that makes staying at this hotel a truly unique and pleasurable experience. Thank you.

author: Peter S
title: A true gem of a hotel in Monti
text: A real gem of a find for 5 days in Rome. Very responsive during a seamless booking process and they organised yhe airport and port transfers that worked perfectly. Very clean and comfortable room and the breakfast is superb. Friendly and helpful staff that gave excellent recommendations for places to eat nearby and organised tacis as we needed them

author: Caitlin E
title: Perfection in Rome
text: My husband and I absolutely loved every second of our experience. He hasn't stopped talking about it. It is beautiful, with a lovely welcoming space and courtyard for breakfast, tea and cocktails. The bar is fantastic with a great selection and a lovely cocktail of the day. Breakfast was much better than expected, with a wide selection of delicious hand baked and cooked options, and the chef out there making sure it was all to everyone's liking. The staff was friendly and accommodating at every step with anything we could need (including plastic wrap for our fresh tattoos - above and beyond). They offered great local dining advice as well. The street is quaint and quiet but easy to wander up and down and find any number of cute shops, places to eat or grab a coffee, convenience stores, and a short walk to the coliseum as well. We loved it and wished our stay was longer!

author: Leanne S
title: Unexpected welcome
text:
Although the hotel is conveniently located to most tourist attractions I would not return or recommend to families.  
The rooms are very small, the beds a small doubles and there is only one single wardrobe. It’s a challenge to find space to open your suitcase. 
The elevator situation is terrible, we took the stairs down from floor 24 on a few occasions as one elevator was out of action. The elevators are also used by the staff, which also slows down the flow. 

Outside of the hotel had to be the biggest surprise. There are public benches which appear to be the home of several homeless drug addicts, who sit there day and night in various states of consciousness.

author: Karine P
title: Very good for the proximity!
text: Easy to access, comfortable and clean room. Paid parking very close by. The reception is supervised by a guard at all times, so even if the neighborhood seems less secure, it is well protected.

author: Julen G
title: Excellent, ideal hotel
text: Exceptional hotel, helpful and friendly team, adequate and clean rooms

author: Meander17469737493
title: Do not stay here
text: I don't know where to start. First the area in front of the hotel is open to the public so there are drunks and people smoking weed all the time. Then the front door was broken for a couple days as well as one of two elevators. Then the elevators, there are only two elevators and that are shared between staff and guest which is unfortunate for all parties. The staff is delayed and the guys have to be in the elevator with leaking trash bags. The room seemed fine at first if a bit small but there was a corner of the room that smelled like urine the entire stay, the cleaning crew only does a very basic once over and the comforter and sheets are often dirty, I felt sick in the room and often had to go outside to feel better. The front of the hotel is a designated public area which I understand but at all hours there are teens, adults, and homeless people passed out, drinking, or vomiting on or around the benches. There was also apparently a leak downstairs so they had to come into our room on two different occasions to work on the shower and then we were told not to use it for some time. I'm sure there is a lot I am forgetting, but we rented here because my daughter had to come to NYC and this was close to where she had to go for her activity next time I'll book somewhere else even if it's further away. I would not recommend this place at all.

author: billyblaze
title: Great room. No issues
text: Very Nice Stay! I used my IHG cardmember free night award for this stay and was happy to find availability in the heart of NYC. Room was small but we don’t spend a lot of time in the room. It was clean and appeared to be recently renovated. Elevators are an issue in most NYC hotels so just be patient and not a big deal. Location is great for exploring NYC.

author: Oriol G
title: Great!!
text: Great experience. Extremely clean.Melahki has been very kind and effiecient, thank him so much for his professionalism.

author: L C
title: Modern amenities, friendly front desk
text: Got to the Arlo at 6am after an overnight train from DC. Theo at the front desk was very accommodating and was able to find me an available room to check in SUPER early and with the bonus of an upgraded bed.  Great service. Make sure to check out the lovely rooftop. Looking forward to visiting again.

author: Chloe G
title: Great hotel with great staff
text: Had such a great stay at Arlo! Sean at the front desk was super helpful and friendly. He went out of his way to accommodate us and made us feel right at home.

author: Relax29570311181
title: A great find
text:
Very smart place ..not too posh and not too below par. 
Great staff . Shawn was a true gent and great for a chat . We loved the vibe over all.  I think we'll stay again .

author: Leah A
title: Musu is the best!!!
text: Wow!! I had such an incredible experience at the Arlo, and truly all thanks to Musukula, the front office manager. I had to adjust my travel plans due to my daughter being sick, and she was SO responsive and made everything a breeze. We exchanged emails back and forth prior to my visit in which she was attentive and professional through our communication.  She was there when I checked in, and made sure I had everything I needed for my entire stay. She truly went above and beyond. So grateful for her and just making my entire NY weekend enjoyable!!!

author: Guillaume
title: Great relaxing spot after busy Rome visits
text: Family of 5, 3 boys 6, 11 and 12, the resort was great to relax after busy days in Rome. Kids LOVED the buffet, we were coming from JW Marriott in Venice which is much higher end, but they preferred this one :)

author: ghania n
title: Excellent hotel
text:
Excellent hotel, very varied breakfast, quiet location, very clean, smiling staff, excellent pool, transport nearby, bus to the city center 5 minutes away on foot, otherwise hotel shuttle to the city center available. 
A small detail, the hotel is a bit far from the city center, you have to plan for 45 minutes by bus

author: Chouffe
title: A nice hotel but not for the summer.
text:
We first had a room where the air conditioning didn't work. After much insistence we got another room
Where the air conditioning did work. 
At the pool you could not lie down after a day in Rome, all the chairs were already taken.
The shuttle bus was reserved in the evening, when we wanted to take the bus the next morning, it was incorrectly reserved. We then shared a taxi with another couple. Last time in November we were satisfied. Not this time.

author: Mrs D
title: Highly recommended
text: This hotel really has everything you need. Very modern. Very clean. Great spa. Had a lovely massage too. We had a junior corner balcony suite which was nice. My husband arranged surprise balloons in our room :) Pool gets busy so struggle for loungers after 10am. There’s a guy manning the pool so does help you get sorted, and he kept the kids around the pool under control which I thought was great. The rooms are in a separate building with a tunnel to connect everything. Easy to get lost though as it’s a big hotel with multiple lifts. Food was good. A few English foods missing which would have made it even better but not the end of the world. Lots of variety to eat. Shuttles available into Rome (5euro) drops you right in the middle of everything which is perfect. Book them asap though as it does get full which we found out. Ubers are so handy though. Really do recommend this place. I would 100% stay here again when I next go to Rome.

author: Helen R
title: A great hotel
text: We had a great time at the hotel. Staff were great, really helpful. Lots of amenities. The pool was a decent size and plenty of chairs most of the time. We used the shuttle bus a few times which is usually available if you book at least the day before you need it. We used public transport as well and went to some of the local restaurants. Great location overall out of the city and a green, residential area.

author: Wilson P
title: Excellent Location, Great Service and a Very Enjoyable Stay
text:
Overall, I had a very good experience at Andaz London Liverpool Street. The location is excellent, with extremely convenient access to both the Underground and trains. It’s also very easy to get to and from Heathrow Airport, taking only about 40 minutes by direct train.

The service was very good throughout my stay, from check-in to check-out, and the staff were always helpful with any requests. The room was very nice as well. I especially liked the slippers—they were stylish and came in a distinctive pink color, which I believe is a nod to the history of the original Andaz.

The main area that could be improved is the air conditioning. It didn’t seem to cool the room effectively. Even when I set the thermostat to 20°C, the room temperature would not go below around 24–24.5°C. This made the room warmer than I would have preferred, particularly during the summer.

Overall, it was a very enjoyable stay, with a great location, comfortable room, and excellent service. Improving the air conditioning would make the experience even better.

author: Paul
title: Great stay and experience
text: Great stay. Spacious room. Modern facilities and amenities in a historic building. Location is perfect. Right next to the train station, within walking distance to Spitalfields market and some famous landmarks, and just a few stops to the West End. What stood out was the fantastic service. We were pleasantly surprised to find a gift in our room accompanied by a sweet handwritten note to make up for a minor inconvenience during check-in which was not the fault of the hotel.

author: Sara C
title: Modern and comfortable
text: Superb hotel, great location. Staff helpful and welcoming, Cannot fault anything. Would have loved to have stayed longer!

author: J Nigos
title: Great Experience
text: It was our first time in London. This trip was for my husband’s birthday celebration. There are so many hotels in London to choose from but Im glad we chose Andaz Liverpool. I was worried that it was not close to the main attractions but the train/subway was just a few minutes walk from the hotel so it was very easy to go to all the places we planned to visit. We arrived late and we were surprised to see the size of the rooms. I booked 2 king connecting guestrooms but Im globalist and they were able to upgrade 1 room to a suite which made our stay very comfortable. They stacked the fridge with drinks everyday and have chips and treats to enjoy. Rooms were cleaned nicely and the staff were very receptive to our requests. Buffet breakfast is from 6:30-10:30 which have great selections of pastries, hot items, made to order pancakes. If you wake up a bit later, no problems because they have another restaurant that offers a la carte breakfast items and they serve it i think until 11:30. My kids also loved the cute Andaz bears that were waiting for them when we first arrived and became part of their souvenirs from London. We would definitely stay in this property the next time we visit.

author: Mark Daniel H
title: Globalist Review
text: Hyatt Andaz Liverpool St continues to deliver the most outstanding service of all the properties I’ve stayed at.   Why should you care?  I’ve stayed at Hyatt properties over 70 nights since January.  Not necessarily proud of that; but I do appreciate stellar service and so should you.

author: Sophia
title: Thank You, InterContinental London – The O2!
text:
A huge thank you to the InterContinental London – The O2! ❤️

I’ve stayed here personally, many times and for my son’s birthday, I booked him and his friend tickets to see Ariana Grande at The O2, along with a stay at this adjoining hotel and WOW, what an incredible experience!

The team went above and beyond to make my son’s birthday incredibly special. The way they treated him was genuinely lovely, and it made the whole experience even more memorable for him.

I honestly can’t thank you enough for such a fantastic stay and for making his birthday one he’ll remember for a long time. 🥰

Thank you so much, InterContinental London – The O2! You were amazing! ❤️

author: Chris D
title: Really poor - avoid
text:
Really disappointing experience, made considerably worse by how the complaint has been handled afterwards.

I booked and paid for a 60-minute aromatherapy massage. Despite arriving at the requested time, I was told by reception to hurry because my session had started, and I was dismissed when i told her I was early - despite having an email saying so. I was rushed to get changed, and the massage then finished 25 minutes later. When I pointed out that I had booked an hour, the therapist had to go away and check before she realised there had been a mistake.

I had to get dressed during the confusion, then back to the room to undress to continue the massage. By the time everything was sorted, several minutes had been lost, and honestly at no point was this a relaxing experience. Even the second part finished before the actual time it was supposed to. 

Overall, I didn't even receive 45 minutes of actual treatment, split into two sessions with an awkward interruption in the middle. Not exactly the relaxing experience you'd expect for the money it cost.

Mistakes happen, though, and had the situation been handled properly afterwards, I probably wouldn't be leaving this review.

Unfortunately, the handling of my complaint has been more disappointing than the original mistake. Having to chase for a response and eventually offered additional massage time if i booked and paid for another one. 

Other emails have just been flat out and ignored. 

For a hotel and spa of this standard, I find that completely unacceptable. Getting the treatment wrong was an unfortunate mistake; ignoring a customer who has taken the time to raise a legitimate complaint - twice - is a choice.

Sadly, I certainly won't be returning.

author: Eliza
title: Perfect location for the o2
text: We stayed one night for the Ariana Grande concert and this location simply can’t be beaten for the o2 arena. Rooms and common areas are exceptionally clean and breakfast was great. This will always be our first choice when attending events at the o2!

author: Ibrahim Al-Badr
title: Services were Perfectly Done
text: Service was amazing as well as accomodating to your needs. Exceptional staff. Facilities and location next to O2 and Transport.

author: Carrie B
title: Absolutely stunning hotel! Can't wait to come back!
text:
From the moment we arrived, the staff team were incredible! 
The gentleman who checked us in was attentive, helful, and sorted a booking error around breakfast for us in the best way possible! - Thank you so much!
 Every single person was helpful and friendly,throughout our entire stay.
The rooms were luxurious, the beds the comfiest I have ever slept in, and the standards of cleanliness were just so high.
We made full use of the beautiful spa on every one of our 3 days, and it was an absolute pleasure. 
I travelled with my 15 year old daughter as we were watching Ariana Grande at the O2. The location was beyond perfect as we were able to utilise the walkway, straight in to the O2.
Breakfast was also incredible, a buffett with a great choice of beautifully fresh produce, with the option to request from the eggs menu (smashed avocado on sour dough with poached was stunning!) 
I get that the price is high , theree is definitely a location premium, but it really is worth it. 
We spent our 4th night in our capital, in a hotel across London as we were also attending a concert at Wembley. The price per night there  was the same as The Intercontinental -  but the quality and cleanliness were nowhere near the same.
We really look forward to coming back -  hopefully soon!

author: MOBAHD
title: This is a real scam !!
text:
My stay had already been fully paid through Booking.com, yet my card was charged a second time under the pretext of a “security deposit” or pre-authorization.
It has now been four weeks since my check-out, and I still have not received my money back.
What is even more concerning is the contradictory information I have received. First, I was told that a refund had been processed. Later, I was told it was only a released pre-authorization. My bank has confirmed that it has received neither a refund nor any released authorization.
I have filed a formal complaint with Booking.com and disputed the charge with my bank. Despite sending several emails and follow-ups, I still have not received any response from the manager, Shakira Luqman, nor any meaningful attempt to resolve this issue.
I strongly recommend that anyone staying here carefully checks their bank statements after check-out. Until this issue is resolved and my money is returned, I cannot recommend this hotel.

author: Yaumama
title: Don’t be cheated
text:
Beware of the hidden fees.

I booked two rooms at Soho 54 Hotel through Expedia for a 3-night family trip to New York because the advertised rates looked much cheaper than many other hotels in the area.

What I didn’t realise until after booking was that the hotel charges a mandatory “resort fee” of USD 40.16 per room, per night. For two rooms over three nights, that came to over USD 240 in additional charges.

The most frustrating part is that this fee was not prominently disclosed during the booking process. It only appeared afterwards in the confirmation email under “Additional Property Fees”. By the time you discover it, you’ve already paid.

To make matters worse, the so-called “resort fee” covers basic amenities that most travellers would reasonably expect to be included in the room rate anyway, such as Wi-Fi, bottled water, coffee and gym access. There is nothing remotely “resort-like” about this property.

The hotel itself was equally disappointing. The online photos create a much better impression than reality. The bathrooms were tired and outdated, the carpets looked worn, and the Wi-Fi was unreliable despite being one of the items supposedly covered by the resort fee. Other than the air conditioning working properly, very little justified the overall cost.

What appeared to be a bargain turned out to be anything but. Once all the mandatory fees were added, the value for money simply wasn’t there.

This hotel feels like a classic bait-and-switch: attract guests with a low headline price, then recover the difference through mandatory fees.

My advice: don’t be fooled by the headline room rate. Check every hidden charge carefully and compare the true total cost with other hotels before booking. There are far better options in New York for the same money.

author: Jess L
title: Total scam - beware of hidden fees!!!
text: Total scam. I booked through a portal and there were hefty hidden "facility fees" ON TOP of what I paid at checkout. I never would have booked this hotel if I had known the true cost. I'm actually embarrassed and disturbed at how much I ended up paying to spend 3 nights here. What a joke.

author: josef70115
title: Fine for the price
text:
Pros - very affable and competent staff.  fast elevators. comfortable beds

Cons - well worn hotel

Nice location walkable to SoHo, TriBeCa, Little Italy, Chinatown.  near subway

author: P L
title: Nice hotel but loud.
text:
Hotel is ok. Staff is nice. TV is spotty. The only buttons on the remote that work are the power, the volume, and the down channel button. 
But the big thing is the traffic noise. This block of Watts street is at the holland tunnel. Traffic is very busy here and VERY loud. 
Horns honking until 11:00 pm every night. Hard to sleep even on our upper floor.

author: julien312026
title: Cardinal Hotel St. Peter
text:
Overall, a superb hotel with a pool.
Very appreciated in this hot weather!
A truly top-notch team, whether at the front desk, the restaurant, or housekeeping; they are all super friendly!
Hotel is a 2-minute walk from the bus and also a 10-minute walk from the subway,
Ideal for the sightseeing trips we were able to take, and there are many! 
Close to the Vatican, Colosseum, Pantheon, and others…
I recommend it.

author: LO75
title: Does not deserve 4 stars
text:
Don't deserve 4 stars!
The size of the pool is misleading compared to the photos. Once we arrive we are told the obligation to wear a swim cap to access it (without prior information although we had booked 4 months before) and the purchase of the cap is at our expense.

Staff not understanding and closed to discussion when we expressed disappointment with this obligation

Outdated room that requires a great refreshment, cleaning being very limited

Breakfast worthy of a summer camp refectory, to flee!

author: Angelo G
title: Pleasant stay
text: Elegant and clean facility. Professional and efficient staff. Especially the dining room staff at the restaurant. Kind, polite, and well-groomed. Even the hour of relaxation in the pool was made pleasant by the staff

author: suerichardson2026
title: Clean, comfortable and friendly.
text: We spent most of out time out of the hotel but it was nice to come back to and take a quick dip in the pool. They should have told us upfront that we had to pay for the caps which we didn't need on day 1. Not impressed with that, no notices put up.

author: mamametkids2017
title: Enjoyed it!!!
text: Lovely hotel for good price. Slightly dated but makes one totally well with very friendly staff and pool. It was during our stay up to 38 degrees celcius, fantastic working e air conditioning in the room, ground floor. If you do not expect super luxury and needs absolute must.

author: Travel754916
title: Beacon not what it used to be.
text: No air conditioning in hall on a hot day in New York. Air conditioning in room did not work. Front desk resisted changing rooms after engineer could not fix the air conditioning. New room had working air conditioner but no hot water in shower. I’ve stayed here many times. This will be the last.

author: Rima S
title: A lot of upsides but worn furnishings
text: There are a lot of upsides to this hotel. Great location, close to Lincoln Center, Riverside Park, and all the UWS has to offer. Staff are very friendly and helpful. The kitchenette is a real convenience—we buy cereal, milk, and fruit across the street at Fairway, and then we are all set for a healthier and certainly less expensive breakfast than if we were eating out. Bed is comfortable, and the rooms are spacious. The primary downside is that the furnishings are old, heavy, and worn—the place feels pretty dated.

author: Paul Davis
title: Comfort, quiet, signs of age
text: Great location; a 10 minute walk to Lincoln Center and to Central Park “Stawberry Fields” which is across from the Dakota.   Received a free upgrade to a King Suite with terrific view of the Beaux Arts style Ansonia, a gem.  Two small rooms adjoining.   Building engineering/maintenance promptly replaced batteries so thermostat would work.   Mildewy smell in the shower curtains ( replaced, lingering smell).   New very soundproof windows.  Room very clean, but old scuffed furniture with worn upholstery really looked out of place.   Why can’t they afford newer furniture to sit on?   That factor a drawback - Would be embarrassing if I had a guest.  Kitchenette; did not use during my 3 night stay.   No food service.  Bodega nearby.   Great selection of restaurants - a guide sheet they’ll give you along with personal recommendations.   Steps up to elevator; not sure wheelchair accessible ( possibly a steep ramp?)   Comfort and quiet.  With taxes about $500 a night.  Yes, I would return, especially for the neighborhood feel.

author: alexnico
title: Great for families, convenient, quiet and in a great location!
text:
Ideal location near the Natural History Museum
We were in a room with two beds for the adults and a sofa bed for the children (15 and 19 years old)
Clean and convenient kitchenette
Quiet location at night
Personally, she is super nice and helpful
Easy with line 2
We recommend it!

author: Katherine P
title: Loved it
text: We had the most lovely stay this weekend. The staff was kind, helpful, and charming. I had a snafu when booking and they worked with me and made everything right. We loved our room and will 100 percent choose Beacon again .Great and safe neighborhood and Sunday Bazar was the coolest! My teens had a great time !

author: Carlos R. Martinez
title: Very well located.
text: Small rooms, beautiful terrace, it is one block from the subway.

author: Yolanda S
title: First Time in New York
text: The room was nice, we had are own bathroom which was nice, clean and comfortable the only thing didn’t have microwave or fridge to stored left overs are your drinks.

author: Explorer36355915805
title: Wonderful hotel-hostel in east midtown
text: Location was excellent in E Midtown.  Close to the E and 6 trains, which got us everywhere we wanted to go, otherwise very walkable.  Definitely a hotel/hostel hybrid, rooms are small with a bunk bed (full sized), shared bathrooms on each floor, but with housekeeping and a front desk staff (both very helpful and friendly).  Rooms and bathrooms were clean and comfortable.  Truly did not have any issues with noise.  And don't miss out on the Rooftop patio, is was perfect, great views, comfortable, great way to end the night.

author: Jordana L
title: Long and pleasant stay in room with private bathroom
text: Great location, clean room, comfortable and functional (pod queen). Careful employees. No inconvenience. Good cost benefit.

author: Johannes M
title: Very small but clean rooms good for spending the entire day out in NYC
text:
We originally booked a bunk bedroom with a shared hallway bathroom, which I was originally unaware of. We found this out when we arrived, but were able to upgrade to a queen bed and private bathroom for about $20. Also, whenever you check in, there is a roughly $30 charge that you have to pay. The rooms are very small, and the bathroom is even smaller and cramped. There's also, strangely, a window that looks into the bathroom from the bedroom. The bathroom door is also only a thin sliding door so make sure you are very comfortable with the person you are sharing the room with. 
The room is clean, and the check-in process was fairly smooth.

author: Venture51741493896
title: A good experience with this hotel
text: My family and I had a great experience at this hotel. We had heard that the Times Square area is very noisy, yet we didn't hear a thing from our room. The room was small but cozy and kept clean by the excellent housekeeping staff. We also had a positive experience with Maria at the front desk; she welcomed us to New York with open arms. If we ever return, we would stay here again.

author: Carlos L
title: Horror hotel! RUN
text: If I could give it minus 100 stars, I would 🤬. Upon arriving at the lobby, the seats were damaged, dirty, and torn; the bathroom had an unbearable smell of urine; the rooms were dirty with unpainted, scratched walls; the bathroom had mold; the curtains were torn; the walls had spiderwebs; the TV was stuck almost to your bed; the beds squeaked like in a horror movie. I went to cancel my reservation and they accepted it, only for me to receive an email 2 days later informing me that they will not refund me! They stole $278 from me. New York City should shut down this so-called hotel, if it could even be called that. DO NOT waste your money there; it is the worst in New York. Look at photos from former guests and you will realize what I am talking about. I left so scared that I did not manage to take photos.

author: multi coloured productions
title: Ranging not got my secity depoist back.
text: Never got my security depoist back emailed 11 times ian kelly stayed there from 30th june to 1st july room1007 disabled rung told i never stayed there not record my resverstion gave no correct booking no rachel took depoist not been returned. Noe 24th august

author: Stay32187897042
title: AVOID IT AT ALL COSTS
text:
5/5 location, but not worth the money as it is clearly not a 4 star hotel. Extremely noisy room opposite the busiest road in Times Square due to a single-pane window. The loud sounds passed easily through the thin glass and tiny air gaps. I could not sleep at all even if the staff gave me free ear plugs. Filthy and very run down lift, corridor and room. Scuffs on the walls, torn blinds and gum on the couch. The AC worked the first 2 days of our stay but we had to turn it off because it was also noisy. Spacious shower but covered in mold. No tea, coffee or fridge. Worst of all, MARIA, the hotel staff at the front desk gave us the rudest welcome to New York. She should look for another job because it is obvious she is not happy working there. She should also learn how to treat customers from her colleagues Jaz, Rachel and Richy.
I would not recommend this hotel and suggest to avoid it at all costs. There is plenty of accommodation in this busy city.

author: Ana
text:
It is very frustrating to see that, two years after our terrible experience at this hotel, the same problems continue to occur with complete impunity.
In addition to the appalling standards of cleanliness and maintenance, the most serious issue is the fact that money is being charged to guests’ credit cards without their authorization / consent.
What is difficult to understand is how, despite the large number of complaints and reports from different guests, nothing seems to be done about it. It is shocking that such practices can apparently continue without any effective action being taken.

author: Charlie
title: Our new favorite
text: We just got back to Denver after a wonderful stay at Hotel Belleclaire. My wife and I have visited some great places over the last three years, in Cairo, Rome, Madrid, and Paris, but I think Hotel Belleclaire is now our sentimental favorite. One big reason is room 606, a big, bright and beautifully decorated turret room where you almost feel suspended over Broadway, though with no street noise. The other was the extremely welcoming and helpful staff. For some reason, they knew our names when we walked in, but more importantly they assisted us throughout our stay with my electric scooter, which I rented and had dropped off at the hotel because of my broken foot. In this regard I have to identify the chief bellman, Mark, who went well beyond the call in making sure everything ran smoothly. It did, exceedingly so, and we are grateful to him and the entire staff for a very pleasant three days.

author: Kathryn Saunders
title: Great experience at Hotel Belleclair
text: Clean, quiet, comfortable, convenient location to Central Park, restaurants, bakery, pubs.  Friendly and helpful staff.

author: cindib22
title: Stay here when in NYC!
text: This is a hidden gem on the Upper West Side! Spacious rooms, friendly, helpful staff, and a beautiful sparkling clean space

author: Stephen R
title: Oasis on the Upper West Side
text: What a beautiful and beautifully-kept hotel -- it's like stepping into another world. This was a longer-term stay and felt very warm, comfortable and inviting throughout. Consistently first-class all the way: atmosphere, cafe, friendly staff. Excellent boutique hotel.

author: Yamini J
title: Probably the best there is on the UWS!
text:
It’s a wonderful space with the most friendly and supportive staff. I had a long stay and but the end of the duration, everyone felt like family. Big thanks to Jeffrey from sales for ensuring all our needs and requests were catered to. Also to Amanda, Benedict, Ned, Sare and Edward for being so supportive and warm. I could reach out to them with various questions knowing that they would promptly help. 

The location is ideal for anyone looking to have a classic UWS experience. Lots of restaurants around and the park is just 10 mins away.

author: Reichiko
title: Lovely, clean, convenient, great Security
text: Our room was very clean, nice, and quiet. My son left his stuffed puppy and, currently, security staff (Irvin, Danny, JB, Alex and Erik) have found it and packed it to send back to us! Very grateful for their help and my son looks forward to receiving his long lost pup. We hope to return to this lovely place one day!

author: L C
title: Perfect Base for a Broadway Trip
text:
If you're headed to the Theater District, it's hard to beat the Edison. The location is unbeatable - we were steps from everything we needed, and the staff was genuinely helpful throughout our stay. Oh, and every time we walked through the lobby, Frank Sinatra was playing. Honestly, perfect.

Is it a grand luxury hotel? No. The hallway from the door to the bed has serious backrooms energy (we laughed every time), the bathroom is cozy to say the least, and the open shower concept means the entire bathroom becomes a splash zone. Housekeeping kept up admirably with the chaos and we were never short on towels.

A mini fridge would have been nice, but this is Manhattan - I get it. Every square inch counts.

For the price and location, the Edison delivers exactly what you need for a NYC trip. We'd absolutely stay again.

author: James F
title: Excellent stay !
text: The Staff and management at the hotel were fantastic ! Completly attentive and freindly. The bed was quite comfortable and the food at the restaurant was top draw ! This was my second trip in the past three months and i will be going back in the fall.

author: Dmitry K
title: Perfect place to stay when exploring New York with your family
text: Overall very nice hotel, very authentic and comfortable. Spacious clean rooms with stunning views. Perfect location in the heart of Manhattan. Plenty of breakfast options.

author: trishmsh
title: A Must Stay-Hotel Edison Time Square!!
text:
If you ever are in New York City, Hotel Edison is a truly MUST STAY !!!!!
    Michael and I have just had the most magical stay at this Incredible Theater District/Time Square Historical Hotel!!
  Exquisite Art Deco styling, outstanding professional and friendly staff, beautifully appointed rooms with views of this amazing city, top notch security, very knowledgeable  and extremely helpful concierge  are only the beginning of what Hotel Edison offers-the moment the Doorman opens the door for you and welcomed you in!
    So, with out any doubt…. Make your next stay in New York at this very special hotel!!!’  You will be over the moon happy you chose Hotel Edison.   This is forever on- the only place we will stay in NY!!
❤️❤️

author: Atif Q
title: Excellent location, celaniness can be improved.
text: Location is excellent. Rooms are well furniished but needed housekeeping to get bath tubs cleaned and bedsheet changed

author: sailorann
title: Decent stay near Grand Central
text:
Hotel is connected to Grand Central station in 42nd and Park. Huge hotel, very busy.

Check in was good, but not thorough. I had to remind them of my free breakfast and no info provided about internet. You get this $15 credit which you can apply to their store or breakfast.

Room was good and spacious. Modern and updated. Housekeeping was basic, no sweeping in the bathroom, quick make up of bed. No coffee maker or kettle, but a mini fridge.

Huge closet, no dressers. 

Room was quiet, but walls are thin and could hear noise in the hallway. 

Breakfast was excellent and staff very friendly!

Check out easy! 

Overall for a quick business trip and location it was a good choice.

author: Cruiser48356313682
title: DO NOT BOOK if you want safety and polite service.
text: Service at this hotel is terrible. Management is rude. They do nothing to help you. I was in my room packing up and a manager opened my door and started to walk in my room while I was in it. I clearly said hold on after they knocked while I was walking towards the door, and he beeped himself in before I even got to the door and started to walk in. This made me feel extremely unsafe and violated as a woman alone in her room. I also had a "currently occupied" sign on my door. He then argued with me saying he has the right to come into my room because it was after the check out time. It was 20 mins past check out time and I had extended the check out for the extra allowed 2 hours. The security later told me that he should have never done that and that is not allowed. I did not receive a check out call to my room which is also protocol.  They refused to bring the guy in violation to me for an apology claiming they don't know who they sent to my room (which is scary) and said they had no camera footage of the hallways. This hotel now is the trademark worst experience in service, safety, accommodation and consideration. NEVER GO HERE!

author: Anthony J
title: It’s NY baby!!!
text: Location is top tier. Walking distance from everything. Atmosphere was electric as NY will always be. Rooms were nice and clean. One thing I’d suggest is the longe with free food and paid wine available. Really enjoyed my stay.

author: owlwoman1
title: Great location
text: Felt nice and safe. Great location. Room was a very nice size. Appreciated room being ready early and the late checkout. Very pleasant staff

author: swoopypie
title: We Love Being InContinent
text:
We typically prefer to stay at a Staybridge, so now you know where we’re coming from.

We were completely impressed with our inaugural stay at an InterContinental, from the swanky lobby with bar, to the nicer rooms with Keurig, to the all day Lounge access for Ambassadors.

Yes, there’s a $45 amenity fee, but you get a $30 food & beverage credit and a $20 garment care credit.  Also, Ambassadors get a 4pm checkout!

The Lounge, open from 7am to 9pm offers light bites, coffee, lattes, cappuccinos, soft drinks, candy, nuts and a machine which makes fresh sorbet once you place a pod in it.

Rockefeller Center is only a few blocks to the west, so why don’t you just sashay your pretty little self on over to Saks Fifth Ave.

author: Natalie T
title: B+ Experience
text: Great location and beautiful rooms, and soap. I would have expected better hospitality just because it's a 4-star hotel; the front desk asked us why we needed another pair of slippers, and it was because we spilled water on them. As well, the time waited for the breakfast is extremely long

author: Kim Schmidt A
title: Location is great but only 1 cup of coffee for breakfast
text: Great location close to time square and in the heart of new york. Only thing I didn't like was that when having the breakfast for 49 usd you can only have 1 cup of coffee and 1 glass of juice.  If you wants more coffee or juice you have to pay for it. Even with access to the Intercontinental club lounge we had to leave out table and go to the lounge to continue the breakfast where the coffee is free. I have been at this hotel before and this is a new thing they came up with. Most likely I won't be back due to this.

author: Alister R
title: Ambassador member review
text:
All Ambassador members should avoid this hotel. When I enquired about my so called upgraded room I was informed that the bed was larger than the normal rooms! So I was stuck with a bed and not a room upgrade.
The Club Intercontinental was disappointing with only red or white wine on offer. Forget a gin and tonic at 6pm. It was not available at this hotel. All very different from the Buenos Aires experience a few weeks earlier when one was greeted with a suite and a fully stocked bar in the Club room. Very disappointing and never to be repeated.

author: Kara C
title: Misrepresented stay
text: Booked this place for a quick getaway for one night for our daughter's 11th bday. Told the front desk it was a special birthday. Was expecting to have a note or something saying happy birthday but got nothing when we checked in, even after saying it again at check in. We were charged an additional $150 for an early check in as we were coming to go to the today show. I called ahead of time and told them this, they didn't mention they would charge me for that for use of the room. The room was empty anyway. Hotels used to put a note in the room wishing a happy birthday or give a chocolate or flower. We also booked this place because of the picture of the roof deck featured on the website. We wanted to use this area but when we got there we were told that is the penthouse suite roof deck and not accessible to other guests, felt this was misrepresenting the hotel and very deceptive. Don't advertise this if it's not a common area for guests to use. The staff was kind of snotty, and not very welcoming. Now on a positive note now, it's a great location to Rockefeller center and Times Square. Lots's of good restaurants around the hotel and a Starbucks for an early bird coffee. There is a parking lot across the street from the hotel so I recommend using that as it's just more convenient. Bathroom was clean expect for a hair on the soap dispenser.

author: DaveH36
title: Great spot and staff
text:
Great staff, friendly, helpful and professional 
Hudson River view king room
Typical big city hotel room.  Just not big enough but good enough 
Never an issue with hot water 
Need bottles water, just ask the front desk.
Great location to subway stations 
Tourist spots and Wall St area high spots

author: Elizabeth G
title: A pretty good experience
text: The location is really perfect for what we wanted, which was to visit the 9/11 Museum. It was very convenient. The rooms were ok, not much storage space and seemed a little dated. I really liked the gym but the last day, the ac was on 80 and it was awful. They turned it down to 76 but it had been on 70 all week, it was weird. The hotel has a connected restaurant which was pretty good and then a cocktail bar with live music every night, we loved that and went there every night. Great water pressure in the shower. We didn't love the room and probably wouldn't stay there again but it was a good experience.

author: MLMRocksTravel
title: Good Hotel if needed in this area
text:
I don't know New York at all, so had to depend on the reviews to help me pick a hotel close to my office. This was a great location for my company work, as it was walking distance. I enjoyed the location by World Trade Center, and was able to walk to the memorial gardens and to WTC. 
The hotel doormen were wonderful, very odd to have stairs right inside the front door that you have to lug up the suitcases....but they were there to use the lift or carry them. 
Front desk may not have been overly accomodating but they were efficient. Gave me two bottles of water, the room key and said to let them know if I had any questions. 
The room was very clean, and housekeeping was exceptional the entire time. I ran into her a few times and she was so pleasant and eager to help. 
The restaurant in the hotel (Bill's) was really good with american food. There was also a lobby bar, but it was not open very often. 
There was a subway stop close, a Dunkin' Donuts and Morton's Steakhouse right next door. The Uber ride to Broadway was about $50, the taxi ride to La Guardia was $70. 
I'll stay here again next time.

author: Paul harding
title: Exceptional
text:
Great location if you want to stay out the hussle and bussle of midtown but so easy to get access to metro. Cheaper and much bigger rooms here than midtown just for the cost of a 20 minute metro. Spotless friendly and the restaurant is a bonus. 
Tip. Upgrade to suites for about £100. So worth it.
Tip 2. Don't let taxi driver get you to put hotel address into his satnav yourself.  He will get it wrong on purpose then blaim you for the cock up and then charge you more.

author: AlbertoBag
title: Room not corresponding, customer relations tragicomic.
text: One of the two rooms we booked on Booking did not match the photos, and it was sold to us for 3 people but had only one king-size bed (!). After many insistences at the reception, which claimed that they do not sell rooms based on the number of people but on the number of beds, that the king size is still large (!!!), and that the hotel was fully booked, they assigned us a room identical to the one we had booked, but asked us for an additional $100 per night (totaling $400 plus taxes). Not to mention the initial request of $15 per day for wifi (!), which was only waived when we noticed it upon receiving the credit card message. It's a shame because the location is good and the rooms are clean.

author: graham052016
title: Great location. We enjoyed our stay.
text:
The location is great if you want to be near Times Square.
The staff are friendly.
We stayed 8 nights.
Our room was old (but we knew that from other reviews) but it was clean and very functional.
The daily service of the room was great.
Very secure building.
2 lounge chairs, king bed, plenty of storage, large bathroom with a bath.
Safe. Desk and chair. Good WiFi 
Good air-conditioning.
Good views out the window.
The odd siren, otherwise it was quiet.
We requested a fridge and they brought one to our room.
Plenty of cafes and restaurants nearby. McDonald's is on the corner.
Various subway (train) options to get around town.
Easy walk to Bryant Park.
Easy walk to Hudson Yards and the High Line.
Aldi is not far if you want to pick up some snacks and drinks.

author: Danilo D
title: Disappointment
text: Excellent location right next to Times Square. Room on a high floor (48) with a nice view of the city, comfortable beds. Otherwise, the room is old, the bathroom is old with damaged tiles, the furniture is old and damaged, the TV shows one channel out of ten, and there is a lack of a refrigerator (the door that once housed it is now empty). When we asked to change to a better room, we were told that they are all like that. In short, a disappointment.

author: Amish A
title: Wonderful hospitality and genuinely caring staff
text: A very pleasant stay with a great location and welcoming atmosphere. When my flight was cancelled, Marlene was exceptionally kind and supportive, after I explained the situation, she personally spoke with her manager and helped arrange a considerable discount for an early check-in, which I truly appreciated. Christopher was also very courteous and took the time to assist me despite his busy schedule. Their genuine care and kindness made a stressful situation much easier. It was a memorable experience.

author: ddadams2021
title: Cannot fault this hotel 10/10
text:
My first stay at the Millennium hotel; was pre warned about the renovations going on, but to be honest, with the exception of the 44th street entrance being closed, it didn't make the slightest bit of difference. 
The check in process was  seamless and the customer service, excellent.
Location was amazing 
I was given a corner room with a Times Square view, which was completely unexpected, but it was just perfect. The air conditioning was fantastic, the room size was fabulous, especially for a room in the heart of Times Sqaure, the bed was super comfy, I honestly can't fault this place. 
If I had to pull things apart, I'd say it is quite tired looking but I assume the renovation will correct this, but for the price, it was EXCELLENT.
I managed to talk to George (Rooms Manager) who went above and beyond to answer my question and help me out.
I shan't hesitate to stay here the next time I'm in the city, it's a 10/10 for me.

author: L H
title: Great value and great people
text: Best place to stay in the city for price, value, view and their people. Thank you manager Lenny and Kyce for taking care of us and answering all of our questions. Your attention to detail and memory of us was appreciated. See you again soon!

author: jennings-kirsten
title: First NYC Trip - Reception Desk was Great!
text: At check in our Receptionist was so nice!  She originally mentioned our room was on 14, and my son was so excited to be that high!  When she saw his excitement she offered to see if there was a room higher up!  She ended up upgrading us and our kids were so excited to be on such a high floor!  (We come from a small town! And this was very exciting!)

author: stephanie A
title: Good experience
text:
Great Location for Exploring New York, but Some Room for Improvement

I just returned from a week-long trip to New York City and stayed at the New York Marriott Marquis. Overall, I had a good experience, and the location is absolutely unbeatable, especially for young adults and teens. There is so much to do nearby, and there is literally food everywhere! Times Square and many attractions are right outside your door, which makes it very convenient.

The hotel is very large and always busy, but I actually saw that as a positive. There is plenty going on, and the hotel helps guests arrange tours, which was a big plus for me.

The Room

I stayed on the 35th floor, so the noise level was surprisingly low. We could hear sirens from outside occasionally, but that's just part of being in New York City, and it did not interfere with our sleep.

The rooms are nice overall, but there are a few areas that could use improvement. My room had a slight smell that reminded me of cigarette smoke when I first arrived. Thankfully, it eventually faded. Since this is supposed to be a smoke-free hotel, I thought it was worth mentioning.

The cleanliness could also be better. The carpets could use a good cleaning, and I noticed that the housekeeping staff appeared to use the same cleaning cloths from room to room. Fresh cleaning cloths should definitely be used for each room.

The biggest issue for me was the bed. The mattresses felt worn and were not comfortable. After long days of work conferences and walking around New York, I really wanted a comfortable bed to come back to!

Food & Restaurants

Be prepared to spend money here. The hotel is definitely on the expensive side when it comes to both rooms and food.

The breakfast buffet is excellent, with something for everyone, but it is expensive at around $50 per person.

The restaurants inside the hotel were just okay for me. In addition to being expensive, I didn't find the food particularly kid-friendly, and there wasn't a huge variety of choices.

One of the best meals I had in the area was at Cane's Chicken (I'm not sure of the exact name). The restaurant was packed — there were more than 300 people there — but they still served us quickly, and the food was fresh and hot. It was also much more reasonably priced than many of the other options in the area.

Getting Around

There are always cabs waiting outside the hotel, which is very convenient, although they can get expensive. If you're able to walk, I highly recommend it. There is so much to see and experience in New York by simply walking around.

I have some difficulty with walking long distances, but I managed to walk a few miles each day by taking breaks along the way. It was worth it because walking allowed me to really experience the city.

Tours

The hotel was very helpful with arranging tours, which I really appreciated. Of all the tours we took, the Big Bus night tour was my favorite. Seeing New York City at night from the bus was an experience I highly recommend.

Overall

I would stay at the New York Marriott Marquis again, mainly because of its fantastic location and convenience. It is a great choice if you want to be right in the middle of the action, especially for families, teens, and young adults.

Just be prepared for the higher prices, and don't expect the most comfortable mattresses or perfect housekeeping. Despite those issues, the location makes it easy to explore New York and experience everything the city has to offer.

author: Cy
title: Location in the center of the world
text: I am writing this review a few months late after having processed that the trip to New York was not a dream but reality. This hotel is exactly what you expect in New York, a skyscraper with about 50 floors (our room was on the 30th floor). Beautiful property, impeccable cleanliness, but the quality for which it would deserve 6 stars is the location, a few minutes' walk from Times Square, which therefore allows you to enjoy it at any time of the day even just for a short time, and a stone's throw (on the same street, you can see it from the room window) from the Minskoff Theatre, the theater of The Lion King (superlative show that alone is worth the trip). I don't think you could wish for anything better in the heart of Manhattan.

author: Paul B
title: Hotel was fine but rude staff
text: Room was nice. Hotel is convenient for Times Square. The M Club is an absolute joke and the staff is some of the rudest I’ve ever interacted as a lifetime platinum elite member. Spoke with the front desk staff about it and they were not very helpful. The manager was conveniently “unavailable” when I asked to speak to him in person.

author: Camper38110
title: Great Hotel, Great Location, Great Staff
text:
This is a great hotel with a dedicated and engaging staff.  The pleasantness and focus that you experience with the staff is consistent and a direct reflection of their focus on the “customer experience”.  

In particular I would like to commend “Nesha” in housekeeping who welcomed us to the hotel and proactively focused on ensuring that we had everything that we needed for our stay.  Nesha is a superstar.

author: Emma C
title: Brilliant location to explore New York 🌟🌟🌟🌟🌟

author: Percival B
title: Will do it again.
text:
For first timers to the city of New York and for our first couples vacation,the atmosphere was fabulous, we were greeted with smiles, the service was exceptional. Rooms was comfy, cleaned and well kept. I was surprised to even know that we stayed in your Hotel which was close to the well known Time Square. author: Travel40785504076
title: Great crew
text: I stay at your hotel a lot and always enjoy the hospitality, but I must share with you my experience with the lovely Elizabeth. I had a problem during my stay at the hotel and Elizabeth helped me a lot. Thanks to good people like Elizabeth, it is so pleasant to stay at your hotel. Thank you very much and I also express my gratitude to Elizabeth.

author: BecklarS
title: Not a 4 star hotel
text:
We stayed at The Park Central hotel at the end of July ‘26 for 8 nights. 

The good bits;
Location - The hotel is in a perfect location to explore the city. Close to everything and a subway station on the corner of the street. 

Fantastic bar man - John works in the hotel bar and deserves a special mention. He gave us some very helpful advice about the city, was always smiling and welcoming. 

The bad bits;
Not a 4 star hotel - Inside the lobby and bar, the hotel portrays a 4 star look. Once you get into the rooms, they are in need of decoration. The latch on the window in our room wasn’t secure (luckily we were 17 floors up) and came loose every time the main door closed. Windows were dirty too. Not what I would expect from a 4 star hotel.

Reception staff - Well they weren’t rude but I wouldn’t exactly call them welcoming! They told you the information you needed to know and any questions beyond that felt like an inconvenience. 

Room service - This is non existent. Coffee and tea making facilities are available in the room upon request. I asked for a kettle THREE TIMES before it was delivered to the room. Being British, it was lucky we had brought our own tea bags as nothing was offered. The cups provided were paper and I had to get my own plastic spoon from the shop in the lobby. 

The lifts - There were just 2 lifts serving all floors. To go from the 17th floor, you’d stop multiple times on the way down and people around the 5th floor were finding that by the time it reached them, they were too full. They were not adequate for the size of the hotel.
 
Security deposit - This was my BIGGEST bug bear. I had seen online that it was a $500 security deposit. I was told at check in it was $100 per night then charged $700. We checked out on the 1st of August. The security deposit was left pending on my credit card until the 24th of August despite being told it would be released upon checkout and then told within 14 days when I queried it after 7 days.

Conclusion - If you are looking for a roof over your head and a bed to sleep on in a good location whilst staying in the city, it fits the bill. If you are looking for a 4 star hotel, it does not.

author: Wendy H
title: Park Central. Why stay anywhere else?
text: Park Central is probobly my favorite place to stay on Manhattan . From the moment I step onto the lobby , I’m greeted with helpful , cheerful people.  Carolyn , at the front desk, always remembers me by name, and makes sure that I have all the accommodations that I need.. Carlolym is always quick to make sure  my special requests are met and has great suggestions of  pkaces to go and things to do . . that’s why I choose Park Central again and again, the Customer Service!

author: Alnesha Banks
title: Romantic Birthday Weekend
text: We truly enjoyed our stay at the Sanctuary Hotel in New York. We travelled there to see Bruno Mars at Metlife Stadium on August 22nd 2026. It was about ~20-25 minutes walk from Penn Station and was located right in the thick of Times Square. Upon arrival, check-in was smooth and pleasant. The staff was very friendly and welcoming. When we arrived, our room was beautifully decorated with a happy birthday sign and colorful balloons which was included in our prepaid birthday package. We also had a large piece of strawberry cheesecake and a chilled bottle of champagne waiting for us. I was very satisfied with this purchase. My boyfriend loved it and it really made him feel special on his birthday. We definitely took advantage of the $25 dollars a day food/beverage credit at the Haven rooftop and let me tell you the food was fabulous! We ate there on Friday and Saturday night and both times were amazing! The staff was super friendly and the manager stopped by several times to make sure we were enjoying our meal. I would definitely stay at Sanctuary again :)

author: NorthStar11253775574
title: Amazing Experience.
text:
I stayed here last week with my Mother, She yearly comes to visit me in New York and we always stay in different hotels. The Sanctuary Hotel was our favorite so far. The location is perfect, and the Hotel has a very Classy and clean look. 
All the staff is extremely friendly and helpful. 
Jhona is so so sweet, she checked us in and her warm genuine energy made us immediately feel super welcome.
I truly recommend this Hotel.

author: Kayla
title: Clean, great location, few hiccups
text:
Nice hotel I would stay at again. Great location close to Times Square and theaters, super easy walk from Penn Station. Room was clean and staff was very polite. Didn’t notice much noise (on the 5th floor). 

A few complaints: our one window was frosted over & facing an alley (? I think, it was hard to see through it!) so no sunlight whatsoever in the room. Pitch black in the morning!

Check in took a pretty long time. Partially because a few of the parties in front of us had issues with their reservations and partially because they only had one person checking people in at first, even though it was check in time. 

The $25 credit toward food is a little useless if you’re staying one night like I did. By the time we finally managed to check in, we didn’t want to linger around the hotel any longer, we wanted to get out there! And the places we could use it at the hotel didn’t stay open late, and we couldn’t use the money the next morning. I’m sure a lot of people don’t end up spending it. Not sure what the other $15 of the destination fee is meant to cover because they don’t provide any unique amenities or anything to make them stand out among the other hotels around. 

We got this hotel for a great deal and for that price, I’d definitely stay again - but I wouldn’t spend more on it.

author: Trina L
title: Will definitely be back
text: This is the second time that we have stayed at The Sanctuary Hotel New York. They are wonderful!! The hotel is beautiful, the staff are extremely friendly and accommodating. The housekeeping staff did a wonderful job keeping our room clean and tidy and keeping us stocked with fresh linens. We got the small room but it was perfect as we only needed it to sleep. This hotel is extremely nice for the price. We can go to New York without breaking the bank and stay in a beautiful hotel that is at the center of everything.

author: anjpanj55
title: Clean, comfortable, friendly, but very loud
text:
It was clean, the staff was friendly, the bed was comfortable, room was decorated nice, and the shower water was hot. 
The location could be good if you want to be basically right in Times Square. But if you want more quiet, this is not it. 
This was our first time in NYC so I didn't realize this about the location. 
The problem I had was the noise from our room. They put us on the 2nd floor street view and it was extremely loud. I know this is NYC, but it was so loud I couldn't sleep at all the first night. It felt like I was sleeping outside. I have a video taken by the closed window and it sounds like I'm outside on the street. 
We asked to be moved to a quieter room and the 2nd night they were able to accommodate. We were on the same side of the street, but on level 7. You could still hear street noise, but it was bearable. 
I would not stay here again mostly for this reason and I didn't love the location.

author: Renata G
title: Great weekend!
text:
Took my daughter to NYC for the weekend to celebrate her birthday, and we couldn’t have asked for a better welcome! 🎉🗽

As soon as we arrived, we were greeted and checked in by Raquel. She was so nice, welcoming, and incredibly helpful. She gave us some great tips on what to do, where to go, and the best way to hit some of the top spots around the city.

Her kindness and helpfulness really helped make our weekend extra special. Thank you, Raquel, for starting our NYC birthday adventure off on such a great note! ❤️

author: DaeSun C
title: DO NOT BOOK HERE! THEY PROMISED ME A REFUND AND ARE AVOIDING ME NOW!
text:
DO NOT STAY! Currently FIGHTING to get my money back that they TOLD ME I would get back during my early check out. My room was God awful and did not match the pictures. The wall was peeling, smoke detector was ripped out so I could see rats in open wall. Room smelled like a sewer. Sheets had stains on them. I upgraded to a premium in hopes to avoid problem. It has now been 14 days and they have ignored all communications from Air BnB in regard to my refund request. DO NOT STAY HERE! Not only do the photos not match the actual rooms and my stay was horrible, but they are avoiding the refund THEY confirmed for me before leaving. Avoid them.
UPDATE: IT HAS BEEN OVER A MONTH AND THEY HAVE DENIED ALL CHARGE DISPUTES!

author: topharry123
title: DO NOT STAY, THIS HOTEL IS A HELL HOLE
text:
To put it mildly, this hotel might be the biggest hotel scam I have ever seen. Two reasons:

1. We booked through Priceline and spent roughly $3,000 for 6 nights. Every picture made the hotel look beautiful and newly renovated. When we checked in, we got a room looking something like it was out of a horror movie. I asked the front desk and they told us that only one out of the 18 floors or so was renovated and those were the highest price rooms. Nowhere in the booking did it reference that only 5% of the rooms looked like they did in the picture. Ours has old carpets, brown stains in the bathroom, peeling wallpaper etc. 
2. Our hotel came with free breakfast. It was noted in the booking confirmation that I got and when we checked in, the person that checked us in told us it came with breakfast included. Day one, no issues. Day two, we got told it was only for 2 people vs the 4 we had booked. We went to front desk, showed them our Priceline reservation and she gave us a card (which we still have) that says "breakfast for 4". Days 3-6 we asked for 4 and were told it was only for 2 again so we gave up and fed the kids at a coffee shop. When we checked out, we were told we were good to go. I noticed we were charged an extra $180 so I contacted the hotel. They told me we had been charged $30 per day for breakfast. I sent them proof it had been paid for and they "passed it onto accounting". In the last 6 weeks, they won't respond, they won't return calls after leaving a voicemail, and they won't pick up the phone. We have been forced to seek legal action against the hotel and have now made formal complaints to the DWP and DWCP to push for a resolution. 

DO NOT STAY HERE. They have the proof yet still do nothing about it. Their customer service is lousy, their hotel is disgusting and the staff are rude and nasty. I have stayed at maybe 2,500 hotels in my lifetime and this is 100% the worst experience I have ever had.

author: Meryem R
title: Great experience that made my heart happy
text: The hotel is clean and the stuff are very nice and helpful I had the chance to be supported by Racquel that guided me not only for the utilities at the hotel but also where I can visit around and handed me a brochure with all the nice places even made the exception so I can get my room before the check in time taking in consideration the long trip I had

author: Dion I
title: Great Birthday Stay
text:
Very good customer service. 
Especially Raquel at the front desk, my guardian angel hostess Leía, and the doorman Gene. Made my daughter’s birthday trip memorable!

author: Tom G
title: Avoid
text:
My colleague (staying in another hotel) summed it up perfectly, “I first stated at The Sheraton in 2006 and when I was there again last year, it felt like the carpets were the same”.

The rooms are really tired, run down and in desperate need of a full renovation.

I’ve never seen anything like the queues for check in / out and getting a coffee - ridiculous. 

I complained to a manager after checking in to find a big, heavy mirror visibly about to fall off the wall, the safe not working. Yes I was moved rooms, but his attitude was appalling and should be fired. 

The wifi didn’t work and had to spend 15 minutes on the phone to their IT support line.

I was given someone else’s luggage by the left-luggage desk. 

Definitely find somewhere better.

author: Mike W
title: NEVER NEVER NEVER AGAIN!!!
text:
This is gonna be a long one so bear with me.

I honestly don't know where to start. This is possibly the worst hotel I've ever stayed at. As a Lifetime Platinum member that's a serious statement.

Booked with points hoping to make the most of status benefits during a World Cup trip.

Arrival....don't expect the offer of any help while you're struggling with your luggage from the several porters (I assume that's there role) at the entrance. 

Check in. No Club Lounge in the hotel. Check in staff said it never re-opened after Covid. And that it states this on the website. Lie. I checked hotel website and Bonvoy. No mention.

Told me that's why they offer complimentary breakfast. They couldn't get their heads around what I was saying when I pointed out that you normally get club lounge access with breakfast. Not one or the other !!!

Entered room, toilet basin full of excrement and hair on the sink. Back down to complain to front desk manager. "We'll send someone to clean it". No apology.

Re-iterated complaint about no club lounge. The FD manager told me they've never had a club lounge and told me once again about the free breakfast. When I explained that normally when there is no lounge, every hotel I've stayed at offers something in place. "Yes, free breakfast". After an abrupt "so what do you want" she offered me one drink voucher per night. When I told her we were two she replied "sorry that's all we can do".

Returned to room at the end of the day. Room still not cleaned.

Breakfast queue filled the lobby every morning.

Orderd a drink at the lounge one afternoon. Was absolutely shocked when, I assume a manager, ordered me to leave the area as it needed to be prepared for the evening. I was actually taken back. And in front of my daughter. Never ever been spoken to like that anywhere. Nevermind a hotel. No "sorry but", "would you please mind" or "is it okay if". No apology.

Truely gobsmacked!!!!

In the evening, I'd order a cocktail at the bar. Staff happy to make a mojito even though not on the list. Until last night when a new guy stated bluntly "I'm not making those" to the glance of his colleagues.

Customer service just does not exist in this hotel. Why are you employing people who should not be working in the service industry? It's mind boggling. What is the general manager and senior management doing.

Please, do not bother replying to my complaint. I've read your standard replies. This post is not for the hotel but to warn people off staying. 

You don’t deserve the Sheraton or Bonvoy badge.
