author: Anthony  G
title: THEY WILL ADD CHARGES TO YOUR CARD AFTER YOU LEAVE AND IT WILL TAKE MONTHS TO REFUND
text:
Our experience with the Sheraton Times Square in New York has been incredibly frustrating and disappointing.

After we checked out, the hotel charged us an additional $707.08 that we believe was incorrect. It has now been approximately a month, and despite repeated promises that the charge would be refunded, we are still waiting for the issue to be resolved.

What has made the situation even worse is the way we have been treated while trying to get our money back. We have called repeatedly, only to be hung up on, transferred around, or told to send an email for resolution. We have sent emails, yet we have not received meaningful responses or a resolution. On multiple occasions, we have asked to speak with a manager and have not even been given that opportunity.

A billing mistake is one thing. Mistakes happen. What is unacceptable is making customers spend weeks chasing their own money while refusing to provide basic communication, accountability, or access to management.

As Black and brown patrons, the way we were treated throughout this process was especially troubling. I cannot speak for every guest's experience, but we did not feel respected, valued, or treated with the level of professionalism that anyone should expect from a Sheraton property.

At this point, I would strongly encourage others to keep your money and stay somewhere that values its guests and treats them with respect. A Times Square location and a recognizable brand name mean very little when customer service and accountability are missing.

Sheraton Times Square: please return the $707.08 that was improperly charged and provide the level of customer service your guests should be able to expect.

author: Roam07075831619
title: Bad service
text:
I am currently staying at the Sheraton New York Times Square, and this has become one of the most unacceptable hotel experiences I’ve ever had. On our first night, we couldn’t sleep because we were sneezing nonstop, and today we discovered thick dust and dirt behind the pedestal. For a hotel of this size and reputation, this level of dirt is shocking.

Today is day two, and we returned at 17h30 to find the room STILL not cleaned. We reported the issue earlier, left for the Lion King show, and came back expecting at least basic housekeeping. Yet again, nothing. No cleaning. No fresh towels. No effort from the hotel to correct the situation.

We went to reception to speak to the manager. She peeked at us through the door, refused to come out, and sent someone else instead. The dismissive attitude was unbelievable. After explaining everything, we were told there is “nothing they can do” because housekeeping has already knocked off. We asked for fresh towels — the bare minimum — and even those are still not arriving.

We are currently sleeping here, in a room that hasn’t been cleaned for two days, with no fresh towels and visible dirt. The hotel is failing at cleanliness, service, professionalism, and basic hospitality. Completely unacceptable experience.

author: Hayliella
title: Awful
text: Awful hotel…just look at the bad comments. Don’t stay here and expect American hospitality because you’ll be disappointed. Expect rude staff, long waits for the lift and check in.

author: fdm71
title: Excellent solution in Manhattan
text: Hotel near Grand Central Station, near the subway and about 800m on foot from Times Square. Spacious rooms and a business, serious, but still clean and welcoming environment.

author: clemson1991
title: Great Stay at the Westin Grand Central!!
text:
I don't understand the mixed reviews this hotel has on TripAdvisor as we were very pleased.

My wife and I had a great stay at the Westin Grand Central this past weekend (8/14 - 8/16/26).  Arrived at about 9:30 a.m. on Friday and the hotel already had a room ready for us (that was great!!).  Room was on the the 7th floor and perfect for our needs.  Plenty of space, except that the bathroom was a little small.  Water pressure was excellent.  The a/c kept the room at a very comfortable temperature.  The concierge, Jose Miguel, surprised us with chocolate covered strawberries and prosecco for a celebration.

There's great access to the subway system, Midtown and all of NYC.  We went to two Mets games and the 7 line out to Citi Field is a very short walk from the hotel.

I would definetly stay at the Westin the next time I'm in New York!!

author: has74
title: Poor housekeeping
text:
I will start with the positives which is the hotel is in a good central location and the staff are friendly.  

The main issue is with housekeeping and the poor condition of the rooms   The bedding had holes in it and despite repeated requests this was never rectified.  The general cleanliness of the room was very poor - I am not sure when the hoover was last used and also there were sticky marks on most surfaces.  The bathroom was no better - there were several marks on the mirror and the bath was not pleasant.    We had some operational issues in our room - the door didn’t shut properly and they did come and take the door off the hinges and fix this during our visit.  

We were also disturbed twice during our stay later in the evening - once housekeeping knocked on the door even though there was a do not disturb sign as they weren’t sure the room was occupied; the other time the phone rang at 10pm and maintenance queried if it would be ok to pop and fix a faulty tap. 

Plates and cutlery remained out in corridors for days which just shows the lack of care from housekeeping.

author: Happiness696844
title: The People of the Westin NY Grand Central are the Best in the World! Thank You to Jeff from Hotel Security!
text: I've stayed at all types and levels of hotels—including Ritz-Carltons and Rosewoods—all over the world, and I have never been compelled to write a review. But I had to sign up for a Trip advisor account and write one for the people of Westin New York Grand Central. Besides being in the best and most convenient Midtown location, with spacious and spotless rooms that felt like a haven from the city, it was the helpfulness and hospitality of the staff that was truly beyond compare. This goes for everyone from check-in and housekeeping to the concierge, cafe staff, valet, and security! I accidentally left a bank envelope of money in my room after checking out and leaving New York. Jeff from security went to my room, found the envelope, and kept it safe for me for a few days until I arranged for it to be picked up. In a world where it is easy to grow cynical, Jeff's honesty has restored my faith in humanity. The people at the Westin NY Grand Central are the absolute definition of hospitality, service, and most of all integrity. I will now always plan to stay here whenever I visit the city.

author: babygLondon
title: A Wonderful Stay - Eve is the Best!
text:
We stayed at The Westin New York Grand Central to celebrate our son’s 16th birthday, and it was a fantastic choice for our family trip to New York.

Before we arrived, I messaged the hotel for recommendations for birthday decorations and places to eat, and I have to give an extra special shout-out to Eve, who was incredibly helpful throughout. Her communication was excellent, and she went out of her way to make sure we had everything we needed. It really made the birthday feel that little bit more special.

The location is excellent. It is far enough away from the hustle and bustle of Times Square to feel relaxed, but still close enough to walk to many of the main sights. Grand Central is right nearby, with easy access to the 4, 5, 6 and 7 subway lines, making getting around the city really straightforward. We could also walk to Fifth Avenue, Macy’s and Times Square.

Our room was on the 34th floor, with amazing views overlooking the Chrysler Building and Vanderbilt. Waking up to that view really made our stay feel special and gave us a true New York experience.

There’s a Starbucks downstairs, which was perfect for grabbing a coffee before heading out for a busy day exploring, and there’s also a sandwich place right next door.

All of the staff we encountered were friendly, welcoming and helpful, which made a big difference after long days of walking around the city.

Overall, we had a wonderful stay and would definitely recommend The Westin New York Grand Central. The location, views, friendly staff and excellent communication before our stay made it a great base for celebrating such a special birthday in New York.

Thank you Eve and thank you Westin! See you again soon!

author: NP London
title: Awful
text: An awful hotel. Deceptive website. Dirty rooms. No shower gel in rooms. No tea or coffee making facilities. No drinking water after hours due to ‘short staffing’. Repeated failure of key fobs. No flexibility on check in and out times. Breakfast is a stale croissant and mouldy banana in a paper bag. Stay somewhere else. Customer service is dreadful

author: StClare R
title: “Staff Assured Refund — Hotel Reversed Course After ATC Cancellation”
text: booked a Junior Suite at The Shoreham Hotel for August 7-10, 2026. My trip was cancelled due to an ATC power outage that grounded JetBlue flight B6 286 on August 7 — a federally documented event completely beyond my control. Gabriel at the front desk assured me a refund would be processed given the extraordinary circumstances. However, when my booking platform Hopper contacted the hotel for written authorization, the hotel reversed course and declined to authorize the refund. Over $900 lost for a stay that never happened due to a government-caused disruption. Hopper has confirmed they will process the refund immediately upon written authorization from the hotel. I have always believed that how a business handles adversity defines their character. Unfortunately The Shoreham’s handling of this situation does not reflect the standard expected of a luxury Midtown boutique hotel. I am still hopeful management will do the right thing and honor the commitment made by their staff.

author: Cas
title: Okay hotel with everything you want walking distance
text:
I had no issues with my actual stay at the hotel but upon checkout I was told I would get my $240.55 refunded back as that was a holding fee. I have tried to email but the email bounced back so I don’t have a proper email address that works to get in contact with this hotel. Could someone please contact me.
I checked out the hotel on 16th of July and today is now 27th of July and a refund still has not come into my account

author: Magali H
title: Avoid-bad experience

Unrenovated room, old 1970s carpet, stained. Sofa as old as the carpet, afraid to sit on it. 

In addition, they charged me for the room twice plus a deposit amount, so I have to finish my trip with $1000 less in my budget.

author: lora H
title: Awful filthy hotel
text: First room was dirty, carpet and sheets felt damp, bed bugs, rusty tub, stained carpet. Told front desk and got a second room and it had filthy bedding with bed bugs and hairs. Hotel refused to refund us even though we didn’t stay there. We checked out immediately. Claim it’s Expedia policy.

author: Sharon L
title: Convenient and comfortable stay
text:
Location very convenient, walkable to many sightseeing spots and a min to metro station 
Comfortable and clean room with self service bar at reception for drinks and snacks

author: Andre T
title: I recommend this hotel
text: Very good value for money, very varied breakfast.

author: Heike B
title: High-quality hotel in a perfect location
text:
Very nice staff, simple and uncomplicated check-in with luggage storage for early arrivals. 
Room, clean and reasonably sized. Complimentary soft drinks in the minibar. Open bar from 2 PM. 
Hotel centrally located, subway right around the corner, many bars and restaurants. Everything perfect.

author: HGF H
title: Highly recommended.
text:
Its location is perfect for tourism, in a strategic place. The staff is very attentive to cleanliness and they have a service until 2:00 A.M. for drinks and some snacks available to guests.
The rooms are very spacious and are in good condition, just a few adjustments like the sink drain, which was somewhat clogged, or a small lamp with a burnt-out light bulb…
Highly recommended for location and value for money.

author: Magalie B
title: Beautiful experience, very delighted.
text:
I recommend it 100%.
Modern, clean, and quiet hotel, a very beautiful, friendly place. 
Pleasant and spacious rooms with every comfort.
Super welcoming staff, available for any request. 
Hearty breakfasts.

author: Gary
title: Great Trip to NYC Upper West Side
text: Great and quiet location.  Our room was cleaned each day. Coupons for delicious coffee and sweet treats. Great doorman that arranged a shuttle (black car) to get us to the airport. Clean hotel. Nice little gym. Let us in the room before official check in. Upgraded us to a king size bed. Nice staff. What’s not to like.

author: Nicole N
title: Great stay
text: Great rooms.  Clean hotel. Nice location. Very convenient and comfortable

author: Jackie M
title: The ArtHouse is perfect in every way!
text:
The ArtHouse was by far the best hotel we have stayed at in NYC. From the initial contact with the staff, my daughter and I were impressed. We received a welcoming text a few days before our visit. The person answered all of our questions. Every person with whom we interacted was caring, kind and helpful, from the baggage handlers to the front desk staff to the baristas and bartenders.  

The accommodations were impeccable. The room we stayed in was clean and comfortable. The furnishings were stylish. The entire hotel had a stylish vibe!

The location on the upper west side was perfect and safe!

This hotel will be our hotel of choice any time we stay in NYC!

author: Seetheworld
title: Just so-so
text: Not my favorite hotel. Just seemed ok. Clean enough. Not enough water pressure and dark in the room. There were no overhead lighting. The room is large, but nothing special.

author: Malalole
title: New York beautiful hotel
text:
Clean and fairly large room. The staff is kind and discreet.
Not touristy, close to the subway. Offers $ croissants, pastries and coffee sandwiches, I loved it. In the evening you can have a drink. And restaurants nearby.

Good choice.

author: Silvia
title: Stayed Twice, Would Choose It Again!
text:
We had a really great experience at this hotel, so much so that we chose to stay here twice in a row during our trips to Manhattan. The value for money is excellent, especially considering the location, which is very convenient for exploring the city and getting around easily.

The service was impeccable, with friendly and attentive staff who were always happy to help. We had a very positive experience on both occasions, and if we return to Manhattan in the future, I would definitely choose this hotel again without hesitation.

Highly recommended! ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

author: Trip19612431586
title: Great Location, Poor Service
text: Will definitely be looking at other options when traveling to NYC.  We had to make multiple calls for repairs in the room, one being a leaking shower door than never got fixed.  Since we stayed for 7 days we ordered groceries.  When they were delivered we had to go down to meet the delivery person (he couldn't come up as we're accustomed to).  Plus, a lady working in the lobby said we couldn’t use the luggage cart to bring up the many bags and case of water.  Unacceptable!  They had several carts available for use.  The cleaning lady was persistent daily for wanting to clean the room.  We were on vacation and didn’t want the pressure to leave the room.  Putting out the door sign did not help.  The sleeper sofa in the 1 Bedroom was surprisingly comfortable.   I strongly recommend bringing a charging station.  We could not use the outlet in the living room while sleeping on sleeper sofa as the light switch at the entrance controlled this outlet.  Also, the bedroom lacks lighting.  There is no light anywhere near the closet so finding things in the closet/luggage was challenging.  Also, be prepared to pay a resort fee of 54.51 USD per night.

author: Laurie A
title: My best NYC hotel visit ever!
text: This place is fantastic! You can’t beat the location, Carnegie Hall, right across the street and a 10 minute walk to go see shows. We stayed in a room with one bedroom and two bathrooms and overall probably about 500 ft.². The only thing I wish the room had was a toaster!  I am 100% sure I will be staying there again on my next trip to New York City!!

author: MrsVV38
title: Great location, awful room & experience.
text:
The hotel needs to be updated. 
The reception area is nice and the seating area on floor 26 is nice. 
Other than that the hotel is majorly run down. 
For such a big hotel the elevator situation was terrible. 

The room we stayed in is not a suite and should not be sold as such. It is a small cramped, dark and dingy room. 

We stayed in room 226. It is the worst hotel room we have ever encountered. 
There is no proper window in the room.
There is no proper lighting in the room,  just 3 lamps. Without a window (it is half 3 quarter coated glass) this makes the room incredibly dark and dingy. 
No proper light in the bathroom so you can’t see in the mirror. 
When we arrived as a family of 4, we had expected 2 x double beds. This was probably a mistake on booking (through an agent). We had one bed and a sofa bed and the sofa bed that was not made up. 
We had to wait for it to be made and it was like a concrete block. So hard and uncomfortable. No proper duvet. The lady who made the bed was going to leave one pillow on the bed. After travelling for 12 hours this wasn’t a great start to our trip. 
We only had 2 big towels and 2 hand towels for 4 guests. 

We were only staying a few days before heading elsewhere so I didn’t have the energy to move rooms or hotels. I checked online and the hotel was full so no chance of a room move. 

The hotel should not be selling this room. The carpet was dirty, the blind didn’t fully come down, it wasn’t up to a cleanliness standard I would expect. 

The reception staff were all lovely and really helpful. Cannot fault the staff. It’s not their fault the owners / management have the hotel in the state it is in. 

We had to ask for clean towels, toilet rolls etc. 

The location is great but I wouldn’t book here. 

The images the hotel use seem to be from a long time ago. It is not like that now. 

We can only go off our room and experience. 

Avoid room 226 at all costs. Higher rooms you have the issue of getting up and down with one lift in operation or using the staff lift. It takes forever for lifts to come. 

At least we had the choice to use the staircase for our room. On saving grace. 

My daughter cried after being in the rock hard sofa bed so my husband slept on that instead. It is not OK to give that to guests.

author: Linda B
title: 4 star amazing hotel with balcony options!
text: Excellent hotel! Great staff, reasonably priced valet parking, breakfast and I upgraded to a junior suite with a Balcony! Great location for theater and concerts. Just stayed at a supposedly 4 star hotel that had ZERO of the advertised necessities like no food at all (not even coffee), no parking at all, a broken down version of its former self. The Manhatten Club is walking distance from theaters, concerts and museums. Can’t always afford that junior balcony suite but a regular room is well priced for this clear 4 star winner (Only a handful of hotels reach 5 stars in NYC and cost at least 2-3x as much). Will return and highly recommend.

author: Renee A
title: Love the staff above all
text:
The best experience was with the staff. Everyone was kind and helpful but 3 people stood out. One was the evening receptionist ( unfortunately I don’t remember her name), who went above and beyond to make me happy and has a fantastic personality. The other two people were Mohamed and Said  who greet you at the door and make an amazing team. These two guys are worth booking a room there again. 

The location is awesome too, in the theatre district, and you can pretty much walk everywhere. Everything I needed last minute was on that block. 2 minute walk to snacks, pharmacy, street cart right in front of the hotel if you need a midnight coffee or refreshment, lots of restaurants and bars and very diverse crowd. 

The bed was very comfortable, clean linens, fresh towels, complementary water and overall homey, relaxed atmosphere. 

I would come to this hotel again next time I’m in town.

author: Mariellen H
title: Very Nice!
text:
Location was great, hotel was very nice, room was compact but comfortable.
We did request ice & a few glasses/cups from front desk but they never arrived

author: Kelly B
title: Great 1 night stay
text:
Great 1 night stay. Check in was easy. The room was clean and the beds were really soft. Rooms are smaller but clean. The bathroom shower was excellent with fantastic hot water!  
A couple of opportunities were that there was no mini fridge to store cold drinks or leftovers.  Even though our room door was locked and secured with deadbolt it did not feel as secure as other hotel doors. The hotel is modern and renovated however I feel like newer room doors should have been part of what should have been replaced.
Jeff the doorman at the entrance was exceptional and super accommodating and friendly. 
Overall we enjoyed the experience

author: Korrawan K
title: Excellent Service and Great Location At Ameritania Times Square
text: I had a great stay at Ameritania at Times Square. The hotel is in a very convenient location, and the staff were incredibly helpful and friendly. A special thank you to Javal, Jeff, and Mohamed for helping us with our luggage and arranging a car to the airport. They made everything so much easier and stress-free, especially when we had a lot of bags. I really appreciate their kindness and excellent service. I would definitely recommend this hotel and would be happy to stay here again!

author: Shelly H
title: Fabulous stay in the heart of Times Square/Theater district
text: Staff were very attentive and housekeeping was excellent and room was very clean. Jeff at the front was very kind and helpful with our heavy bags too!!

author: CarlC-DC
title: Comfortable and Convenient
text:
Thankfully my experience was better than the two reviews that preceded mine.  The hotel was very convenient to where I needed to be.  Easy access from both Penn Station and Grand Central Station.  Ten minute or so walk to the theatre district and steps away from Bryant Park. Plenty of dining options in the area.

My room was ready upon arrival.  Check-in was a breeze, and Miguel at the front desk was both very friendly and helpful.  I was very happy with my room.  The bed was quite comfortable and I didn't hear any noise on my particular floor. I appreciated the noon check-out time as other places I've stayed at have been earlier.

I was only here for one night, but I would gladly stay at this property again in the future.

author: Rick
title: Terrible experience. Room is in poor quality and Karen at the front desk is awful.
text:
I checked-in with Karen at the front desk. She was not able to locate my reservation that I booked a few days ago. She repeatedly asked if I'm in the correct hotel and I continuously assured her that I was at the right hotel and showed her my confirmation letter multiple times. She said that the reservation is missing and she cannot enter it herself. She tries to call the Reservations Manager to make the reservation but they are in a meeting. She is making multiple phone calls on her mobile phone and taking multiple phone calls from her landline, apparently someone is trapped in the elevator. All this while the two gentlemen staff at the next desk is just chatting and goofing around and Karen singing to herself "lalalalala".

Finally the reservation is entered. But there are no rooms available at check-in time.  Karen is now trying to locate a Housekeeping Manager, but apparently they are also in a meeting. 20 minutes later I receive my room keys. I get to the room and it smells terrible... musky and mildew. At this point I decided to just deal with it than have another interaction with Karen and wait for the extremely slow elevators. 

Already a very disappointing stay and experience. It finally ends with the housekeeper opens the room door before my check-out time. 

Please do not stay here.

author: Dan B
title: Hotel Elevator Nightmare
text:
Terrible experience with elevators.  The building has 3 of which 2 were operating some times and only 1 several times.
Along with others in a full elevator were stuck for 40 hot sweaty minutes.
The hotel staff stalled calling NYFD to get us out.
This was FIFA weekend so hotel was packed. I had to walk down 21 floors one time.

author: Jeo
title: Perfect location
text: Nice hotel, we stayed in 4 adults and three children in a room double king bed + sofa. Good stay we didn't have coffee at the hotel, but there was a choice.

author: Bill C
title: Don’t waste your time or money. Awful, hot, needs updating
text: I would never stay at this place again.  The air did not work, at points it was 80 plus degrees in our room. The staff was dismissive.   I called more than 5 times during our stay and as soo. As I called the temperature dropped for a hour or so.   Sometimes there was a 20 minute wait for an elevator as they all did not work.  There was constant pot smoking out side the front door.  The area is dirty and acceptable that people act and behave the way they do.   The place is in need of a major renovation and face lift.   The management team should be ashamed at best.   By far the worst Marriott property I have ever stayed at.  A one rating is grateful conduit can’t give it a zero or a negative number

author: mao70
title: Great hotel, location & staff.
text:
We stayed 4 nights and had a great time at Kixby. The room was clean,
The house cleaning service was great. The front desk staff were very helpful and always friendly and professional. Loved how the hotel provides refillable bottles of water and the hotel’s  a water /coffee room on the second floor was great a d available 24/7 with. Different flavors and good quality of both coffee and water. The rooftop  bar was wonderful and the view of the Empire State Building was awesome. 
 The King Bed Room was spacious for an NYC hotel, and we liked it had not carpet on our room. We arrived super late on our first night due to major flight delays. They still had the type of room we reserved but we got a low floor which was a bit noisy between 2:00am -4:00am depending on the day. That is the only reason I give a 4 of 5; but when we went to the PH floor it was quiet, so make sure to get a high floor room. The value was great and we loved our location with a subway station right on the corner.  I would recommend this hotel to others.

author: Donna B
title: Highly recommend this hotel and their rooftop bar!
text: My daughter and I were in NYC for a few days and stayed at the Kixby. Our room was clean and the service was excellent. They have a great rooftop bar with a beautiful view of the Empire State Building.

author: Phil R
title: Excellent Hotel, but….
text: Just got back from 10 days at Kixby..staff are super friendly and accommodating, location is amazing, 2 mins to Macys, 10 mins to Penn Station/MSG, 15 mins to Time Square. Plenty of shops, restaurants and watering holes within staggering distance.. The room was a good size, bed was super comfy, could do with a bit more storage and a kettle but I’m nit picking.  Everything very clean and tidy.  On the downside, we were in a room facing 35th street and (currently) unlucky enough to have some major refurb work in the building across the street and they like to start early and don’t really give a hoot about keeping quiet.  That said, the bin men (every morning) and the general, constant hooting of the NY traffic didn’t help for uninterrupted sleep.  Can’t blame the hotel for any of these things and it definitely wouldn’t stop me booking again..  On the whole, a great hotel I a great spot..

author: Amy R
title: 4 nights in July
text: Stayed here for 4 nights with my husband. Brilliant location for walking and getting the subway. Subway entrance right outside the hotel. Room was clean and comfortable. Staff were all very friendly. Rooftop bar is a great touch for the view of the Empire State Building. If I were to return to New York or a friend asked for a recommendation I would definitely say the Kixby is where to go.

author: NYCisFabulous
title: Kixby Rocks
text:
I stayed here from July. 21st through the 29th. Great experience overall! I arrived way later than anticipated due to flight delays. Check in was very straightforward and simple. My request for a courtyard view and higher floor was honored. My room was spacious and comfortable. The only negative was the first night my bedding smelled slightly like a wet dog. I thought this might be due to the industrial soap and machine they use because the next night the smell was gone. 
I was greeted every time I walked thru the lobby and the everyone was extremely courteous. I loved that the hotel was so centrally located and everything I wanted to visit was either an easy walk or a few minutes to the subway.

author: Mirko Bianchi
title: Bad
text:
Let's start with the key point: this hotel cannot be a three-star. 
Dirty carpet in both the hallways and the rooms, very small bathrooms with toilets that clog every other minute, water that tastes like iron, minimal and basic breakfast service. 
These are just the general negative details.
In my specific case, one evening the shower knob came off in my hand… 
The only point in its favor is the strategic location near the park and near the metro 1 
I will not return.

author: matthew m
title: wonderful
text: Such a great hotel for couples who want a cozy place to stay at in Central Park. Jennifer at front desk was really helpful and great customer service. Definitely recommended. P/S: Thanks again, Jennifer for all your help!

author: tnypco
title: Fleabag - should be shut down at once.
text: Filthy and smelly room, with a huge indention in the bed, showing someone had been lying there and yet the room was sold to me as a new clean room. Not enough clean towels provided. No housekeeping provided unless requested - that was never disclosed, I overheard that in the elevator from another guest! Room lights went out when I was showering. TV failed due to rain - explained to me by the front desk as "TV fails in rain as it is a satellite dish as the manager is too cheap to provide cable"; the noisy through window air conditioner had a filter that had never been changed = I had to turn it off. Windows didn't open - the one that did slid shut on its own. Room phone to front desk not operational. The electricity shorted out unexpectedly, leaving me with no light, no power - nothing! And to charge me for one night with all of this, is a disgrace.  Finally, beg bug bites noted by physician the next day. This all will be reported to the City of New York's Dept of Health as well as the Dept of Consumer Affairs!

author: LLL2225
title: This property should be condemned
text: Terrible, horrible, shameful !  The great location doesn't compensate for the disgusting condition of the property.  The A/C window unit roared like a DC3,  the carpet in the hallway had bleach stains throughout , the carpet in the room was so bad I wore shoes the entire stay; would not dare put bare feet on the floor!  The excuse for pillows are lumps of compressed foam. The windows are filthy making the purple room seem even darker and smaller. The wait for the elevator exceeded 10 minutes most of the time since there is only one elevator to service 14 floors AND the housekeeping team (there is no daily housekeeping service and the mops and vacuums remain on the narrow halls all the time).  If you can ignore the subpar rooms, furniture and outlets that are broken and don't function, the rattle of the AC, awful breakfasts and wait time to exit the building then the surrounding neighborhood is pretty great.  Have fortitude and low standards to endure the hotel itself.

author: Michael M
title: Total mess of a hotel and way over priced
text:
Terrible messy hotel.
Arrived to find it was undergoing refurbishment. Mess in corridors and in the room. Bathroom had lumps of plaster falling off the walls onto the floor.
We left immediately and were told a refund would be given. Three weeks later no refund. They’re ignoring calls and emails.

author: KBD87
title: Ok just don’t over expect
text: We stayed at the hotel for a concert at Madison Square Garden. It is convenient for a two block walk to the arena. The hotel is old and hasn’t been renovated recently, the bathroom is primitive and rooms are small. But, it is clean and the beds are fine and the price is good for manhattan. The hotel is fine but just do not over expect. Not much of a lobby or staff but I rarely hang out in lobbies or need anything anyway.

author: SharonM371133
title: Great stay
text: Room was clean and quiet overnight. Staff were friendly upon check-in and check-out. Would definitely stay here again.

author: Lauren S
title: Decent value hotel
text: Went with 3 teenage girls and the size of the room was good for 5 people.  It was very clean.  Two complaints were that hot water frequently ran out and the elevator was extremely slow.  Staff were nice.

author: VFMEK
title: Perfect for what we wanted
text: We were delighted with this hotel. It is about one block away from the Empire State Building and close to the underground. It has a small rooftop terrace service food and drink and you could see the building lit up. It was beautiful. Every staff member we met was friendly and helpful. We would definitely choose it again.

author: NYC2VT
title: Decent Midtown Hotel
text: This hotel was perfectly adequate. Rooms were clean and staff were nice enough. Lobby is a bit lackluster, but we weren’t there to hang out in it! Very conveniently located to MSG and Penn Station.
